Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems.

(** * Generic environment facts *)

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (A:Type) (E:env A) (x:var) (v:A),
  binds x v E -> x \in dom E.
Proof.
  intros A E x v H.
  eapply (@LibEnv.get_some_inv A x v E).
  eapply LibEnv.binds_get. eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma dom_binds_exists : forall (A:Type) (E:env A) (x:var),
  x \in dom E -> exists v, binds x v E.
Proof.
  intros A E x H. destruct (@LibEnv.get_some A x E H) as [v Hv].
  exists v. exact Hv.
Qed.

(** * Heap correspondence *)

Lemma heap_correspond_dom : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap),
  heap_correspond G Sigma -> dom G = dom Sigma.
Proof. intros G Sigma [Hdom _]. exact Hdom. Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_ty_item : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var),
  heap_correspond G Sigma -> x \in dom G -> ty_item_s G Sigma x.
Proof. intros G Sigma x [_ H]. exact (H x). Qed.

Lemma ty_item_s_obj_inv : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (T:typ) (hds:heap_defs),
  ty_item_s G Sigma x ->
  binds x (item_obj T hds) Sigma ->
  binds x (typ_bnd T) G /\ G ⊢ hds ∶ open x T.
Proof.
  intros G Sigma x T hds Hty Hb. inversion Hty; subst.
  - (* lit item *)
    match goal with
    | Hl : binds x (item_lit l) Sigma |- _ =>
      assert (Heq : item_lit l = item_obj T hds) by
        (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; [exact Hl|exact Hb]);
      discriminate Heq
    end.
  - (* obj item *)
    match goal with
    | Hu : binds x (item_obj U hds0) Sigma |- _ =>
      assert (Heq : item_obj U hds0 = item_obj T hds) by
        (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; [exact Hu|exact Hb]);
      injection Heq as HU Hh; subst; split; assumption
    end.
Qed.

Lemma ty_item_s_lit_inv : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (l:lit),
  ty_item_s G Sigma x ->
  binds x (item_lit l) Sigma ->
  exists T, binds x T G /\ G ⊢ l ∶ T.
Proof.
  intros G Sigma x l Hty Hb. inversion Hty; subst.
  - assert (Heq : item_lit l0 = item_lit l) by
      (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; eassumption).
    injection Heq as Hl. subst. eexists. split; eassumption.
  - match goal with
    | Hu : binds x (item_obj U hds) Sigma |- _ =>
      assert (Heq : item_obj U hds = item_lit l) by
        (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; [exact Hu|exact Hb]);
      discriminate Heq
    end.
Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_obj : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (T:typ) (hds:heap_defs),
  heap_correspond G Sigma ->
  binds x (item_obj T hds) Sigma ->
  binds x (typ_bnd T) G /\ G ⊢ hds ∶ open x T.
Proof.
  intros G Sigma x T hds HC Hb.
  destruct HC as [Hdom Hitem].
  assert (Hin : x \in dom G).
  { rewrite Hdom. eapply binds_in_dom; eexact Hb. }
  eapply ty_item_s_obj_inv; [eapply Hitem; exact Hin|exact Hb].
Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_lit : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (l:lit),
  heap_correspond G Sigma ->
  binds x (item_lit l) Sigma ->
  exists T, binds x T G /\ G ⊢ l ∶ T.
Proof.
  intros G Sigma x l HC Hb.
  destruct HC as [Hdom Hitem].
  assert (Hin : x \in dom G).
  { rewrite Hdom. eapply binds_in_dom; eexact Hb. }
  eapply ty_item_s_lit_inv; [eapply Hitem; exact Hin|exact Hb].
Qed.

(** * Free sub heaps *)

Lemma free_sub_heaps_well_committed : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (Es:list eff_ctx),
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es -> well_committed_heap G D Sigma.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma Es H. induction H.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heaps_cons_inv : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (E:eff_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx),
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma (E :: Es) ->
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D /\ free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma E Es H. inversion H; subst.
  split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heap_item : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (D:init_ctx) (x:var) (effs:effects),
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D ->
  binds x effs E ->
  exists itm, binds x itm Sigma /\ free_heap_item D E x itm.
Proof.
  intros E Sigma D x effs Hf Hb. unfold free_sub_heap in Hf.
  destruct (Hf x effs Hb) as [_ [itm [Hbind Hitem]]].
  exists itm. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma free_heap_item_obj_inv : forall (D:init_ctx) (E:eff_ctx) (y:var) (T:typ) (hds:heap_defs),
  free_heap_item D E y (item_obj T hds) -> free_heap_defs D E y hds.
Proof. intros D E y T hds H. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

(** * Committed heaps *)

Lemma well_committed_heap_item : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (itm:item),
  well_committed_heap G D Sigma ->
  binds x committed D ->
  binds x itm Sigma ->
  committed_heap_item G D itm.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma x itm [_ [_ H]] Hb1 Hb2. eapply H; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_item_obj_inv : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (T:typ) (hds:heap_defs),
  committed_heap_item G D (item_obj T hds) -> committed_heap_defs D hds.
Proof. intros G D T hds H. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_item_lit_inv : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (l:lit),
  committed_heap_item G D (item_lit l) -> G ⸴ D ⊢c l.
Proof. intros G D l H. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

(** * Inert contexts *)

Lemma inert_binds_inert_typ : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (T:typ),
  inert G -> binds x T G -> inert_typ T.
Proof.
  intros G x T Hi. induction Hi as [| G0 y U Hi IH]; intros Hb.
  - exfalso. eapply LibEnv.binds_empty_inv; eexact Hb.
  - eapply LibEnv.binds_push_inv in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Heq1 Heq2]|[Hneq Hb]].
    + inversion Heq1; inversion Heq2; subst. assumption.
    + eapply IH; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma inert_inits_binds_inv : forall (D:init_ctx) (x:var) (i:init_typ),
  inert_inits D -> binds x i D -> i = free \/ i = committed.
Proof. intros D x i H Hb. unfold inert_inits in H. eapply H; eassumption. Qed.

(** * Record shapes *)

Lemma record_type_has_rt : forall (T:typ),
  record_type T -> exists ls, record_typ T ls.
Proof. intros T H. exact H. Qed.

Lemma record_typ_rcd_inv : forall (D:dec) (ls:fset label),
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) ls ->
  record_dec D /\ ls = \{label_of D}.
Proof.
  intros D ls H. inversion H; subst.
  split; [assumption|]. subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_and_inv : forall (T U:typ) (ls:fset label),
  record_typ (typ_and T U) ls ->
  exists ls' D, record_typ T ls' /\ U = typ_rcd D /\ record_dec D /\
                label_of D \notin ls' /\ ls = ls' \u \{label_of D}.
Proof.
  intros T U ls H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists _, _. repeat split; eauto.
Qed.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Notation avars := (list avar).

Instance AvarOpenable : Openable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n = i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarFreeVar : FreeVar avar :=
  fun a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => \{}
    | avar_f x => \{x}
    end.

Instance AvarSubstVar : SubstVar avar :=
  fun (x: var) (y: var) (a: avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f z => (avar_f (If z = x then y else z))
    end.

Instance AvarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax AvarOpenable AvarFreeVar AvarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarDecideFv : DecideFv AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => false
    | avar_f y => (If x = y then true else false)
    end.

  fun (n : nat) (x : var) (a : avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i

Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.

(** * Uniqueness of labels in a typed dec list *)

Section TyDefsUnique.

Context {A:Set} `{LA:LabelOf A} `{DTA:DecTyping A}.
Hypothesis DTL : forall (G:ctx) (d:A) (D:dec), G ⊢ d ∶d D -> label_of D = label_of d.

Lemma ty_defs_label_unique : forall (G:ctx) (ds:list A) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
  forall d1 d2, List.In d1 ds -> List.In d2 ds ->
    label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2.
Proof.
  intros G ds T H. induction H; intros d1 d2 I1 I2 E.
  - inversion I1; inversion I2; subst; reflexivity.
  - destruct I1 as [->|I1]; destruct I2 as [->|I2].
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso. eapply (labels_hasnt_sound H1 d2 I2). symmetry. exact E.
    + exfalso. eapply (labels_hasnt_sound H1 d1 I1). exact E.
    + eapply IHty_defs; eassumption.
Qed.

End TyDefsUnique.

Lemma ty_defs_def_label_unique : forall (G:ctx) (ds:defs) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
  forall d1 d2, List.In d1 ds -> List.In d2 ds ->
    label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2.
Proof.
  intros. eapply (@ty_defs_label_unique def _ _ label_of_ty_def);
    eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma ty_heap_defs_label_unique : forall (G:ctx) (hds:heap_defs) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ hds ∶ T ->
  forall d1 d2, List.In d1 hds -> List.In d2 hds ->
    label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2.
Proof.
  intros. eapply (@ty_defs_label_unique heap_def _ _ label_of_ty_heap_def);
    eassumption.
Qed.

(** * get_labeld_list and labels_has *)

Section GetLabeledListIn.

Context {A:Set} `{LA:LabelOf A}.

Lemma get_labeld_list_in : forall (l:label) (ds:list A) (d:A),
  (forall d1 d2, List.In d1 ds -> List.In d2 ds ->
     label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2) ->
  List.In d ds ->
  label_of d = l ->
  get_labeld_list l ds = Some d.
Proof.
  intros l ds. induction ds as [|a ds IH]; intros d Huniq Hin Hl.
  - inversion Hin.
  - cbn.
    destruct (classic (label_of a = l)) as [E|NE].

      * apply List.in_eq.
      * exact Hin.
      * rewrite E. symmetry. exact Hl.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of a = l) _ _ NE).
      destruct Hin as [->|Hin].
      * exfalso. apply NE. exact Hl.
      * eapply IH.
        -- intros d1 d2 I1 I2 E12. eapply Huniq.
           ++ apply List.in_cons. exact I1.
           ++ apply List.in_cons. exact I2.
           ++ exact E12.
        -- exact Hin.
        -- exact Hl.
Qed.

Lemma labels_has_in : forall (ds:list A) (d:A),
  (forall d1 d2, List.In d1 ds -> List.In d2 ds ->
     label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2) ->
  List.In d ds ->
  labels_has ds d.
Proof.
  intros ds d Huniq Hin. unfold labels_has.
  eapply get_labeld_list_in; eauto.
Qed.

End GetLabeledListIn.

(** * Uniqueness of labels in a typed dec list *)

Lemma ty_defs_label_unique : forall (A:Set) `{LA:LabelOf A} `{DTA:DecTyping A}
    (G:ctx) (ds:list A) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
  forall d1 d2, List.In d1 ds -> List.In d2 ds ->
    label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2.
Proof.
  intros A LA DTA G ds T H. induction H; intros d1 d2 I1 I2 E.
  - destruct I1 as [E1|F1]; [|inversion F1].
    destruct I2 as [E2|F2]; [|inversion F2].
    subst. reflexivity.
  - destruct I1 as [->|I1]; destruct I2 as [->|I2].
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso. eapply (labels_hasnt_sound H1 d2 I2). symmetry. exact E.
    + exfalso. eapply (labels_hasnt_sound H1 d1 I1). exact E.
    + eapply IHty_defs; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma ty_defs_def_label_unique : forall (G:ctx) (ds:defs) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
  forall d1 d2, List.In d1 ds -> List.In d2 ds ->
    label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2.
Proof.
  intros G ds T H d1 d2 I1 I2 E.
  eapply (@ty_defs_label_unique def _ _ G ds T H d1 d2 I1 I2 E).
Qed.

Lemma ty_heap_defs_label_unique : forall (G:ctx) (hds:heap_defs) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ hds ∶ T ->
  forall d1 d2, List.In d1 hds -> List.In d2 hds ->
    label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2.
Proof.
  intros G hds T H d1 d2 I1 I2 E.
  eapply (@ty_defs_label_unique heap_def _ _ G hds T H d1 d2 I1 I2 E).
Qed.

(** * get_labeld_list and labels_has *)

Lemma get_labeld_list_in : forall (A:Set) `{LA:LabelOf A}
    (l:label) (ds:list A) (d:A),
  (forall d1 d2, List.In d1 ds -> List.In d2 ds ->
     label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2) ->
  List.In d ds ->
  label_of d = l ->
  get_labeld_list l ds = Some d.
Proof.
  intros A LA l ds. induction ds as [|a ds IH]; intros d Huniq Hin Hl.
  - inversion Hin.
  - cbn.
    destruct (classic (label_of a = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_of a = l) _ _ E).
      f_equal. symmetry. eapply Huniq.
      * apply List.in_eq.
      * exact Hin.
      * rewrite E. symmetry. exact Hl.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of a = l) _ _ NE).
      destruct Hin as [->|Hin].
      * exfalso. apply NE. exact Hl.
      * eapply IH.
        -- intros d1 d2 I1 I2 E12. eapply Huniq.
           ++ apply List.in_cons. exact I1.
           ++ apply List.in_cons. exact I2.
           ++ exact E12.
        -- exact Hin.
        -- exact Hl.
Qed.

Lemma labels_has_in : forall (A:Set) `{LA:LabelOf A} (ds:list A) (d:A),
  (forall d1 d2, List.In d1 ds -> List.In d2 ds ->
     label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2) ->
  List.In d ds ->
  labels_has ds d.
Proof.
  intros A LA ds d Huniq Hin. unfold labels_has.
  eapply get_labeld_list_in; eauto.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect.

Inductive init_typ : Set :=
  | committed : init_typ
  | free : init_typ
  | unspecified : init_typ.

Notation inits := (list init_typ).

Notation init_ctx := (env init_typ).

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_all  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_con  : typs -> inits -> typ -> typ

with typs : Set :=
  | typs_nil : typs
  | typs_cons : typ -> typs -> typs

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_trm  : trm_label -> typ -> typ -> dec.

Scheme typ_mut  := Induction for typ Sort Prop
with   typs_mut := Induction for typs Sort Prop
with   dec_mut  := Induction for dec Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typ_mutind from typ_mut, typs_mut, dec_mut.

Fixpoint typs_to_list (Ts : typs) : list typ :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => nil
  | typs_cons T Ts' => (T :: typs_to_list Ts')%list
  end.

Instance TypsToList : ToList typ typs := typs_to_list.

Arguments TypsToList _ /.

Fixpoint typs_of_list (xs : list typ) : typs :=
  match xs with
  | nil => typs_nil
  | (T :: Ts')%list => typs_cons T (typs_of_list Ts')
  end.

Instance TypsOfList : OfList typ typs := typs_of_list.

Arguments TypsOfList _ /.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L    => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_all T1 T2  => typ_all (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_con Ts is' T =>
    typ_con
      (open_rec_typs k u Ts)
      is'
      (open_rec_typ (S (length_s Ts) + k) u T)

  end with
open_rec_typs (k : nat) (u : var) (Ts : typs) : typs :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => typs_nil
  | typs_cons T Ts =>
    typs_cons (open_rec_typ k u T)
              (open_rec_typs k u Ts)
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_trm m T U => dec_trm m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance TypsOpenable : Openable typs := open_rec_typs.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L    => (fv x)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_all T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_con Ts is' T   => (fv_typs Ts) \u (fv_typ T)
  end with
fv_typs (Ts : typs) : vars :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => \{}
  | typs_cons T Ts => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typs Ts)
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_trm m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)

Arguments TypsOfList _ /.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L    => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_all T1 T2  => typ_all (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_con Ts is' T =>
    typ_con
      (open_rec_typs k u Ts)
      is'
      (open_rec_typ (S (length_s Ts) + k) u T)

  end with
open_rec_typs (k : nat) (u : var) (Ts : typs) : typs :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => typs_nil
  | typs_cons T Ts =>
    typs_cons (open_rec_typ k u T)
              (open_rec_typs k u Ts)
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_trm m T U => dec_trm m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance TypsOpenable : Openable typs := open_rec_typs.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L    => (fv x)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_all T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_con Ts is' T   => (fv_typs Ts) \u (fv_typ T)
  end with
fv_typs (Ts : typs) : vars :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => \{}
  | typs_cons T Ts => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typs Ts)
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_trm m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)

Lemma subst_open_rec_trm_mut :
  (forall (t:trm) (x y z:var) (n:nat),
      subst_var x y (open_rec n z t) =
      open_rec n (z \[x -> y]) (subst_var x y t)) /\
  (forall (l:lit) (x y z:var) (n:nat),
      subst_var x y (open_rec n z l) =
      open_rec n (z \[x -> y]) (subst_var x y l)).
Proof.
  apply trm_mutind; intros; simpl.
  - f_equal. apply subst_open_avar.
  - f_equal. apply subst_open_avar.
  - f_equal; [apply subst_open_avar|apply subst_open_avar].
  - f_equal.
    + apply (proj1 subst_open_rec_mut).
    + apply H.
    + apply H0.
  - f_equal.
    + apply (proj1 subst_open_rec_mut).
    + apply H.
    + apply H0.
  - f_equal; [apply subst_open_avar|apply subst_open_avar].
  - f_equal.
    + apply subst_open_avar.
    + apply subst_open_rec_avars.
  - f_equal.
    + apply (proj1 subst_open_rec_mut).
    + apply H.
  - rewrite length_s_subst_typs.
    f_equal.
    + apply (proj1 (proj2 subst_open_rec_mut)).
    + apply (proj1 subst_open_rec_mut).
    + apply subst_open_rec_defs.
    + apply H.

Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping PreciseTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems.

(** * Opening preserves record structure *)

Lemma label_of_open_dec : forall (D:dec) (n:nat) (u:var),
  label_of (open_rec n u D) = label_of D.
Proof. intros D n u. destruct D; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma record_dec_open : forall (D:dec) (n:nat) (u:var),
  record_dec D -> record_dec (open_rec n u D).
Proof. intros D n u H. destruct H; simpl; [apply rd_typ|apply rd_trm]. Qed.

Lemma record_typ_open : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (n:nat) (u:var),
  record_typ T ls -> record_typ (open_rec n u T) ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls n u H. induction H.
  - cbn. apply rt_one.
    + apply record_dec_open; assumption.
    + rewrite label_of_open_dec. assumption.
  - cbn. apply rt_cons.
    + match goal with IH : record_typ (open_rec n u ?X) ?LX
                       |- record_typ (open_rec n u ?X) ?LX => exact IH end.
    + apply record_dec_open; assumption.
    + rewrite label_of_open_dec. assumption.
    + assumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_open : forall (T:typ) (n:nat) (u:var),
  record_type T -> record_type (open_rec n u T).
Proof.
  intros T n u [ls Hrt]. exists ls. apply record_typ_open. assumption.
Qed.

(** * Shape facts *)

Lemma record_type_not_top : record_type typ_top -> False.
Proof. intros [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_bot : record_type typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_sel : forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), record_type (typ_sel a A) -> False.
Proof. intros a A [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_all : forall (S T:typ), record_type (typ_all S T) -> False.
Proof. intros S T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_con : forall (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (T:typ), record_type (typ_con Ts is' T) -> False.
Proof. intros Ts is' T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), record_type (typ_bnd T) -> False.
Proof. intros T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_not_top : inert_typ typ_top -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_bot : inert_typ typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_sel : forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), inert_typ (typ_sel a A) -> False.
Proof. intros a A H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_rcd : forall (D:dec), inert_typ (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_and : forall (T U:typ), inert_typ (typ_and T U) -> False.
Proof. intros T U H. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Shape of precise flow tips in an inert setting *)

Lemma flow_shape : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  inert_typ T0 ->
  binds x T0 G ->
  (V = T0 /\ inert_typ T0) \/ record_type V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf; intros Hi Hb.
  - left. split; [reflexivity|assumption].
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + inversion Heq; subst. inversion Hi2; subst.
      right. apply record_type_open. assumption.
    + exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exists ls. exact Hr.
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists ls'. exact (proj1 HP).
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists (\{label_of D}).
      assert (HeqU : U2 = typ_rcd D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 HP)).
      assert (Hrd : record_dec D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 HP))).
      rewrite HeqU. apply rt_one; [exact Hrd|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma flow_typing : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf.
  - apply ty_var. assumption.
  - eapply ty_rec_elim. exact IHHf.
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and11].
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and12].
Qed.

Lemma inert_typing: forall G x T U, inert G -> binds x T G -> G ⊢ x ∶ U -> exists V, G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ V /\ G ⊢ V <: U.

Definition P_trm (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_: G ⊢ t ∶ T) : Prop :=
  forall G1 G2 (xm ym:var) (Sm:typ),
    G = G1 & xm ~ Sm & G2 ->
    xm # G2 -> xm \notin fv_env G1 ->
    (G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ trm_var (avar_f ym) ∶ subst_var xm ym Sm) ->
    G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ subst_var xm ym t ∶ subst_var xm ym T.
Arguments P_trm G t T _ : clear implicits.

Definition P_lit (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_: G ⊢ l ∶ T) : Prop :=
  forall G1 G2 (xm ym:var) (Sm:typ),
    G = G1 & xm ~ Sm & G2 ->
    xm # G2 -> xm \notin fv_env G1 ->
    (G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ trm_var (avar_f ym) ∶ subst_var xm ym Sm) ->
    G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ subst_var xm ym l ∶ subst_var xm ym T.
Arguments P_lit G l T _ : clear implicits.

Definition P_sub (G:ctx) (T U:typ) (_: G ⊢ T <: U) : Prop :=
  forall G1 G2 (xm ym:var) (Sm:typ),
    G = G1 & xm ~ Sm & G2 ->
    xm # G2 -> xm \notin fv_env G1 ->
    (G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ trm_var (avar_f ym) ∶ subst_var xm ym Sm) ->
    G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ subst_var xm ym T <: subst_var xm ym U.
Arguments P_sub G T U _ : clear implicits.

Definition P_avars (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_: G ⊢ avs :: Ts) : Prop :=
  forall G1 G2 (xm ym:var) (Sm:typ),
    G = G1 & xm ~ Sm & G2 ->
    xm # G2 -> xm \notin fv_env G1 ->
    (G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ trm_var (avar_f ym) ∶ subst_var xm ym Sm) ->
    G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ subst_var xm ym avs :: subst_var xm ym Ts.
Arguments P_avars G avs Ts _ : clear implicits.

Definition P_trm (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_: G ⊢ t ∶ T) : Prop :=
  forall G1 G2 (xm ym:var) (Sm:typ),
    G = G1 & xm ~ Sm & G2 ->

    G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ subst_var xm ym t ∶ subst_var xm ym T.

Definition P_lit (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_: G ⊢ l ∶ T) : Prop :=
  forall G1 G2 (xm ym:var) (Sm:typ),

    xm # G2 -> xm \notin fv_env G1 ->

    G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ subst_var xm ym l ∶ subst_var xm ym T.

Definition P_sub (G:ctx) (T U:typ) (_: G ⊢ T <: U) : Prop :=

    G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ subst_var xm ym T <: subst_var xm ym U.

Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.

Lemma binds_drop_middle : forall (A:Type) (D1 D2:env A) (xm z:var) (v v0:A),
  z <> xm ->
  binds z v (D1 & xm ~ v0 & D2) ->
  binds z v (D1 & D2).
Proof.
  intros A D1 D2 xm z v v0 Hne Hb.
  destruct (LibEnv.binds_concat_inv Hb) as [H2|[Hnot H1]].
  - eapply LibEnv.binds_concat_right. exact H2.
  - eapply LibEnv.binds_concat_left.
    + destruct (LibEnv.binds_push_inv H1) as [[Heq _]|[_ H0]].
      * exfalso. apply Hne. exact Heq.
      * exact H0.
    + exact Hnot.
Qed.

Lemma in_vars_subst : forall (vs:vars) (xm ym z:var),
  z \in vs -> z <> xm -> z \in (subst_var xm ym vs).
Proof.
  intros vs xm ym z Hin Hne.
  unfold subst_var. cbn.
  destruct (classic (xm \in vs)) as [Hx|Hx].
  - rewrite (If_l (P:=xm \in vs) _ _ Hx).
    rewrite in_union. left. rewrite in_remove. split; [exact Hin|].
    intro E. apply Hne. rewrite in_singleton in E. exact E.
  - rewrite (If_r (P:=xm \in vs) _ _ Hx). exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma in_vars_subst_self : forall (vs:vars) (xm ym:var),
  xm \in vs -> ym \in (subst_var xm ym vs).
Proof.
  intros vs xm ym Hx. unfold subst_var. cbn.
  rewrite (If_l (P:=xm \in vs) _ _ Hx).
  rewrite in_union. right. apply in_singleton_self.
Qed.

Lemma subst_vars_union_singleton : forall (vs:vars) (xm ym z:var),
  z <> xm ->
  subst_var xm ym (vs \u \{z}) = (subst_var xm ym vs) \u \{z}.
Proof.
  intros vs xm ym z Hne. unfold subst_var. cbn.
  destruct (classic (xm \in vs \u \{z})) as [Hx|Hx].
  - destruct (classic (xm \in vs)) as [Hv|Hv].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=xm \in vs \u \{z}) _ _ Hx).
      rewrite (If_l (P:=xm \in vs) _ _ Hv).
      (* (vs ∪ {z}) \ {xm} ∪ {ym} = ((vs \ {xm}) ∪ {ym}) ∪ {z} *)
      apply LibFset.fset_extens; intros a.
      rewrite !in_union, !in_remove, !in_singleton.
      tauto.
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=xm \in vs \u \{z}) _ _ Hx).
      rewrite (If_r (P:=xm \in vs) _ _ Hv).
      rewrite in_union in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hxv|Hxz].
      * exfalso; apply Hv; exact Hxv.
      * rewrite in_singleton in Hxz. subst xm. exfalso. apply Hne. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (If_r (P:=xm \in vs \u \{z}) _ _ Hx).
    assert (Hv : ~ xm \in vs) by (intro H; apply Hx; rewrite in_union; left; exact H).
    rewrite (If_r (P:=xm \in vs) _ _ Hv). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma init_var_committed_split : forall (D1 D2:init_ctx) (xm:var),
  xm # D2 -> binds xm committed (D1 & xm ~ committed & D2).
Proof.
  intros D1 D2 xm Hnot.
  eapply LibEnv.binds_concat_left.
  - apply LibEnv.binds_push_eq.
  - exact Hnot.
Qed.

Lemma init_var_subst : forall (D1 D2:init_ctx) (vs:vars) (xm ym x:var) (i:init_typ),
  xm # D2 ->
  binds ym committed (D1 & D2) ->
  init_var (D1 & xm ~ committed & D2) vs x i ->
  init_var (D1 & D2) (subst_var xm ym vs) (x \[xm -> ym]) i.

  - (* commit *)

    + rewrite (@subst_if_eq xm ym). apply init_var_commit.
      exact Hbinds.
    + rewrite (@subst_if_neq xm ym x Hne). apply init_var_commit.
      eapply binds_drop_middle; eassumption.
  - (* free *)
    destruct (classic (x = xm)) as [->|Hne].
    + exfalso.
      pose proof (init_var_committed_split HxD) as Hc.
      pose proof (@LibEnv.binds_functional init_typ xm committed free
                    (D1 & xm ~ committed & D2) Hc H) as Heq.
      discriminate Heq.
    + rewrite (@subst_if_neq xm ym x Hne). apply init_var_free.
      * eapply in_vars_subst; eassumption.
      * eapply binds_drop_middle; eassumption.
  - (* unspec *)
    destruct (classic (x = xm)) as [->|Hne].
    + exfalso.

      pose proof (@LibEnv.binds_functional init_typ xm committed unspecified

Continued the build with the first stage of the **commit/init substitution** development (needed for the application step), now verified in `Task.v` (3356 lines; still checks through everything before the targets, which are byte-identical to the original).

## Added this round

**Environment arithmetic**
- `binds_drop_middle` — dropping a middle binding `xm ~ v0` preserves bindings of a different variable `z`.
- `in_vars_subst` — if `z ∈ vs` and `z ≠ xm`, then `z ∈ subst_var xm ym vs`.
- `in_vars_subst_self` — `xm ∈ vs → ym ∈ subst_var xm ym vs`.
- `subst_vars_union_singleton` — `subst_var xm ym (vs ∪ {z}) = subst_var xm ym vs ∪ {z}` when `z ≠ xm` (needed for the substituted `vs ∪ {z}` in the `init_let` case), proved via `fset_extens`.

**`init_var` substitution**
- `init_var_committed_split` — the middle `xm ~ committed` binding is present when `xm # D2`.
- `init_var_subst` — if `init_var (D1 & xm ~ committed & D2) vs x i` and `binds ym committed (D1 & D2)`, then `init_var (D1 & D2) (subst_var xm ym vs) (x[xm→ym]) i`. The proof is by induction on the remembered init context (so the compound index specializes), with the `x = xm` free/unspecified cases eliminated by `binds_functional` against the committed binding.

The next milestone is the full 5-motive mutual substitution for `⊢c` and `⊢i`, whose statement mirrors the typing-substitution motive:

```
G = G1 & xm ~ Sm & G2 -> D = D1 & xm ~ committed & D2 ->
xm # G2 -> xm # D2 -> xm ∉ fv_env G1 ->
(G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ var ym ∶ subst Sm) ->
binds ym committed (D1 & D2) ->
G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⸴ D1 & D2 ⊢c subst xm ym t
```

with the analogous init motive using `subst_var xm ym vs`. The per-rule helpers will follow the `hc_*` pattern from the transfer lemma (implicit induction hypotheses as premises, discharged by `eauto`), and the binder cases reuse the typing-substitution `concat_assoc`/`map_push`/freshness setup.

Remaining after that: the inert canonical forms (still the core blocker), effect-context correspondence preservation, heap extension for allocating steps, and then preservation/progress. No proof escapes; support files untouched.

content.thinking:
The runner continues. Let me now implement the full commit/init substitution. This is the next milestone. I'll follow the helper-lemma + 5-motive strategy.

Let me design the helper lemmas. Actually, maybe I can adapt the transfer proof's helper lemmas almost verbatim by replacing `binds_extends` with the substitution environment. The helper lemmas for substitution would be:

For a rule with conclusion in G,D and premises, the helper takes as hypotheses:
- the substituted IH forms for each recursive premise, i.e., for a premise in G,D:
  `forall G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm, G = G1&xm~Sm&G2 -> D = D1&xm~committed&D2 -> xm#G2 -> xm#D2 -> xm∉fv_env G1 -> (G1&subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ var ym ∶ subst Sm) -> binds ym committed (D1&D2) -> G1&subst_env xm ym G2 ⸴ D1&D2 ⊢c subst xm ym t`
- For a binder premise `forall z, z∉L -> (G&z~T) ⸴ (D&z~committed) ⊢c open z u`, the IH form is `forall z, z∉L -> <the Q form for env (G&z~T),(D&z~committed)>`.
- The rule's typing/init premises (non-recursive) in G,D.
- Then the conclusion: for all G1 G2 D1 D2 ..., same side conditions, `G1&subst_env... ⸴ D1&D2 ⊢c subst ...`.

The main proof then is:
```
apply (well_init_mut_ind Qc Qa Ql Qi Qis);
intros; unfold Qc,... in *;
intros G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm HeqG HeqD HxG HxD Hfv Hpre Hbinds; subst;
first [ solve [eapply sc_commit_var; eauto 4] | ... ].
```
Wait: after `subst`, HeqG and HeqD are consumed. The helpers' statements must not include the equalities for the *outer* env (since we've substituted); they should be stated in terms of the split env directly. The eauto must supply the IH hypotheses to the helpers; the IH hypotheses in context have the Q form with the *equalities*, and after subst the equalities are gone? The IH hypotheses are generated by the induction principle for the recursive premises, with the Q motive instantiated at the premise's env:
`IH : forall G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm, (G_case = G1&xm~Sm&G2) -> (D_case = ...) -> ... -> ...`.
After `subst` (which rewrote G and D in all hypotheses, including the recursive premises' types), the IH's equalities' LHS become the split forms — but the equalities are still premises in the IH (not automatically discharged). The helper's IH-hypothesis should be exactly the IH type, including the equalities. So the helper's statement should take the IH as a premise with its full forall over the equalities. Then `eauto 4` can use the local IH as an exact match (assumption). And the helper applies the IH by providing the equalities (often reflexivity, or concat_assoc).

This mirrors the transfer helpers, where the helper premises were the IH forms with binds_extends premises. So I'll write helpers whose recursive-premise hypotheses are exactly the Q-form for the *premise's env*, i.e., with `(env = G1&...)` premises.

Let me define the Q motives as Definitions to make the helper statements readable:
```
Definition Qc (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (t:trm) (_:G ⸴ D ⊢c t) : Prop :=
  forall G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm,
    G = G1 & xm ~ Sm & G2 ->
    D = D1 & xm ~ committed & D2 ->
    xm # G2 -> xm # D2 -> xm \notin fv_env G1 ->
    (G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ trm_var (avar_f ym) ∶ subst_var xm ym Sm) ->
    binds ym committed (D1 & D2) ->
    G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⸴ D1 & D2 ⊢c subst_var xm ym t.
Arguments Qc G D t _ : clear implicits.
```
Similarly Qa (avars), Ql (lit), Qi (init trm with vs and i), Qis (init avars with is').

Important: in the init motive, the vs is substituted: `subst_var xm ym vs`, and the init judgment is `G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⸴ D1 & D2 ⸴ subst_var xm ym vs ⊢i subst_var xm ym t ∶ i`.

Now the helpers. Let me enumerate the rules and their case handling:

**Commit trm rules:**
1. `sc_commit_var (G D x)`: premise `binds x committed D` [in split env after subst]. Conclusion `G1 & subst_env... ⸴ D1&D2 ⊢c subst (var x)`. Cases x=xm / x≠xm as designed. The helper statement:
```
Lemma sc_commit_var : forall G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm x,
  binds x committed (D1 & xm ~ committed & D2) ->
  xm # D2 ->
  binds ym committed (D1 & D2) ->
  G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⸴ D1 & D2 ⊢c subst_var xm ym (trm_var (avar_f x)).
```
No G1/G2/Sm/Hpre needed. (The helper's G1 G2 Sm may be unused.)
2. `sc_commit_all_elim`: premises IHc for x and z (in the same split env). Conclusion app. The substituted app: `subst_var xm ym (trm_app (avar_f x) (avar_f z))` reduces to `trm_app (avar_f (x[...])) (avar_f (z[...]))`. We need to reshape via change/rewrite. The helper:
```
Lemma sc_commit_all_elim : forall G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm x z,
  (Qc (G1&xm~Sm&G2) (D1&xm~committed&D2) (trm_var (avar_f x)) Hx) ->  (* full IH premise *)
  (Qc ... (trm_var (avar_f z)) Hz) ->
  G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⸴ D1 & D2 ⊢c subst_var xm ym (trm_app (avar_f x) (avar_f z)).
```
But the IH hypotheses' exact form includes the typing derivations Hx/Hz (proof args). Since Qc is a Definition with the proof argument implicit/clear, the local IH's type is `Qc G D (trm_var ...) Hx` — as a hypothesis, it prints with the proof arg. To match, the helper can take the IH as `forall ...` without referencing the proof: I can state the helper's premise as the *unfolded* forall (as the transfer helpers did), which is syntactically what the IH's type is (Qc unfolds to it). If I state the helper premise with the same unfolded forall, the local IH (whose type is Qc applied, but Qc is a Definition reducing to the forall) should be convertible and `assumption`/eauto should match up to delta? `eauto`'s assumption uses conversion, so it should.
So for each recursive premise, the helper takes a premise of the unfolded form:
```

    (G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ trm_var (avar_f ym) ∶ subst_var xm ym Sm) ->
    binds ym committed (D1 & D2) ->
    G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⸴ D1 & D2 ⸴ subst_var xm ym vs
      ⊢i subst_var xm ym t ∶ i.

Definition QisF (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars) (avs:avars) (is':inits) : Prop :=
  forall G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm,
    G = G1 & xm ~ Sm & G2 ->
    D = D1 & xm ~ committed & D2 ->
    xm # G2 -> xm # D2 -> xm \notin fv_env G1 ->
    (G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ trm_var (avar_f ym) ∶ subst_var xm ym Sm) ->
    binds ym committed (D1 & D2) ->
    G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⸴ D1 & D2 ⸴ subst_var xm ym vs
      ⊢i subst_var xm ym avs :: is'.

(** * Helpers for the easy commit rules *)

Lemma sc_commit_var : forall (G1 G2:ctx) (D1 D2:init_ctx) (xm ym:var) (Sm:typ) (x:var),
  xm # D2 ->
  binds ym committed (D1 & D2) ->
  binds x committed (D1 & xm ~ committed & D2) ->
  G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⸴ D1 & D2 ⊢c subst_var xm ym (trm_var (avar_f x)).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm x HxD Hbinds Hb.
  simpl.
  destruct (classic (x = xm)) as [->|Hne].
  - rewrite (@subst_if_eq xm ym). apply commit_var. exact Hbinds.
  - rewrite (@subst_if_neq xm ym x Hne). apply commit_var.
    eapply (@binds_drop_middle init_typ D1 D2 xm x committed committed);
      [exact Hne|exact Hb].
Qed.

  (forall z, z \notin L ->
     QcF ((G1 & xm ~ Sm & G2) & z ~ T)
         ((D1 & xm ~ committed & D2) & z ~ committed)
         (open z u)) ->
  xm # G2 -> xm # D2 -> xm \notin fv_env G1 ->
  (G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ trm_var (avar_f ym) ∶ subst_var xm ym Sm) ->
  binds ym committed (D1 & D2) ->

If the body mentions xm (the substituted outer variable), an assignment `xm.a := ...` produces effect (xm,a) ∈ def_eff x ds? def_eff x ds only contains pairs with first component x. For xm's effect (xm,a) to be in def_eff x ds, we'd need xm = x. But xm is the outer variable and x the literal's fresh binder; they are distinct if we choose the literal's x fresh from xm. However, the *given* derivation's literal binder x was chosen by the rule's L and could equal xm? In commit_con_intro, the binder x is fresh from L; L is part of the derivation. When we substitute xm, the binder x may equal xm or not. If x = xm, then the literal is shadowing xm; substituting xm in the body should not affect occurrences of the binder x (they're bound?). Wait the term `open_vars (cons x ys) t` has x and ys as *free* variables (the literal's parameters/self), not bound in the term (the binder semantics is at the rule level). The term may contain x free. Substituting xm in this term: if x = xm, then substituting xm→ym renames the literal's self-variable occurrences, breaking the rule's structure! But we can choose the literal's fresh binder x to be distinct from xm and ym: the rule commit_con_intro's binder x is under a fresh premise (forall x ys, ... fresh L ...), and the L can be enlarged. When we apply the commit rule for the *substituted* literal, we choose a new L' including xm and ym, so the binder x is fresh from them. But the *given* derivation's commit_con_intro case (from the induction on the original derivation) has an arbitrary L and its premises hold for x fresh from that L; we can choose x ourselves? The induction case provides the rule's L and the premise `forall x ys, fresh L ... -> ...`; we can instantiate x with a value fresh from L ∪ {xm,ym, ...} to apply the IH. In the *helper* for the substituted conclusion, we need to prove the new rule's body premise for all x ys fresh from L' (our chosen L'), where L' includes xm,ym. So we instantiate the given premise at that same x,ys (fresh from L ∪ ...?) — we need x fresh from the original L too, so choose L' to include L. Then x ≠ xm, x ≠ ym. Also the original premise's term `open_vars (cons x ys) t` then has x distinct from xm, and substituting xm renames free occurrences of xm in t; these are free variables of the literal's body referring to the outer context, and their effects... An assignment to xm inside the literal's body would produce effect (xm,a), which must be in def_eff x ds (all first-components x), impossible since xm≠x. Therefore, in a *valid* derivation, the body cannot have effects on xm; i.e., the effects set def_eff x ds contains only x-labeled effects, and any free assignment to xm would require (xm,a) ∈ from_list (def_eff x ds), which is false. So the effect typing of t under the literal's body must avoid xm-effects. Then substituting xm→ym doesn't change the effect set (the renamed effects (ym,a) wouldn't arise because there were no xm effects). This is the argument: has_effs original effects = from_list (def_eff x ds); all elements have first component x; hence no effect on xm; hence renaming xm→ym leaves the effects unchanged (as a set), since no (xm,a) occurs. But proving this syntactically requires an effect-typing substitution lemma plus a lemma that the effect set is unchanged when the *set of effects* contains no xm-labeled effects. The latter would need reasoning about from_list and renaming, which is possible if we formulate the substitution lemma with the hypothesis "no effect with first component xm in the effect set". This is getting deep, but maybe the original proof handled it this way.

- `sc_commit_var` — with `binds_drop_middle` for the non-substituted branch, `binds_functional` machinery for the `x = xm` branch.
- `sc_commit_all_elim`, `sc_commit_rcd_elim`, `sc_commit_fld_asn` — IH application via explicit `refine (H G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm …)`; `commit_fld_asn`’s unused `i` is supplied as `unspecified`.

Resolved the effect-renaming obstruction found last round, and verified a new effect-substitution layer in `Task.v` (now 3804 lines; still checks through everything before the targets, unchanged and byte-identical; no escapes).

## Added this round

**Effect substitution / invariance**
- `def_eff_first` — every effect in `from_list (def_eff x ds)` has first component `x` (by induction on `defs`: `def_typ` is skipped, `def_trm l` contributes `(x,l)`).
- `def_eff_no_subst` — if `xm ≠ x`, then no `(xm, a)` occurs in `from_list (def_eff x ds)`.
- `eff_trm_subst_fresh` — if no effect labelled `xm` occurs in the chosen effect list, then
  `⊢e t ∶ effs  →  ⊢e subst xm ym t ∶ effs`.
  Proof by induction on `eff_trm`:
  - `eff_ignore` is direct;
  - `eff_fld_asn` must show the assigned variable differs from `xm` (otherwise `(xm,a)` would occur in the effect list), using `subst_if_neq`;
  - `eff_let`/`eff_llit` use a fresh binder `z` avoiding `xm` (so substitution commutes with opening via `subst_open_fresh_trm`), the IH on the recursive premise and on the body-function IH, and `from_list_app`/`notin_union` to project the no-`xm`-effect hypothesis to each component.
- `has_effs_subst_fresh` — `has_effs t effs` plus no `xm`-labelled effect in `effs` implies `has_effs (subst xm ym t) effs`.

This is exactly what the `commit_con_intro` substitution case needs: its effect premise can keep the same effect list after substituting, because the declared literal effects are all labelled by the literal's fresh self-variable, which is distinct from `xm`.

After that, the larger still-open items are the inert canonical forms, effect-context correspondence/bookkeeping, heap extension for allocating steps, and the preservation/progress case analyses.

Lemma sc_commit_llit : forall (L:fset var) (G1 G2:ctx) (D1 D2:init_ctx)
    (xm ym:var) (Sm:typ) (l:lit) (u:trm) (T:typ),
  QlF (G1 & xm ~ Sm & G2) (D1 & xm ~ committed & D2) l ->
  (forall z, z \notin L ->
     QcF ((G1 & xm ~ Sm & G2) & z ~ T)
         ((D1 & xm ~ committed & D2) & z ~ committed)
         (open z u)) ->
  xm # G2 -> xm # D2 -> xm \notin fv_env G1 ->
  (G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ trm_var (avar_f ym) ∶ subst_var xm ym Sm) ->
  binds ym committed (D1 & D2) ->
  G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⸴ D1 & D2
    ⊢c subst_var xm ym (trm_lit T l u).
Proof.
  intros L G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm l u T Hl Hu HxG HxD Hfv Hpre Hbinds.
  set (L' := ((L \u dom G1) \u dom G2) \u \{xm}).
  unfold QlF in Hl. unfold QcF in Hu. simpl.
  eapply (@commit_llit L' _ _ _ _ _).
  - refine (Hl G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm _ _ _ _ _ _ _);
      [reflexivity|reflexivity|exact HxG|exact HxD|exact Hfv|exact Hpre|exact Hbinds].
  - intros z Hz.
    assert (Hz1 : z \notin (L \u dom G1) \u dom G2) by
      (exact (@notin_union_r1 z ((L \u dom G1) \u dom G2) \{xm} Hz)).
    assert (HzL1 : z \notin L \u dom G1) by
      (exact (@notin_union_r1 z (L \u dom G1) (dom G2) Hz1)).
    assert (HzG2 : z \notin dom G2) by
      (exact (@notin_union_r2 z (L \u dom G1) (dom G2) Hz1)).
    assert (HzL : z \notin L) by
      (exact (@notin_union_r1 z L (dom G1) HzL1)).
    assert (HzG1 : z \notin dom G1) by
      (exact (@notin_union_r2 z L (dom G1) HzL1)).
    assert (Hzxm : z \notin \{xm}) by
      (exact (@notin_union_r2 z ((L \u dom G1) \u dom G2) \{xm} Hz)).
    assert (Hzx : z <> xm) by (exact (@notin_singleton_r z xm Hzxm)).
    assert (Hru : subst_var xm ym (open_rec 0 z u) = open_rec 0 z (subst_var xm ym u))
      by (apply subst_open_fresh_trm; auto).
    assert (HeqG : ((G1 & xm ~ Sm & G2) & z ~ T) = G1 & xm ~ Sm & (G2 & z ~ T)).
    { symmetry. apply concat_assoc. }
    assert (HeqD : ((D1 & xm ~ committed & D2) & z ~ committed)
                    = D1 & xm ~ committed & (D2 & z ~ committed)).
    { symmetry. apply concat_assoc. }
    assert (Hpre' : G1 & subst_env xm ym (G2 & z ~ T)
                    ⊢ trm_var (avar_f ym) ∶ subst_var xm ym Sm).
    { rewrite map_push. rewrite concat_assoc.
      eapply ty_trm_binds_extends; [exact Hpre|].
      apply binds_extends_push_fresh.
      rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact HzG1|].
      rewrite dom_subst_env. exact HzG2. }
    assert (HxG' : xm # (G2 & z ~ T)).
    { rewrite dom_push. apply notin_union_l.
      - apply notin_singleton_l. intro E; apply Hzx; symmetry; exact E.
      - exact HxG. }
    assert (HxD' : xm # (D2 & z ~ committed)).
    { rewrite dom_push. apply notin_union_l.
      - apply notin_singleton_l. intro E; apply Hzx; symmetry; exact E.
      - exact HxD. }
    repeat rewrite <- concat_assoc.
    rewrite <- map_push.
    change (G1 & subst_env xm ym (G2 & z ~ T) ⸴ D1 & (D2 & z ~ committed)
            ⊢c open_rec 0 z (subst_var xm ym u)).
    rewrite <- Hru.
    assert (Hbinds' : binds ym committed (D1 & (D2 & z ~ committed))).
    { destruct (classic (ym = z)) as [Heq|Hne].
      - subst z. eapply LibEnv.binds_concat_right. apply LibEnv.binds_push_eq.
      - assert (Hb : binds ym committed ((D1 & D2) & z ~ committed)).
        { eapply LibEnv.binds_push_neq; [exact Hbinds|exact Hne]. }
        rewrite concat_assoc. exact Hb. }
    refine (Hu z HzL G1 (G2 & z ~ T) D1 (D2 & z ~ committed) xm ym Sm
              _ _ _ _ _ _ _);
      [exact HeqG|exact HeqD|exact HxG'|exact HxD'|exact Hfv|exact Hpre'|exact Hbinds'].
Qed.
EOF

Lemma notin_L_prime : forall (L:fset var) (G1 G2:ctx) (xm ym z:var),

Corollary commit_subst : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (t:trm), G ⸴ D ⊢c t ->
  forall G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm,
    G = G1 & xm ~ Sm & G2 ->

    G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⸴ D1 & D2 ⊢c subst_var xm ym t.
Proof.

  pose proof (proj1 init_commit_subst_mut G D t H) as Hq.
  unfold QcF in Hq. exact (Hq G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm HeqG HeqD HxG HxD Hfv Hpre Hb).

Corollary lit_commit_subst : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (l:lit), G ⸴ D ⊢c l ->
  forall G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm,
    G = G1 & xm ~ Sm & G2 ->
    D = D1 & xm ~ committed & D2 ->
    xm # G2 -> xm # D2 -> xm \notin fv_env G1 ->
    (G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ trm_var (avar_f ym) ∶ subst_var xm ym Sm) ->
    binds ym committed (D1 & D2) ->
    G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⸴ D1 & D2 ⊢c subst_var xm ym l.
Proof.
  intros G D l H G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm HeqG HeqD HxG HxD Hfv Hpre Hb.
  pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 init_commit_subst_mut)) G D l H) as Hq.
  unfold QlF in Hq. exact (Hq G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm HeqG HeqD HxG HxD Hfv Hpre Hb).
Qed.

Corollary init_subst : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars) (t:trm) (i:init_typ),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i t ∶ i ->
  forall G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm,
    G = G1 & xm ~ Sm & G2 ->
    D = D1 & xm ~ committed & D2 ->
    xm # G2 -> xm # D2 -> xm \notin fv_env G1 ->
    (G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⊢ trm_var (avar_f ym) ∶ subst_var xm ym Sm) ->
    binds ym committed (D1 & D2) ->
    G1 & subst_env xm ym G2 ⸴ D1 & D2 ⸴ subst_var xm ym vs

  pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 init_commit_subst_mut))) G D vs t i H) as Hq.
  unfold QiF in Hq. exact (Hq G1 G2 D1 D2 xm ym Sm HeqG HeqD HxG HxD Hfv Hpre Hb).

  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f a) ∶ S ->
  binds a committed D ->
  G ⸴ D ⊢c open a t.
Proof.

  destruct (@var_fresh (((L \u fv_env G) \u fv t) \u fv S)) as [x Hx].
  pose proof (notin_union_r1 Hx) as Hx1.
  pose proof (notin_union_r1 Hx1) as Hx2.
  pose proof (notin_union_r1 Hx2) as HxL.
  pose proof (notin_union_r2 Hx2) as HxG.
  pose proof (notin_union_r2 Hx1) as Hxt.
  pose proof (notin_union_r2 Hx) as HxS.

  assert (Hpre : G & subst_env x a empty ⊢ trm_var (avar_f a) ∶ subst_var x a S).

                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (D & x ~ committed)))

  rewrite map_empty in Hres. rewrite !concat_empty_r in Hres.
  rewrite <- (@subst_intro_trm t x a 0 Hxt).
  exact Hres.

Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.

Lemma committed_heap_defs_extend : forall (D:init_ctx) (hds:heap_defs) (x:var),
  x \notin dom D ->
  committed_heap_defs D hds ->
  committed_heap_defs (D & x ~ committed) hds.
Proof.
  intros D hds x HxD H. induction H.
  - apply committed_heap_defs_nil.
  - apply committed_heap_defs_cons; [exact (IHcommitted_heap_defs HxD)|].
    inversion H0; subst.
    + apply committed_heap_def_typ.
    + apply committed_heap_def_trm.
      match goal with Hy : binds ?y committed Delta |- _ =>
        assert (Hne : y <> x) by
          (intro E; subst y; exact (HxD (@binds_in_dom init_typ Delta y committed Hy)));
        eapply LibEnv.binds_push_neq; [exact Hy|exact Hne] end.
Qed.

Lemma free_heap_defs_extend : forall (D:init_ctx) (E:eff_ctx) (y:var) (hds:heap_defs) (x:var),
  free_heap_defs D E y hds ->
  x \notin dom D -> x \notin dom E ->
  free_heap_defs (D & x ~ committed) E y hds.
Proof.
  intros D E y hds x [Hb [Hbe Hwp]] HxD HxE. split; [|split].
  - assert (Hne : y <> x).
    { intro E; subst y.
      assert (HyE : x \in dom E) by (eapply binds_in_dom; eexact Hbe).
      exact (HxE HyE). }
    eapply LibEnv.binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|exact Hne].
  - exact Hbe.
  - intros z Hz. destruct (Hwp z Hz) as [Hc|[HzE Hf]].
    + assert (Hzx : z <> x).
      { intro E; subst z; exact (HxD (@binds_in_dom init_typ D z committed Hc)). }
      left. eapply LibEnv.binds_push_neq; [exact Hc|exact Hzx].
    + assert (Hzx : z <> x) by (intro E; subst z; exact (HxE HzE)).
      right. split; [exact HzE|].
      eapply LibEnv.binds_push_neq; [exact Hf|exact Hzx].
Qed.

Lemma free_heap_item_extend : forall (D:init_ctx) (E:eff_ctx) (y:var) (itm:item) (x:var),
  free_heap_item D E y itm ->
  x \notin dom D -> x \notin dom E ->
  free_heap_item (D & x ~ committed) E y itm.
Proof.
  intros D E y itm x H HxD HxE. inversion H; subst.
  apply free_heap_obj. eapply free_heap_defs_extend; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heaps_dom_in : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (Es:list eff_ctx),
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es ->
  forall E, List.In E Es -> forall x, x \in dom E -> x \in dom Sigma.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma Es H. induction H; intros E0 Hin x Hx.
  - inversion Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [->|Hin].

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Typing Initialization InitTyping InitWeakening GeneralTyping.

Inductive committed_heap_def : init_ctx -> heap_def -> Prop :=

| committed_heap_def_typ : forall Delta A T,
    committed_heap_def Delta (heap_def_typ A T)

| committed_heap_def_trm : forall Delta a x,
    binds x committed Delta ->
    committed_heap_def Delta (heap_def_trm a (Some x)).

Inductive committed_heap_defs : init_ctx -> heap_defs -> Prop :=
| committed_heap_defs_nil : forall Delta,
    committed_heap_defs Delta nil

| committed_heap_defs_cons : forall Delta hd hds,
    committed_heap_defs Delta hds ->
    committed_heap_def Delta hd ->
    committed_heap_defs Delta (cons hd hds).

Inductive committed_heap_item :
  ctx -> init_ctx -> item -> Prop :=

| committed_heap_lit : forall Gamma Delta l,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c l ->
    committed_heap_item Gamma Delta (item_lit l)

| committed_heap_obj : forall Gamma Delta T hds,
    committed_heap_defs Delta hds ->
    committed_heap_item Gamma Delta (item_obj T hds).

Definition well_committed_heap (Gamma : ctx) (Delta : init_ctx) (Sigma : heap) :=
  dom Gamma = dom Delta /\
  dom Delta = dom Sigma /\
  forall x itm,
    binds x committed Delta ->
    binds x itm Sigma ->
    committed_heap_item Gamma Delta itm.

Definition more_committed Delta Delta' :=
  (forall x, binds x committed Delta -> binds x committed Delta').
=====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Effects.

Require Import FreeItems.

Definition free_sub_heap (ℰ : eff_ctx) (Sigma : heap) (Delta : init_ctx) :=
  forall x effs,

    binds x effs ℰ ->
    (forall y a, (y,a) \in (from_list effs) -> y = x) /\

    exists itm, binds x itm Sigma /\

                free_heap_item Delta ℰ x itm.

committed_heap_defs D hds ->
  committed_heap_defs (D & x ~ committed) hds.
Proof.
  intros D hds x HxD H. induction H.
  - apply committed_heap_defs_nil.
  - apply committed_heap_defs_cons; [exact (IHcommitted_heap_defs HxD)|].
    inversion H0; subst.

          (intro E; subst y; exact (HxD (@binds_in_dom init_typ Delta y committed Hy)));
        eapply LibEnv.binds_push_neq; [exact Hy|exact Hne] end.
Qed.

  committed_heap_defs D hds ->

  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es ->
  forall E, List.In E Es -> forall x, x \in dom E -> x \in dom Sigma.

      destruct (H0 x effs Hb) as [_ [itm [HbS _]]].

  | inert_typ_all : forall S T, inert_typ (typ_all S T)

| ty_def_typ : forall G A T,
    G ⊢ def_typ A T ∶d dec_typ A T T

| ty_def_trm : forall G a t T,
    G ⊢ def_trm a ∶d dec_trm a T T.

| ty_var : forall G x T,
    binds x T G ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T

| ty_all_elim : forall G x z S T,

    G ⊢ trm_new (avar_f x) avs ∶ typ_bnd (open_rec_vars 1 xs T)

| ty_let : forall L G t u T U,
    G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open x u ∶ U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_let T t u ∶ U

| ty_llit : forall L G l u T U,
    G ⊢ l ∶ T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->

    G ⊢ trm_lit T l u ∶ U

    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T

| ty_rec_elim : forall G x T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x T

    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_and T U

| ty_sub : forall G (t : trm) T U,
    G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    G ⊢ T <: U ->
    G ⊢ t ∶ U

with ty_lit : Typing lit :=

| ty_all_intro : forall L G T t U,
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open x t ∶ open x U) ->
    G ⊢ lit_fun T t ∶ typ_all T U

| ty_con_intro : forall L G Ts is' T ds t T',
    (forall x ys,
        length ys = length_s Ts ->
        fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys) ->
        G & (ys ~** (to_list Ts))
        & (x ~ open_vars (cons x ys) T)
            ⊢ (open_vars (cons x ys) ds)
            ∶ (open_vars (cons x ys) T)) ->
    (forall x ys,
        length ys = length_s Ts ->
        fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys) ->
        (G & (ys ~** (to_list Ts)) & (x ~ open_vars (cons x ys) T)
            ⊢ (open_vars (cons x ys) t)
            ∶ (open_vars (cons x ys) T'))) ->
    G ⊢ lit_con Ts is' T ds t ∶ typ_con Ts is' T

with subtyp : Subtyping :=

| subtyp_top: forall G T,
    G ⊢ T <: typ_top

| subtyp_bot: forall G T,
    G ⊢ typ_bot <: T

| subtyp_refl: forall G T,
    G ⊢ T <: T

| subtyp_trans: forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T ->
    G ⊢ T <: U ->
    G ⊢ S <: U

| subtyp_and11: forall G T U,
    G ⊢ typ_and T U <: T

| subtyp_and12: forall G T U,
    G ⊢ typ_and T U <: U

| subtyp_and2: forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T ->
    G ⊢ S <: U ->
    G ⊢ S <: typ_and T U

| subtyp_fld: forall G a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    G ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G ⊢ U1 <: U2 ->
    G ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_trm a T2 U1) <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a T1 U2)

| subtyp_typ: forall G A S1 T1 S2 T2,

    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) A <: T

| subtyp_all: forall L G S1 T1 S2 T2,
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       G & x ~ S2 ⊢ open x T1 <: open x T2) ->
    G ⊢ typ_all S1 T1 <: typ_all S2 T2

with ty_avars : Typings (list avar) :=
     | typ_avars_nil : forall G,

     | typ_avars_cons : forall G x T avs Ts,
         G ⊢ (trm_var (avar_f x)) ∶ T ->
         G ⊢ avs :: Ts ->
         G ⊢ (cons (avar_f x) avs) :: (typs_cons T Ts).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping.

Require Import Effects Initialization InitTyping.

Inductive ty_stack :
  ctx -> init_ctx -> list eff_ctx -> stack ->
  typ -> init_typ -> list effects -> typ -> Prop :=

  | ty_stack_nil : forall Gamma Delta T U ℰ i,
      Gamma ⊢ T <: U ->
              ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: nil)
                       nil T i
                       (nil :: nil)%list U

  | ty_stack_let : forall L Gamma Delta ℰ ℰs Fs t S i i' T effs effss effs' U,
      ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs)
               Fs T i'
               (effs :: effss) U ->
      (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ S ⊢ open x t ∶ T) ->
      (forall x,
          x \notin L ->
          Gamma & x ~ S ⸴ Delta & x ~ i ⸴ dom ℰ \u \{ x} ⊢i open x t ∶ i') ->
      (forall x, x \notin L -> ⊢e open x t ∶ effs') ->
      ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs)
               (frame_let t :: Fs)%list S i
               ((effs' ++ effs) :: effss)%list U

  | ty_stack_ret_free : forall Gamma Delta ℰ ℰs Fs x S i effs effss T U,
      ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs)
               Fs T free
               (effs :: effss) U ->
      Gamma ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
      Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ (dom ℰ) ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ free ->
      ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs)
               (frame_ret x :: Fs)%list S i
               (effs :: effss)%list U

  | ty_stack_ret_committed : forall Gamma Delta ℰ ℰs Fs x S i effss T U,
      ty_stack Gamma Delta ℰs
               Fs T committed
               effss U ->
      Gamma ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->

      Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ (dom ℰ) ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ free ->
      ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs)
               (frame_ret x :: Fs)%list S i
               (nil :: effss)%list U.
====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Effects.

Definition eff_ctx_corr_one (ℰ : eff_ctx) effs :=
  (forall x effs', binds x effs' ℰ ->
                   forall eff, (eff \in (from_list effs')) ->
                               (eff \in (from_list effs))).

Inductive eff_ctx_corr : list eff_ctx -> list effects -> Prop :=

| eff_ctx_corr_nil : eff_ctx_corr nil nil

| eff_ctx_corr_cons : forall ℰ ℰs effs effss,
    eff_ctx_corr ℰs effss ->
    eff_ctx_corr_one ℰ effs ->
    eff_ctx_corr (ℰ :: ℰs) (effs :: effss).
====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Definition inert_inits Delta :=
  forall x init, binds x init Delta ->
            init = free \/ init = committed.

Proof. intros a A [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_all : forall (S T:typ), record_type (typ_all S T) -> False.
Proof. intros S T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_con : forall (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (T:typ), record_type (typ_con Ts is' T) -> False.
Proof. intros Ts is' T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), record_type (typ_bnd T) -> False.
Proof. intros T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_not_top : inert_typ typ_top -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_bot : inert_typ typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_sel : forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), inert_typ (typ_sel a A) -> False.
Proof. intros a A H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_rcd : forall (D:dec), inert_typ (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_and : forall (T U:typ), inert_typ (typ_and T U) -> False.
Proof. intros T U H. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Shape of precise flow tips in an inert setting *)

Lemma flow_shape : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  inert_typ T0 ->
  binds x T0 G ->
  (V = T0 /\ inert_typ T0) \/ record_type V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf; intros Hi Hb.
  - left. split; [reflexivity|assumption].
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + inversion Heq; subst. inversion Hi2; subst.
      right. apply record_type_open. assumption.
    + exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exists ls. exact Hr.
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists ls'. exact (proj1 HP).
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists (\{label_of D}).
      assert (HeqU : U2 = typ_rcd D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 HP)).
      assert (Hrd : record_dec D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 HP))).
      rewrite HeqU. apply rt_one; [exact Hrd|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma flow_typing : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf.
  - apply ty_var. assumption.
  - eapply ty_rec_elim. exact IHHf.
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and11].
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and12].
Qed.

(** * Corollaries: no flow tip is a top/bottom/selection type *)

Lemma flow_not_top : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_top -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_top Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_top Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_top. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_bot : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_bot -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_bot Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_bot Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_bot. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_sel : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ) (a:avar) (A:typ_label),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_sel a A -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 a A Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 (typ_sel a A) Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_sel a A Hi2).
  - exact (@record_type_not_sel a A Hr).
Qed.

Lemma flow_bnd_eq : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 U:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->

Proof.
  intros x G T0 U Hi Hb Hf.

  - exact Heq.
  - exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma record_has_rcd_inv : forall (D D':dec), record_has (typ_rcd D) D' -> D' = D.
Proof. intros D D' H. inversion H; subst; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma record_has_and_inv : forall (T U:typ) (D:dec),
  record_has (typ_and T U) D -> record_has T D \/ record_has U D.
Proof. intros T U D H. inversion H; subst; [left|right]; assumption. Qed.

Lemma defs_update_label_in : forall (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  exists d, List.In d hds /\ label_of d = label_trm a.
Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y H. induction H.
  - exists (heap_def_trm a o). split; [apply List.in_eq|reflexivity].
  - destruct IHdefs_update as [d0 [Hin Hl]]. exists d0.
    split; [apply List.in_cons; exact Hin|exact Hl].
Qed.

Lemma labels_hasnt_update : forall (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (l:label),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  labels_hasnt hds l ->
  labels_hasnt hds' l.
Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y l Hup. revert l. induction Hup; intros l Hl.
  - unfold labels_hasnt in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classic (label_trm a = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_trm a = l) _ _ E) in Hl. discriminate.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_trm a = l) _ _ NE) in Hl.
      rewrite (If_r (P:=label_trm a = l) _ _ NE). exact Hl.
  - unfold labels_hasnt in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classic (label_of d = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_of d = l) _ _ E) in Hl. discriminate.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of d = l) _ _ NE) in Hl.
      rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of d = l) _ _ NE).
      eapply IHHup. exact Hl.
Qed.

(** * Shape of precise flow tips in an inert setting *)

Lemma flow_shape : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  inert_typ T0 ->
  binds x T0 G ->
  (V = T0 /\ inert_typ T0) \/ record_type V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf; intros Hi Hb.
  - left. split; [reflexivity|assumption].
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + inversion Heq; subst. inversion Hi2; subst.
      right. apply record_type_open. assumption.
    + exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exists ls. exact Hr.
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists ls'. exact (proj1 HP).
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists (\{label_of D}).
      assert (HeqU : U2 = typ_rcd D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 HP)).
      assert (Hrd : record_dec D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 HP))).
      rewrite HeqU. apply rt_one; [exact Hrd|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma flow_typing : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf.
  - apply ty_var. assumption.
  - eapply ty_rec_elim. exact IHHf.
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and11].
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and12].
Qed.

(** * Corollaries: no flow tip is a top/bottom/selection type *)

Lemma flow_not_top : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_top -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_top Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_top Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_top. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_bot : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),

Proof.

  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_bot Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_bot. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_sel : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ) (a:avar) (A:typ_label),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_sel a A -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 a A Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 (typ_sel a A) Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].

Lemma record_has_rcd_inv : forall (D D':dec), record_has (typ_rcd D) D' -> D' = D.
Proof. intros D D' H. inversion H; subst; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma record_has_and_inv : forall (T U:typ) (D:dec),
  record_has (typ_and T U) D -> record_has T D \/ record_has U D.
Proof. intros T U D H. inversion H; subst; [left|right]; assumption. Qed.

Lemma defs_update_label_in : forall (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  exists d, List.In d hds /\ label_of d = label_trm a.
Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y H. induction H.
  - exists (heap_def_trm a o). split; [apply List.in_eq|reflexivity].
  - destruct IHdefs_update as [d0 [Hin Hl]]. exists d0.

Lemma labels_hasnt_update : forall (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (l:label),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  labels_hasnt hds l ->
  labels_hasnt hds' l.
Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y l Hup. revert l. induction Hup; intros l Hl.
  - unfold labels_hasnt in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classic (label_trm a = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_trm a = l) _ _ E) in Hl. discriminate.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_trm a = l) _ _ NE) in Hl.

  - unfold labels_hasnt in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classic (label_of d = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_of d = l) _ _ E) in Hl. discriminate.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of d = l) _ _ NE) in Hl.
      rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of d = l) _ _ NE).

    + (* head updated: d = heap_def_trm a o *)

      { destruct (@record_has_and_inv T (typ_rcd D) (dec_trm a Tf Tf) Hrh) as [HinTs|HinR].
        - destruct (ty_heap_defs_correspond H) as [ls [_ [_ Hbwd]]].

          exfalso. eapply (labels_hasnt_sound H1 d0 Hin0).
          rewrite <- Heq0. reflexivity.
        - symmetry. eapply record_has_rcd_inv. eassumption. }
      subst D. eapply ty_defs_cons.
      * exact H.
      * eapply ty_heap_def_trm_some. exact Hy.
      * simpl. exact H1.
    + (* update in the tail *)
      assert (Htail : defs_update ds a y hds'0) by
        (match goal with Hx : defs_update ds _ _ hds'0 |- _ => exact Hx end).
      eapply ty_defs_cons.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping.

Require Import Effects Initialization InitLookup.

Implicit Types (i : init_typ) (t : trm) (l : lit).

Inductive all_comm_unspec : inits -> Prop :=
| all_comm_unspec_nil : all_comm_unspec nil
| all_comm_unspec_cons : forall i is',
    (i = committed) \/ (i = unspecified) ->
    all_comm_unspec is' ->
    all_comm_unspec (cons i is').

Inductive well_committed : CommitTyping trm :=

| commit_var : forall Gamma Delta x,
    binds x committed Delta ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c (trm_var (avar_f x))

| commit_all_elim : forall Gamma Delta x z,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f z) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_app (avar_f x) (avar_f z)

| commit_new : forall Gamma Delta x avs Ts is' T,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_con Ts is' T ->
    all_comm_unspec is' ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c avs ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_new (avar_f x) avs

| commit_rcd_elim : forall Gamma Delta x a,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_sel (avar_f x) a

| commit_fld_asn : forall Gamma Delta x i y a,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f y) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)

| commit_let : forall L Gamma Delta t u T,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c t ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ committed ⊢c open x u) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_let T t u

| commit_llit : forall L Gamma Delta l u T,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c l ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ committed ⊢c open x u) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_lit T l u

with well_committed_avars : CommitTyping avars :=
     | committed_nil : forall Gamma Delta,
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c nil

     | committed_cons : forall Gamma Delta x avs,
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c (trm_var (avar_f x)) ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c avs ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c (cons (avar_f x) avs)

with well_committed_lit : CommitTyping lit :=

     | commit_all_intro : forall L Gamma Delta T t,
         (forall x, x \notin L ->
               Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ committed ⊢c open x t) ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c lit_fun T t

     | commit_con_intro : forall L Gamma Delta Ts is' T i ds t,
         length is' = length_s Ts ->
         (forall x ys,
             length ys = length_s Ts ->
             fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys) ->
             has_effs (open_vars (cons x ys) t) (def_eff x ds)) ->
         (forall x ys,
             length ys = length_s Ts ->
             fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys) ->
             (Gamma & (ys ~** (to_list Ts))
              & (x ~ open_vars (cons x ys) T) ⸴ Delta
              & (ys ~** is') & (x ~ free) ⸴ (from_list ys) \u \{ x}
                                          ⊢i (open_vars (cons x ys) t) ∶ i)) ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c lit_con Ts is' T ds t

with well_init : InitTyping trm :=

| init_var_binds : forall Gamma Delta vs x i,

    init_var Delta vs x i ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ i

| init_commit : forall Gamma Delta t vs,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c t ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i t ∶ committed

| init_new_free : forall Gamma Delta vs x avs Ts is' T,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_con Ts is' T ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i avs :: is' ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_new (avar_f x) avs ∶ free

| init_fld_asn_ac : forall Gamma Delta vs x i y a,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ i ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ committed ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ committed

| init_fld_asn_ff : forall Gamma Delta vs x y a,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ free ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ free ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ free

| init_let : forall L Gamma Delta vs t u T i i',
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i t ∶ i ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ i ⸴ vs \u \{ x} ⊢i open x u ∶ i') ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_let T t u ∶ i'

| init_llit : forall L Gamma Delta vs l u T i,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c l ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ committed ⸴ vs ⊢i open x u ∶ i) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_lit T l u ∶ i

with well_inits : InitTypings avars :=
     | well_inits_nil : forall Gamma Delta vs,
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i nil :: nil

     | well_inits_cons : forall Gamma Delta vs x i avs is',
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i (trm_var (avar_f x)) ∶ i ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i avs :: is' ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i (cons (avar_f x) avs) :: (cons i is').

Existing Instance well_committed.

Existing Instance well_committed_avars.

Existing Instance well_init.

Existing Instance well_inits.

Existing Instance well_committed_lit.

Scheme well_committed_mut        := Induction for well_committed Sort Prop
with   well_committed_avars_mut  := Induction for well_committed_avars Sort Prop
with   well_committed_lit_mut    := Induction for well_committed_lit Sort Prop
with   well_init_mut             := Induction for well_init Sort Prop
with   well_inits_mut            := Induction for well_inits Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme well_init_mut_ind from
         well_committed_mut, well_committed_avars_mut, well_committed_lit_mut,
         well_init_mut, well_inits_mut.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Notation effect := (var * trm_label)%type.

Notation effects := (list effect).

Notation eff_ctx := (env effects).

Fixpoint def_eff (x : var) (ds : defs) : (list effect) :=
  match ds with
  | nil => nil
  | (def_typ _ _) :: ds => def_eff x ds
  | (def_trm l) :: ds => (x,l) :: (def_eff x ds)
  end%list.

Reserved Notation "'⊢e' t '∶' eff"
         (at level 40, t at level 59).

Inductive eff_trm :
  trm -> effects -> Prop :=

| eff_ignore : forall t,
    ⊢e t ∶ nil

| eff_fld_asn : forall x a y,
    ⊢e trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ ((x,a) :: nil)

| eff_let : forall L T t u eff1 eff2,
    ⊢e t ∶ eff1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> ⊢e open x u ∶ eff2) ->
    ⊢e trm_let T t u ∶ (eff1 ++ eff2)

| eff_llit : forall L T l u eff,
    (forall x, x \notin L -> ⊢e open x u ∶ eff) ->
    ⊢e trm_lit T l u ∶ eff

where "'⊢e' t '∶' eff" := (eff_trm t eff).

Definition has_effs t effs := exists effs',
    ⊢e t ∶ effs' /\ from_list effs = from_list effs'.
====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Effects.

Fixpoint heap_defs_effs (x : var) (hds : heap_defs) : effects :=
  match hds with
  | nil                             => nil
  | (heap_def_typ _ _)        :: ds => heap_defs_effs x ds
  | (heap_def_trm l (Some _)) :: ds => heap_defs_effs x ds
  | (heap_def_trm l None)     :: ds => (x,l) :: (heap_defs_effs x ds)
  end%list.
====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Inductive defs_update : heap_defs -> trm_label -> var -> heap_defs -> Prop :=

| defs_update_var : forall hds a o x,
    defs_update (cons (heap_def_trm a o) hds)
                a x
                (cons (heap_def_trm a (Some x)) hds)
| defs_update_push : forall hds d a x hds',
    defs_update hds a x hds' ->
    defs_update (cons d hds) a x (cons d hds').

Definition heap_update (Sigma : heap) (x : var) (a : trm_label) (y : var) (Sigma' : heap) :=
  exists T hds hds' Sigma1 Sigma2,
    (Sigma = Sigma1 & x ~ (item_obj T hds) & Sigma2) /\
    (x # Sigma2) /\
    (defs_update hds a y hds') /\
    (Sigma' = Sigma1 & x ~ (item_obj T hds') & Sigma2).

Definition vs_subset (vs vs' : vars) : Prop :=
  forall x, x \in vs -> x \in vs'.

Lemma vs_subset_remove : forall (vs vs':vars) (x:var),
  vs_subset vs vs' -> vs_subset (vs \u \{x}) (vs' \u \{x}).
Proof.
  intros vs vs' x H y Hy. rewrite in_union in Hy. rewrite in_union.
  destruct Hy as [Hy|Hy]; [left; apply H; exact Hy|right; exact Hy].
Qed.

Lemma init_var_transfer : forall (Delta Delta':init_ctx) (vs vs':vars) (x:var) (i:init_typ),
  binds_extends Delta Delta' -> vs_subset vs vs' ->
  init_var Delta vs x i -> init_var Delta' vs' x i.
Proof.
  intros Delta Delta' vs vs' x i He Hvs H. induction H.
  - apply init_var_commit. apply He. exact H.
  - apply init_var_free; auto.
  - apply init_var_unspec; auto.
  - apply init_var_sub with (i':=i'); auto.
Qed.

Lemma hc_commit_var : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (x:var),
  binds x committed D ->
  forall G' D' vs vs', binds_extends G G' -> binds_extends D D' ->
    vs_subset vs vs' -> G' ⸴ D' ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x).
Proof. intros. apply commit_var. apply H1. exact H. Qed.

Lemma hc_commit_all_elim : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (x z:var),
  (forall G' D' vs vs', binds_extends G G' -> binds_extends D D' ->
