Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing.

Implicit Types (Gamma G : ctx) (T U : typ) (x y z : var) (t : trm).

Inductive ty_def : DecTyping def :=

| ty_def_typ : forall G A T,
    G ⊢ def_typ A T ∶d dec_typ A T T

| ty_def_trm : forall G a t T,
    G ⊢ def_trm a ∶d dec_trm a T T.

Existing Instance ty_def.

Inductive ty_trm : Typing trm :=

| ty_var : forall G x T,
    binds x T G ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T

| ty_all_elim : forall G x z S T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_all S T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ S ->
    G ⊢ trm_app (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ∶ open z T

| ty_new : forall G x avs xs Ts is' T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_con Ts is' T ->
    G ⊢ avs :: Ts ->
    vars_of_avars xs avs ->
    G ⊢ trm_new (avar_f x) avs ∶ typ_bnd (open_rec_vars 1 xs T)

| ty_rcd_elim : forall G x a S T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T) ->
    G ⊢ trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ T

| ty_fld_asn : forall G x y a S T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T) ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S ->
    G ⊢ trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ T

| ty_let : forall L G t u T U,
    G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open x u ∶ U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_let T t u ∶ U

| ty_llit : forall L G l u T U,
    G ⊢ l ∶ T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open x u ∶ U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_lit T l u ∶ U

| ty_rec_intro : forall G x T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T

| ty_rec_elim : forall G x T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x T

| ty_and_intro : forall G x T U,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_and T U

| ty_sub : forall G (t : trm) T U,
    G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    G ⊢ T <: U ->
    G ⊢ t ∶ U

with ty_lit : Typing lit :=

| ty_all_intro : forall L G T t U,
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open x t ∶ open x U) ->
    G ⊢ lit_fun T t ∶ typ_all T U

| ty_con_intro : forall L G Ts is' T ds t T',
    (forall x ys,
        length ys = length_s Ts ->
        fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys) ->
        G & (ys ~** (to_list Ts))
        & (x ~ open_vars (cons x ys) T)
            ⊢ (open_vars (cons x ys) ds)
            ∶ (open_vars (cons x ys) T)) ->
    (forall x ys,
        length ys = length_s Ts ->
        fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys) ->
        (G & (ys ~** (to_list Ts)) & (x ~ open_vars (cons x ys) T)
            ⊢ (open_vars (cons x ys) t)
            ∶ (open_vars (cons x ys) T'))) ->
    G ⊢ lit_con Ts is' T ds t ∶ typ_con Ts is' T

with subtyp : Subtyping :=

| subtyp_top: forall G T,
    G ⊢ T <: typ_top

| subtyp_bot: forall G T,
    G ⊢ typ_bot <: T

| subtyp_refl: forall G T,
    G ⊢ T <: T

| subtyp_trans: forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T ->
    G ⊢ T <: U ->
    G ⊢ S <: U

| subtyp_and11: forall G T U,
    G ⊢ typ_and T U <: T

| subtyp_and12: forall G T U,
    G ⊢ typ_and T U <: U

| subtyp_and2: forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T ->
    G ⊢ S <: U ->
    G ⊢ S <: typ_and T U

| subtyp_fld: forall G a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    G ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G ⊢ U1 <: U2 ->
    G ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_trm a T2 U1) <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a T1 U2)

| subtyp_typ: forall G A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    G ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)

| subtyp_sel2: forall G x A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G ⊢ S <: typ_sel (avar_f x) A

| subtyp_sel1: forall G x A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) A <: T

| subtyp_all: forall L G S1 T1 S2 T2,
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       G & x ~ S2 ⊢ open x T1 <: open x T2) ->
    G ⊢ typ_all S1 T1 <: typ_all S2 T2

with ty_avars : Typings (list avar) :=
     | typ_avars_nil : forall G,
         G ⊢ nil :: typs_nil

     | typ_avars_cons : forall G x T avs Ts,
         G ⊢ (trm_var (avar_f x)) ∶ T ->
         G ⊢ avs :: Ts ->
         G ⊢ (cons (avar_f x) avs) :: (typs_cons T Ts).

Existing Instance ty_trm.

Existing Instance ty_avars.

Existing Instance subtyp.

Existing Instance ty_lit | 1.

Scheme ts_ty_trm_mut := Induction for ty_trm Sort Prop
with   ts_subtyp     := Induction for subtyp Sort Prop
with   ts_ty_avars   := Induction for ty_avars Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme ts_mutind from ts_ty_trm_mut, ts_subtyp, ts_ty_avars.

Scheme rules_trm_mut    := Induction for ty_trm Sort Prop
with   rules_lit_mut    := Induction for ty_lit Sort Prop
with   rules_subtyp     := Induction for subtyp Sort Prop
with   rules_avars_mut  := Induction for ty_avars Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme rules_mutind from rules_trm_mut, rules_lit_mut,
rules_subtyp, rules_avars_mut.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Typing PreTyping.

Require Import GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping PreciseTyping.

Require Import SubstitutionClass Substitution Weakening Narrowing BndIntro.

Inductive ty_heap_def : DecTyping heap_def :=

| ty_heap_def_typ : forall Gamma A T,
    Gamma ⊢ heap_def_typ A T ∶d dec_typ A T T

| ty_heap_def_trm_none : forall Gamma a T,
    Gamma ⊢ heap_def_trm a None ∶d dec_trm a T T

| ty_heap_def_trm_some : forall Gamma a x T,
    Gamma ⊢ (trm_var (avar_f x)) ∶ T ->
    Gamma ⊢ heap_def_trm a (Some x) ∶d dec_trm a T T.

Existing Instance ty_heap_def.

Inductive ty_item_s : ctx -> heap -> var -> Prop :=
| ty_item_lit_s : forall Gamma Sigma x l T,
    binds x T Gamma ->
    binds x (item_lit l) Sigma ->
    Gamma ⊢ l ∶ T ->
    ty_item_s Gamma Sigma x
| ty_item_obj_s : forall Gamma Sigma x U hds,
    binds x (typ_bnd U) Gamma ->
    binds x (item_obj U hds) Sigma ->
    Gamma ⊢ hds ∶ open x U ->
    ty_item_s Gamma Sigma x.

Definition heap_correspond (G : ctx) (Sigma : heap) : Prop :=
  (dom G = dom Sigma) /\
  (forall x,
      x \in dom G ->
      ty_item_s G Sigma x).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping.

Require Import Effects Initialization InitLookup.

Implicit Types (i : init_typ) (t : trm) (l : lit).

Inductive all_comm_unspec : inits -> Prop :=
| all_comm_unspec_nil : all_comm_unspec nil
| all_comm_unspec_cons : forall i is',
    (i = committed) \/ (i = unspecified) ->
    all_comm_unspec is' ->
    all_comm_unspec (cons i is').

Inductive well_committed : CommitTyping trm :=

| commit_var : forall Gamma Delta x,
    binds x committed Delta ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c (trm_var (avar_f x))

| commit_all_elim : forall Gamma Delta x z,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f z) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_app (avar_f x) (avar_f z)

| commit_new : forall Gamma Delta x avs Ts is' T,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_con Ts is' T ->
    all_comm_unspec is' ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c avs ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_new (avar_f x) avs

| commit_rcd_elim : forall Gamma Delta x a,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_sel (avar_f x) a

| commit_fld_asn : forall Gamma Delta x i y a,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f y) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)

| commit_let : forall L Gamma Delta t u T,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c t ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ committed ⊢c open x u) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_let T t u

| commit_llit : forall L Gamma Delta l u T,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c l ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ committed ⊢c open x u) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_lit T l u

with well_committed_avars : CommitTyping avars :=
     | committed_nil : forall Gamma Delta,
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c nil

     | committed_cons : forall Gamma Delta x avs,
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c (trm_var (avar_f x)) ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c avs ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c (cons (avar_f x) avs)

with well_committed_lit : CommitTyping lit :=

     | commit_all_intro : forall L Gamma Delta T t,
         (forall x, x \notin L ->
               Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ committed ⊢c open x t) ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c lit_fun T t

     | commit_con_intro : forall L Gamma Delta Ts is' T i ds t,
         length is' = length_s Ts ->
         (forall x ys,
             length ys = length_s Ts ->
             fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys) ->
             has_effs (open_vars (cons x ys) t) (def_eff x ds)) ->
         (forall x ys,
             length ys = length_s Ts ->
             fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys) ->
             (Gamma & (ys ~** (to_list Ts))
              & (x ~ open_vars (cons x ys) T) ⸴ Delta
              & (ys ~** is') & (x ~ free) ⸴ (from_list ys) \u \{ x}
                                          ⊢i (open_vars (cons x ys) t) ∶ i)) ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c lit_con Ts is' T ds t

with well_init : InitTyping trm :=

| init_var_binds : forall Gamma Delta vs x i,

    init_var Delta vs x i ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ i

| init_commit : forall Gamma Delta t vs,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c t ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i t ∶ committed

| init_new_free : forall Gamma Delta vs x avs Ts is' T,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_con Ts is' T ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i avs :: is' ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_new (avar_f x) avs ∶ free

| init_fld_asn_ac : forall Gamma Delta vs x i y a,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ i ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ committed ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ committed

| init_fld_asn_ff : forall Gamma Delta vs x y a,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ free ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ free ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ free

| init_let : forall L Gamma Delta vs t u T i i',
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i t ∶ i ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ i ⸴ vs \u \{ x} ⊢i open x u ∶ i') ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_let T t u ∶ i'

| init_llit : forall L Gamma Delta vs l u T i,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c l ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ committed ⸴ vs ⊢i open x u ∶ i) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_lit T l u ∶ i

with well_inits : InitTypings avars :=
     | well_inits_nil : forall Gamma Delta vs,
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i nil :: nil

     | well_inits_cons : forall Gamma Delta vs x i avs is',
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i (trm_var (avar_f x)) ∶ i ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i avs :: is' ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i (cons (avar_f x) avs) :: (cons i is').

Existing Instance well_committed.

Existing Instance well_committed_avars.

Existing Instance well_init.

Existing Instance well_inits.

Existing Instance well_committed_lit.

Scheme well_committed_mut        := Induction for well_committed Sort Prop
with   well_committed_avars_mut  := Induction for well_committed_avars Sort Prop
with   well_committed_lit_mut    := Induction for well_committed_lit Sort Prop
with   well_init_mut             := Induction for well_init Sort Prop
with   well_inits_mut            := Induction for well_inits Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme well_init_mut_ind from
         well_committed_mut, well_committed_avars_mut, well_committed_lit_mut,
         well_init_mut, well_inits_mut.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Typing Initialization InitTyping InitWeakening GeneralTyping.

Inductive committed_heap_def : init_ctx -> heap_def -> Prop :=

| committed_heap_def_typ : forall Delta A T,
    committed_heap_def Delta (heap_def_typ A T)

| committed_heap_def_trm : forall Delta a x,
    binds x committed Delta ->
    committed_heap_def Delta (heap_def_trm a (Some x)).

Inductive committed_heap_defs : init_ctx -> heap_defs -> Prop :=
| committed_heap_defs_nil : forall Delta,
    committed_heap_defs Delta nil

| committed_heap_defs_cons : forall Delta hd hds,
    committed_heap_defs Delta hds ->
    committed_heap_def Delta hd ->
    committed_heap_defs Delta (cons hd hds).

Inductive committed_heap_item :
  ctx -> init_ctx -> item -> Prop :=

| committed_heap_lit : forall Gamma Delta l,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c l ->
    committed_heap_item Gamma Delta (item_lit l)

| committed_heap_obj : forall Gamma Delta T hds,
    committed_heap_defs Delta hds ->
    committed_heap_item Gamma Delta (item_obj T hds).

Definition well_committed_heap (Gamma : ctx) (Delta : init_ctx) (Sigma : heap) :=
  dom Gamma = dom Delta /\
  dom Delta = dom Sigma /\
  forall x itm,
    binds x committed Delta ->
    binds x itm Sigma ->

Lemma flow_shape : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  inert_typ T0 ->
  binds x T0 G ->
  (V = T0 /\ inert_typ T0) \/ record_type V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf; intros Hi Hb.
  - left. split; [reflexivity|assumption].
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + inversion Heq; subst. inversion Hi2; subst.
      right. apply record_type_open. assumption.
    + exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exists ls. exact Hr.
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists ls'. exact (proj1 HP).
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists (\{label_of D}).
      assert (HeqU : U2 = typ_rcd D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 HP)).
      assert (Hrd : record_dec D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 HP))).
      rewrite HeqU. apply rt_one; [exact Hrd|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_bot : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_bot -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_bot Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_bot Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_bot. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_sel : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ) (a:avar) (A:typ_label),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_sel a A -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 a A Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 (typ_sel a A) Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_sel a A Hi2).
  - exact (@record_type_not_sel a A Hr).
Qed.

Lemma flow_bnd_eq : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 U:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_bnd U -> typ_bnd U = T0.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 U Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 (typ_bnd U) Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - exact Heq.
  - exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma record_has_rcd_inv : forall (D D':dec), record_has (typ_rcd D) D' -> D' = D.
Proof. intros D D' H. inversion H; subst; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma record_has_and_inv : forall (T U:typ) (D:dec),
  record_has (typ_and T U) D -> record_has T D \/ record_has U D.
Proof. intros T U D H. inversion H; subst; [left|right]; assumption. Qed.

  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  exists d, List.In d hds /\ label_of d = label_trm a.
Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y H. induction H.
  - exists (heap_def_trm a o). split; [apply List.in_eq|reflexivity].
  - destruct IHdefs_update as [d0 [Hin Hl]]. exists d0.
    split; [apply List.in_cons; exact Hin|exact Hl].
Qed.

Lemma labels_hasnt_update : forall (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (l:label),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  labels_hasnt hds l ->

Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y l Hup. revert l. induction Hup; intros l Hl.
  - unfold labels_hasnt in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classic (label_trm a = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_trm a = l) _ _ E) in Hl. discriminate.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_trm a = l) _ _ NE) in Hl.
      rewrite (If_r (P:=label_trm a = l) _ _ NE). exact Hl.
  - unfold labels_hasnt in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classic (label_of d = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_of d = l) _ _ E) in Hl. discriminate.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of d = l) _ _ NE) in Hl.
      rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of d = l) _ _ NE).
      eapply IHHup. exact Hl.
Qed.

Lemma commit_var_binds : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (x:var),
  G ⸴ D ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) -> binds x committed D.
Proof.
  intros G D x H. change (well_committed G D (trm_var (avar_f x))) in H.
  inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma init_sel_commit : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (i:init_typ),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ i ->
  i = committed /\ (G ⸴ D ⊢c trm_sel (avar_f x) a).
Proof.
  intros G D vs x a i H. change (well_init G D vs (trm_sel (avar_f x) a) i) in H.
  inversion H; subst.
  - split; [reflexivity|assumption].
Qed.

Lemma init_app_commit : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars) (x z:var) (i:init_typ),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_app (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ∶ i ->
  i = committed /\ (G ⸴ D ⊢c trm_app (avar_f x) (avar_f z)).
Proof.
  intros G D vs x z i H. change (well_init G D vs (trm_app (avar_f x) (avar_f z)) i) in H.
  inversion H; subst.
  - split; [reflexivity|assumption].
Qed.

Lemma commit_sel_binds : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label),
  G ⸴ D ⊢c trm_sel (avar_f x) a -> binds x committed D.
Proof.
  intros G D x a H. change (well_committed G D (trm_sel (avar_f x) a)) in H.
  inversion H; subst. eapply commit_var_binds; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma commit_app_binds : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (x z:var),
  G ⸴ D ⊢c trm_app (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ->
  binds x committed D /\ binds z committed D.
Proof.
  intros G D x z H. change (well_committed G D (trm_app (avar_f x) (avar_f z))) in H.
  inversion H; subst. split; eapply commit_var_binds; eauto.
Qed.

(** * Generic environment facts *)

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (A:Type) (E:env A) (x:var) (v:A),
  binds x v E -> x \in dom E.
Proof.
  intros A E x v H.
  eapply (@LibEnv.get_some_inv A x v E).
  eapply LibEnv.binds_get. eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma dom_binds_exists : forall (A:Type) (E:env A) (x:var),
  x \in dom E -> exists v, binds x v E.
Proof.
  intros A E x H. destruct (@LibEnv.get_some A x E H) as [v Hv].
  exists v. exact Hv.
Qed.

(** * Heap correspondence *)

Lemma heap_correspond_dom : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap),
  heap_correspond G Sigma -> dom G = dom Sigma.
Proof. intros G Sigma [Hdom _]. exact Hdom. Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_ty_item : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var),
  heap_correspond G Sigma -> x \in dom G -> ty_item_s G Sigma x.
Proof. intros G Sigma x [_ H]. exact (H x). Qed.

Lemma ty_item_s_obj_inv : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (T:typ) (hds:heap_defs),
  ty_item_s G Sigma x ->
  binds x (item_obj T hds) Sigma ->
  binds x (typ_bnd T) G /\ G ⊢ hds ∶ open x T.
Proof.
  intros G Sigma x T hds Hty Hb. inversion Hty; subst.
  - (* lit item *)
    match goal with
    | Hl : binds x (item_lit l) Sigma |- _ =>
      assert (Heq : item_lit l = item_obj T hds) by
        (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; [exact Hl|exact Hb]);
      discriminate Heq
    end.
  - (* obj item *)
    match goal with
    | Hu : binds x (item_obj U hds0) Sigma |- _ =>
      assert (Heq : item_obj U hds0 = item_obj T hds) by
        (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; [exact Hu|exact Hb]);
      injection Heq as HU Hh; subst; split; assumption
    end.
Qed.

Lemma ty_item_s_lit_inv : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (l:lit),
  ty_item_s G Sigma x ->
  binds x (item_lit l) Sigma ->
  exists T, binds x T G /\ G ⊢ l ∶ T.
Proof.
  intros G Sigma x l Hty Hb. inversion Hty; subst.
  - assert (Heq : item_lit l0 = item_lit l) by
      (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; eassumption).
    injection Heq as Hl. subst. eexists. split; eassumption.
  - match goal with
    | Hu : binds x (item_obj U hds) Sigma |- _ =>
      assert (Heq : item_obj U hds = item_lit l) by
        (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; [exact Hu|exact Hb]);
      discriminate Heq
    end.
Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_obj : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (T:typ) (hds:heap_defs),
  heap_correspond G Sigma ->
  binds x (item_obj T hds) Sigma ->
  binds x (typ_bnd T) G /\ G ⊢ hds ∶ open x T.
Proof.
  intros G Sigma x T hds HC Hb.
  destruct HC as [Hdom Hitem].
  assert (Hin : x \in dom G).
  { rewrite Hdom. eapply binds_in_dom; eexact Hb. }
  eapply ty_item_s_obj_inv; [eapply Hitem; exact Hin|exact Hb].
Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_lit : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (l:lit),
  heap_correspond G Sigma ->
  binds x (item_lit l) Sigma ->
  exists T, binds x T G /\ G ⊢ l ∶ T.
Proof.
  intros G Sigma x l HC Hb.
  destruct HC as [Hdom Hitem].
  assert (Hin : x \in dom G).
  { rewrite Hdom. eapply binds_in_dom; eexact Hb. }
  eapply ty_item_s_lit_inv; [eapply Hitem; exact Hin|exact Hb].
Qed.

(** * Free sub heaps *)

Lemma free_sub_heaps_well_committed : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (Es:list eff_ctx),
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es -> well_committed_heap G D Sigma.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma Es H. induction H.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heaps_cons_inv : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (E:eff_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx),
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma (E :: Es) ->
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D /\ free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma E Es H. inversion H; subst.
  split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heap_item : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (D:init_ctx) (x:var) (effs:effects),
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D ->
  binds x effs E ->
  exists itm, binds x itm Sigma /\ free_heap_item D E x itm.
Proof.
  intros E Sigma D x effs Hf Hb. unfold free_sub_heap in Hf.
  destruct (Hf x effs Hb) as [_ [itm [Hbind Hitem]]].
  exists itm. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma free_heap_item_obj_inv : forall (D:init_ctx) (E:eff_ctx) (y:var) (T:typ) (hds:heap_defs),
  free_heap_item D E y (item_obj T hds) -> free_heap_defs D E y hds.
Proof. intros D E y T hds H. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

(** * Committed heaps *)

Lemma well_committed_heap_item : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (itm:item),
  well_committed_heap G D Sigma ->
  binds x committed D ->
  binds x itm Sigma ->
  committed_heap_item G D itm.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma x itm [_ [_ H]] Hb1 Hb2. eapply H; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_item_obj_inv : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (T:typ) (hds:heap_defs),
  committed_heap_item G D (item_obj T hds) -> committed_heap_defs D hds.
Proof. intros G D T hds H. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_item_lit_inv : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (l:lit),
  committed_heap_item G D (item_lit l) -> G ⸴ D ⊢c l.
Proof. intros G D l H. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

(** * Inert contexts *)

Lemma inert_binds_inert_typ : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (T:typ),

  - (* obj item *)

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax PreTyping.

Class DecTyping (A : Set) := dec_typing : ctx -> A -> dec -> Prop.

Notation "Gamma ⊢ d '∶d' D" := (dec_typing Gamma d D) (at level 40, d at level 59).

Class Typing (A : Set) := typing : ctx -> A -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "Gamma ⊢ t '∶' T" := (typing Gamma t T) (at level 40, t at level 59).

Class Typings (A : Set) := typings : ctx -> A -> typs -> Prop.

Notation "Gamma ⊢ t '::' Ts" := (typings Gamma t Ts) (at level 40, t at level 59).

Class Subtyping := subtyping : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "Gamma ⊢ T '<:' U" := (subtyping Gamma T U) (at level 40, T at level 59).

Section DecTypingLabels.

Context {A : Set} `{LabelOf A}.

Class DecTypingLabels `(DecTyping A) :=
    ty_def_label_eq :
      forall Gamma d D,
        Gamma ⊢ d ∶d D ->
        label_of D = label_of d.

End DecTypingLabels.

Section DecPreTyping.

Context {A : Set} (TyA : DecTyping A).

Instance DecPreTyping : PreTyping dec_typing := {}.

End DecPreTyping.

Existing Instance DecPreTyping.

Section TyPreTyping.

Context {A : Set} (TyA : Typing A).

Instance TyPreTyping : PreTyping typing := {}.

End TyPreTyping.

Existing Instance TyPreTyping.

Section TysPreTyping.

Context {A : Set} (TysA : Typings A).

Instance TysPreTyping : PreTyping typings := {}.

End TysPreTyping.

Section SubPreTyping.

Context {A : Set} {TysA : Subtyping}.

Instance SubPreTyping : PreTyping subtyping := {}.

End SubPreTyping.

Existing Instance SubPreTyping.

Inductive ty_defs {A : Set} `{LabelOf A} `{DecTyping A} : Typing (list A) :=

| ty_defs_one : forall Gamma d D,
    Gamma ⊢ d ∶d D ->
    Gamma ⊢ cons d nil ∶ typ_rcd D

| ty_defs_cons : forall Gamma ds d T D,
    Gamma ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
    Gamma ⊢ d ∶d D ->
    labels_hasnt ds (label_of d) ->
    Gamma ⊢ cons d ds ∶ typ_and T (typ_rcd D).

Existing Instance ty_defs | 1.

Section DefsWeaken.

Context {A : Set} {TyA: DecTyping A}
          (TyWM: PreTypingWeakenMiddle (DecPreTyping TyA)).

Context `{LabelOf A}.

End DefsWeaken.

Section DefsBndIntro.

Context {A : Set} `{TyA : DecTyping A}
          (TyBIM: PreTypingBndIntroMiddle (DecPreTyping TyA)).

Context `{LabelOf A}.

End DefsBndIntro.

Lemma get_labeld_list_in : forall (A:Set) `{LA:LabelOf A}
    (l:label) (ds:list A) (d:A),
  (forall d1 d2, List.In d1 ds -> List.In d2 ds ->
     label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2) ->
  List.In d ds ->
  label_of d = l ->
  get_labeld_list l ds = Some d.
Proof.
  intros A LA l ds. induction ds as [|a ds IH]; intros d Huniq Hin Hl.
  - inversion Hin.
  - cbn.
    destruct (classic (label_of a = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_of a = l) _ _ E).
      f_equal. symmetry. eapply Huniq.
      * exact Hin.
      * apply List.in_eq.
      * rewrite E. exact Hl.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of a = l) _ _ NE).
      destruct Hin as [->|Hin].
      * exfalso. apply NE. exact Hl.
      * eapply IH.
        -- intros d1 d2 I1 I2 E12. eapply Huniq.
           ++ apply List.in_cons. exact I1.
           ++ apply List.in_cons. exact I2.
           ++ exact E12.
        -- exact Hin.
        -- exact Hl.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Notation avars := (list avar).

Instance AvarOpenable : Openable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n = i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarFreeVar : FreeVar avar :=
  fun a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => \{}
    | avar_f x => \{x}
    end.

Instance AvarSubstVar : SubstVar avar :=
  fun (x: var) (y: var) (a: avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f z => (avar_f (If z = x then y else z))
    end.

Instance AvarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax AvarOpenable AvarFreeVar AvarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarDecideFv : DecideFv AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => false
    | avar_f y => (If x = y then true else false)
    end.

Instance AvarClosing : Closing AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun (n : nat) (x : var) (a : avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f y => (If y = x then avar_b n else avar_f y)
    end.

Inductive vars_of_avars : list var -> list avar -> Prop :=
| vars_of_avars_nil : vars_of_avars nil nil
| vars_of_avars_cons : forall x vs avs,
    vars_of_avars vs avs ->
    vars_of_avars (cons x vs) (cons (avar_f x) avs).

Require Import TransformCollect.

Instance AvarsCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax ListAbstractSyntax :=
  fun {C} df f comb => List.fold_right (fun a acc => comb (f a) acc) df.

Instance AvarsTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax ListAbstractSyntax :=
  fun f a n => List.map (fun b => (f b n)) a.

Notation open_depth := (open_depth_rec 0).

Arguments open_depth_rec _ _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Definition closed `{AS: Openable A} a
  := forall n x, open_rec n x a = a.

Fixpoint open_rec_vars `{AS : Openable A} (k: nat) (ys: list var) (X: A): A :=
  match ys with
  | nil => X
  | cons y ys => open_rec_vars (S k) ys (open_rec k y X)
  end.

Notation open_vars := (open_rec_vars 0).

Arguments open_rec_vars _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Class DecideFv `(AS: AbstractSyntax A) := dec_fv : var -> A -> bool.

Arguments dec_fv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Definition dec_notin_fv `{DFv: DecideFv A} x a := negb (dec_fv x a).

Arguments dec_notin_fv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class ReflectFv `(DFv: DecideFv A) :=
  reflect_fv : forall x a,
    (x \in fv a) <-> (dec_fv x a) = true.

Class Closing `(AS: AbstractSyntax A) :=
  close_rec : nat -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Closing.

Notation close := (close_rec 0).

Arguments close_rec _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Definition close_depth_rec `{Cl : Closing A} n x a d
  := close_rec (n + d) x a.

Notation close_depth := (close_depth_rec 0).

Arguments close_depth_rec _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Parameter typ_label: Set.

Parameter trm_label: Set.

Inductive label: Set :=
| label_typ: typ_label -> label
| label_trm: trm_label -> label.

Class LabelOf (A : Type) := label_of : A -> label.

Arguments label_of _ _ !_ /.

Class GetLabeled (B A : Type) `(LabelOf B) :=
  get_labeld : label -> A -> option B.

Arguments get_labeld _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Definition labels_has `{GetLabeled B A} (ds: A) (d: B) :=
  get_labeld (label_of d) ds = Some d.

Definition labels_hasnt `{GetLabeled B A} (ds: A) (l: label) :=
  get_labeld l ds = None.

Class SubstLabel `(SubstVar A) `(LabelOf A) :=
  subst_label: forall x y d,
    label_of (subst_var x y d) = label_of d.

Class OpenTwice `(AS: Openable A) :=
  open_twice : forall n x y,
    (open_rec n y) ∘ (open_rec n x) = (open_rec n x).

Class OpenCommut `(AS: Openable A) :=
    open_commut : forall m n x y,
        m <> n ->
        (open_rec m x) ∘ (open_rec n y) = (open_rec n y) ∘ (open_rec m x).

Class SubstFresh `(AS : AbstractSyntax A) :=
  subst_fresh : forall x y X,
    x \notin fv X -> subst_var x y X = X.

Class SubstOpenCommut `(AS : AbstractSyntax A) :=
  subst_open_commut : forall x y z X n,
    subst_var x y (open_rec n z X)
    = open_rec n (z \[x -> y]) (subst_var x y X).

Class FvOpenCases `(AS : AbstractSyntax A) :=
  fv_open_cases : forall x a n,
    fv (open_rec n x a) = fv a \/
    fv (open_rec n x a) = \{ x} \u fv a.

Class OpenClose `(Cl: Closing A) :=
  open_close : forall n x,
    (open_rec n x) ∘ (close_rec n x) = open_rec n x.

Class CloseOpen `(Cl: Closing A) :=
  close_open : forall n x,
    (close_rec n x) ∘ (open_rec n x) = close_rec n x.

Class SubstOpenClose `(Cl: Closing A) :=
  subst_open_close : forall n x y,
    (subst_var x y) ∘ (open_rec n x) = (open_rec n y) ∘ (close_rec n x).

Class CloseUnbound `(Cl: Closing) :=
  close_unbound : forall x a n,
    x \notin fv a ->
    close_rec n x a = a.

Class OpenInjective `(AS : AbstractSyntax) :=
  open_fresh_injective : forall (X Y : A) k z,
    z \notin fv X ->
    z \notin fv Y ->
    open_rec k z X = open_rec k z Y ->
    X = Y.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Notation effect := (var * trm_label)%type.

Notation effects := (list effect).

Notation eff_ctx := (env effects).

Fixpoint def_eff (x : var) (ds : defs) : (list effect) :=
  match ds with
  | nil => nil
  | (def_typ _ _) :: ds => def_eff x ds
  | (def_trm l) :: ds => (x,l) :: (def_eff x ds)
  end%list.

Reserved Notation "'⊢e' t '∶' eff"
         (at level 40, t at level 59).

Inductive eff_trm :
  trm -> effects -> Prop :=

| eff_ignore : forall t,
    ⊢e t ∶ nil

| eff_fld_asn : forall x a y,
    ⊢e trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ ((x,a) :: nil)

| eff_let : forall L T t u eff1 eff2,
    ⊢e t ∶ eff1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> ⊢e open x u ∶ eff2) ->
    ⊢e trm_let T t u ∶ (eff1 ++ eff2)

| eff_llit : forall L T l u eff,
    (forall x, x \notin L -> ⊢e open x u ∶ eff) ->
    ⊢e trm_lit T l u ∶ eff

where "'⊢e' t '∶' eff" := (eff_trm t eff).

Definition has_effs t effs := exists effs',
    ⊢e t ∶ effs' /\ from_list effs = from_list effs'.

Require Import Case.
Require Import LetVar.
Require Import RetAux.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.

Unset Implicit Arguments.

Lemma free_sub_heaps_cons_inv3 : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap)
  (ℰ:eff_ctx) (ℰs:list eff_ctx),
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma (ℰ :: ℰs) ->
  all_notin (dom ℰ) (list_dom_union ℰs) /\
  free_sub_heap ℰ Sigma D /\
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma ℰs.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma ℰ ℰs H. inversion H; subst.
  split; [|split]; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma ty_config_red_return : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx)
  (effss:list effects) (Fs:stack) (Sigma:heap) (U:typ) (t:trm) (y x:var),
  ty_config G D Es effss (trm_var (avar_f y) ; (frame_ret x :: Fs)%list ; Sigma) U ->
  exists G' D' Es' effss',
    ty_config (G & G') D' Es' effss' (trm_var (avar_f x) ; Fs ; Sigma) U.
Proof.
  intros G D Es effss Fs Sigma U t y x Hcfg.
  destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D Es effss (trm_var (avar_f y))
              ((frame_ret x :: Fs)%list) Sigma U Hcfg) as
    (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effsH & effs' & effss0 &
     HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr).
  destruct (@ty_stack_ret_inv G D (ℰ :: ℰs) x Fs Ts ii (effsH :: effss0) U Hstack) as
    [ (ℰ0 & ℰs0 & T & effs0 & effssF &
        HeqEs0 & HeqEffs0 & Hstack_free & HxT & Hxinit)
    | (ℰ0 & ℰs0 & T & effssC &
        HeqEs0 & HeqEffs0 & Hstack_tail & HxT & Hxinit) ].
  - (* free branch *)
    inversion HeqEs0; subst.
    injection HeqEffs0 as HeffH Heffss. subst effsH effss0.
    assert (Heffnil : effs' = nil) by (eapply eff_trm_var_nil; exact Heff).
    subst effs'.
    cbn in Hcorr.
    eapply (@ty_config_pop_ret_free G D ℰ0 ℰs0 Fs Sigma U T x effs0 effssF);
      eassumption.
  - (* committed branch *)
    inversion HeqEs0; subst.
    injection HeqEffs0 as HeffH Heffss. subst effsH effss0.
    assert (Heffnil : effs' = nil) by (eapply eff_trm_var_nil; exact Heff).
    subst effs'.
    cbn in Hcorr.
    assert (Hcorr_cons : eff_ctx_corr (ℰ0 :: ℰs0) (nil :: effssC)) by exact Hcorr.
    destruct (@eff_ctx_corr_cons_inv ℰ0 ℰs0 nil effssC Hcorr_cons) as [Hcorr_tail Hone].
    destruct (@free_sub_heaps_cons_inv3 G D Sigma ℰ0 ℰs0 Hfs) as [Hnot [Hfree_sub Hfs_tail]].
    assert (Hfreeℰ0 : forall z, z \in dom ℰ0 -> binds z free D).
    { intros z Hz. exact (@free_sub_heap_binds_free ℰ0 Sigma D z Hfree_sub Hz). }
    assert (Hallsome : forall z T0 hds, z \in dom ℰ0 ->
                        binds z (item_obj T0 hds) Sigma -> all_some_hds hds).
    { intros z T0 hds Hz Hb. exact (@nil_eff_all_some ℰ0 Sigma D Hfree_sub Hone z T0 hds Hz Hb). }
    assert (Hstack' : ty_stack G (D & commit_ctx ℰ0) ℰs0 Fs T committed effssC U).
    { eapply (@ty_stack_strengthen G D ℰ0 ℰs0 Fs T committed effssC U);
        [exact Hfreeℰ0|exact Hnot|exact Hstack_tail]. }
    assert (Hfs' : free_sub_heaps G (D & commit_ctx ℰ0) Sigma ℰs0).
    { eapply (@free_sub_heaps_strengthen_some G D ℰ0 Sigma ℰs0);
        [exact Hfreeℰ0|exact Hfree_sub|exact Hallsome|exact Hnot|exact Hfs_tail]. }
    assert (Hinits' : inert_inits (D & commit_ctx ℰ0))
      by (exact (@inert_inits_commit_ctx D ℰ0 Hinits)).
    assert (Hxmem : x \in dom ℰ0) by (exact (@init_typing_var_free_mem G D (dom ℰ0) x Hxinit)).
    assert (Hxb : binds x committed (D & commit_ctx ℰ0))
      by (apply LibEnv.binds_concat_right; exact (@binds_commit_ctx_in ℰ0 x Hxmem)).
    destruct ℰs0 as [|ℰ1 ℰs'].
    + inversion Hstack'.
    + destruct effssC as [|effs1 effss'].
      * inversion Hstack'.
      * exists (empty:ctx), (D & commit_ctx ℰ0), (ℰ1 :: ℰs'), (effs1 :: effss').
        rewrite concat_empty_r.
        eapply (@ty_config_c G (D & commit_ctx ℰ0) Sigma ℰ1 ℰs' Fs
                  (trm_var (avar_f x)) T committed U nil effs1 effss').
        -- exact Hinert.
        -- exact Hinits'.
        -- exact Hhc.
        -- exact Hfs'.
        -- exact Hstack'.
        -- exact HxT.
        -- apply eff_ignore.
        -- eapply init_var_binds. apply init_var_commit. exact Hxb.
        -- exact Hcorr_tail.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Effects CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle.

Definition all_notin {A} (xs ys : fset A) :=
  forall x, x \in xs -> x \notin ys.

Fixpoint list_dom_union {A} (Es : list (env A)) :=
  match Es with
  | nil => \{}
  | (E :: Es)%list => dom E \u list_dom_union Es
  end.

Inductive free_sub_heaps :
  ctx -> init_ctx -> heap -> list eff_ctx -> Prop :=

| free_sub_heaps_nil : forall Gamma Delta Sigma,
    well_committed_heap Gamma Delta Sigma ->
    free_sub_heaps Gamma Delta Sigma nil

| free_sub_heaps_cons : forall Gamma Delta Sigma ℰ ℰs,
    all_notin (dom ℰ) (list_dom_union ℰs) ->
    free_sub_heap ℰ Sigma Delta ->
    free_sub_heaps Gamma Delta Sigma ℰs ->
    free_sub_heaps Gamma Delta Sigma (ℰ :: ℰs).

Lemma ty_config_red_let_sta : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx)
  (effss:list effects) (Fs:stack) (i0:init_typ) (effsS:list effects)
  (Sigma:heap) (U TL:typ) (s t:trm),
  ty_config G D Es effss (trm_let TL s t ; Fs ; Sigma) U ->
  exists G' D' Es' effss',
    ty_config (G & G') D' Es' effss' (s ; (frame_let t :: Fs)%list ; Sigma) U.
Proof.
  intros G D Es effss Fs i0 effsS Sigma U TL s t Hcfg.
  destruct (ty_config_inv_s G D Es effss (trm_let TL s t) Fs Sigma U Hcfg) as
    (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effsH & effs' & effss0 &
     HeqEs & Heqeff & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr).
  destruct (ty_trm_let_inv G TL s t Ts Hty) as (L & U0 & Hty_s & Hbody_ty & Hsub).
  destruct (eff_trm_let_inv TL s t effs' Heff) as (Le & eff1 & eff2 & Heqeffs & Heff_s & Hbody_eff).
  destruct (init_trm_let_inv G D (dom ℰ) TL s t ii Hinit) as (Li & is & Hinit_s & Hbody_init).
  rewrite Heqeffs in Hcorr.
  rewrite <- List.app_assoc in Hcorr.
  assert (Hstack' : ty_stack G D (ℰ :: ℰs) (frame_let t :: Fs)%list TL is
                     (((eff2 ++ effsH)%list) :: effss0) U).
  { eapply ty_stack_let with (L := L \u Le \u Li \u dom G)
      (T := Ts) (i' := ii) (effs := effsH) (effss := effss0)
      (effs' := eff2) (t := t) (S := TL) (i := is).
    - exact Hstack.
    - intros x0 Hx0.
      assert (HxL : x0 \notin L) by (intro K; apply Hx0; repeat rewrite in_union; tauto).
      assert (HxG0 : x0 # G) by (intro K; apply Hx0; repeat rewrite in_union; tauto).
      eapply ty_sub.
      + eapply Hbody_ty; exact HxL.
      + eapply subtyp_binds_extends; [exact Hsub|apply binds_extends_push_fresh; exact HxG0].
    - intros x0 Hx0.
      assert (HxLi : x0 \notin Li) by (intro K; apply Hx0; repeat rewrite in_union; tauto).
      eapply Hbody_init; exact HxLi.
    - intros x0 Hx0.
      assert (HxLe : x0 \notin Le) by (intro K; apply Hx0; repeat rewrite in_union; tauto).
      eapply Hbody_eff; exact HxLe.
  }
  exists (empty:ctx), D, (ℰ :: ℰs), (((eff1 ++ (eff2 ++ effsH))%list) :: effss0).
  rewrite concat_empty_r.
  eapply ty_config_c; eassumption.

Require Import Base.
Require Import Case.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.

Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* A record component reachable by field selection. *)
Inductive has_field : typ -> trm_label -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| hf_one : forall (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
    has_field (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U)) a S U
| hf_andl : forall (T U:typ) (a:trm_label) (S Uf:typ),
    has_field T a S Uf -> has_field (typ_and T U) a S Uf
| hf_andr : forall (T U:typ) (a:trm_label) (S Uf:typ),
    has_field U a S Uf -> has_field (typ_and T U) a S Uf.

Lemma has_field_record_has : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
  has_field T a S U -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U).
Proof.
  intros T a S U H. induction H.
  - apply rh_one.
  - apply rh_andl. assumption.
  - apply rh_andr. assumption.
Qed.

(* Types built from top and records by intersection. *)
Inductive rc : typ -> Prop :=
| rc_top : rc typ_top
| rc_rcd : forall (D:dec), rc (typ_rcd D)
| rc_and : forall (T U:typ), rc T -> rc U -> rc (typ_and T U).

Lemma rc_not_bot : forall (T:typ), rc T -> T = typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intro E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_sel : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), T = typ_sel a A -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros a A E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_all : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (S U:typ), T = typ_all S U -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros S U E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_con : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (X:typ),
  T = typ_con Ts is' X -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros Ts is' X E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (X:typ), T = typ_bnd X -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros X E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma record_typ_rc : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label),
  record_typ T ls -> rc T.
Proof.
  intros T ls H. induction H.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - apply rc_and; [assumption|apply rc_rcd].
Qed.

Lemma record_type_rc : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> rc T.
Proof. intros T [ls H]. apply record_typ_rc. assumption. Qed.

Lemma subtyp_top_inv : forall (G:ctx) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ typ_top <: T -> T = typ_top.
Proof.
  intros G T H. induction H; try reflexivity.
  - (* trans *) subst. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma rc_subtyp : forall (G:ctx) (T U:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: U -> rc T -> rc U.
Proof.
  intros G T U H. induction H; intros Hrc.
  - apply rc_top.
  - exfalso. eapply rc_not_bot; eassumption.
  - exact Hrc.
  - apply IHHsubtyp2. apply IHHsubtyp1. exact Hrc.
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hrc; subst. assumption.
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hrc; subst. assumption.
  - (* and2 *) apply rc_and; [apply IHHsubtyp1|apply IHHsubtyp2]; exact Hrc.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - exfalso. eapply rc_not_sel; eassumption.
  - exfalso. eapply rc_not_sel; eassumption.
  - exfalso. eapply rc_not_all; eassumption.
Qed.

(* Field extraction for rc types. *)
Lemma rc_field : forall (G:ctx) (T R:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: R ->
  rc T ->
  forall (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
    R = typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    exists Sf Uf, has_field T a Sf Uf /\ G ⊢ S <: Sf /\ G ⊢ Uf <: U.
Proof.
  intros G T R Hsub. induction Hsub; intros Hrc a S U Heq.
  - (* top *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* bot *) exfalso. eapply rc_not_bot; eassumption.
  - (* refl *) inversion Heq; subst.
    exists S, U. split; [apply hf_one|split; apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* trans *) subst.
    assert (HrcS : rc S) by (eapply rc_subtyp; eassumption).
    eapply IHHsub2; [exact HrcS|reflexivity].
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hrc; subst.
    eapply IHHsubtyp; [exact H1|reflexivity].
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hrc; subst.
    eapply IHHsubtyp; [exact H2|reflexivity].
  - (* and2 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* fld *) inversion Heq; subst.
    exists T2, U1. split.
    + apply hf_one.
    + split; assumption.
  - (* typ *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* sel2 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* sel1 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* all *) discriminate Heq.
Qed.

Proof.

  - apply rc_and; [assumption|apply rc_rcd].
Qed.

Proof. intros T [ls H]. exact (@record_typ_rc T ls H). Qed.

Lemma subtyp_top_inv : forall (G:ctx) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ typ_top <: T -> T = typ_top.
Proof.
  intros G T H. induction H; try reflexivity.
  - (* trans *) subst. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma rc_subtyp : forall (G:ctx) (T U:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: U -> rc T -> rc U.
Proof.

  - exfalso. eapply rc_not_sel; eassumption.

Lemma rc_field : forall (G:ctx) (T R:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: R ->

    R = typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    exists Sf Uf, has_field T a Sf Uf /\ G ⊢ S <: Sf /\ G ⊢ Uf <: U.
Proof.
  intros G T R Hsub. induction Hsub; intros Hrc a S U Heq.
  - (* top *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* bot *) exfalso. eapply rc_not_bot; eassumption.
  - (* refl *) inversion Heq; subst.
    exists S, U. split; [apply hf_one|split; apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* trans *) subst.

  - (* and11 *) inversion Hrc; subst.

  - (* and12 *) inversion Hrc; subst.

  - (* and2 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* fld *) inversion Heq; subst.
    exists T2, U1. split.
    + apply hf_one.
    + split; assumption.
  - (* typ *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* sel2 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* sel1 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* all *) discriminate Heq.
Qed.

  init_weaken_middle : forall Gamma1 x T' Gamma3 Delta1 i' Delta3 vs vs' (t : A) i,
    Gamma1 & Gamma3 ⸴ Delta1 & Delta3 ⸴ vs ⊢i t ∶ i ->
    x # Gamma1 ->
    x # Delta1 ->

    ok (Gamma1 & Gamma2) ->
    ok (Delta1 & Delta2) ->
    Gamma1 & Gamma2 & Gamma3 ⸴ Delta1 & Delta2 & Delta3 ⸴ vs \u vs' ⊢i t ∶ i.

Context {A : Set} `{ITyA : InitTyping A}.

    Gamma1 & x ~ T' & Gamma3 ⸴ Delta ⊢c t.

    x # Delta1 ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta1 & x ~ i' & Delta3 ⊢c t.

Section CommitWeaken.

Context {A : Set} `{ITyA : CommitTyping A}.

Section Weaken.

Context {ITyWMG : CommitTypingWeakenMiddleG ITyA}.

End Weaken.

End CommitWeaken.

Require Import Base.
Require Import Case.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.

Unset Implicit Arguments.

Lemma get_labeld_list_some_in : forall (A:Set) `{LabelOf A} (l:label) (ds:list A) (d:A),
  get_labeld_list l ds = Some d -> List.In d ds.
Proof.
  intros A LA l ds. induction ds as [|a ds IH]; intros d H.
  - simpl in H. discriminate H.
  - simpl in H. destruct (classic (label_of a = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_of a = l) _ _ E) in H.
      injection H as Heq. subst d. apply List.in_eq.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of a = l) _ _ NE) in H.
      apply List.in_cons. eapply IH; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_defs_in : forall (D:init_ctx) (hds:heap_defs) (d:heap_def),
  committed_heap_defs D hds -> List.In d hds -> committed_heap_def D d.
Proof.
  intros D hds d H. induction H; intros Hin.
  - inversion Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + subst d. assumption.
    + eapply IHcommitted_heap_defs; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_def_trm_some_binds : forall (D:init_ctx) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  committed_heap_def D (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) -> binds y committed D.
Proof. intros D a y H. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_def_trm_none_false : forall (D:init_ctx) (a:trm_label),
  committed_heap_def D (heap_def_trm a None) -> False.
Proof. intros D a H. inversion H. Qed.

(* Effects: an effect-context inclusion survives dropping a prefix whose
   variables are not bound in the effect context. *)
Lemma eff_ctx_corr_one_suffix : forall (E:eff_ctx) (effs' effs:effects),
  eff_ctx_corr_one E (effs' ++ effs) ->
  (forall x, binds x effs' E -> False) ->
  eff_ctx_corr_one E effs.
Proof.
  intros E effs' effs H Hnodom x effs0 Hb e He.
  eapply H; [exact Hb|]. rewrite from_list_app. rewrite in_union.
  right. exact He.
Qed.

Lemma eff_ctx_corr_one_nil : forall (E:eff_ctx), eff_ctx_corr_one E nil.
Proof. intros E x effs Hb e He. cbn in He. exact (in_empty_inv He). Qed.

(* Typing inversion for selection. *)
Lemma ty_sel_inv : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ T ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof.
  intros G x a T H.
  remember (trm_sel (avar_f x) a) as t eqn:Heqt.
  revert T Heqt.
  induction H; intros T0 Heqt; try discriminate Heqt.
  - (* ty_rcd_elim *) injection Heqt as Hx Ha. subst x0 a0.
    exists S, T0. split; [assumption|apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* ty_sub *) subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm T Heqt) as [S [T1 [Hx Hsub]]].
    exists S, T1. split; [exact Hx|]. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact H].
Qed.

(* Typing inversion for assignment. *)
Lemma ty_asn_inv : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ T ->

               G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.

---

metadata:

Working on /workspace/Task.v (Rocq iDOT type+initialization safety): prove `preservation` and `progress`; support `.v` files are definitions-only (all original lemmas/instances stripped), so the whole metatheory must be rebuilt in Task.v. Prohibited: Admitted/admit/Abort/Axiom/Parameter and importing an existing proof.

By 2026-11-22 Task.v (~4855 lines) compiles up to the two target theorems (make reports the "Nested proofs" error at the target line, meaning everything before it checks). Verified in Task.v: syntax/substitution algebra, weakening (`binds_extends`), env_sim, full typing substitution, init/commit transfer, record correspondence for `ty_defs`, heap/inert extraction lemmas, `ty_stack_binds_extends`, label-uniqueness/`labels_has_in`, `subst_intro_*`, effect/free-subheap dom facts, record-opening/shape lemmas, `flow_shape`/`flow_typing`/flow corollaries, heap-update typing, stack inversion, `ty_config_inv`, heap-correspondence binds/update, stack weakening, substitution stage 1, `ty_all_intro_open`, the substitution motives `QcF/QaF/QlF/QiF/QisF`, and the complete commit-side substitution helpers including `sc_commit_llit`, `sc_commit_all_intro`, and the hard `sc_commit_con_intro` (effect transport via `has_effs_subst_fresh`/`def_eff_subst`/`def_eff_no_subst`; `open_vars` commutation via `subst_open_rec_vars_trm`+`map_ren_id`; nested init-typing IH applied through the `ys ~** to_list Ts`/`ys ~** is'` pushes using `map_concat`/`map_single`/`subst_env_singles`/`dom_ys_tolist`/`dom_ys_inits`/`binds_extends_push_env_fresh`/`concat_assoc`; freshness from `fresh_head_L`/`fresh_tail_L` over `L' = (((L ∪ dom G1) ∪ dom G2) ∪ {xm}) ∪ {ym}`). Also verified: `notin_from_list_intro`, `dom_ys_tolist`, `dom_ys_inits`, `fresh_head_L`, `fresh_tail_L`, `def_eff_subst`, `vars_subst_notin`. Also verified: `init_open_rename_committed` (fresh-variable renaming for an init premise `∀ x0∉L, G&x0~T ⸴ D&x0~committed ⸴ vs ⊢i open x0 t ∶ i` to `G&x~T ⸴ D&x~committed ⸴ vs ⊆ ...`, using the init transfer `init_binds_extends` and `init_subst` with `D1 = D & x~committed`; the `vs` set is kept unchanged via `vars_subst_notin`, requiring `x0∉vs`). Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import Stdlib.Init.Sumbool.

Require Import LibExtra.

Generalizable Variables A B.

Declare Scope syntax_scope.

Delimit Scope syntax_scope with S.

Open Scope syntax_scope.

Class Openable (A : Type) := open_rec : nat -> var -> A -> A.

Class FreeVar (A : Type) := fv : A -> vars.

Class SubstVar (A : Type) := subst_var : var -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Openable FreeVar SubstVar.

Arguments open_rec _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Arguments fv _ _ !_ /.

Arguments subst_var _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class AbstractSyntax (A : Type) `(Openable A) `(FreeVar A) `(SubstVar A).

Notation "z '/[' x '->' y ']'"
  := (subst_var x y z) (x at level 69, at level 70) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_vars := (vars_zip_map subst_var).

Notation "z '/[' xs '-->' ys ']'"
  := (subst_vars xs ys z) (xs at level 69, at level 70) : syntax_scope.

Notation open := (open_rec 0).

Definition open_depth_rec `{AS : Openable A} n x a d
  := open_rec (n + d) x a.

Notation open_depth := (open_depth_rec 0).

Arguments open_depth_rec _ _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Definition closed `{AS: Openable A} a
  := forall n x, open_rec n x a = a.

Fixpoint open_rec_vars `{AS : Openable A} (k: nat) (ys: list var) (X: A): A :=
  match ys with
  | nil => X
  | cons y ys => open_rec_vars (S k) ys (open_rec k y X)
  end.

Notation open_vars := (open_rec_vars 0).

Arguments open_rec_vars _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Class DecideFv `(AS: AbstractSyntax A) := dec_fv : var -> A -> bool.

Arguments dec_fv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Definition dec_notin_fv `{DFv: DecideFv A} x a := negb (dec_fv x a).

Arguments dec_notin_fv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class ReflectFv `(DFv: DecideFv A) :=
  reflect_fv : forall x a,
    (x \in fv a) <-> (dec_fv x a) = true.

Class Closing `(AS: AbstractSyntax A) :=
  close_rec : nat -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Closing.

Notation close := (close_rec 0).

Arguments close_rec _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Definition close_depth_rec `{Cl : Closing A} n x a d
  := close_rec (n + d) x a.

Notation close_depth := (close_depth_rec 0).

Arguments close_depth_rec _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Parameter typ_label: Set.

Parameter trm_label: Set.

Inductive label: Set :=
| label_typ: typ_label -> label
| label_trm: trm_label -> label.

Class LabelOf (A : Type) := label_of : A -> label.

Arguments label_of _ _ !_ /.

Class GetLabeled (B A : Type) `(LabelOf B) :=
  get_labeld : label -> A -> option B.

Arguments get_labeld _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Definition labels_has `{GetLabeled B A} (ds: A) (d: B) :=
  get_labeld (label_of d) ds = Some d.

Definition labels_hasnt `{GetLabeled B A} (ds: A) (l: label) :=
  get_labeld l ds = None.

Class SubstLabel `(SubstVar A) `(LabelOf A) :=
  subst_label: forall x y d,
    label_of (subst_var x y d) = label_of d.

Class OpenTwice `(AS: Openable A) :=
  open_twice : forall n x y,
    (open_rec n y) ∘ (open_rec n x) = (open_rec n x).

Class OpenCommut `(AS: Openable A) :=
    open_commut : forall m n x y,
        m <> n ->
        (open_rec m x) ∘ (open_rec n y) = (open_rec n y) ∘ (open_rec m x).

Class SubstFresh `(AS : AbstractSyntax A) :=
  subst_fresh : forall x y X,
    x \notin fv X -> subst_var x y X = X.

====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Notation avars := (list avar).

Instance AvarOpenable : Openable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n = i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarFreeVar : FreeVar avar :=
  fun a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => \{}
    | avar_f x => \{x}
    end.

Instance AvarSubstVar : SubstVar avar :=
  fun (x: var) (y: var) (a: avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f z => (avar_f (If z = x then y else z))
    end.

Instance AvarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax AvarOpenable AvarFreeVar AvarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarDecideFv : DecideFv AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => false
    | avar_f y => (If x = y then true else false)
    end.

Instance AvarClosing : Closing AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun (n : nat) (x : var) (a : avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f y => (If y = x then avar_b n else avar_f y)
    end.

Inductive vars_of_avars : list var -> list avar -> Prop :=
| vars_of_avars_nil : vars_of_avars nil nil
| vars_of_avars_cons : forall x vs avs,
    vars_of_avars vs avs ->
    vars_of_avars (cons x vs) (cons (avar_f x) avs).

Require Import TransformCollect.

Instance AvarsCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax ListAbstractSyntax :=
  fun {C} df f comb => List.fold_right (fun a acc => comb (f a) acc) df.

Instance AvarsTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax ListAbstractSyntax :=

Require Import Base.
Require Import Case.
Require Import RetAux.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.

Unset Implicit Arguments.

Lemma committed_heap_defs_update : forall (D:init_ctx) (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  committed_heap_defs D hds ->
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  binds y committed D ->
  committed_heap_defs D hds'.
Proof.
  intros D hds hds' a y Hc Hu. revert hds' Hu. induction Hc; intros hds' Hu Hy.
  - inversion Hu.
  - inversion Hu; subst.
    + (* head updated *)
      inversion Hc; subst.
      eapply committed_heap_defs_cons.
      * exact Hc2.
      * apply committed_heap_def_trm. exact Hy.
    + (* tail updated *)
      match goal with
      | Hu' : defs_update hds a0 y0 hds'0 |- _ =>
        eapply committed_heap_defs_cons;
        [eapply IHHc; [exact Hu'|exact Hy] | exact Hc]
      end.
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heap_asn_update : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Sigma Sigma':heap) (D:init_ctx)
  (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D ->
  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
  binds x committed D ->
  free_sub_heap E Sigma' D.
Proof.
  intros E Sigma Sigma' D x a y Hfree Hup Hxcomm.
  destruct Hup as (T & hds & hds' & S1 & S2 & Heq & Hfresh & Hdu & Heq').
  subst Sigma Sigma'.
  intros z effs Hb. destruct (Hfree z effs Hb) as [Hsame Hrest].
  destruct Hrest as [itm [Hbinds Hitem]].
  assert (Hne : z <> x).
  { intro E0. subst z.
    inversion Hitem; subst.
    match goal with
    | Hf : free_heap_defs D E x (item_obj T0 hds0) |- _ =>
      destruct Hf as [Hbzfree _]
    end.
    pose proof (@LibEnv.binds_functional init_typ x free committed Hbzfree Hxcomm) as Heqfc.
    discriminate Heqfc. }
  exists itm. split.
  - eapply (binds_replace (A:=item) (E1:=S1) (E2:=S2) (x0:=x) (z:=z)
               (v:=item_obj T hds) (v':=item_obj T hds') (itm:=itm));
      [exact Hne|exact Hbinds].
  - exact Hitem.
Qed.

Lemma well_committed_heap_asn_update : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx)
  (Sigma Sigma':heap) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  well_committed_heap G D Sigma ->
  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
  binds x committed D ->
  binds y committed D ->
  well_committed_heap G D Sigma'.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma Sigma' x a y Hwc Hup Hxcomm Hycomm.
  destruct Hwc as [HdomG [HdomD Hitem]].
  destruct Hup as (T & hds & hds' & S1 & S2 & Heq & Hfresh & Hdu & Heq').
  subst Sigma Sigma'.
  split; [exact HdomG|]. split.
  - rewrite HdomD. rewrite !LibEnv.dom_concat, !LibEnv.dom_single. reflexivity.
  - intros z itm Hzcomm Hbinds.
    destruct (classic (z = x)) as [->|Hne].
    + assert (Hcanon : binds x (item_obj T hds')
                      (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds' & S2)).
      { eapply LibEnv.binds_concat_left.
        - apply LibEnv.binds_push_eq.
        - exact Hfresh. }
      assert (Heqitm : itm = item_obj T hds')
        by (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; [exact Hbinds|exact Hcanon]).
      subst itm.
      assert (Hcanon_old : binds x (item_obj T hds)
                          (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2)).
      { eapply LibEnv.binds_concat_left.
        - apply LibEnv.binds_push_eq.
        - exact Hfresh. }
      pose proof (Hitem x (item_obj T hds) Hzcomm Hcanon_old) as Hci.
      destruct (committed_heap_item_obj_inv Hci) as Hcdefs.
      eapply committed_heap_obj. eapply committed_heap_defs_update; eassumption.
    + assert (Hbinds_old : binds z itm (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2)).
      { eapply (binds_replace (A:=item) (E1:=S1) (E2:=S2) (x0:=x) (z:=z)
                   (v:=item_obj T hds') (v':=item_obj T hds) (itm:=itm));
          [exact Hne|exact Hbinds]. }
      exact (Hitem z itm Hzcomm Hbinds_old).
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heaps_asn_update : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma Sigma':heap)
  (Es:list eff_ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es ->
  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
  binds x committed D ->
  binds y committed D ->
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma' Es.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma Sigma' Es x a y Hfs Hup Hxcomm Hycomm.
  induction Hfs.
  - eapply free_sub_heaps_nil.
    eapply well_committed_heap_asn_update; eassumption.
  - eapply free_sub_heaps_cons.
    + exact H.
    + eapply free_sub_heap_asn_update; eassumption.
    + eapply IHHfs; assumption.
Qed.

Proof.

Lemma free_sub_heap_effect_same : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (D:init_ctx) (x:var) (effs:effects) (y:var) (a:trm_label),
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D ->
  binds x effs E ->
  (y,a) \in from_list effs ->
  y = x.
Proof.
  intros. unfold free_sub_heap in H. exact (proj1 (H x effs H0) y a H1).
Qed.

Lemma in_list_dom_union : forall (A:Type) (Es:list (env A)) (x:var),
  x \in list_dom_union Es <-> exists E, List.In E Es /\ x \in dom E.
Proof.
  intros A Es. induction Es as [|E Es IH]; intros x.
  - cbn. split.
    + intros H. exfalso. exact (in_empty_inv H).
    + intros [E' [Hin _]]. inversion Hin.
  - cbn. rewrite in_union. split.
    + intros [H|H].
      * exists E. split; [apply List.in_eq|exact H].
      * destruct (proj1 (IH x) H) as [E' [Hin Hdom]].
        exists E'. split; [apply List.in_cons; exact Hin|exact Hdom].
    + intros [E' [Hin Hdom]]. destruct Hin as [->|Hin].
      * left. exact Hdom.
      * right. apply (proj2 (IH x)). exists E'. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heaps_all_notin : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (E:eff_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx),
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma (E :: Es) ->
  all_notin (dom E) (list_dom_union Es).
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst.
  match goal with H' : all_notin _ _ |- _ => exact H' end.
Qed.

Lemma well_committed_heap_doms : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap),
  well_committed_heap G D Sigma ->
  dom G = dom D /\ dom D = dom Sigma.
Proof. intros G D Sigma [H1 [H2 _]]. split; assumption. Qed.

Lemma ty_stack_nil_inv : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx) (T:typ) (i:init_typ) (effs:list effects) (U:typ),
  ty_stack G D Es nil T i effs U ->
  exists E, Es = E :: nil /\ effs = (nil :: nil)%list /\ G ⊢ T <: U.
Proof.
  intros G D Es T i effs U H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; [reflexivity|assumption]].
Qed.

(** * Opening preserves record structure *)

Lemma label_of_open_dec : forall (D:dec) (n:nat) (u:var),
  label_of (open_rec n u D) = label_of D.
Proof. intros D n u. destruct D; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma record_dec_open : forall (D:dec) (n:nat) (u:var),
  record_dec D -> record_dec (open_rec n u D).
Proof. intros D n u H. destruct H; simpl; [apply rd_typ|apply rd_trm]. Qed.

Lemma record_typ_open : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (n:nat) (u:var),
  record_typ T ls -> record_typ (open_rec n u T) ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls n u H. induction H.
  - cbn. apply rt_one.
    + apply record_dec_open; assumption.
    + rewrite label_of_open_dec. assumption.
  - cbn. apply rt_cons.
    + match goal with IH : record_typ (open_rec n u ?X) ?LX
                       |- record_typ (open_rec n u ?X) ?LX => exact IH end.
    + apply record_dec_open; assumption.
    + rewrite label_of_open_dec. assumption.
    + assumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_open : forall (T:typ) (n:nat) (u:var),
  record_type T -> record_type (open_rec n u T).
Proof.
  intros T n u [ls Hrt]. exists ls. apply record_typ_open. assumption.
Qed.

(** * Shape facts *)

Lemma record_type_not_top : record_type typ_top -> False.
Proof. intros [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_bot : record_type typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_sel : forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), record_type (typ_sel a A) -> False.
Proof. intros a A [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_all : forall (S T:typ), record_type (typ_all S T) -> False.
Proof. intros S T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_con : forall (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (T:typ), record_type (typ_con Ts is' T) -> False.
Proof. intros Ts is' T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), record_type (typ_bnd T) -> False.
Proof. intros T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_not_top : inert_typ typ_top -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_bot : inert_typ typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_sel : forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), inert_typ (typ_sel a A) -> False.
Proof. intros a A H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_rcd : forall (D:dec), inert_typ (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_and : forall (T U:typ), inert_typ (typ_and T U) -> False.
Proof. intros T U H. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Shape of precise flow tips in an inert setting *)

Lemma flow_shape : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  inert_typ T0 ->
  binds x T0 G ->
  (V = T0 /\ inert_typ T0) \/ record_type V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf; intros Hi Hb.
  - left. split; [reflexivity|assumption].
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + inversion Heq; subst. inversion Hi2; subst.
      right. apply record_type_open. assumption.
    + exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exists ls. exact Hr.
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists ls'. exact (proj1 HP).
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists (\{label_of D}).
      assert (HeqU : U2 = typ_rcd D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 HP)).
      assert (Hrd : record_dec D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 HP))).
      rewrite HeqU. apply rt_one; [exact Hrd|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma flow_typing : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf.
  - apply ty_var. assumption.
  - eapply ty_rec_elim. exact IHHf.
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and11].
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and12].
Qed.

(** * Corollaries: no flow tip is a top/bottom/selection type *)

Lemma flow_not_top : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_top -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_top Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_top Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_top. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_bot : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_bot -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_bot Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_bot Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_bot. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_sel : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ) (a:avar) (A:typ_label),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_sel a A -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 a A Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 (typ_sel a A) Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_sel a A Hi2).
  - exact (@record_type_not_sel a A Hr).
Qed.

Lemma flow_bnd_eq : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 U:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_bnd U -> typ_bnd U = T0.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 U Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 (typ_bnd U) Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - exact Heq.
  - exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma record_has_rcd_inv : forall (D D':dec), record_has (typ_rcd D) D' -> D' = D.

Lemma defs_update_label_in : forall (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  exists d, List.In d hds /\ label_of d = label_trm a.
Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y H. induction H.
  - exists (heap_def_trm a o). split; [apply List.in_eq|reflexivity].
  - destruct IHdefs_update as [d0 [Hin Hl]]. exists d0.
    split; [apply List.in_cons; exact Hin|exact Hl].
Qed.

Lemma labels_hasnt_update : forall (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (l:label),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  labels_hasnt hds l ->
  labels_hasnt hds' l.
Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y l Hup. revert l. induction Hup; intros l Hl.
  - unfold labels_hasnt in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classic (label_trm a = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_trm a = l) _ _ E) in Hl. discriminate.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_trm a = l) _ _ NE) in Hl.
      rewrite (If_r (P:=label_trm a = l) _ _ NE). exact Hl.
  - unfold labels_hasnt in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classic (label_of d = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_of d = l) _ _ E) in Hl. discriminate.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of d = l) _ _ NE) in Hl.
      rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of d = l) _ _ NE).
      eapply IHHup. exact Hl.
Qed.

  forall (a:trm_label) (y:var) (hds':heap_defs),

        - symmetry. eapply record_has_rcd_inv. eassumption. }
      subst D. eapply ty_defs_cons.
      * exact H.
      * eapply ty_heap_def_trm_some. exact Hy.
      * simpl. exact H1.
    + (* update in the tail *)
      assert (Htail : defs_update ds a y hds'0) by
        (match goal with Hx : defs_update ds _ _ hds'0 |- _ => exact Hx end).
      eapply ty_defs_cons.
      * eapply IHHds; [exact Htail| |exact Hy].
        destruct (@record_has_and_inv T (typ_rcd D) (dec_trm a Tf Tf) Hrh) as [HinTs|HinR].

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Class PreTyping {B : Set} {A : Set} (ty_rel : ctx -> A -> B -> Prop).

Class PreTypingWeakenMiddle {A : Set} {B : Set}
      {ty_rel : ctx -> A -> B -> Prop} (PTy : PreTyping ty_rel) :=
  weaken_middle : forall Gamma1 x T' Gamma2 t T,
      ty_rel (Gamma1 & Gamma2) t T ->
      x # Gamma1 ->
      ty_rel (Gamma1 & x ~ T' & Gamma2) t T.

Class PreTypingBndIntroMiddle {A : Set} {B : Set}
      {ty_rel : ctx -> A -> B -> Prop} (PTy : PreTyping ty_rel) :=
  bnd_intro_middle : forall Gamma1 Gamma2 y T1 t T,
    ty_rel (Gamma1 & y ~ open y T1 & Gamma2) t T ->
    ty_rel (Gamma1 & y ~ typ_bnd T1 & Gamma2) t T.

Section Weakening.

Context {B : Set} {A : Set} {ty_rel : ctx -> A -> B -> Prop}.

Context {PTy : PreTyping ty_rel} {PTyWM : PreTypingWeakenMiddle PTy}.

End Weakening.

Context {B : Set} {A : Set} {ty_rel : ctx -> A -> B -> Prop}.

Context {PTy : PreTyping ty_rel} {PTyWM : PreTypingBndIntroMiddle PTy}.

Lemma eff_trm_sel_nil : forall (x:var) (a:trm_label) (effs:effects),
  ⊢e trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ effs -> effs = nil.
Proof.
  intros x a effs H. inversion H; subst; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ty_heap_def_trm_some_inv : forall (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (D:dec),
  G ⊢ heap_def_trm a (Some y) ∶d D ->
  exists Tf, D = dec_trm a Tf Tf /\ G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ Tf.
Proof.
  intros G a y D H. change (ty_heap_def G (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) D) in H.
  inversion H; subst. eexists. split; [reflexivity|assumption].
Qed.

Lemma labels_has_heap_in : forall (hds:heap_defs) (d:heap_def),
  labels_has hds d -> List.In d hds.
Proof.
  intros hds d H. unfold labels_has in H.
  eapply (@get_labeld_list_some_in heap_def HeapDefLabelOf (label_of d) hds d).
  exact H.
Qed.

Lemma heap_def_typing_rh : forall (G:ctx) (hds:heap_defs) (T:typ)
  (a:trm_label) (y:var),

  exists Tf, record_has T (dec_trm a Tf Tf) /\ G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ Tf.

Lemma get_labeld_list_some_in : forall (A:Set) `{LabelOf A} (l:label) (ds:list A) (d:A),
  get_labeld_list l ds = Some d -> List.In d ds.
Proof.
  intros A LA l ds. induction ds as [|a ds IH]; intros d H.
  - simpl in H. discriminate H.
  - simpl in H. destruct (classic (label_of a = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_of a = l) _ _ E) in H.
      injection H as Heq. subst d. apply List.in_eq.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of a = l) _ _ NE) in H.
      apply List.in_cons. eapply IH; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_defs_in : forall (D:init_ctx) (hds:heap_defs) (d:heap_def),
  committed_heap_defs D hds -> List.In d hds -> committed_heap_def D d.
Proof.
  intros D hds d H. induction H; intros Hin.
  - inversion Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + subst d. assumption.
    + eapply IHcommitted_heap_defs; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_def_trm_some_binds : forall (D:init_ctx) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  committed_heap_def D (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) -> binds y committed D.
Proof. intros D a y H. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_def_trm_none_false : forall (D:init_ctx) (a:trm_label),
  committed_heap_def D (heap_def_trm a None) -> False.
Proof. intros D a H. inversion H. Qed.

(* Effects: an effect-context inclusion survives dropping a prefix whose
   variables are not bound in the effect context. *)
Lemma eff_ctx_corr_one_suffix : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (D:init_ctx)
  (effs' effs:effects),
  eff_ctx_corr_one E (effs' ++ effs) ->
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D ->
  (forall e, List.In e effs' -> fst e \notin dom E) ->
  eff_ctx_corr_one E effs.
Proof.
  intros E Sigma D effs' effs Hcorr Hfree Hnodom x effs0 Hb e He.
  destruct e as [z l].
  assert (Hin : (z,l) \in from_list (effs' ++ effs)).
  { exact (Hcorr x effs0 Hb (z,l) He). }
  rewrite from_list_app in Hin. rewrite in_union in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
  - exfalso.
    pose proof (proj1 (Hfree x effs0 Hb) z l He) as Hz.
    assert (Hdom : x \in dom E) by (eapply binds_in_dom; exact Hb).
    apply (Hnodom (z,l) (proj1 (@in_from_list effect (z,l) effs') Hin)). rewrite Hz. exact Hdom.

Qed.

Lemma ty_sel_inv_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  forall (x:var) (a:trm_label), t = trm_sel (avar_f x) a ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  induction H; intros x0 a0 Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - injection Heq as Hx Ha. subst x0 a0.
    exists S, T. split; [assumption|apply subtyp_refl].
  - subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm x0 a0 eq_refl) as [S [T1 [Hx Hsub]]].
    exists S, T1. split; [exact Hx|]. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact H0].
Qed.

Lemma ty_sel_inv : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (T:typ),

Proof.

  induction H; intros x0 y0 a0 Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - injection Heq as Hx Ha Hy. subst x0 y0 a0.
    exists S, T. split; [exact H|]. split; [exact H0|apply subtyp_refl].
  - subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm x0 y0 a0 eq_refl) as [S [T1 [Hx [Hy Hsub]]]].
    exists S, T1. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hy|].

  G ⊢ trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ T ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\

Lemma init_typing_sel_committed : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars)

Require Import Base.
Require Import Case.
Require Import RetAux.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.

Unset Implicit Arguments.

Lemma committed_heap_defs_update : forall (D:init_ctx) (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  committed_heap_defs D hds ->
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  binds y committed D ->
  committed_heap_defs D hds'.
Proof.
  intros D hds hds' a y Hc Hu Hy. revert Hc. induction Hu; intros Hc.
  - inversion Hc; subst.
    eapply (@committed_heap_defs_cons D (heap_def_trm a (Some x)) hds).
    + exact H2.
    + eapply committed_heap_def_trm. change (binds x committed D). exact Hy.
  - inversion Hc; subst.
    eapply (@committed_heap_defs_cons D d hds').
    + eapply IHHu; [exact Hy|exact H2].
    + exact H3.
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heap_asn_update : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Sigma Sigma':heap) (D:init_ctx)
  (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D ->
  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
  binds x committed D ->
  free_sub_heap E Sigma' D.
Proof.
  intros E Sigma Sigma' D x a y Hfree Hup Hxcomm.
  destruct Hup as (T & hds & hds' & S1 & S2 & Heq & Hfresh & Hdu & Heq').
  subst Sigma Sigma'.
  intros z effs Hb. destruct (Hfree z effs Hb) as [Hsame Hrest].
  destruct Hrest as [itm [Hbinds Hitem]].
  assert (Hne : z <> x).
  { intro E0. subst z.
    inversion Hitem; subst.
    match goal with
    | Hf : free_heap_defs D E x ?hds0 |- _ =>
      destruct Hf as [Hbzfree _]
    end.
    pose proof (@LibEnv.binds_functional init_typ x free committed D Hbzfree Hxcomm) as Heqfc.
    discriminate Heqfc. }
  split.
  - exact Hsame.
  - exists itm. split.
    + eapply (@binds_replace item S1 S2 x z
                 (item_obj T hds) (item_obj T hds') itm);
      [exact Hne|exact Hbinds].
    + exact Hitem.
Qed.

Lemma well_committed_heap_asn_update : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx)
  (Sigma Sigma':heap) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  well_committed_heap G D Sigma ->
  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
  binds x committed D ->
  binds y committed D ->
  well_committed_heap G D Sigma'.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma Sigma' x a y Hwc Hup Hxcomm Hycomm.
  destruct Hwc as [HdomG [HdomD Hitem]].
  destruct Hup as (T & hds & hds' & S1 & S2 & Heq & Hfresh & Hdu & Heq').
  subst Sigma Sigma'.
  split; [exact HdomG|]. split.
  - rewrite HdomD. rewrite !LibEnv.dom_concat, !LibEnv.dom_single. reflexivity.
  - intros z itm Hzcomm Hbinds.
    destruct (classic (z = x)) as [->|Hne].
    + assert (Hcanon : binds x (item_obj T hds')
                      (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds' & S2)).
      { eapply LibEnv.binds_concat_left.
        - apply LibEnv.binds_push_eq.
        - exact Hfresh. }
      assert (Heqitm : itm = item_obj T hds')
        by (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; [exact Hbinds|exact Hcanon]).
      subst itm.
      assert (Hcanon_old : binds x (item_obj T hds)
                          (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2)).
      { eapply LibEnv.binds_concat_left.
        - apply LibEnv.binds_push_eq.
        - exact Hfresh. }
      pose proof (Hitem x (item_obj T hds) Hzcomm Hcanon_old) as Hci.
      pose proof (committed_heap_item_obj_inv Hci) as Hcdefs.
      eapply committed_heap_obj. eapply committed_heap_defs_update; eassumption.
    + assert (Hbinds_old : binds z itm (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2)).
      { eapply (@binds_replace item S1 S2 x z
                   (item_obj T hds') (item_obj T hds) itm);
          [exact Hne|exact Hbinds]. }
      exact (Hitem z itm Hzcomm Hbinds_old).
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heaps_asn_update : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma Sigma':heap)
  (Es:list eff_ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es ->
  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
  binds x committed D ->
  binds y committed D ->
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma' Es.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma Sigma' Es x a y Hfs Hup Hxcomm Hycomm.
  induction Hfs.
  - eapply free_sub_heaps_nil.
    eapply well_committed_heap_asn_update; eassumption.
  - eapply free_sub_heaps_cons.
    + exact H.
    + eapply free_sub_heap_asn_update; eassumption.
    + eapply IHHfs; assumption.
Qed.
