Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.

Unset Implicit Arguments.

Lemma get_labeld_list_some_in : forall (A:Set) `{LabelOf A} (l:label) (ds:list A) (d:A),
  get_labeld_list l ds = Some d -> List.In d ds.
Proof.
  intros A LA l ds. induction ds as [|a ds IH]; intros d H.
  - simpl in H. discriminate H.
  - simpl in H. destruct (classic (label_of a = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_of a = l) _ _ E) in H.
      injection H as Heq. subst d. apply List.in_eq.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of a = l) _ _ NE) in H.
      apply List.in_cons. eapply IH; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_defs_in : forall (D:init_ctx) (hds:heap_defs) (d:heap_def),
  committed_heap_defs D hds -> List.In d hds -> committed_heap_def D d.
Proof.
  intros D hds d H. induction H; intros Hin.
  - inversion Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + subst d. assumption.
    + eapply IHcommitted_heap_defs; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_def_trm_some_binds : forall (D:init_ctx) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  committed_heap_def D (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) -> binds y committed D.
Proof. intros D a y H. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_def_trm_none_false : forall (D:init_ctx) (a:trm_label),
  committed_heap_def D (heap_def_trm a None) -> False.
Proof. intros D a H. inversion H. Qed.

(* Effects: an effect-context inclusion survives dropping a prefix whose
   variables are not bound in the effect context. *)
Lemma eff_ctx_corr_one_suffix : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (D:init_ctx)
  (effs' effs:effects),
  eff_ctx_corr_one E (effs' ++ effs) ->
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D ->
  (forall e, List.In e effs' -> fst e \notin dom E) ->
  eff_ctx_corr_one E effs.
Proof.
  intros E Sigma D effs' effs Hcorr Hfree Hnodom x effs0 Hb e He.
  destruct e as [z l].
  assert (Hin : (z,l) \in from_list (effs' ++ effs)).
  { exact (Hcorr x effs0 Hb (z,l) He). }
  rewrite from_list_app in Hin. rewrite in_union in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
  - exfalso.
    pose proof (proj1 (Hfree x effs0 Hb) z l He) as Hz.
    assert (Hdom : x \in dom E) by (eapply binds_in_dom; exact Hb).
    apply (Hnodom (z,l) (proj1 (@in_from_list effect (z,l) effs') Hin)). rewrite Hz. exact Hdom.
  - exact Hin.
Qed.

(* Typing inversion for selection. *)
Lemma ty_sel_inv_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  forall (x:var) (a:trm_label), t = trm_sel (avar_f x) a ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  induction H; intros x0 a0 Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - (* ty_rcd_elim *) injection Heq as Hx Ha. subst x0 a0.
    exists S, T. split; [assumption|apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* ty_sub *) subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm x0 a0 eq_refl) as [S [T1 [Hx Hsub]]].
    exists S, T1. split; [exact Hx|]. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact H].
Qed.

Lemma ty_sel_inv : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ T ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof. intros. eapply ty_sel_inv_gen; [exact H|reflexivity]. Qed.

(* Typing inversion for assignment. *)
Lemma ty_asn_inv : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ T ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\
               G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof.
  intros G x a y T H.
  remember (trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)) as t eqn:Heqt.
  revert T Heqt.
  induction H; intros T0 Heqt; try discriminate Heqt.
  - (* ty_fld_asn *) injection Heqt as Hx Ha Hy. subst x0 y0 a0.
    exists S, T0. split; [exact H|]. split; [exact H0|apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* ty_sub *) subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm T Heqt) as [S [T1 [Hx [Hy Hsub]]]].
    exists S, T1. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hy|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact H].
Qed.

(* Initialization status facts for the reduction of selection/assignment. *)
Lemma init_typing_sel_committed : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars)
  (x:var) (a:trm_label) (i:init_typ),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ i ->
  i = committed /\ binds x committed D.
Proof.
  intros G D vs x a i H.
  destruct (@init_sel_commit G D vs x a i H) as [Heq Hc]. subst i.
  split; [reflexivity|].
  eapply commit_sel_binds; exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma init_typing_asn_status : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars)
  (x y:var) (a:trm_label) (i:init_typ),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ i ->
  (i = committed /\ binds y committed D) \/
  (i = free /\ y \in vs).
Proof.
  intros G D vs x y a i H.
  change (well_init G D vs (trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)) i) in H.
  inversion H; subst.
  - (* init_commit *) left. split; [reflexivity|].
    eapply commit_var_binds. inversion H1; subst. assumption.
  - (* init_fld_asn_ac *) left. split; [reflexivity|].
    eapply init_typing_var_committed_binds; exact H2.
  - (* init_fld_asn_ff *) right. split; [reflexivity|].
    eapply @init_typing_var_free_mem with (G:=G) (D:=D) (vs:=vs) (x:=y).
    exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma init_var_committed_binds_gen : forall (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars) (x:var) (i:init_typ),
  init_var D vs x i -> i = committed -> binds x committed D.
Proof. intros D vs x i H. remember committed as c eqn:E. induction H; subst; try discriminate; assumption. Qed.

  intros D hds d H. induction H; intros Hin.
  - inversion Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + subst d. assumption.
    + eapply IHcommitted_heap_defs; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_def_trm_some_binds : forall (D:init_ctx) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  committed_heap_def D (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) -> binds y committed D.
Proof. intros D a y H. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_def_trm_none_false : forall (D:init_ctx) (a:trm_label),
  committed_heap_def D (heap_def_trm a None) -> False.
Proof. intros D a H. inversion H. Qed.

(* Effects: an effect-context inclusion survives dropping a prefix whose
   variables are not bound in the effect context. *)
Lemma eff_ctx_corr_one_suffix : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (D:init_ctx)
  (effs' effs:effects),
  eff_ctx_corr_one E (effs' ++ effs) ->
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D ->
  (forall e, List.In e effs' -> fst e \notin dom E) ->
  eff_ctx_corr_one E effs.
Proof.
  intros E Sigma D effs' effs Hcorr Hfree Hnodom x effs0 Hb e He.
  destruct e as [z l].
  assert (Hin : (z,l) \in from_list (effs' ++ effs)).
  { exact (Hcorr x effs0 Hb (z,l) He). }
  rewrite from_list_app in Hin. rewrite in_union in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
  - exfalso.
    pose proof (proj1 (Hfree x effs0 Hb) z l He) as Hz.
    assert (Hdom : x \in dom E) by (eapply binds_in_dom; exact Hb).
    apply (Hnodom (z,l) (proj1 (@in_from_list effect (z,l) effs') Hin)). rewrite Hz. exact Hdom.
  - exact Hin.
Qed.

(* Typing inversion for selection. *)
Lemma ty_sel_inv_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  forall (x:var) (a:trm_label), t = trm_sel (avar_f x) a ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  induction H; intros x0 a0 Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - injection Heq as Hx Ha. subst x0 a0.
    exists S, T. split; [assumption|apply subtyp_refl].
  - subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm x0 a0 eq_refl) as [S [T1 [Hx Hsub]]].
    exists S, T1. split; [exact Hx|]. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact H0].
Qed.

Lemma ty_sel_inv : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ T ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof. intros. eapply ty_sel_inv_gen; [exact H|reflexivity]. Qed.

(* Typing inversion for assignment. *)
Lemma ty_asn_inv_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  forall (x y:var) (a:trm_label), t = trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\
               G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  induction H; intros x0 y0 a0 Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - injection Heq as Hx Ha Hy. subst x0 y0 a0.
    exists S, T. split; [exact H|]. split; [exact H0|apply subtyp_refl].
  - subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm x0 y0 a0 eq_refl) as [S [T1 [Hx [Hy Hsub]]]].
    exists S, T1. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hy|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact H0].
Qed.

Lemma ty_asn_inv : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ T ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\
               G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof. intros. eapply ty_asn_inv_gen; [exact H|reflexivity]. Qed.

(* Initialization status facts for the reduction of selection/assignment. *)
Lemma init_typing_sel_committed : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars)
  (x:var) (a:trm_label) (i:init_typ),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ i ->
  i = committed /\ binds x committed D.
Proof.
  intros G D vs x a i H.
  destruct (@init_sel_commit G D vs x a i H) as [Heq Hc]. subst i.
  split; [reflexivity|].
  eapply commit_sel_binds; exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma init_typing_asn_status : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars)
  (x y:var) (a:trm_label) (i:init_typ),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ i ->
  (i = committed /\ binds y committed D) \/
  (i = free /\ y \in vs).
Proof.
  intros G D vs x y a i H.
  change (well_init G D vs (trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)) i) in H.
  inversion H; subst.
  - (* init_commit *) left. split; [reflexivity|].
    inversion H0; subst. eapply commit_var_binds. eassumption.
  - (* init_fld_asn_ac *) left. split; [reflexivity|].
    eapply init_typing_var_committed_binds; exact H8.
  - (* init_fld_asn_ff *) right. split; [reflexivity|].
    Show.
Qed.

Lemma init_var_committed_binds_gen : forall (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars) (x:var) (i:init_typ),
  init_var D vs x i -> i = committed -> binds x committed D.
Proof. intros D vs x i H. remember committed as c eqn:E. induction H; subst; try discriminate; assumption. Qed.

Inductive ty_config :
  ctx -> init_ctx -> list eff_ctx -> list effects -> config -> typ -> Prop :=

| ty_config_c : forall Gamma Delta Sigma ℰ ℰs Fs t T i U effs' effs effss,
    inert Gamma ->
    inert_inits Delta ->
    heap_correspond Gamma Sigma ->
    free_sub_heaps Gamma Delta Sigma (ℰ :: ℰs) ->
    ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs) Fs T i (effs :: effss)%list U ->
    Gamma ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    ⊢e t ∶ effs' ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ (dom ℰ) ⊢i t ∶ i ->
    eff_ctx_corr (ℰ :: ℰs) ((effs' ++ effs) :: effss)%list ->
    ty_config Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs) ((effs' ++ effs) :: effss)%list (t; Fs; Sigma) U.
===== StackTyping =====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping.

Require Import Effects Initialization InitTyping.

Inductive ty_stack :
  ctx -> init_ctx -> list eff_ctx -> stack ->
  typ -> init_typ -> list effects -> typ -> Prop :=

  | ty_stack_nil : forall Gamma Delta T U ℰ i,
      Gamma ⊢ T <: U ->
              ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: nil)
                       nil T i
                       (nil :: nil)%list U

  | ty_stack_let : forall L Gamma Delta ℰ ℰs Fs t S i i' T effs effss effs' U,
      ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs)
               Fs T i'
               (effs :: effss) U ->
      (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ S ⊢ open x t ∶ T) ->
      (forall x,
          x \notin L ->
          Gamma & x ~ S ⸴ Delta & x ~ i ⸴ dom ℰ \u \{ x} ⊢i open x t ∶ i') ->
      (forall x, x \notin L -> ⊢e open x t ∶ effs') ->
      ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs)
               (frame_let t :: Fs)%list S i
               ((effs' ++ effs) :: effss)%list U

  | ty_stack_ret_free : forall Gamma Delta ℰ ℰs Fs x S i effs effss T U,
      ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs)
               Fs T free
               (effs :: effss) U ->
      Gamma ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
      Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ (dom ℰ) ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ free ->
      ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs)
               (frame_ret x :: Fs)%list S i
               (effs :: effss)%list U

  | ty_stack_ret_committed : forall Gamma Delta ℰ ℰs Fs x S i effss T U,
      ty_stack Gamma Delta ℰs
               Fs T committed
               effss U ->
      Gamma ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->

      Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ (dom ℰ) ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ free ->
      ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs)
               (frame_ret x :: Fs)%list S i
               (nil :: effss)%list U.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Inductive defs_update : heap_defs -> trm_label -> var -> heap_defs -> Prop :=

| defs_update_var : forall hds a o x,
    defs_update (cons (heap_def_trm a o) hds)
                a x
                (cons (heap_def_trm a (Some x)) hds)
| defs_update_push : forall hds d a x hds',
    defs_update hds a x hds' ->
    defs_update (cons d hds) a x (cons d hds').

Definition heap_update (Sigma : heap) (x : var) (a : trm_label) (y : var) (Sigma' : heap) :=
  exists T hds hds' Sigma1 Sigma2,
    (Sigma = Sigma1 & x ~ (item_obj T hds) & Sigma2) /\
    (x # Sigma2) /\
    (defs_update hds a y hds') /\
    (Sigma' = Sigma1 & x ~ (item_obj T hds') & Sigma2).
===== OperationalSemantics =====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax HeapUpdate.

Reserved Notation "t1 ↦ t2" (at level 40, t2 at level 39).

Inductive red : config -> config -> Prop :=

| red_sel : forall x a Sigma y T hds fs,
    binds x (item_obj T hds) Sigma ->
    labels_has hds (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) ->
    (trm_sel (avar_f x) a; fs ; Sigma)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f y); fs ; Sigma)

| red_asn : forall x a Sigma y Sigma' fs,
    heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
    (trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y); fs; Sigma)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f y); fs; Sigma')

| red_app : forall f a Sigma T t fs,
    binds f (item_lit (lit_fun T t)) Sigma ->
    (trm_app (avar_f f) (avar_f a); fs; Sigma)
      ↦ (open a t; fs; Sigma)

| red_let_lit : forall T l t Sigma x fs,
    x # Sigma ->
    (trm_lit T l t ; fs; Sigma)
      ↦ (open x t ; fs; Sigma & x ~ (item_lit l))

| red_new : forall Ts is' T ds t Sigma x c ys avs fs,
    x # Sigma ->
    x \notin fv (open_rec_vars 1 ys ds) ->
    binds c (item_lit (lit_con Ts is' T ds t)) Sigma ->
    length ys = length_s Ts ->
    vars_of_avars ys avs ->
    (trm_new (avar_f c) avs; fs; Sigma)
      ↦ ((open_vars (cons x ys) t)
           ; (frame_ret x :: fs)%list
           ; Sigma & x ~ (item_obj
                        (open_rec_vars 1 ys T)
                        (open_vars (cons x ys) (heap_defs_of_defs ds))))

| red_return : forall Sigma x y fs,
    (trm_var (avar_f y); (frame_ret x :: fs)%list; Sigma)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f x); fs; Sigma)

| red_let_var : forall t Sigma x fs,
    (trm_var (avar_f x); (frame_let t :: fs)%list; Sigma)
      ↦ (open x t; fs; Sigma)

| red_let_sta : forall T s t fs Sigma,
    (trm_let T s t; fs; Sigma)
      ↦ (s; (frame_let t :: fs)%list; Sigma)

where "t1 ↦ t2" := (red t1 t2).

Inductive answer: config -> Prop :=
| nf_loc: forall x Sigma, answer (trm_var (avar_f x); nil; Sigma).

  G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> List.length avs = length_s Ts.
Proof.
  intros G avs Ts H. change (ty_avars G avs Ts) in H.
  induction H; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. exact IHty_avars.
Qed.

  vars_of_avars xs avs ->
  G ⊢ avs :: Ts ->
  exists Ts', Ts = Ts'.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Notation effect := (var * trm_label)%type.

Notation effects := (list effect).

Notation eff_ctx := (env effects).

Fixpoint def_eff (x : var) (ds : defs) : (list effect) :=
  match ds with
  | nil => nil
  | (def_typ _ _) :: ds => def_eff x ds
  | (def_trm l) :: ds => (x,l) :: (def_eff x ds)
  end%list.

Reserved Notation "'⊢e' t '∶' eff"
         (at level 40, t at level 59).

Inductive eff_trm :
  trm -> effects -> Prop :=

| eff_ignore : forall t,
    ⊢e t ∶ nil

| eff_fld_asn : forall x a y,
    ⊢e trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ ((x,a) :: nil)

| eff_let : forall L T t u eff1 eff2,
    ⊢e t ∶ eff1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> ⊢e open x u ∶ eff2) ->
    ⊢e trm_let T t u ∶ (eff1 ++ eff2)

| eff_llit : forall L T l u eff,
    (forall x, x \notin L -> ⊢e open x u ∶ eff) ->
    ⊢e trm_lit T l u ∶ eff

where "'⊢e' t '∶' eff" := (eff_trm t eff).

Definition has_effs t effs := exists effs',
    ⊢e t ∶ effs' /\ from_list effs = from_list effs'.
===== EffCorr =====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Effects.

Definition eff_ctx_corr_one (ℰ : eff_ctx) effs :=
  (forall x effs', binds x effs' ℰ ->
                   forall eff, (eff \in (from_list effs')) ->
                               (eff \in (from_list effs))).

Inductive eff_ctx_corr : list eff_ctx -> list effects -> Prop :=

| eff_ctx_corr_nil : eff_ctx_corr nil nil

| eff_ctx_corr_cons : forall ℰ ℰs effs effss,
    eff_ctx_corr ℰs effss ->
    eff_ctx_corr_one ℰ effs ->
    eff_ctx_corr (ℰ :: ℰs) (effs :: effss).
===== HeapEffects =====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Effects.

Fixpoint heap_defs_effs (x : var) (hds : heap_defs) : effects :=
  match hds with
  | nil                             => nil
  | (heap_def_typ _ _)        :: ds => heap_defs_effs x ds
  | (heap_def_trm l (Some _)) :: ds => heap_defs_effs x ds
  | (heap_def_trm l None)     :: ds => (x,l) :: (heap_defs_effs x ds)
  end%list.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping.

Require Import Effects Initialization InitLookup.

Implicit Types (i : init_typ) (t : trm) (l : lit).

Inductive all_comm_unspec : inits -> Prop :=
| all_comm_unspec_nil : all_comm_unspec nil
| all_comm_unspec_cons : forall i is',
    (i = committed) \/ (i = unspecified) ->
    all_comm_unspec is' ->
    all_comm_unspec (cons i is').

Inductive well_committed : CommitTyping trm :=

| commit_var : forall Gamma Delta x,
    binds x committed Delta ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c (trm_var (avar_f x))

| commit_all_elim : forall Gamma Delta x z,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f z) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_app (avar_f x) (avar_f z)

| commit_new : forall Gamma Delta x avs Ts is' T,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_con Ts is' T ->
    all_comm_unspec is' ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c avs ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_new (avar_f x) avs

| commit_rcd_elim : forall Gamma Delta x a,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_sel (avar_f x) a

| commit_fld_asn : forall Gamma Delta x i y a,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f y) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)

| commit_let : forall L Gamma Delta t u T,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c t ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ committed ⊢c open x u) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_let T t u

| commit_llit : forall L Gamma Delta l u T,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c l ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ committed ⊢c open x u) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_lit T l u

with well_committed_avars : CommitTyping avars :=
     | committed_nil : forall Gamma Delta,
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c nil

     | committed_cons : forall Gamma Delta x avs,
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c (trm_var (avar_f x)) ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c avs ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c (cons (avar_f x) avs)

with well_committed_lit : CommitTyping lit :=

     | commit_all_intro : forall L Gamma Delta T t,
         (forall x, x \notin L ->
               Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ committed ⊢c open x t) ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c lit_fun T t

     | commit_con_intro : forall L Gamma Delta Ts is' T i ds t,
         length is' = length_s Ts ->
         (forall x ys,
             length ys = length_s Ts ->
             fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys) ->
             has_effs (open_vars (cons x ys) t) (def_eff x ds)) ->
         (forall x ys,
             length ys = length_s Ts ->
             fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys) ->
             (Gamma & (ys ~** (to_list Ts))
              & (x ~ open_vars (cons x ys) T) ⸴ Delta
              & (ys ~** is') & (x ~ free) ⸴ (from_list ys) \u \{ x}
                                          ⊢i (open_vars (cons x ys) t) ∶ i)) ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c lit_con Ts is' T ds t

with well_init : InitTyping trm :=

| init_var_binds : forall Gamma Delta vs x i,

    init_var Delta vs x i ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ i

| init_commit : forall Gamma Delta t vs,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c t ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i t ∶ committed

| init_new_free : forall Gamma Delta vs x avs Ts is' T,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_con Ts is' T ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i avs :: is' ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_new (avar_f x) avs ∶ free

| init_fld_asn_ac : forall Gamma Delta vs x i y a,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ i ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ committed ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ committed

| init_fld_asn_ff : forall Gamma Delta vs x y a,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ free ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ free ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ free

| init_let : forall L Gamma Delta vs t u T i i',
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i t ∶ i ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ i ⸴ vs \u \{ x} ⊢i open x u ∶ i') ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_let T t u ∶ i'

| init_llit : forall L Gamma Delta vs l u T i,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c l ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ committed ⸴ vs ⊢i open x u ∶ i) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_lit T l u ∶ i

with well_inits : InitTypings avars :=
     | well_inits_nil : forall Gamma Delta vs,
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i nil :: nil

     | well_inits_cons : forall Gamma Delta vs x i avs is',
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i (trm_var (avar_f x)) ∶ i ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i avs :: is' ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i (cons (avar_f x) avs) :: (cons i is').

Existing Instance well_committed.

Existing Instance well_committed_avars.

Existing Instance well_init.

Existing Instance well_inits.

Existing Instance well_committed_lit.

Scheme well_committed_mut        := Induction for well_committed Sort Prop
with   well_committed_avars_mut  := Induction for well_committed_avars Sort Prop
with   well_committed_lit_mut    := Induction for well_committed_lit Sort Prop
with   well_init_mut             := Induction for well_init Sort Prop
with   well_inits_mut            := Induction for well_inits Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme well_init_mut_ind from
         well_committed_mut, well_committed_avars_mut, well_committed_lit_mut,
         well_init_mut, well_inits_mut.
===== InitLookup =====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Effects Initialization.

Inductive init_sub : init_typ -> init_typ -> Prop :=
| init_sub_refl : forall i, init_sub i i
| init_sub_comm_unspec : init_sub committed unspecified
| init_sub_free_unspec : init_sub free unspecified.

Inductive init_var : init_ctx -> vars -> var -> init_typ -> Prop :=

| init_var_commit : forall Delta vs x,
    binds x committed Delta ->
    init_var Delta vs x committed

| init_var_free : forall Delta vs x,
    x \in vs ->
    binds x free Delta ->
    init_var Delta vs x free

| init_var_unspec : forall Delta vs x,
    x \in vs ->
    binds x unspecified Delta ->

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Effects.

Require Import FreeItems.

Definition free_sub_heap (ℰ : eff_ctx) (Sigma : heap) (Delta : init_ctx) :=
  forall x effs,

    binds x effs ℰ ->
    (forall y a, (y,a) \in (from_list effs) -> y = x) /\

    exists itm, binds x itm Sigma /\

                free_heap_item Delta ℰ x itm.
===== FreeItems =====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Effects HeapEffects.

Require Import HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed.

Definition free_heap_defs (Delta : init_ctx) (ℰ : eff_ctx)
           (y : var) (hds : heap_defs) :=

  binds y free Delta /\

  binds y (heap_defs_effs y hds)  ℰ /\

  forall x, (x \in heap_defs_points_to hds) ->
       well_pointed Delta ℰ x.

Inductive free_heap_item : init_ctx -> eff_ctx -> var -> item -> Prop :=

| free_heap_obj : forall Delta ℰ y T hds,
    free_heap_defs Delta ℰ y hds ->
    free_heap_item Delta ℰ y (item_obj T hds).
===== FreeSubHeapStack =====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Effects CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle.

Definition all_notin {A} (xs ys : fset A) :=
  forall x, x \in xs -> x \notin ys.

Fixpoint list_dom_union {A} (Es : list (env A)) :=
  match Es with
  | nil => \{}
  | (E :: Es)%list => dom E \u list_dom_union Es
  end.

Inductive free_sub_heaps :
  ctx -> init_ctx -> heap -> list eff_ctx -> Prop :=

| free_sub_heaps_nil : forall Gamma Delta Sigma,
    well_committed_heap Gamma Delta Sigma ->
    free_sub_heaps Gamma Delta Sigma nil

| free_sub_heaps_cons : forall Gamma Delta Sigma ℰ ℰs,
    all_notin (dom ℰ) (list_dom_union ℰs) ->
    free_sub_heap ℰ Sigma Delta ->
    free_sub_heaps Gamma Delta Sigma ℰs ->
    free_sub_heaps Gamma Delta Sigma (ℰ :: ℰs).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Effects.

Implicit Types (Delta : init_ctx) (Sigma : heap) (ℰ : eff_ctx).

Notation well_pointed Delta ℰ x :=
  ((binds x committed Delta) \/ (x \in dom ℰ /\ binds x free Delta)).
===== HeapDefsPointsTo =====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Effects.

Fixpoint heap_defs_points_to (hds : heap_defs) :=
  match hds with
  | nil => \{}
  | (heap_def_typ _ _) :: ds => heap_defs_points_to ds
  | (heap_def_trm l (Some x)) :: ds => \{ x} \u heap_defs_points_to ds
  | (heap_def_trm l None) :: ds => heap_defs_points_to ds
  end%list.
===== CommittedSubHeap =====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Typing Initialization InitTyping InitWeakening GeneralTyping.

Inductive committed_heap_def : init_ctx -> heap_def -> Prop :=

| committed_heap_def_typ : forall Delta A T,
    committed_heap_def Delta (heap_def_typ A T)

| committed_heap_def_trm : forall Delta a x,
    binds x committed Delta ->
    committed_heap_def Delta (heap_def_trm a (Some x)).

Inductive committed_heap_defs : init_ctx -> heap_defs -> Prop :=
| committed_heap_defs_nil : forall Delta,
    committed_heap_defs Delta nil

| committed_heap_defs_cons : forall Delta hd hds,
    committed_heap_defs Delta hds ->
    committed_heap_def Delta hd ->
    committed_heap_defs Delta (cons hd hds).

Inductive committed_heap_item :
  ctx -> init_ctx -> item -> Prop :=

| committed_heap_lit : forall Gamma Delta l,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c l ->
    committed_heap_item Gamma Delta (item_lit l)

| committed_heap_obj : forall Gamma Delta T hds,
    committed_heap_defs Delta hds ->
    committed_heap_item Gamma Delta (item_obj T hds).

Definition well_committed_heap (Gamma : ctx) (Delta : init_ctx) (Sigma : heap) :=
  dom Gamma = dom Delta /\
  dom Delta = dom Sigma /\
  forall x itm,
    binds x committed Delta ->
    binds x itm Sigma ->
    committed_heap_item Gamma Delta itm.

Definition more_committed Delta Delta' :=
  (forall x, binds x committed Delta -> binds x committed Delta').

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Typing PreTyping.

Require Import GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping PreciseTyping.

Require Import SubstitutionClass Substitution Weakening Narrowing BndIntro.

Inductive ty_heap_def : DecTyping heap_def :=

| ty_heap_def_typ : forall Gamma A T,
    Gamma ⊢ heap_def_typ A T ∶d dec_typ A T T

| ty_heap_def_trm_none : forall Gamma a T,
    Gamma ⊢ heap_def_trm a None ∶d dec_trm a T T

| ty_heap_def_trm_some : forall Gamma a x T,
    Gamma ⊢ (trm_var (avar_f x)) ∶ T ->
    Gamma ⊢ heap_def_trm a (Some x) ∶d dec_trm a T T.

Existing Instance ty_heap_def.

Inductive ty_item_s : ctx -> heap -> var -> Prop :=
| ty_item_lit_s : forall Gamma Sigma x l T,
    binds x T Gamma ->
    binds x (item_lit l) Sigma ->
    Gamma ⊢ l ∶ T ->
    ty_item_s Gamma Sigma x
| ty_item_obj_s : forall Gamma Sigma x U hds,
    binds x (typ_bnd U) Gamma ->
    binds x (item_obj U hds) Sigma ->
    Gamma ⊢ hds ∶ open x U ->
    ty_item_s Gamma Sigma x.

Definition heap_correspond (G : ctx) (Sigma : heap) : Prop :=
  (dom G = dom Sigma) /\
  (forall x,
      x \in dom G ->
      ty_item_s G Sigma x).

Definition commit_ctx (E:eff_ctx) : init_ctx := EnvOps.map (fun (_:effects) => committed) E.

Lemma commit_ctx_dom : forall (E:eff_ctx), dom (commit_ctx E) = dom E.
Proof. intros. unfold commit_ctx. apply dom_map. Qed.

Lemma binds_commit_ctx_in : forall (E:eff_ctx) (x:var),
  x \in dom E -> binds x committed (commit_ctx E).
Proof.
  intros E x Hx. destruct (dom_binds_exists Hx) as [v Hb].
  unfold commit_ctx. exact (@binds_map effects init_typ x v (fun _ => committed) E Hb).
Qed.

Lemma binds_commit_ctx_notin : forall (E:eff_ctx) (x:var) (v:init_typ),
  x \notin dom E -> ~ binds x v (commit_ctx E).
Proof.
  intros E x v Hx Hb. apply Hx. rewrite <- commit_ctx_dom.
  eapply binds_in_dom; exact Hb.
Qed.

Section Strengthen.
Variables (D:init_ctx) (ℰ:eff_ctx).
Definition Dstr := D & commit_ctx ℰ.

Hypothesis Hfree_ℰ : forall x, x \in dom ℰ -> binds x free D.

Lemma binds_str_in : forall (E:init_ctx) (x:var),
  (forall y, y \in dom E -> y \notin dom ℰ) ->
  x \in dom ℰ -> binds x committed (Dstr & E).
Proof.
  intros E x Hdisj Hx.
  assert (HxE : x \notin dom E) by (intro K; exact (Hdisj x K Hx)).
  apply LibEnv.binds_concat_left with (E2:=E).
  - unfold Dstr. apply LibEnv.binds_concat_right.
    apply binds_commit_ctx_in. exact Hx.
  - exact HxE.
Qed.

Lemma binds_str_out : forall (E:init_ctx) (x:var) (v:init_typ),
  (forall y, y \in dom E -> y \notin dom ℰ) ->
  x \notin dom ℰ ->
  binds x v (D & E) -> binds x v (Dstr & E).
Proof.
  intros E x v Hdisj Hx Hb.
  destruct (classic (x \in dom E)) as [HinE|HnotinE].
  - assert (HbE : binds x v E).
    { destruct (@LibEnv.binds_concat_inv' init_typ x v D E Hb) as [[HxE _]|HbE].
      - exfalso. exact (HxE HinE).
      - exact HbE. }
    apply LibEnv.binds_concat_right. exact HbE.
  - assert (HbD : binds x v D) by (eapply LibEnv.binds_concat_left_inv; [exact Hb|exact HnotinE]).
    apply LibEnv.binds_concat_left with (E2:=E).
    + unfold Dstr. apply LibEnv.binds_concat_left with (E2:=commit_ctx ℰ).
      * exact HbD.
      * rewrite commit_ctx_dom. exact Hx.
    + exact HnotinE.
Qed.

Lemma init_var_transfer_commit : forall (E:init_ctx) (vs:vars) (x:var) (i:init_typ),
  (forall y, y \in dom E -> y \notin dom ℰ) ->
  (forall y, y \in dom ℰ -> y \notin vs) ->
  init_var (D & E) vs x i -> init_var (Dstr & E) vs x i.
Proof.
  intros E vs x i Hdisj Hvs H. remember (D & E) as Delta eqn:Heq.
  induction H.
  - (* commit *) subst Delta. apply init_var_commit.
    destruct (classic (x \in dom ℰ)) as [Hx|Hx].
    + exfalso.
      assert (HxE : x \notin dom E) by (intro K; exact (Hdisj x K Hx)).
      assert (HbD : binds x committed D) by (eapply LibEnv.binds_concat_left_inv; [exact H|exact HxE]).
      pose proof (Hfree_ℰ x Hx) as Hf.
      pose proof (@LibEnv.binds_functional init_typ x committed free D HbD Hf) as E0.
      discriminate E0.
    + eapply binds_str_out; [exact Hdisj|exact Hx|exact H].
  - (* free *) subst Delta. apply init_var_free.
    + exact H.
    + destruct (classic (x \in dom ℰ)) as [Hx|Hx].
      * exfalso. exact (Hvs x Hx H).
      * eapply binds_str_out; [exact Hdisj|exact Hx|exact H0].
  - (* unspec *) subst Delta. apply init_var_unspec.
    + exact H.
    + destruct (classic (x \in dom ℰ)) as [Hx|Hx].
      * exfalso. exact (Hvs x Hx H).
      * eapply binds_str_out; [exact Hdisj|exact Hx|exact H0].
  - (* sub *) eapply init_var_sub; [apply IHinit_var; [exact Hvs|exact Heq]|exact H0].
Qed.

Proof.
  intros ℰ Sigma D y H Hy.

  - eapply init_var_free_mem. exact H4.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect.

Inductive init_typ : Set :=
  | committed : init_typ
  | free : init_typ
  | unspecified : init_typ.

Notation inits := (list init_typ).

Notation init_ctx := (env init_typ).

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_all  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_con  : typs -> inits -> typ -> typ

with typs : Set :=
  | typs_nil : typs
  | typs_cons : typ -> typs -> typs

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_trm  : trm_label -> typ -> typ -> dec.

Scheme typ_mut  := Induction for typ Sort Prop
with   typs_mut := Induction for typs Sort Prop
with   dec_mut  := Induction for dec Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typ_mutind from typ_mut, typs_mut, dec_mut.

Fixpoint typs_to_list (Ts : typs) : list typ :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => nil
  | typs_cons T Ts' => (T :: typs_to_list Ts')%list
  end.

Instance TypsToList : ToList typ typs := typs_to_list.

Arguments TypsToList _ /.

Fixpoint typs_of_list (xs : list typ) : typs :=
  match xs with
  | nil => typs_nil
  | (T :: Ts')%list => typs_cons T (typs_of_list Ts')
  end.

Instance TypsOfList : OfList typ typs := typs_of_list.

Arguments TypsOfList _ /.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L    => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_all T1 T2  => typ_all (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_con Ts is' T =>
    typ_con
      (open_rec_typs k u Ts)
      is'
      (open_rec_typ (S (length_s Ts) + k) u T)

  end with
open_rec_typs (k : nat) (u : var) (Ts : typs) : typs :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => typs_nil
  | typs_cons T Ts =>
    typs_cons (open_rec_typ k u T)
              (open_rec_typs k u Ts)
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_trm m T U => dec_trm m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance TypsOpenable : Openable typs := open_rec_typs.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L    => (fv x)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_all T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_con Ts is' T   => (fv_typs Ts) \u (fv_typ T)
  end with
fv_typs (Ts : typs) : vars :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => \{}
  | typs_cons T Ts => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typs Ts)
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_trm m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)

  fun (x: var) (y: var) (a: avar) =>

  AbstractSyntax AvarOpenable AvarFreeVar AvarSubstVar := {}.

  fun x a =>

  fun (n : nat) (x : var) (a : avar) =>
    match a with

| vars_of_avars_nil : vars_of_avars nil nil
| vars_of_avars_cons : forall x vs avs,
    vars_of_avars vs avs ->
    vars_of_avars (cons x vs) (cons (avar_f x) avs).

  fun {C} df f comb => List.fold_right (fun a acc => comb (f a) acc) df.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Typing.

Implicit Types (ds : defs) (hds : heap_defs).

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ A T T)
| rd_trm : forall a T, record_dec (dec_trm a T T).

Inductive record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D.

Let's try proving `inert_typ_not_sub_record` ourselves in a separate file `InertNoRecord.v`, but this may duplicate agent? FieldSub/RootSub related; still a distinct lemma. If it succeeds, helps progress. Let's attempt with a **semantic inductive predicate** approach and see.

Define `no_record_sub G T D` inversion? We want `inert_typ T -> G⊢T<:typ_rcd D -> False`. We can prove by induction on the subtyping derivation with **source T inert** and a generalized target shape. Cases:
- top: target top not record.
- bot: source bot not inert.
- refl: source record, not inert.
- trans: T<:S, S<:D. Need analyze S. Inert T; Hsub1 T<:S. We need show S is either a "non-record-capable" shape that cannot reach record. Could define an inductive `bad_shape` preserved from inert:
```
Inductive nonrec : typ -> Prop :=
 | nr_top
 | nr_inert T : inert_typ T -> nonrec T
 | nr_and T U : nonrec T -> nonrec U -> nonrec (typ_and T U)
 | nr_sel x A : nonrec (typ_sel x A)  (* selection cannot be record? but can subtype record via sel1; sel1 upper may be record *)
```
If typ_sel can subtype record, nr_sel not enough. But Hsub2 typ_sel<:record via sel1 means the **upper bound** is record, and the lower bound/payload chain; no direct contradiction unless source inert chain. Could include sel with a payload condition.

Maybe use `type_member_graph` recursion on heap/context not available.

Let's think about the sel2/sel1 pair more abstractly. Subtyping is a relation generated by rules; the pair sel2/sel1 essentially allows transitivity through a type member: if `G⊢z∶typ_rcd(dec_typ A S T)`, then `S <: typ_sel z A` and `typ_sel z A <: T`, so `S <: T`. Thus for any type member with lower S and upper T, S <: T. But since `dec_typ` in record types from heaps has equal bounds Tf Tf, the pair gives Tf<:Tf trivial; to get lower S and upper T different, subtyping of the record target dec_typ A S T from the stored dec_typ Tf Tf gives S<:Tf and Tf<:T, so S<:T by transitivity. Thus the sel pair is **redundant**: `S <: T` already follows by transitivity of the two subtyping derivations S<:Tf and Tf<:T, but those derivations are synthesized by subtyping rules from the record typing.   inert G ->
  binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->

  (effss:list effects) (Fs:stack) (Sigma:heap) (U:typ)
  (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (T0:typ) (hds:heap_defs),
  ty_config G D Es effss (trm_sel (avar_f x) a ; Fs ; Sigma) U ->
  binds x (item_obj T0 hds) Sigma ->
  labels_has hds (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) ->
  exists G' D' Es' effss',
    ty_config (G & G') D' Es' effss' (trm_var (avar_f y) ; Fs ; Sigma) U.

  destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D Es effss (trm_sel (avar_f x) a) Fs Sigma U Hcfg) as

  assert (Heffnil : effs' = nil) by (eapply eff_trm_sel_nil; exact Heff).

  cbn in Hcorr. cbn in HeqEffs.
  destruct (@ty_sel_inv G x a Ts Hty) as [S [Ts0 [Hxrec HsubT]]].
  destruct (@init_typing_sel_committed G D (dom ℰ) x a ii Hinit) as [Hi Heqxcomm].
  subst ii.
  destruct (@heap_correspond_obj G Sigma x T0 hds Hhc Hbheap) as [HxG Hhds].
  assert (Hsubopen : G ⊢ open x T0 <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S Ts0))

  pose proof (@labels_has_heap_in hds (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) Hlab) as Hin.
  destruct (@heap_def_typing_rh G hds (open x T0) a y Hhds Hin) as [Tf [Hrh HyTf]].
  assert (Htfsub : G ⊢ Tf <: Ts0) by (eapply Hfield; eassumption).
  assert (HyTs : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ Ts).
  { eapply ty_sub.
    - exact HyTf.
    - eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Htfsub|exact HsubT]. }
  pose proof (@free_sub_heaps_well_committed G D Sigma (ℰ :: ℰs) Hfs) as Hwc.
  pose proof (@well_committed_heap_item G D Sigma x (item_obj T0 hds) Hwc Heqxcomm Hbheap) as Hci.
  pose proof (@committed_heap_item_obj_inv G D T0 hds Hci) as Hcdefs.
  pose proof (@committed_heap_defs_in D hds (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) Hcdefs Hin) as Hcd.
  pose proof (@committed_heap_def_trm_some_binds D a y Hcd) as Hycomm.
  exists (empty:ctx), D, (ℰ :: ℰs), (effs :: effss0).

Lemma dom_binds_exists : forall (A:Type) (E:env A) (x:var),
  x \in dom E -> exists v, binds x v E.
Proof.
  intros A E x H. destruct (@LibEnv.get_some A x E H) as [v Hv].
  exists v. exact Hv.
Qed.

(** * Heap correspondence *)

Lemma heap_correspond_dom : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap),
  heap_correspond G Sigma -> dom G = dom Sigma.
Proof. intros G Sigma [Hdom _]. exact Hdom. Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_ty_item : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var),
  heap_correspond G Sigma -> x \in dom G -> ty_item_s G Sigma x.
Proof. intros G Sigma x [_ H]. exact (H x). Qed.

Lemma ty_item_s_obj_inv : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (T:typ) (hds:heap_defs),
  ty_item_s G Sigma x ->
  binds x (item_obj T hds) Sigma ->
  binds x (typ_bnd T) G /\ G ⊢ hds ∶ open x T.
Proof.
  intros G Sigma x T hds Hty Hb. inversion Hty; subst.
  - (* lit item *)
    match goal with
    | Hl : binds x (item_lit l) Sigma |- _ =>
      assert (Heq : item_lit l = item_obj T hds) by
        (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; [exact Hl|exact Hb]);
      discriminate Heq
    end.
  - (* obj item *)
    match goal with
    | Hu : binds x (item_obj U hds0) Sigma |- _ =>
      assert (Heq : item_obj U hds0 = item_obj T hds) by
        (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; [exact Hu|exact Hb]);
      injection Heq as HU Hh; subst; split; assumption
    end.
Qed.

Lemma ty_item_s_lit_inv : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (l:lit),
  ty_item_s G Sigma x ->
  binds x (item_lit l) Sigma ->
  exists T, binds x T G /\ G ⊢ l ∶ T.
Proof.
  intros G Sigma x l Hty Hb. inversion Hty; subst.
  - assert (Heq : item_lit l0 = item_lit l) by
      (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; eassumption).
    injection Heq as Hl. subst. eexists. split; eassumption.
  - match goal with
    | Hu : binds x (item_obj U hds) Sigma |- _ =>
      assert (Heq : item_obj U hds = item_lit l) by
        (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; [exact Hu|exact Hb]);
      discriminate Heq
    end.
Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_obj : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (T:typ) (hds:heap_defs),

(* Typing inversion for selection. *)
Lemma ty_sel_inv_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  forall (x:var) (a:trm_label), t = trm_sel (avar_f x) a ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  induction H; intros x0 a0 Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - injection Heq as Hx Ha. subst x0 a0.
    exists S, T. split; [assumption|apply subtyp_refl].
  - subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm x0 a0 eq_refl) as [S [T1 [Hx Hsub]]].
    exists S, T1. split; [exact Hx|]. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact H0].
Qed.

Lemma ty_sel_inv : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ T ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof. intros. eapply ty_sel_inv_gen; [exact H|reflexivity]. Qed.

(* Typing inversion for assignment. *)
Lemma ty_asn_inv_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  forall (x y:var) (a:trm_label), t = trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\
               G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  induction H; intros x0 y0 a0 Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - injection Heq as Hx Ha Hy. subst x0 y0 a0.
    exists S, T. split; [exact H|]. split; [exact H0|apply subtyp_refl].
  - subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm x0 y0 a0 eq_refl) as [S [T1 [Hx [Hy Hsub]]]].
    exists S, T1. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hy|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact H0].
Qed.

Lemma ty_asn_inv : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ T ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\
               G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof. intros. eapply ty_asn_inv_gen; [exact H|reflexivity]. Qed.

(* Initialization status facts for the reduction of selection/assignment. *)
Lemma init_typing_sel_committed : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars)
  (x:var) (a:trm_label) (i:init_typ),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ i ->
  i = committed /\ binds x committed D.
Proof.
  intros G D vs x a i H.
  destruct (@init_sel_commit G D vs x a i H) as [Heq Hc]. subst i.
  split; [reflexivity|].
  eapply commit_sel_binds; exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma init_typing_asn_status : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars)
  (x y:var) (a:trm_label) (i:init_typ),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ i ->
  (i = committed /\ binds y committed D) \/
  (i = free /\ y \in vs).
Proof.

  change (well_init G D vs (trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)) i) in H.

  - (* init_commit *) left. split; [reflexivity|].

Lemma committed_heap_defs_update : forall (D:init_ctx) (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  committed_heap_defs D hds ->

  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
  binds x committed D ->
  free_sub_heap E Sigma' D.

  destruct Hup as (T & hds & hds' & S1 & S2 & Heq & Hfresh & Hdu & Heq').
  subst Sigma Sigma'.
  intros z effs Hb. destruct (Hfree z effs Hb) as [Hsame Hrest].
  destruct Hrest as [itm [Hbinds Hitem]].
  assert (Hne : z <> x).
  { intro E0. subst z.
    inversion Hitem; subst.
    match goal with
    | Hf : free_heap_defs D E x ?hds0 |- _ =>
      destruct Hf as [Hbzfree _]

    pose proof (@LibEnv.binds_functional init_typ x free committed D Hbzfree Hxcomm) as Heqfc.
    discriminate Heqfc. }

  - exists itm. split.
    + eapply (@binds_replace item S1 S2 x z

    + exact Hitem.

  (Sigma Sigma':heap) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  well_committed_heap G D Sigma ->
  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
  binds x committed D ->
  binds y committed D ->
  well_committed_heap G D Sigma'.
Proof.

  destruct Hwc as [HdomG [HdomD Hitem]].
  destruct Hup as (T & hds & hds' & S1 & S2 & Heq & Hfresh & Hdu & Heq').
  subst Sigma Sigma'.
  split; [exact HdomG|]. split.
  - rewrite HdomD. rewrite !LibEnv.dom_concat, !LibEnv.dom_single. reflexivity.
  - intros z itm Hzcomm Hbinds.
    destruct (classic (z = x)) as [->|Hne].
    + assert (Hcanon : binds x (item_obj T hds')
                      (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds' & S2)).
      { eapply LibEnv.binds_concat_left.
        - apply LibEnv.binds_push_eq.
        - exact Hfresh. }
      assert (Heqitm : itm = item_obj T hds')
        by (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; [exact Hbinds|exact Hcanon]).
      subst itm.
      assert (Hcanon_old : binds x (item_obj T hds)

        - apply LibEnv.binds_push_eq.
        - exact Hfresh. }

  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
  binds x committed D ->

Require Import Base.
Require Import Case.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.

Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* A record component reachable by field selection. *)
Inductive has_field : typ -> trm_label -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| hf_one : forall (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
    has_field (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U)) a S U
| hf_andl : forall (T U:typ) (a:trm_label) (S Uf:typ),
    has_field T a S Uf -> has_field (typ_and T U) a S Uf
| hf_andr : forall (T U:typ) (a:trm_label) (S Uf:typ),
    has_field U a S Uf -> has_field (typ_and T U) a S Uf.

Lemma has_field_record_has : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
  has_field T a S U -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U).
Proof.
  intros T a S U H. induction H.
  - apply rh_one.
  - apply rh_andl. assumption.
  - apply rh_andr. assumption.
Qed.

(* Types built from top and records by intersection. *)
Inductive rc : typ -> Prop :=
| rc_top : rc typ_top
| rc_rcd : forall (D:dec), rc (typ_rcd D)
| rc_and : forall (T U:typ), rc T -> rc U -> rc (typ_and T U).

Lemma rc_not_bot : forall (T:typ), rc T -> T = typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intro E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_sel : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), T = typ_sel a A -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros a A E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_all : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (S U:typ), T = typ_all S U -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros S0 U0 E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_con : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (X:typ),
  T = typ_con Ts is' X -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros Ts is' X E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (X:typ), T = typ_bnd X -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros X E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma record_typ_rc : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label),
  record_typ T ls -> rc T.
Proof.
  intros T ls H. induction H.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - apply rc_and; [assumption|apply rc_rcd].
Qed.

Lemma record_type_rc : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> rc T.
Proof. intros T [ls H]. exact (@record_typ_rc T ls H). Qed.

Lemma rc_subtyp : forall (G:ctx) (T U:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: U -> rc T -> rc U.
Proof.
  intros G T U H. induction H; intros Hrc.
  - apply rc_top.
  - exfalso. eapply rc_not_bot; [exact Hrc|reflexivity].
  - exact Hrc.
  - apply IHsubtyp0. apply IHsubtyp. exact Hrc.
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hrc; subst. assumption.
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hrc; subst. assumption.
  - (* and2 *) apply rc_and; [apply IHsubtyp|apply IHsubtyp0]; exact Hrc.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - inversion Hrc; try discriminate.
  - inversion Hrc; try discriminate.
  - inversion Hrc; try discriminate.
Qed.

(* Field extraction for rc types. *)
Lemma rc_field : forall (G:ctx) (T R:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: R ->
  rc T ->
  forall (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
    R = typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    exists Sf Uf, has_field T a Sf Uf /\ G ⊢ S <: Sf /\ G ⊢ Uf <: U.
Proof.
  intros G T R Hsub. induction Hsub; intros Hrc a S U Heq.
  - (* top *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* bot *) exfalso. eapply rc_not_bot; eassumption.
  - (* refl *) inversion Heq; subst.
    exists S, U. split; [apply hf_one|split; apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* trans *) subst.
    assert (HrcS : rc S) by (eapply rc_subtyp; eassumption).
    eapply IHHsub2; [exact HrcS|reflexivity].
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hrc; subst.
    eapply IHsubtyp; [exact H1|reflexivity].
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hrc; subst.
    eapply IHsubtyp; [exact H2|reflexivity].
  - (* and2 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* fld *) inversion Heq; subst.
    exists T2, U1. split.
    + apply hf_one.
    + split; assumption.
  - (* typ *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* sel2 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* sel1 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* all *) discriminate Heq.
Qed.

Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* The statement of the proposed lemma, with the label [a] fixed.        *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Definition field_lookup_sub_statement (a : trm_label) : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (Tf S U:typ),
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    G ⊢ Tf <: U.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* A tiny "soundness" interpretation of types, used only to show that    *)
(* the empty context cannot prove [typ_top <: typ_bot].                  *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Fixpoint interp (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_rcd _ => True
  | typ_and T U => interp T /\ interp U
  | typ_sel _ _ => True
  | typ_bnd _ => True
  | typ_all _ _ => True
  | typ_con _ _ _ => True
  end.

(* In the empty context no variable can be typed, and every subtyping   *)
(* derivation is sound for [interp].  In particular the empty context    *)
(* proves no [typ_top <: typ_bot].  The proof is a mutual induction on   *)
(* the typing/subtyping derivation; [sel2]/[sel1] are handled by the    *)
(* fact that their typing premise is a variable typing in the empty      *)
(* context, which is impossible.                                         *)

Lemma empty_typing_sub_sound :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
     G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (T U:typ), G ⊢ T <: U ->
     G = empty -> interp T -> interp U) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).
Proof.
  apply (rules_mutind
    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
       G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False)
    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (T U:typ) (_:G ⊢ T <: U) =>
       G = empty -> interp T -> interp U)
    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True));
  intros;
  try solve [cbn [interp] in *; tauto];
  try (match goal with
       | H : binds ?x ?v ?G, He : ?G = empty |- False =>
           rewrite He in H; exact (binds_empty_inv H)
       end);
  try (match goal with
       | H : ?G = empty -> forall y, ?t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> False,
         He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
           exfalso; eapply H; [exact He | first [eassumption | reflexivity]]
       end);
  try (match goal with H : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- False => discriminate H end);
  try (match goal with H : trm_var (avar_f _) = ?t |- False => discriminate H end).
Qed.

Lemma empty_not_top_sub_bot : ~ (empty ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot).
Proof.
  intro H.
  pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 empty_typing_sub_sound))
                empty typ_top typ_bot H) as Hsub.
  cbn [interp] in Hsub.
  apply Hsub; [reflexivity | exact I].
Qed.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* Refutation of the proposed lemma.                                     *)
(*                                                                       *)
(* Take [G = empty] and                                                     *)
(*   V  = typ_and typ_bot (typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top))          *)
(*   Tf = typ_top,  S = typ_top,  U = typ_bot.                          *)
(*                                                                       *)
(* Both premises hold:                                                   *)
(*  - [record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf)] by [rh_andr]/[rh_one];            *)
(*  - [empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_bot)] by             *)
(*    [subtyp_and11] (V <: typ_bot) followed by [subtyp_bot] and         *)
(*    [subtyp_trans]; this uses no variables at all.                     *)
(*                                                                       *)
(* But the conclusion would be [empty ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot], which is    *)
(* refuted by [empty_not_top_sub_bot].  Thus the lemma is false.         *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Theorem field_lookup_sub_refuted :
  forall (a : trm_label), ~ field_lookup_sub_statement a.
Proof.

27	  | typ_rcd _ => True
28	  | typ_and T U => interp T /\ interp U

43	  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
44	     G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False) /\

54	    (fun (G:ctx) (T U:typ) (_:G ⊢ T <: U) =>

56	    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True));

Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* The statement of the proposed lemma, with the label [a] fixed.        *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Definition field_lookup_sub_statement (a : trm_label) : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (Tf S U:typ),
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    G ⊢ Tf <: U.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* A tiny "soundness" interpretation of types, used only to show that    *)
(* the empty context cannot prove [typ_top <: typ_bot].                  *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Fixpoint interp (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_rcd _ => True
  | typ_and T U => interp T /\ interp U
  | typ_sel _ _ => True
  | typ_bnd _ => True
  | typ_all _ _ => True
  | typ_con _ _ _ => True
  end.

(* In the empty context no variable can be typed, and every subtyping   *)
(* derivation is sound for [interp].  In particular the empty context    *)
(* proves no [typ_top <: typ_bot].  The proof is a mutual induction on   *)
(* the typing/subtyping derivation; [sel2]/[sel1] are handled by the    *)
(* fact that their typing premise is a variable typing in the empty      *)
(* context, which is impossible.                                         *)

Lemma empty_typing_sub_sound :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
     G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (T U:typ), G ⊢ T <: U ->
     G = empty -> interp T -> interp U) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).
Proof.
  apply (rules_mutind
    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
       G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False)
    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)

19	(* A tiny "soundness" interpretation of types, used only to show that    *)
20	(* the empty context cannot prove [typ_top <: typ_bot].                  *)

23	Fixpoint interp (T:typ) : Prop :=
24	  match T with
25	  | typ_top => True
26	  | typ_bot => False
27	  | typ_rcd _ => True
28	  | typ_and T U => interp T /\ interp U
29	  | typ_sel _ _ => True
30	  | typ_bnd _ => True
31	  | typ_all _ _ => True
32	  | typ_con _ _ _ => True
33	  end.

35	(* In the empty context no variable can be typed, and every subtyping   *)
36	(* derivation is sound for [interp].  In particular the empty context    *)
37	(* proves no [typ_top <: typ_bot].  The proof is a mutual induction on   *)
38	(* the typing/subtyping derivation; [sel2]/[sel1] are handled by the    *)
39	(* fact that their typing premise is a variable typing in the empty      *)
40	(* context, which is impossible.                                         *)
41	
42	Lemma empty_typing_sub_sound :
43	  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
44	     G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False) /\
45	  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
46	  (forall (G:ctx) (T U:typ), G ⊢ T <: U ->
47	     G = empty -> interp T -> interp U) /\
48	  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).
49	Proof.
50	  apply (rules_mutind
51	    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
52	       G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False)
53	    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
54	    (fun (G:ctx) (T U:typ) (_:G ⊢ T <: U) =>
55	       G = empty -> interp T -> interp U)
56	    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True));
57	  intros;
58	  try solve [cbn [interp] in *; tauto];
59	  try (match goal with
60	       | H : binds ?x ?v ?G, He : ?G = empty |- False =>
61	           rewrite He in H; exact (binds_empty_inv H)
62	       end);
63	  try (match goal with
64	       | H : ?G = empty -> forall y, ?t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> False,
65	         He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
66	           exfalso; eapply H; [exact He | first [eassumption | reflexivity]]
67	       end);
68	  try (match goal with H : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- False => discriminate H end);
69	  try (match goal with H : trm_var (avar_f _) = ?t |- False => discriminate H end).
70	Qed.

72	Lemma empty_not_top_sub_bot : ~ (empty ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot).
73	Proof.
74	  intro H.
75	  pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 empty_typing_sub_sound))
76	                empty typ_top typ_bot H) as Hsub.
77	  cbn [interp] in Hsub.
78	  apply Hsub; [reflexivity | exact I].
79	Qed.

89	(*  - [record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf)] by [rh_andr]/[rh_one];            *)
90	(*  - [empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_bot)] by             *)
91	(*    [subtyp_and11] (V <: typ_bot) followed by [subtyp_bot] and         *)
92	(*    [subtyp_trans]; this uses no variables at all.                     *)
93	(*                                                                       *)
94	(* But the conclusion would be [empty ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot], which is    *)
95	(* refuted by [empty_not_top_sub_bot].  Thus the lemma is false.         *)
96	(* ==================================================================== *)

98	Theorem field_lookup_sub_refuted :
99	  forall (a : trm_label), ~ field_lookup_sub_statement a.

102	  apply empty_not_top_sub_bot.
103	  eapply Hstmt with
104	    (V := typ_and typ_bot (typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top)))
105	    (S := typ_top).
106	  - apply rh_andr, rh_one.
107	  - eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_bot).
108	    + apply subtyp_and11.
109	    + apply subtyp_bot.

117	(* conjunction rule), and that [typ_bot] is a subtype of every record    *)
118	(* type.  Consequently                                                    *)

121	(*                                                                       *)
122	(* witnesses the second premise while [record_has] of the left           *)
123	(* component is inherited through [rh_andr].  The conclusion would be     *)
124	(* [typ_top <: typ_bot], which is not derivable in the empty context:    *)
125	(* any derivation of it must end in [subtyp_trans] and eventually need   *)
126	(* a [subtyp_sel1] step whose variable typing premise is impossible in   *)

Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* The statement of the proposed lemma, with the label [a] fixed.        *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Definition field_lookup_sub_statement (a : trm_label) : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (Tf S U:typ),
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    G ⊢ Tf <: U.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* A tiny "soundness" interpretation of types, used only to show that    *)
(* the empty context cannot prove [typ_top <: typ_bot].                  *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Fixpoint interp (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_rcd _ => True
  | typ_and T U => interp T /\ interp U
  | typ_sel _ _ => True
  | typ_bnd _ => True
  | typ_all _ _ => True
  | typ_con _ _ _ => True
  end.

(* In the empty context no variable can be typed, and every subtyping   *)
(* derivation is sound for [interp].  In particular the empty context    *)
(* proves no [typ_top <: typ_bot].  The proof is a mutual induction on   *)
(* the typing/subtyping derivation; [sel2]/[sel1] are handled by the    *)
(* fact that their typing premise is a variable typing in the empty      *)
(* context, which is impossible.                                         *)

Lemma empty_typing_sub_sound :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
     G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (T U:typ), G ⊢ T <: U ->
     G = empty -> interp T -> interp U) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).
Proof.
  apply (rules_mutind
    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
       G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False)
    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (T U:typ) (_:G ⊢ T <: U) =>
       G = empty -> interp T -> interp U)
    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True));
  intros;
  try solve [cbn [interp] in *; tauto];
  try (match goal with
       | H : binds ?x ?v ?G, He : ?G = empty |- False =>
           rewrite He in H; exact (binds_empty_inv H)
       end);
  try (match goal with
       | H : ?G = empty -> forall y, ?t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> False,
         He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
           exfalso; eapply H; [exact He | first [eassumption | reflexivity]]
       end);
  try (match goal with H : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- False => discriminate H end);
  try (match goal with H : trm_var (avar_f _) = ?t |- False => discriminate H end).
Qed.

Lemma empty_not_top_sub_bot : ~ (empty ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot).
Proof.
  intro H.
  pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 empty_typing_sub_sound))
                empty typ_top typ_bot H) as Hsub.
  cbn [interp] in Hsub.
  apply Hsub; [reflexivity | exact I].
Qed.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* Refutation of the proposed lemma.                                     *)
(*                                                                       *)
(* Take [G = empty] and                                                     *)
(*   V  = typ_and typ_bot (typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top))          *)
(*   Tf = typ_top,  S = typ_top,  U = typ_bot.                          *)
(*                                                                       *)
(* Both premises hold:                                                   *)
(*  - [record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf)] by [rh_andr]/[rh_one];            *)
(*  - [empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_bot)] by             *)
(*    [subtyp_and11] (V <: typ_bot) followed by [subtyp_bot] and         *)
(*    [subtyp_trans]; this uses no variables at all.                     *)
(*                                                                       *)
(* But the conclusion would be [empty ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot], which is    *)
(* refuted by [empty_not_top_sub_bot].  Thus the lemma is false.         *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Theorem field_lookup_sub_refuted :
  forall (a : trm_label), ~ field_lookup_sub_statement a.
Proof.
  intros a Hstmt.
  apply empty_not_top_sub_bot.
  eapply Hstmt with
    (V := typ_and typ_bot (typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top)))
    (S := typ_top).
  - apply rh_andr, rh_one.
  - eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_bot).
    + apply subtyp_and11.
    + apply subtyp_bot.
Qed.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* Explanation (no [Qed] is claimed for the false statement).            *)
(*                                                                       *)
(* The statement is genuinely false.  The counterexample above uses the  *)
(* fact that a record type is a subtype of [typ_bot] (via the             *)
(* conjunction rule), and that [typ_bot] is a subtype of every record    *)
(* type.  Consequently                                                    *)
(*                                                                       *)
(*   typ_and typ_bot V  <:  typ_bot  <:  typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U)         *)
(*                                                                       *)
(* witnesses the second premise while [record_has] of the left           *)
(* component is inherited through [rh_andr].  The conclusion would be     *)
(* [typ_top <: typ_bot], which is not derivable in the empty context:    *)
(* any derivation of it must end in [subtyp_trans] and eventually need   *)
(* a [subtyp_sel1] step whose variable typing premise is impossible in   *)
(* the empty context.  The lemma [empty_not_top_sub_bot] formalises this *)
(* impossibility.                                                        *)
(*                                                                       *)
(* (There is a second, context-based counterexample as well: bind        *)
(* x : typ_rcd (dec_typ A typ_top (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S typ_bot))).      *)
(* Then [typ_top <: x.A] via [subtyp_sel2], [x.A <: typ_rcd ...] via     *)
(* [subtyp_sel1], so [typ_top <: typ_rcd ...] holds although the         *)
(* conclusion [typ_top <: typ_bot] fails.  This shows the failure is     *)
(* not an artifact of the empty context.)                                *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Require Import Base.
Require Import Case.
Require Import RetAux.
Require Import AsnAux.
Require Import HeapAsn.
Require Import SelPrep.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.

Unset Implicit Arguments.

Section Params.

Hypothesis Hfield : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ Tf <: U.

Hypothesis Hroot : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),
  inert G ->
  binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->
  G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.

Lemma ty_config_red_sel : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx)
  (effss:list effects) (Fs:stack) (Sigma:heap) (U:typ)
  (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (T0:typ) (hds:heap_defs),
  ty_config G D Es effss (trm_sel (avar_f x) a ; Fs ; Sigma) U ->
  binds x (item_obj T0 hds) Sigma ->
  labels_has hds (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) ->
  exists G' D' Es' effss',
    ty_config (G & G') D' Es' effss' (trm_var (avar_f y) ; Fs ; Sigma) U.
Proof.
  intros G D Es effss Fs Sigma U x a y T0 hds Hcfg Hbheap Hlab.
  destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D Es effss (trm_sel (avar_f x) a) Fs Sigma U Hcfg) as
    (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effs & effs' & effss0 &
     HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr).
  assert (Heffnil : effs' = nil) by (eapply eff_trm_sel_nil; exact Heff).
  subst effs'.
  cbn in Hcorr. cbn in HeqEffs.
  destruct (@ty_sel_inv G x a Ts Hty) as [S [Ts0 [Hxrec HsubT]]].
  destruct (@init_typing_sel_committed G D (dom ℰ) x a ii Hinit) as [Hi Heqxcomm].
  subst ii.
  destruct (@heap_correspond_obj G Sigma x T0 hds Hhc Hbheap) as [HxG Hhds].
  assert (Hsubopen : G ⊢ open x T0 <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S Ts0))
    by (eapply Hroot; eassumption).
  pose proof (@labels_has_heap_in hds (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) Hlab) as Hin.
  destruct (@heap_def_typing_rh G hds (open x T0) a y Hhds Hin) as [Tf [Hrh HyTf]].
  assert (Htfsub : G ⊢ Tf <: Ts0) by (eapply Hfield; eassumption).
  assert (HyTs : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ Ts).
  { eapply ty_sub.
    - exact HyTf.
    - eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Htfsub|exact HsubT]. }
  pose proof (@free_sub_heaps_well_committed G D Sigma (ℰ :: ℰs) Hfs) as Hwc.
  pose proof (@well_committed_heap_item G D Sigma x (item_obj T0 hds) Hwc Heqxcomm Hbheap) as Hci.
  pose proof (@committed_heap_item_obj_inv G D T0 hds Hci) as Hcdefs.
  pose proof (@committed_heap_defs_in D hds (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) Hcdefs Hin) as Hcd.
  pose proof (@committed_heap_def_trm_some_binds D a y Hcd) as Hycomm.
  exists (empty:ctx), D, (ℰ :: ℰs), (effs :: effss0).
  rewrite concat_empty_r.
  eapply (@ty_config_c G D Sigma ℰ ℰs Fs (trm_var (avar_f y)) Ts committed U nil effs effss0).
  - exact Hinert.
  - exact Hinits.
  - exact Hhc.
  - exact Hfs.
  - exact Hstack.
  - exact HyTs.
  - apply eff_ignore.
  - eapply init_var_binds. apply init_var_commit. exact Hycomm.
  - exact Hcorr.
Qed.

End Params.

  get_labeld_list l ds = Some d -> List.In d ds.
Proof.
  intros A LA l ds. induction ds as [|a ds IH]; intros d H.
  - simpl in H. discriminate H.
  - simpl in H. destruct (classic (label_of a = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_of a = l) _ _ E) in H.
      injection H as Heq. subst d. apply List.in_eq.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of a = l) _ _ NE) in H.
      apply List.in_cons. eapply IH; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_defs_in : forall (D:init_ctx) (hds:heap_defs) (d:heap_def),
  committed_heap_defs D hds -> List.In d hds -> committed_heap_def D d.
Proof.
  intros D hds d H. induction H; intros Hin.
  - inversion Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + subst d. assumption.
    + eapply IHcommitted_heap_defs; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_def_trm_some_binds : forall (D:init_ctx) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  committed_heap_def D (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) -> binds y committed D.
Proof. intros D a y H. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_def_trm_none_false : forall (D:init_ctx) (a:trm_label),
  committed_heap_def D (heap_def_trm a None) -> False.
Proof. intros D a H. inversion H. Qed.

(* Effects: an effect-context inclusion survives dropping a prefix whose
   variables are not bound in the effect context. *)
Lemma eff_ctx_corr_one_suffix : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (D:init_ctx)
  (effs' effs:effects),
  eff_ctx_corr_one E (effs' ++ effs) ->
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D ->
  (forall e, List.In e effs' -> fst e \notin dom E) ->
  eff_ctx_corr_one E effs.
Proof.
  intros E Sigma D effs' effs Hcorr Hfree Hnodom x effs0 Hb e He.
  destruct e as [z l].
  assert (Hin : (z,l) \in from_list (effs' ++ effs)).
  { exact (Hcorr x effs0 Hb (z,l) He). }
  rewrite from_list_app in Hin. rewrite in_union in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
  - exfalso.
    pose proof (proj1 (Hfree x effs0 Hb) z l He) as Hz.
    assert (Hdom : x \in dom E) by (eapply binds_in_dom; exact Hb).
    apply (Hnodom (z,l) (proj1 (@in_from_list effect (z,l) effs') Hin)). rewrite Hz. exact Hdom.
  - exact Hin.
Qed.

(* Typing inversion for selection. *)
Lemma ty_sel_inv_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  forall (x:var) (a:trm_label), t = trm_sel (avar_f x) a ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  induction H; intros x0 a0 Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - injection Heq as Hx Ha. subst x0 a0.
    exists S, T. split; [assumption|apply subtyp_refl].
  - subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm x0 a0 eq_refl) as [S [T1 [Hx Hsub]]].
    exists S, T1. split; [exact Hx|]. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact H0].
Qed.

Lemma ty_sel_inv : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ T ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof. intros. eapply ty_sel_inv_gen; [exact H|reflexivity]. Qed.

(* Typing inversion for assignment. *)
Lemma ty_asn_inv_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  forall (x y:var) (a:trm_label), t = trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\
               G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  induction H; intros x0 y0 a0 Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - injection Heq as Hx Ha Hy. subst x0 y0 a0.
    exists S, T. split; [exact H|]. split; [exact H0|apply subtyp_refl].
  - subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm x0 y0 a0 eq_refl) as [S [T1 [Hx [Hy Hsub]]]].
    exists S, T1. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hy|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact H0].
Qed.

Lemma ty_asn_inv : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ T ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\
               G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof. intros. eapply ty_asn_inv_gen; [exact H|reflexivity]. Qed.

(* Initialization status facts for the reduction of selection/assignment. *)
Lemma init_typing_sel_committed : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars)
  (x:var) (a:trm_label) (i:init_typ),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ i ->
  i = committed /\ binds x committed D.
Proof.
  intros G D vs x a i H.
  destruct (@init_sel_commit G D vs x a i H) as [Heq Hc]. subst i.
  split; [reflexivity|].
  eapply commit_sel_binds; exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma init_typing_asn_status : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars)
  (x y:var) (a:trm_label) (i:init_typ),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ i ->
  (i = committed /\ binds y committed D) \/
  (i = free /\ y \in vs).
Proof.
  intros G D vs x y a i H.
  change (well_init G D vs (trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)) i) in H.
  inversion H; subst.
  - (* init_commit *) left. split; [reflexivity|].
    inversion H0; subst. eapply commit_var_binds. eassumption.
  - (* init_fld_asn_ac *) left. split; [reflexivity|].
    eapply init_typing_var_committed_binds; exact H8.
  - (* init_fld_asn_ff *) right. split; [reflexivity|].
    eapply @init_typing_var_free_mem with (G:=G) (D:=D) (vs:=vs) (x:=y).
    exact H8.
Qed.
