11	Lemma committed_heap_defs_update : forall (D:init_ctx) (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
12	  committed_heap_defs D hds ->
13	  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
14	  binds y committed D ->
15	  committed_heap_defs D hds'.
16	Proof.
17	  intros D hds hds' a y Hc Hu Hy. revert Hc. induction Hu; intros Hc.
18	  - inversion Hc; subst.
19	    eapply (@committed_heap_defs_cons D (heap_def_trm a (Some x)) hds).
20	    + exact H2.
21	    + eapply committed_heap_def_trm. change (binds x committed D). exact Hy.
22	  - inversion Hc; subst.
23	    eapply (@committed_heap_defs_cons D d hds').
24	    + eapply IHHu; [exact Hy|exact H2].
25	    + exact H3.
26	Qed.

28	Lemma free_sub_heap_asn_update : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Sigma Sigma':heap) (D:init_ctx)
29	  (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
30	  free_sub_heap E Sigma D ->
31	  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
32	  binds x committed D ->
33	  free_sub_heap E Sigma' D.
34	Proof.
35	  intros E Sigma Sigma' D x a y Hfree Hup Hxcomm.
36	  destruct Hup as (T & hds & hds' & S1 & S2 & Heq & Hfresh & Hdu & Heq').
37	  subst Sigma Sigma'.
38	  intros z effs Hb. destruct (Hfree z effs Hb) as [Hsame Hrest].
39	  destruct Hrest as [itm [Hbinds Hitem]].
40	  assert (Hne : z <> x).
41	  { intro E0. subst z.
42	    inversion Hitem; subst.
43	    match goal with
44	    | Hf : free_heap_defs D E x ?hds0 |- _ =>
45	      destruct Hf as [Hbzfree _]
46	    end.
47	    pose proof (@LibEnv.binds_functional init_typ x free committed D Hbzfree Hxcomm) as Heqfc.
48	    discriminate Heqfc. }
49	  split.
50	  - exact Hsame.
51	  - exists itm. split.
52	    + eapply (@binds_replace item S1 S2 x z
53	                 (item_obj T hds) (item_obj T hds') itm);
54	      [exact Hne|exact Hbinds].
55	    + exact Hitem.
56	Qed.

58	Lemma well_committed_heap_asn_update : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx)
59	  (Sigma Sigma':heap) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
60	  well_committed_heap G D Sigma ->
61	  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
62	  binds x committed D ->
63	  binds y committed D ->
64	  well_committed_heap G D Sigma'.
65	Proof.
66	  intros G D Sigma Sigma' x a y Hwc Hup Hxcomm Hycomm.
67	  destruct Hwc as [HdomG [HdomD Hitem]].
68	  destruct Hup as (T & hds & hds' & S1 & S2 & Heq & Hfresh & Hdu & Heq').
69	  subst Sigma Sigma'.
70	  split; [exact HdomG|]. split.
71	  - rewrite HdomD. rewrite !LibEnv.dom_concat, !LibEnv.dom_single. reflexivity.
72	  - intros z itm Hzcomm Hbinds.
73	    destruct (classic (z = x)) as [->|Hne].
74	    + assert (Hcanon : binds x (item_obj T hds')
75	                      (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds' & S2)).
76	      { eapply LibEnv.binds_concat_left.
77	        - apply LibEnv.binds_push_eq.
78	        - exact Hfresh. }
79	      assert (Heqitm : itm = item_obj T hds')
80	        by (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; [exact Hbinds|exact Hcanon]).
81	      subst itm.
82	      assert (Hcanon_old : binds x (item_obj T hds)
83	                          (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2)).
84	      { eapply LibEnv.binds_concat_left.
85	        - apply LibEnv.binds_push_eq.
86	        - exact Hfresh. }
87	      pose proof (Hitem x (item_obj T hds) Hzcomm Hcanon_old) as Hci.
88	      pose proof (committed_heap_item_obj_inv Hci) as Hcdefs.
89	      eapply committed_heap_obj. eapply committed_heap_defs_update; eassumption.
90	    + assert (Hbinds_old : binds z itm (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2)).
91	      { eapply (@binds_replace item S1 S2 x z
92	                   (item_obj T hds') (item_obj T hds) itm);
93	          [exact Hne|exact Hbinds]. }
94	      exact (Hitem z itm Hzcomm Hbinds_old).
95	Qed.

97	Lemma free_sub_heaps_asn_update : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma Sigma':heap)
98	  (Es:list eff_ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
99	  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es ->
100	  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
101	  binds x committed D ->
102	  binds y committed D ->
103	  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma' Es.

110	    + exact H.
111	    + eapply free_sub_heap_asn_update; eassumption.
112	    + eapply IHHfs; assumption.
113	Qed.

    binds x effs ℰ ->

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Effects CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle.

Definition all_notin {A} (xs ys : fset A) :=
  forall x, x \in xs -> x \notin ys.

Fixpoint list_dom_union {A} (Es : list (env A)) :=
  match Es with
  | nil => \{}
  | (E :: Es)%list => dom E \u list_dom_union Es
  end.

Inductive free_sub_heaps :
  ctx -> init_ctx -> heap -> list eff_ctx -> Prop :=

| free_sub_heaps_nil : forall Gamma Delta Sigma,
    well_committed_heap Gamma Delta Sigma ->
    free_sub_heaps Gamma Delta Sigma nil

| free_sub_heaps_cons : forall Gamma Delta Sigma ℰ ℰs,
    all_notin (dom ℰ) (list_dom_union ℰs) ->
    free_sub_heap ℰ Sigma Delta ->
    free_sub_heaps Gamma Delta Sigma ℰs ->
    free_sub_heaps Gamma Delta Sigma (ℰ :: ℰs).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Typing Initialization InitTyping InitWeakening GeneralTyping.

Inductive committed_heap_def : init_ctx -> heap_def -> Prop :=

| committed_heap_def_typ : forall Delta A T,
    committed_heap_def Delta (heap_def_typ A T)

| committed_heap_def_trm : forall Delta a x,
    binds x committed Delta ->
    committed_heap_def Delta (heap_def_trm a (Some x)).

Inductive committed_heap_defs : init_ctx -> heap_defs -> Prop :=
| committed_heap_defs_nil : forall Delta,
    committed_heap_defs Delta nil

| committed_heap_defs_cons : forall Delta hd hds,
    committed_heap_defs Delta hds ->
    committed_heap_def Delta hd ->
    committed_heap_defs Delta (cons hd hds).

Inductive committed_heap_item :
  ctx -> init_ctx -> item -> Prop :=

| committed_heap_lit : forall Gamma Delta l,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c l ->
    committed_heap_item Gamma Delta (item_lit l)

| committed_heap_obj : forall Gamma Delta T hds,
    committed_heap_defs Delta hds ->
    committed_heap_item Gamma Delta (item_obj T hds).

Definition well_committed_heap (Gamma : ctx) (Delta : init_ctx) (Sigma : heap) :=
  dom Gamma = dom Delta /\
  dom Delta = dom Sigma /\
  forall x itm,
    binds x committed Delta ->
    binds x itm Sigma ->
    committed_heap_item Gamma Delta itm.

Definition more_committed Delta Delta' :=
  (forall x, binds x committed Delta -> binds x committed Delta').

Definition free_heap_defs (Delta : init_ctx) (ℰ : eff_ctx)
           (y : var) (hds : heap_defs) :=

  binds y free Delta /\

  binds y (heap_defs_effs y hds)  ℰ /\

  forall x, (x \in heap_defs_points_to hds) ->
       well_pointed Delta ℰ x.

Inductive free_heap_item : init_ctx -> eff_ctx -> var -> item -> Prop :=

| free_heap_obj : forall Delta ℰ y T hds,
    free_heap_defs Delta ℰ y hds ->
    free_heap_item Delta ℰ y (item_obj T hds).

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Definition eff_ctx_corr_one (ℰ : eff_ctx) effs :=
  (forall x effs', binds x effs' ℰ ->
                   forall eff, (eff \in (from_list effs')) ->
                               (eff \in (from_list effs))).

Inductive eff_ctx_corr : list eff_ctx -> list effects -> Prop :=

| eff_ctx_corr_nil : eff_ctx_corr nil nil

| eff_ctx_corr_cons : forall ℰ ℰs effs effss,
    eff_ctx_corr ℰs effss ->
    eff_ctx_corr_one ℰ effs ->
    eff_ctx_corr (ℰ :: ℰs) (effs :: effss).

Fixpoint heap_defs_effs (x : var) (hds : heap_defs) : effects :=
  match hds with

| defs_update_var : forall hds a o x,
    defs_update (cons (heap_def_trm a o) hds)
                a x
                (cons (heap_def_trm a (Some x)) hds)
| defs_update_push : forall hds d a x hds',
    defs_update hds a x hds' ->
    defs_update (cons d hds) a x (cons d hds').

Definition heap_update (Sigma : heap) (x : var) (a : trm_label) (y : var) (Sigma' : heap) :=
  exists T hds hds' Sigma1 Sigma2,
    (Sigma = Sigma1 & x ~ (item_obj T hds) & Sigma2) /\
    (x # Sigma2) /\
    (defs_update hds a y hds') /\
    (Sigma' = Sigma1 & x ~ (item_obj T hds') & Sigma2).

Inductive init_sub : init_typ -> init_typ -> Prop :=
| init_sub_refl : forall i, init_sub i i
| init_sub_comm_unspec : init_sub committed unspecified
| init_sub_free_unspec : init_sub free unspecified.

Inductive init_var : init_ctx -> vars -> var -> init_typ -> Prop :=

| init_var_commit : forall Delta vs x,
    binds x committed Delta ->
    init_var Delta vs x committed

| init_var_free : forall Delta vs x,

    binds x free Delta ->
    init_var Delta vs x free

| init_var_unspec : forall Delta vs x,
    x \in vs ->
    binds x unspecified Delta ->
    init_var Delta vs x unspecified

| init_var_sub : forall Delta vs x i i',
    init_var Delta vs x i' ->
    init_sub i' i ->
    init_var Delta vs x i.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Typing.

Implicit Types (ds : defs) (hds : heap_defs).

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ A T T)
| rd_trm : forall a T, record_dec (dec_trm a T T).

Inductive record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Typing.

Implicit Types (ds : defs) (hds : heap_defs).

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ A T T)
| rd_trm : forall a T, record_dec (dec_trm a T T).

Inductive record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D.

Section HasntNotIn.

Context {A : Set} `{LA : LabelOf A} `{DTA : DecTyping A}.

Context {DTL : DecTypingLabels DTA}.

End HasntNotIn.

Section RecordHasTyDefs.

Context {A : Set} `{LA : LabelOf A} `{DTA : DecTyping A}.

End RecordHasTyDefs.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect.

Inductive init_typ : Set :=
  | committed : init_typ
  | free : init_typ
  | unspecified : init_typ.

Notation inits := (list init_typ).

Notation init_ctx := (env init_typ).

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_all  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_con  : typs -> inits -> typ -> typ

with typs : Set :=
  | typs_nil : typs
  | typs_cons : typ -> typs -> typs

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_trm  : trm_label -> typ -> typ -> dec.

Scheme typ_mut  := Induction for typ Sort Prop
with   typs_mut := Induction for typs Sort Prop
with   dec_mut  := Induction for dec Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typ_mutind from typ_mut, typs_mut, dec_mut.

Fixpoint typs_to_list (Ts : typs) : list typ :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => nil
  | typs_cons T Ts' => (T :: typs_to_list Ts')%list
  end.

Instance TypsToList : ToList typ typs := typs_to_list.

Arguments TypsToList _ /.

Fixpoint typs_of_list (xs : list typ) : typs :=
  match xs with
  | nil => typs_nil
  | (T :: Ts')%list => typs_cons T (typs_of_list Ts')
  end.

Instance TypsOfList : OfList typ typs := typs_of_list.

Arguments TypsOfList _ /.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L    => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_all T1 T2  => typ_all (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_con Ts is' T =>
    typ_con
      (open_rec_typs k u Ts)
      is'
      (open_rec_typ (S (length_s Ts) + k) u T)

  end with
open_rec_typs (k : nat) (u : var) (Ts : typs) : typs :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => typs_nil
  | typs_cons T Ts =>
    typs_cons (open_rec_typ k u T)
              (open_rec_typs k u Ts)
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_trm m T U => dec_trm m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance TypsOpenable : Openable typs := open_rec_typs.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L    => (fv x)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_all T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_con Ts is' T   => (fv_typs Ts) \u (fv_typ T)
  end with
fv_typs (Ts : typs) : vars :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => \{}
  | typs_cons T Ts => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typs Ts)
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_trm m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)

Inductive ty_item_s : ctx -> heap -> var -> Prop :=
| ty_item_lit_s : forall Gamma Sigma x l T,
    binds x T Gamma ->
    binds x (item_lit l) Sigma ->
    Gamma ⊢ l ∶ T ->
    ty_item_s Gamma Sigma x
| ty_item_obj_s : forall Gamma Sigma x U hds,
    binds x (typ_bnd U) Gamma ->
    binds x (item_obj U hds) Sigma ->
    Gamma ⊢ hds ∶ open x U ->
    ty_item_s Gamma Sigma x.

Definition heap_correspond (G : ctx) (Sigma : heap) : Prop :=
  (dom G = dom Sigma) /\
  (forall x,
      x \in dom G ->
      ty_item_s G Sigma x).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing.

Implicit Types (Gamma G : ctx) (T U : typ) (x y z : var) (t : trm).

Inductive ty_def : DecTyping def :=

| ty_def_typ : forall G A T,
    G ⊢ def_typ A T ∶d dec_typ A T T

| ty_def_trm : forall G a t T,
    G ⊢ def_trm a ∶d dec_trm a T T.

Existing Instance ty_def.

Inductive ty_trm : Typing trm :=

| ty_var : forall G x T,
    binds x T G ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T

| ty_all_elim : forall G x z S T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_all S T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ S ->
    G ⊢ trm_app (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ∶ open z T

| ty_new : forall G x avs xs Ts is' T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_con Ts is' T ->
    G ⊢ avs :: Ts ->
    vars_of_avars xs avs ->
    G ⊢ trm_new (avar_f x) avs ∶ typ_bnd (open_rec_vars 1 xs T)

| ty_rcd_elim : forall G x a S T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T) ->
    G ⊢ trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ T

| ty_fld_asn : forall G x y a S T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T) ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S ->
    G ⊢ trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ T

| ty_let : forall L G t u T U,
    G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open x u ∶ U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_let T t u ∶ U

| ty_llit : forall L G l u T U,
    G ⊢ l ∶ T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open x u ∶ U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_lit T l u ∶ U

| ty_rec_intro : forall G x T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T

| ty_rec_elim : forall G x T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T ->

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax PreTyping.

Class DecTyping (A : Set) := dec_typing : ctx -> A -> dec -> Prop.

Notation "Gamma ⊢ d '∶d' D" := (dec_typing Gamma d D) (at level 40, d at level 59).

Class Typing (A : Set) := typing : ctx -> A -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "Gamma ⊢ t '∶' T" := (typing Gamma t T) (at level 40, t at level 59).

Class Typings (A : Set) := typings : ctx -> A -> typs -> Prop.

Notation "Gamma ⊢ t '::' Ts" := (typings Gamma t Ts) (at level 40, t at level 59).

Class Subtyping := subtyping : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "Gamma ⊢ T '<:' U" := (subtyping Gamma T U) (at level 40, T at level 59).

Section DecTypingLabels.

Context {A : Set} `{LabelOf A}.

Class DecTypingLabels `(DecTyping A) :=
    ty_def_label_eq :
      forall Gamma d D,
        Gamma ⊢ d ∶d D ->
        label_of D = label_of d.

End DecTypingLabels.

Section DecPreTyping.

Context {A : Set} (TyA : DecTyping A).

Instance DecPreTyping : PreTyping dec_typing := {}.

End DecPreTyping.

Existing Instance DecPreTyping.

Section TyPreTyping.

Context {A : Set} (TyA : Typing A).

Instance TyPreTyping : PreTyping typing := {}.

End TyPreTyping.

Existing Instance TyPreTyping.

Section TysPreTyping.

Context {A : Set} (TysA : Typings A).

Instance TysPreTyping : PreTyping typings := {}.

End TysPreTyping.

(f0 : forall G x z S T (t : G⊢x : all S T),
    P G x (all S T) t ->

    P G (app x z) (open z T) (ty_all_elim t t0))
```
So order: G x z S T, premise t, IH, premise t0, IH, then conclusion motive.

Thus for our intros, e.g., ty_all_elim: `intros G x z S T p1 IH1 p2 IH2 H y E`. Or simply `intros; discriminate E` if E named. Better to use explicit with interleaving.

(* ==== SelPrep ==== *)


Lemma eff_trm_sel_nil : forall (x:var) (a:trm_label) (effs:effects),
  ⊢e trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ effs -> effs = nil.
Proof.
  intros x a effs H. inversion H; subst; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ty_heap_def_trm_some_inv : forall (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (D:dec),
  G ⊢ heap_def_trm a (Some y) ∶d D ->
  exists Tf, D = dec_trm a Tf Tf /\ G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ Tf.
Proof.
  intros G a y D H. change (ty_heap_def G (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) D) in H.
  inversion H; subst. eexists. split; [reflexivity|assumption].
Qed.

Lemma labels_has_heap_in : forall (hds:heap_defs) (d:heap_def),
  labels_has hds d -> List.In d hds.
Proof.
  intros hds d H. unfold labels_has in H.
  eapply (@get_labeld_list_some_in heap_def HeapDefLabelOf (label_of d) hds d).
  exact H.
Qed.

Lemma heap_def_typing_rh : forall (G:ctx) (hds:heap_defs) (T:typ)
  (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  G ⊢ hds ∶ T ->
  List.In (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) hds ->
  exists Tf, record_has T (dec_trm a Tf Tf) /\ G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ Tf.
Proof.
  intros G hds T a y Hhds Hin.
  destruct (@ty_heap_defs_correspond G hds T Hhds) as (ls & Hrt & Hfwd & Hbwd).
  destruct (Hfwd (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) Hin) as [D [Hrh Hdty]].
  destruct (@ty_heap_def_trm_some_inv G a y D Hdty) as [Tf [Heq Hy]].
  subst D. exists Tf. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma heap_def_typing_rh_any : forall (G:ctx) (hds:heap_defs) (T:typ)
  (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  G ⊢ hds ∶ T ->
  List.In (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) hds ->
  exists Tf, record_has T (dec_trm a Tf Tf) /\ G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ Tf.
Proof. exact heap_def_typing_rh. Qed.

(* ==== LitInv ==== *)


Lemma ty_lit_all_inv : forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (S U:typ),
  G ⊢ l ∶ typ_all S U ->
  exists T t, l = lit_fun T t.
Proof.
  intros G l S U H. change (ty_lit G l (typ_all S U)) in H.
  inversion H; subst; try discriminate; eexists _, _; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ty_lit_con_inv : forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ l ∶ typ_con Ts is' T ->
  exists ds t, l = lit_con Ts is' T ds t.
Proof.
  intros G l Ts is' T H. change (ty_lit G l (typ_con Ts is' T)) in H.
  inversion H; subst; try discriminate; eexists _, _; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ty_lit_fun_shape : forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (S U:typ),
  G ⊢ l ∶ typ_all S U ->
  exists T t, l = lit_fun T t.
Proof. exact ty_lit_all_inv. Qed.

Lemma ty_avars_length : forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs),
  G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> List.length avs = length_s Ts.
Proof.
  intros G avs Ts H. change (ty_avars G avs Ts) in H.
  induction H; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. exact IHty_avars.
Qed.

Lemma ty_avars_types_of_avars : forall (G:ctx) (xs:list var) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs),
  vars_of_avars xs avs ->
  G ⊢ avs :: Ts ->
  exists Ts', Ts = Ts'.
Proof. intros. eexists. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ty_lit_shape : forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ l ∶ T ->
  (exists S U, T = typ_all S U) \/
  (exists Ts is' X, T = typ_con Ts is' X).
Proof.
  intros G l T H. change (ty_lit G l T) in H. induction H.
  - left. eexists _, _. reflexivity.
  - right. eexists _, _, _. reflexivity.
Qed.

Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* Restricted statement under investigation.                            *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Definition field_lookup_sub_record_statement (a : trm_label) : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (Tf S U:typ),
    record_type V ->
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    G ⊢ Tf <: U.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* A variable name; [var] is an abstract parameter, but [var_fresh]     *)
(* provides one.  The term label [a] and the type-member label [A] are  *)
(* abstract parameters too; the refutation below is parametric in them. *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Definition x0 : var := proj1_sig (var_fresh \{}).

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* A soundness interpretation of types for the fixed context            *)
(*   G0 = x0 : typ_rcd (dec_typ A V Targ)                               *)
(* where V and Targ are closed record types.  The interpretation is     *)
(* the same simple one used in FieldSub.v: only [typ_bot] is false.     *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Fixpoint interp (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_rcd _ => True
  | typ_and T U => interp T /\ interp U
  | typ_sel _ _ => True
  | typ_bnd _ => True
  | typ_all _ _ => True
  | typ_con _ _ _ => True
  end.

(* [Inv T] records that a type is a "safe" type for the variable [x0]:
   it is true under [interp], every record type member [dec_typ] has a
   safe upper bound, and bound types are recursively safe at their
   opening.  It has no constructor for [typ_bot]. *)

Inductive Inv : typ -> Prop :=
| inv_top : Inv typ_top
| inv_rcd_trm : forall (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
    Inv (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
| inv_rcd_typ : forall (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
    Inv T -> Inv (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T))
| inv_and : forall (T U:typ),
    Inv T -> Inv U -> Inv (typ_and T U)
| inv_sel : forall (x:avar) (A:typ_label),
    Inv (typ_sel x A)
| inv_bnd : forall (T:typ),
    Inv (open x0 T) -> Inv (typ_bnd T)
| inv_all : forall (S T:typ), Inv (typ_all S T)
| inv_con : forall (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (T:typ),
    Inv (typ_con Ts is' T).

Lemma Inv_sound : forall (T:typ), Inv T -> interp T.
Proof.
  intros T H. induction H; cbn [interp]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Inv_rcd_typ_inv : forall (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
  Inv (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) -> Inv T.
Proof.
  intros A S T H. inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Inv_bnd_inv : forall (T:typ),
  Inv (typ_bnd T) -> Inv (open x0 T).
Proof.
  intros T H. inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Inv_not_bot : forall (T:typ), T = typ_bot -> Inv T -> False.
Proof.
  intros T E H. subst T. inversion H.
Qed.

Section Counterexample.

Variables (a : trm_label) (A : typ_label).

(* The source record type: a genuine [record_type] (indeed a closed one). *)
Definition Vc : typ := typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top).

(* The target record type. *)
Definition Targc : typ := typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_bot).

(* The (bad-bounds) binding of [x0]. *)
Definition RVc : typ := typ_rcd (dec_typ A Vc Targc).

Definition Gc : ctx := x0 ~ RVc.

Lemma record_type_Vc : record_type Vc.
Proof.
  unfold Vc.
  exists (\{label_trm a}).
  eapply rt_one.
  - apply rd_trm.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_has_Vc : record_has Vc (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top).
Proof.
  unfold Vc. apply rh_one.
Qed.

Lemma binds_Gc : binds x0 RVc Gc.
Proof. unfold Gc. apply binds_push_eq. Qed.

(* Vc <: x0.A via sel2, and x0.A <: Targc via sel1, hence Vc <: Targc. *)
Lemma sub_Vc_Targc : Gc ⊢ Vc <: Targc.
Proof.
  eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_sel (avar_f x0) A).
  - eapply subtyp_sel2. exact binds_Gc.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1. exact binds_Gc.
Qed.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* Main soundness/typing-invariant induction for the context [Gc].      *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Lemma Gc_typing_sub_sound :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
     G = Gc -> forall y, t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> y = x0 /\ Inv T) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U ->
     G = Gc -> (interp S -> interp U) /\ (Inv S -> Inv U)) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).
Proof.
  apply (rules_mutind
    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
       G = Gc -> forall y, t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> y = x0 /\ Inv T)
    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (_:G ⊢ S <: U) =>
       G = Gc -> (interp S -> interp U) /\ (Inv S -> Inv U))
    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True)).
  - (* ty_var *)
    intros G x T b H y E. subst G.
    injection E as E1. injection E1 as Exy. subst y.
    apply binds_single_inv in b. destruct b as [Ex ET]. subst x. subst T.
    split; [reflexivity | apply inv_rcd_typ, inv_rcd_trm].
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros G x z S T p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_new *) intros G x avs xs Ts is' T p IH1 p2 IH2 p3 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_rcd_elim *) intros G x a0 S T p IH1 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_fld_asn *) intros G x y0 a0 S T p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_let *) intros L G t u T U p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_llit *) intros L G l u T U p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *)
    intros G x T p IH H y E. subst G.
    injection E as E1. injection E1 as Exy. subst y.
    destruct (IH H x eq_refl) as [Ex Hinv].
    split; [exact Ex | apply inv_bnd; exact Hinv].
  - (* ty_rec_elim *)
    intros G x T p IH H y E. subst G.
    injection E as E1. injection E1 as Exy. subst y.
    destruct (IH H x eq_refl) as [Ex Hinv].
    split; [exact Ex | apply Inv_bnd_inv in Hinv; exact Hinv].
  - (* ty_and_intro *)
    intros G x T U p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. subst G.
    injection E as E1. injection E1 as Exy. subst y.
    destruct (IH1 H x eq_refl) as [Ex Hinv1].
    destruct (IH2 H x eq_refl) as [_ Hinv2].
    split; [exact Ex | apply inv_and; assumption].
  - (* ty_sub *)
    intros G t T U p IH1 s IH2 H y E.
    destruct (IH1 H y E) as [Ex HinvT].
    split; [exact Ex | apply (proj2 (IH2 H)); exact HinvT].
  - (* ty_all_intro *) intros; exact I.
  - (* ty_con_intro *) intros; exact I.
  - (* subtyp_top *)
    intros G T H. split; [intros _; exact I | intros _; apply inv_top].
  - (* subtyp_bot *)
    intros G T H. split.
    + intros HI. cbn [interp] in HI. destruct HI.
    + intros HI. inversion HI.
  - (* subtyp_refl *)
    intros G T H. split; intros; assumption.
  - (* subtyp_trans *)
    intros G S T U s IH1 s0 IH2 H.
    destruct (IH1 H) as [Hi1 Hi2]. destruct (IH2 H) as [Hj1 Hj2].
    split; intros; [apply Hj1, Hi1 | apply Hj2, Hi2]; assumption.
  - (* subtyp_and11 *)
    intros G T U H. split.
    + intros HI. cbn [interp] in HI. tauto.
    + intros HI. inversion HI; subst; assumption.
  - (* subtyp_and12 *)
    intros G T U H. split.
    + intros HI. cbn [interp] in HI. tauto.
    + intros HI. inversion HI; subst; assumption.
  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
    intros G S T U s IH1 s0 IH2 H.
    destruct (IH1 H) as [Hi1 Hi2]. destruct (IH2 H) as [Hj1 Hj2].
    split.
    + intros HS. split; [apply Hi1 | apply Hj1]; exact HS.
    + intros HS. apply inv_and; [apply Hi2 | apply Hj2]; exact HS.
  - (* subtyp_fld *)
    intros G a0 T1 T2 U1 U2 s IH1 s0 IH2 H.
    split; intros; [exact I | apply inv_rcd_trm].
  - (* subtyp_typ *)
    intros G A0 S1 T1 S2 T2 s IH1 s0 IH2 H.
    split.
    + intros _; exact I.
    + intros HI. apply Inv_rcd_typ_inv in HI.
      apply inv_rcd_typ. apply (proj2 (IH2 H)). exact HI.
  - (* subtyp_sel2 *)
    intros G x A0 S T p IHty H.
    split; intros; [exact I | apply inv_sel].
  - (* subtyp_sel1 *)
    intros G x A0 S T p IHty H.
    destruct (IHty H x eq_refl) as [_ Hinv].
    apply Inv_rcd_typ_inv in Hinv.
    split; intros; [apply Inv_sound; exact Hinv | exact Hinv].
  - (* subtyp_all *)
    intros L G S1 T1 S2 T2 s IH1 s0 IH2 H.
    split; intros; [exact I | apply inv_all].
  - (* typ_avars_nil *) intros; exact I.
  - (* typ_avars_cons *) intros; exact I.
Qed.

(* In [Gc] the empty-bounds subtyping [top <: bot] is not derivable. *)
Lemma Gc_not_top_sub_bot : ~ (Gc ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot).
Proof.
  intro Hsub.
  pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (Gc_typing_sub_sound)))
                Gc typ_top typ_bot Hsub eq_refl) as Hconj.
  destruct Hconj as [Hi _].
  cbn [interp] in Hi.
  exact (Hi I).
Qed.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* The counterexample refutes the restricted statement.                 *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Theorem field_lookup_sub_record_refuted :
  ~ field_lookup_sub_record_statement a.
Proof.
  intro Hstmt.
  specialize (Hstmt Gc Vc typ_top typ_top typ_bot).
  assert (Hconc : Gc ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot).
  { eapply Hstmt.
    - exact record_type_Vc.
    - exact record_has_Vc.
    - exact sub_Vc_Targc. }
  exact (Gc_not_top_sub_bot Hconc).
Qed.

End Counterexample.

(* The statement fails for every term-label and every element of the    *)
(* abstract type-label parameter (which is what is needed to build a    *)
(* context with a type member).                                         *)
Theorem field_lookup_sub_record_refuted_all :
  forall (a : trm_label) (A : typ_label),
    ~ field_lookup_sub_record_statement a.
Proof.
  intros a A. exact (field_lookup_sub_record_refuted a A).
Qed.

Lemma record_dec_open : forall (D:dec) (n:nat) (u:var),

Lemma record_typ_open : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (n:nat) (u:var),

Proof.

Qed.

Lemma record_type_open : forall (T:typ) (n:nat) (u:var),
  record_type T -> record_type (open_rec n u T).
Proof.

(** * Shape facts *)

Lemma record_type_not_top : record_type typ_top -> False.
Proof. intros [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_bot : record_type typ_bot -> False.

Lemma record_type_not_sel : forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), record_type (typ_sel a A) -> False.
Proof. intros a A [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_all : forall (S T:typ), record_type (typ_all S T) -> False.
Proof. intros S T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_con : forall (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (T:typ), record_type (typ_con Ts is' T) -> False.
Proof. intros Ts is' T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), record_type (typ_bnd T) -> False.
Proof. intros T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_not_top : inert_typ typ_top -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_bot : inert_typ typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_sel : forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), inert_typ (typ_sel a A) -> False.
Proof. intros a A H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_rcd : forall (D:dec), inert_typ (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_and : forall (T U:typ), inert_typ (typ_and T U) -> False.
Proof. intros T U H. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Shape of precise flow tips in an inert setting *)

Lemma flow_shape : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  inert_typ T0 ->
  binds x T0 G ->
  (V = T0 /\ inert_typ T0) \/ record_type V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf; intros Hi Hb.
  - left. split; [reflexivity|assumption].
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + inversion Heq; subst. inversion Hi2; subst.
      right. apply record_type_open. assumption.
    + exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exists ls. exact Hr.
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists ls'. exact (proj1 HP).
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists (\{label_of D}).
      assert (HeqU : U2 = typ_rcd D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 HP)).
      assert (Hrd : record_dec D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 HP))).
      rewrite HeqU. apply rt_one; [exact Hrd|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma flow_typing : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf.
  - apply ty_var. assumption.
  - eapply ty_rec_elim. exact IHHf.
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and11].
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and12].
Qed.

(** * Corollaries: no flow tip is a top/bottom/selection type *)

Lemma flow_not_top : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->

Proof.

  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_top Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_top Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_top. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_bot : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_bot -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_bot Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].

Lemma defs_update_label_in : forall (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  exists d, List.In d hds /\ label_of d = label_trm a.

  - exists (heap_def_trm a o). split; [apply List.in_eq|reflexivity].

Lemma labels_hasnt_update : forall (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (l:label),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->

Proof. intros. unfold subst_var. cbn. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_avar_f : forall (x y z:var), subst_var x y (avar_f z) = avar_f (z \[x -> y]).

    rewrite If_r; auto.

Lemma lit_typ_inert : forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ l ∶ T -> inert_typ T.
Proof.
  intros G l T H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply inert_typ_all.
  - eapply inert_typ_con.
    set (L0 := L \u fv T0).
    destruct (@var_freshes L0 (length_s Ts)) as [ys Hys].
    destruct (@var_fresh (L0 \u from_list ys)) as [x Hx].
    assert (Hx_ys : x \notin from_list ys) by (eapply notin_union_r2; exact Hx).
    assert (Hx_rest : x \notin L0) by (eapply notin_union_r1; exact Hx).
    assert (HxL : x \notin L) by (eapply notin_union_r1; exact Hx_rest).
    assert (Hxfv : x \notin fv T0) by (eapply notin_union_r2; exact Hx_rest).
    assert (HysL : fresh L (length_s Ts) ys) by (eapply fresh_union_r1; exact Hys).
    assert (Hysfv : fresh (fv T0) (length_s Ts) ys) by (eapply fresh_union_r2; exact Hys).
    assert (Hys_nd : NoDup ys) by (eapply fresh_NoDup; exact Hys).
    assert (Hys_notin : forall y, y \in from_list ys -> y \notin fv T0).
    { intros y Hy. eapply fresh_from_list_notin; [exact Hysfv|exact Hy]. }
    assert (Hlen : List.length ys = length_s Ts).
    { rewrite List_length_LibList_length. symmetry. eapply fresh_length. exact Hys. }
    assert (Hfresh_L : fresh L (List.length ys) ys)
      by (eapply fresh_resize; [exact HysL|exact Hlen]).
    assert (Hfresh_Lx : fresh (L \u \{x}) (List.length ys) ys)
      by (eapply fresh_add_notin; [exact Hfresh_L|exact Hx_ys]).
    assert (Hfresh_cons : fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys)).
    { simpl. split; assumption. }
    assert (Hds_ty : exists Gx, Gx ⊢ open_vars (cons x ys) ds ∶ open_vars (cons x ys) T0).
    { eexists. eapply H0; [exact Hlen|exact Hfresh_cons]. }
    destruct Hds_ty as [Gx Hds_ty].
    assert (Hrt_opened : record_type (open_vars (cons x ys) T0)).
    { eapply ty_defs_def_record_type. exact Hds_ty. }
    eapply (@record_type_open_rec_vars_inv T0 0 (cons x ys)).
    + apply NoDup_cons; [rewrite <- in_from_list; exact Hx_ys|exact Hys_nd].
    + intros z Hz. rewrite from_list_cons in Hz. rewrite in_union in Hz.
      destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz].
      * rewrite in_singleton in Hz. subst z. exact Hxfv.
      * eapply Hys_notin; exact Hz.
    + exact Hrt_opened.
Qed.

Lemma free_heap_defs_extend : forall (D:init_ctx) (E:eff_ctx) (y:var) (hds:heap_defs) (x:var),
  free_heap_defs D E y hds ->
  x \notin dom D -> x \notin dom E ->
  free_heap_defs (D & x ~ committed) E y hds.
Proof.
  intros D E y hds x [Hb [Hbe Hwp]] HxD HxE. split; [|split].
  - assert (Hne : y <> x).
    { intro Exy; subst y.
      assert (HyE : x \in dom E) by (eapply binds_in_dom; eexact Hbe).
      exact (HxE HyE). }
    eapply LibEnv.binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|exact Hne].
  - exact Hbe.
  - intros z Hz. destruct (Hwp z Hz) as [Hc|[HzE Hf]].
    + assert (Hzx : z <> x).
      { intro Ezx; subst z; exact (HxD (@binds_in_dom init_typ D x committed Hc)). }
      left. eapply LibEnv.binds_push_neq; [exact Hc|exact Hzx].
    + assert (Hzx : z <> x) by (intro Ezx; subst z; exact (HxE HzE)).
      right. split; [exact HzE|].
      eapply LibEnv.binds_push_neq; [exact Hf|exact Hzx].

Proof.

Lemma free_sub_heaps_dom_in : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (Es:list eff_ctx),
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es ->
  forall E, List.In E Es -> forall x, x \in dom E -> x \in dom Sigma.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma Es H. induction H; intros E0 Hin x Hx.
  - inversion Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [->|Hin].
    + unfold free_sub_heap in H0.

    apply vs_subset_refl.

Lemma well_committed_heap_extend_lit : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (S:heap)
  (x:var) (T:typ) (l:lit),

Proof.

Proof.
  intros E S D H x HxS HxE.
  destruct (dom_binds_exists HxE) as [effs Hb].
  unfold free_sub_heap in H.
  destruct (H x effs Hb) as [_ Hex].
  destruct Hex as [itm [HbS Hfi]].
  apply HxS. eapply binds_in_dom. eexact HbS.

    free_sub_heap E (S & x ~ itm) (D & x ~ committed).
Proof.
  intros E S D H x itm HxS HxD HxE y effs Hy.
  unfold free_sub_heap in H.
  destruct (H y effs Hy) as [Hfresh [itm0 [HbS Hfi]]].
  split; [exact Hfresh|].
  exists itm0. split.
  - assert (Hne : y <> x).
    { intro E0; subst y. exact (HxE (binds_in_dom Hy)). }
    eapply binds_push_neq; [exact HbS|exact Hne].
  - eapply free_heap_item_extend; eassumption.

  free_sub_heaps (G & x ~ T) (D & x ~ committed) (S & x ~ item_lit l) Es.
Proof.

  - apply free_sub_heaps_nil.
    eapply well_committed_heap_extend_lit; eassumption.
  - apply free_sub_heaps_cons.
    + exact H.
    + eapply free_sub_heap_extend; [exact H0|exact HxS|exact HxD|].

Lemma inert_typ_open_rec : forall (T:typ) (n:nat) (u:var),

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect Types Terms.

Inductive heap_def : Set :=
  | heap_def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> heap_def
  | heap_def_trm  : trm_label -> option var -> heap_def.

Notation heap_defs := (list heap_def).

Inductive item : Set :=
  | item_obj : typ -> heap_defs -> item
  | item_lit : lit -> item.

Definition heap_def_of_def (d : def) : heap_def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ A T => heap_def_typ A T
  | def_trm a   => heap_def_trm a None
  end.

Definition heap_defs_of_defs (ds : defs) : heap_defs :=
  List.map heap_def_of_def ds.

Instance HeapDefLabelOf : LabelOf heap_def | 1 :=
  fun hd =>
      match hd with
      | heap_def_typ L _ => label_typ L
      | heap_def_trm m _ => label_trm m
      end.

Definition fv_heap_def (hd: heap_def) : vars :=
  match hd with
  | heap_def_typ _ T        => (fv T)
  | heap_def_trm _ None     => \{}
  | heap_def_trm _ (Some x) => \{ x}
  end.

Instance HeapDefFreeVar : FreeVar heap_def := fv_heap_def.

Fixpoint open_rec_heap_def (k: nat) (u: var) (hd: heap_def)
         {struct hd} : heap_def :=
  match hd with
  | heap_def_typ L T     => heap_def_typ L (open_rec k u T)
  | heap_def_trm m opt_x => heap_def_trm m opt_x
  end.

Instance HeapDefOpenable : Openable heap_def := open_rec_heap_def.

Definition fv_item (v: item) : vars :=
  match v with
  | item_obj T hds    => (fv T) \u (fv hds)
  | item_lit l => (fv l)
  end.

Instance ItemFreeVar : FreeVar item := fv_item.

Definition subst_heap_def (z: var) (u: var) (hd: heap_def)
  : heap_def :=
  match hd with
  | heap_def_typ l t        => heap_def_typ l (subst_var z u t)
  | heap_def_trm l None     => heap_def_trm l None
  | heap_def_trm l (Some x) =>
    heap_def_trm l (Some (subst_fvar z u x))
  end.

Instance HeapDefSubstVar : SubstVar heap_def := subst_heap_def.

Instance HeapDefAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax HeapDefOpenable HeapDefFreeVar HeapDefSubstVar := {}.

Definition open_rec_item (n: nat) (x: var) (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj T ds    => item_obj (open_rec n x T)
                              (open_rec (S n) x ds)
  | item_lit l => item_lit (open_rec n x l)
  end.

Arguments open_rec_vars _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Class DecideFv `(AS: AbstractSyntax A) := dec_fv : var -> A -> bool.

Arguments dec_fv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Definition dec_notin_fv `{DFv: DecideFv A} x a := negb (dec_fv x a).

Arguments dec_notin_fv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class ReflectFv `(DFv: DecideFv A) :=
  reflect_fv : forall x a,
    (x \in fv a) <-> (dec_fv x a) = true.

Class Closing `(AS: AbstractSyntax A) :=
  close_rec : nat -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Closing.

Notation close := (close_rec 0).

Arguments close_rec _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Definition close_depth_rec `{Cl : Closing A} n x a d
  := close_rec (n + d) x a.

Notation close_depth := (close_depth_rec 0).

Arguments close_depth_rec _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Parameter typ_label: Set.

Parameter trm_label: Set.

Inductive label: Set :=
| label_typ: typ_label -> label
| label_trm: trm_label -> label.

Class LabelOf (A : Type) := label_of : A -> label.

Arguments label_of _ _ !_ /.

Class GetLabeled (B A : Type) `(LabelOf B) :=
  get_labeld : label -> A -> option B.

Arguments get_labeld _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Definition labels_has `{GetLabeled B A} (ds: A) (d: B) :=
  get_labeld (label_of d) ds = Some d.

Definition labels_hasnt `{GetLabeled B A} (ds: A) (l: label) :=
  get_labeld l ds = None.

Class SubstLabel `(SubstVar A) `(LabelOf A) :=
  subst_label: forall x y d,
    label_of (subst_var x y d) = label_of d.

Class OpenTwice `(AS: Openable A) :=
  open_twice : forall n x y,
    (open_rec n y) ∘ (open_rec n x) = (open_rec n x).

Class OpenCommut `(AS: Openable A) :=
    open_commut : forall m n x y,
        m <> n ->
        (open_rec m x) ∘ (open_rec n y) = (open_rec n y) ∘ (open_rec m x).

Class SubstFresh `(AS : AbstractSyntax A) :=
  subst_fresh : forall x y X,
    x \notin fv X -> subst_var x y X = X.

Instantiate `G := Gc`, `V := Vc`, `Tf := typ_top`, `S := S0`, `U := typ_bot`.

Both premises hold with real derivations:
- `record_type Vc` via `rt_one`/`rd_trm`.
- `record_has Vc (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top)` via `rh_one`.
- `Gc ⊢ Vc <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S0 typ_bot)`: `x0 : RVc = rcd(dec_typ A Vc Targc)` is bound, so `subtyp_sel2` gives `Vc <: x0.A`, `subtyp_sel1` gives `x0.A <: Targc`, and `subtyp_trans` yields `Vc <: Targc`. Formally `sub_Vc_Targc`.

But the conclusion would be `Gc ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot`, which is unprovable. This is proved rigorously by `Gc_not_top_sub_bot : ~ Gc ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot`, obtained from a mutual induction over `rules_mutind` (all 27 rules handled) using:
- a semantic interpretation `interp` with `interp typ_top = True`, `interp typ_bot = False`, `interp (typ_and T U) = interp T /\ interp U`, everything else `True`; every derivable `Gc ⊢ S <: U` satisfies `interp S -> interp U`;
- an inductive typing invariant `Inv` (closed under records, intersections, selections, binders, etc., with **no constructor for `typ_bot`**) showing every type appearing in a derivation from the singleton context `Gc` is `Inv`, and that the only typable term is `x0`.

Hence `field_lookup_sub_record_refuted : ~ field_lookup_sub_record_statement a` and the `_all` version above.

### Related variants — all refuted

1. **Equal target bounds** (`S = U`):
```coq
Definition field_lookup_sub_record_eq_statement (a : trm_label) : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (Tf S:typ),
    record_type V -> record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S S) -> G ⊢ Tf <: S.
Theorem field_lookup_sub_record_eq_refuted :
  forall (a : trm_label) (A : typ_label), ~ field_lookup_sub_record_eq_statement a.
```
Refuted by the same `Vc` with the target bound set to `S0 := typ_bot` (so target `rcd(dec_trm a typ_bot typ_bot)`), `Tf := typ_top`.

2. **`rc V`** (records/top closed under `typ_and`) instead of `record_type V`:
```coq
Inductive rc : typ -> Prop :=
| rc_top : rc typ_top
| rc_rcd : forall (D:dec), rc (typ_rcd D)
| rc_and : forall T U, rc T -> rc U -> rc (typ_and T U).

Theorem field_lookup_sub_rc_refuted :
  forall (a : trm_label) (A : typ_label), ~ field_lookup_sub_rc_statement a.
```
`Vc` satisfies `rc` via `rc_rcd`; refuted with `S0 := typ_top` (target `rcd(dec_trm a typ_top typ_bot)`), `Tf := typ_top`.

### Key structural caveat

The counterexample necessarily uses a **non-inert context**: `Gc` binds a type member with unequal bounds (`Vc` vs `Targc`), which is exactly the bad-bounds configuration. Moreover, `V` itself can never be `inert_typ`: `record_has` (see `/workspace/Definitions/Typing/RecordTypes.v`) only holds of `typ_rcd` and `typ_and`, whereas `inert_typ` (see `/workspace/Definitions/Typing/InertTypes.v`) contains only `typ_all`, `typ_con (record_type _)`, and `typ_bnd (record_type _)` — so "V genuinely `inert_typ` with `record_has`" is impossible.

In the actual intended use (`/mnt/claude-home/scratch/SelCaseParam.v`), the context is `inert G` and `V = open x T0` comes from an `inert` binding `x : typ_bnd T0` with `record_type T0`; there the type-member bounds of an inert binder cannot be asymmetric, so this counterexample does not apply. Thus **`inert G` is the missing hypothesis** for the version actually used — the lemma is false for arbitrary `G`, but the bad-bounds obstruction is excluded by inertness. (This observation is reasoned in the file's comments, not separately formalized.)

Require Import Base.
Require Import Case.
Require Import RetAux.

Require Import SelPrep.
Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Basic initialization facts                                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma init_var_free_binds : forall (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars) (x:var),
  init_var D vs x free -> binds x free D.
Proof.
  intros D vs x H. remember free as i eqn:Heq. induction H; subst.
  - discriminate Heq.
  - exact H0.
  - discriminate Heq.
  - inversion H0; subst. apply IHinit_var. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma init_typing_var_free_binds : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars) (x:var),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ free -> binds x free D.
Proof.
  intros G D vs x H. change (well_init G D vs (trm_var (avar_f x)) free) in H.
  inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  eapply init_var_free_binds. eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma init_typing_var_bind_mem : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars)
  (x:var) (i:init_typ),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ i ->
  binds x free D -> x \in vs.
Proof.
  intros G D vs x i H Hf.
  destruct (@init_typing_var_status G D vs x i H) as [i0 [Hb [Hsub Hcase]]].
  assert (Heq : i0 = free) by (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; eassumption).
  subst i0.
  destruct Hcase as [Hin|Hc]; [exact Hin|].
  inversion Hc.
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heaps_binds_free : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap)
  (Es:list eff_ctx) (E:eff_ctx),
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es ->
  List.In E Es ->
  forall x, x \in dom E -> binds x free D.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma Es E Hfs. induction Hfs; intros Hin x Hx.
  - inversion Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [->|Hin].
    + eapply free_sub_heap_binds_free; [exact H0|exact Hx].
    + eapply IHfree_sub_heaps; eassumption.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Environment / point-to helpers                                       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma dom_push_in : forall (A:Type) (E:env A) (x:var) (v:A),
  x \in dom E -> dom (E & x ~ v) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros A E x v Hin. rewrite dom_push.
  apply fset_extens.
  - intros z Hz. rewrite in_union in Hz. destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hz. subst z. exact Hin.
    + exact Hz.
  - intros z Hz. rewrite in_union. right. exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma well_pointed_dom_eq : forall (D:init_ctx) (E E':eff_ctx) (z:var),
  dom E' = dom E -> well_pointed D E z -> well_pointed D E' z.
Proof.
  intros D E E' z Heq H. unfold well_pointed in *.
  destruct H as [Hc|[Hin Hf]].
  - left. exact Hc.
  - right. split; [rewrite Heq; exact Hin|exact Hf].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* heap_defs_effs and defs_update                                       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma heap_defs_effs_update_in : forall (hds hds':heap_defs)
  (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  forall (x:var) (e:effect),
    List.In e (heap_defs_effs x hds') ->
    List.In e (heap_defs_effs x hds).
Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y H. induction H; intros x e Hin; simpl in *.
  - destruct o.
    + exact Hin.
    + right. exact Hin.
  - destruct d as [A T|m o]; simpl in *.
    + apply IHdefs_update. exact Hin.
    + destruct o.
      * apply IHdefs_update. exact Hin.
      * right. apply IHdefs_update. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma heap_defs_effs_in_inv : forall (x:var) (l:trm_label) (hds:heap_defs),
  List.In (x,l) (heap_defs_effs x hds) ->
  List.In (heap_def_trm l None) hds.
Proof.
  intros x l hds. induction hds as [|d hds IH]; simpl.
  - intro H. inversion H.
  - destruct d as [A T|m o]; simpl.
    + intro H. apply List.in_cons. apply IH. exact H.
    + destruct o.
      * intro H. apply List.in_cons. apply IH. exact H.
      * intro H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
        -- injection Heq as _ Hl. subst l. apply List.in_eq.
        -- apply List.in_cons. apply IH. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma defs_update_some_in : forall (hds hds':heap_defs)
  (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  List.In (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) hds'.
Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y H. induction H.
  - apply List.in_eq.
  - apply List.in_cons. exact IHH.
Qed.

Lemma ty_heap_defs_label_unique : forall (G:ctx) (hds:heap_defs) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ hds ∶ T ->
  forall d1 d2, List.In d1 hds -> List.In d2 hds ->
    label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2.
Proof.
  intros G hds T H. change (ty_defs G hds T) in H. induction H;
    intros d1 d2 I1 I2 Heq.
  - simpl in I1, I2. destruct I1 as [->|[]]. destruct I2 as [->|[]].
    reflexivity.
  - simpl in I1, I2.
    destruct I1 as [->|I1]; destruct I2 as [->|I2].
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso. eapply (@labels_hasnt_sound heap_def HeapDefLabelOf ds (label_of d) H1 d2 I2).
      rewrite <- Heq. reflexivity.
    + exfalso. eapply (@labels_hasnt_sound heap_def HeapDefLabelOf ds (label_of d) H1 d1 I1).
      rewrite Heq. reflexivity.
    + eapply IHty_defs; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma defs_update_not_none : forall (hds hds':heap_defs)
  (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  (forall d1 d2, List.In d1 hds' -> List.In d2 hds' ->
    label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2) ->
  ~ List.In (heap_def_trm a None) hds'.
Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y Hup Huniq Hnone.
  assert (Hsome : List.In (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) hds')
    by (eapply defs_update_some_in; exact Hup).
  pose proof (Huniq _ _ Hsome Hnone eq_refl) as Heq.
  inversion Heq.
Qed.

Lemma heap_defs_points_to_update : forall (hds hds':heap_defs)
  (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  forall z, z \in heap_defs_points_to hds' ->
    z = y \/ z \in heap_defs_points_to hds.
Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y H. induction H; intros z Hz; simpl in *.
  - destruct o as [z0|].
    + rewrite in_union in Hz. destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz].
      * left. rewrite in_singleton in Hz. exact Hz.
      * right. rewrite in_union. right. exact Hz.
    + rewrite in_union in Hz. destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz].
      * left. rewrite in_singleton in Hz. exact Hz.
      * right. exact Hz.
  - destruct d as [A T|m o]; simpl in *.
    + apply IHdefs_update. exact Hz.
    + destruct o.
      * rewrite in_union in Hz. destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz].
        -- right. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hz.
        -- right. rewrite in_union. right. apply IHdefs_update. exact Hz.
      * apply IHdefs_update. exact Hz.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Effect-context correspondence helpers                               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma eff_trm_asn_inv : forall (x y:var) (a:trm_label) (effs:effects),
  ⊢e trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ effs ->
  effs = nil \/ effs = ((x,a) :: nil).
Proof.
  intros x y a effs H.
  change (eff_trm (trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)) effs) in H.
  inversion H; subst; [left|right]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma eff_ctx_corr_inv : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx)
  (effs:effects) (effss:list effects),
  eff_ctx_corr (E :: Es) (effs :: effss) ->
  eff_ctx_corr Es effss /\ eff_ctx_corr_one E effs.
Proof.
  intros E Es effs effss H. inversion H; subst. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma eff_ctx_corr_one_update_at : forall (E:eff_ctx) (effs' effs:effects)
  (x:var) (e' e:effects),
  eff_ctx_corr_one E (effs' ++ effs) ->
  (forall z effsz, binds z effsz E ->
     forall p, p \in from_list effsz -> fst p = z) ->
  (forall p, List.In p effs' -> fst p = x) ->
  (forall p, p \in from_list e' -> p \notin from_list effs') ->
  (forall p, p \in from_list e' -> p \in from_list e) ->
  binds x e E ->
  eff_ctx_corr_one (E & x ~ e') effs.
Proof.
  intros E effs' effs x e' e Hcorr HfreshE Hfst Havoid Hsub Hbinds
    z effsz Hz p Hp.
  destruct (LibEnv.binds_push_inv Hz) as [[Heqz Heqe]|[Hne Hzb]].
  - subst z effsz.
    assert (Hpold : p \in from_list e) by (apply Hsub; exact Hp).
    assert (Hin : p \in from_list (effs' ++ effs))
      by (apply Hcorr; [exact Hbinds|exact Hpold]).
    rewrite from_list_app in Hin. rewrite in_union in Hin.
    destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin]; [|exact Hin].
    exfalso. eapply (Havoid p Hp). exact Hin.
  - assert (Hin : p \in from_list (effs' ++ effs))
      by (apply Hcorr; [exact Hzb|exact Hp]).
    rewrite from_list_app in Hin. rewrite in_union in Hin.
    destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin]; [|exact Hin].
    exfalso.
    pose proof (Hfst p Hin) as Hfpx.
    pose proof (@HfreshE z effsz Hzb p Hp) as Hfpz.
    rewrite Hfpx in Hfpz. exact (Hne Hfpz).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Stack typing only depends on the domains of the effect contexts     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition envs_dom_eq (Es Es':list eff_ctx) : Prop :=
  List.length Es = List.length Es' /\
  forall n E E', nth_error Es n = Some E -> nth_error Es' n = Some E' ->
    dom E = dom E'.

Lemma envs_dom_eq_cons_inv : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx)
  (E':eff_ctx) (Es':list eff_ctx),
  envs_dom_eq (E :: Es) (E' :: Es') ->
  dom E = dom E' /\ envs_dom_eq Es Es'.
Proof.
  intros E Es E' Es' [Hlen Hdom]. split.
  - exact (Hdom 0 E E' eq_refl eq_refl).
  - split.
    + simpl in Hlen. exact (eq_add_S _ _ Hlen).
    + intros n E1 E2 H1 H2. eapply Hdom with (n:=S n); simpl; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma envs_dom_eq_zero : forall (Es Es':list eff_ctx),
  envs_dom_eq Es Es' -> List.length Es = 0 -> Es' = nil.
Proof.
  intros Es Es' [Hlen _] H0. destruct Es'; [reflexivity|].
  simpl in Hlen. rewrite H0 in Hlen. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma envs_dom_eq_one : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx)
  (Es':list eff_ctx),
  envs_dom_eq (E :: Es) Es' -> Es = nil -> exists E', Es' = E' :: nil.
Proof.
  intros E Es Es' [Hlen Hdom] Hnil. destruct Es' as [|E' Es''].
  - simpl in Hlen. discriminate.
  - assert (Es'' = nil) as ->.
    { destruct Es''; [reflexivity|]. simpl in Hlen. rewrite Hnil in Hlen. discriminate. }
    exists E'. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ty_stack_dom_eq : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Es Es':list eff_ctx)
  (Fs:stack) (T:typ) (i:init_typ) (effss:list effects) (U:typ),
  envs_dom_eq Es Es' ->
  ty_stack G D Es Fs T i effss U ->
  ty_stack G D Es' Fs T i effss U.
Proof.
  intros G D Es Es' Fs T i effss U Hde H. revert Es' Hde.
  induction H; intros Es' Hde.
  - destruct Es' as [|E' Es'']; [simpl in Hde; destruct Hde as [Hlen _]; discriminate Hlen|].
    destruct Es'' as [|E2 Es2]; [|simpl in Hde; destruct Hde as [Hlen _]; discriminate Hlen].
    apply ty_stack_nil. assumption.
  - destruct Es' as [|E' Es'']; [simpl in Hde; destruct Hde as [Hlen _]; discriminate Hlen|].
    destruct (envs_dom_eq_cons_inv _ _ _ _ Hde) as [Hdomhead Hde_tail].
    eapply ty_stack_let.
    + eapply IHty_stack. exact Hde_tail.
    + exact H0.
    + intros x Hx. rewrite Hdomhead. eapply H1. exact Hx.
    + exact H2.
  - destruct Es' as [|E' Es'']; [simpl in Hde; destruct Hde as [Hlen _]; discriminate Hlen|].
    destruct (envs_dom_eq_cons_inv _ _ _ _ Hde) as [Hdomhead Hde_tail].
    eapply ty_stack_ret_free.
    + eapply IHty_stack. exact Hde_tail.
    + exact H0.
    + rewrite Hdomhead. exact H1.
  - destruct Es' as [|E' Es'']; [simpl in Hde; destruct Hde as [Hlen _]; discriminate Hlen|].
    destruct (envs_dom_eq_cons_inv _ _ _ _ Hde) as [Hdomhead Hde_tail].
    eapply ty_stack_ret_committed.
    + eapply IHty_stack. exact Hde_tail.
    + exact H0.
    + rewrite Hdomhead. exact H1.
Qed.

Lemma init_typing_sel_committed : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars)

Lemma committed_heap_defs_update : forall (D:init_ctx) (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  committed_heap_defs D hds ->
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  binds y committed D ->
  committed_heap_defs D hds'.
Proof.
  intros D hds hds' a y Hc Hu Hy. revert Hc. induction Hu; intros Hc.
  - inversion Hc; subst.
    eapply (@committed_heap_defs_cons D (heap_def_trm a (Some x)) hds).
    + exact H2.
    + eapply committed_heap_def_trm. change (binds x committed D). exact Hy.
  - inversion Hc; subst.
    eapply (@committed_heap_defs_cons D d hds').
    + eapply IHHu; [exact Hy|exact H2].
    + exact H3.
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heap_asn_update : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Sigma Sigma':heap) (D:init_ctx)
  (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D ->
  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
  binds x committed D ->
  free_sub_heap E Sigma' D.
Proof.
  intros E Sigma Sigma' D x a y Hfree Hup Hxcomm.
  destruct Hup as (T & hds & hds' & S1 & S2 & Heq & Hfresh & Hdu & Heq').
  subst Sigma Sigma'.
  intros z effs Hb. destruct (Hfree z effs Hb) as [Hsame Hrest].
  destruct Hrest as [itm [Hbinds Hitem]].
  assert (Hne : z <> x).
  { intro E0. subst z.
    inversion Hitem; subst.
    match goal with
    | Hf : free_heap_defs D E x ?hds0 |- _ =>
      destruct Hf as [Hbzfree _]
    end.
    pose proof (@LibEnv.binds_functional init_typ x free committed D Hbzfree Hxcomm) as Heqfc.
    discriminate Heqfc. }
  split.
  - exact Hsame.
  - exists itm. split.
    + eapply (@binds_replace item S1 S2 x z
                 (item_obj T hds) (item_obj T hds') itm);
      [exact Hne|exact Hbinds].
    + exact Hitem.
Qed.

Lemma well_committed_heap_asn_update : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx)
  (Sigma Sigma':heap) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  well_committed_heap G D Sigma ->
  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
  binds x committed D ->
  binds y committed D ->
  well_committed_heap G D Sigma'.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma Sigma' x a y Hwc Hup Hxcomm Hycomm.
  destruct Hwc as [HdomG [HdomD Hitem]].
  destruct Hup as (T & hds & hds' & S1 & S2 & Heq & Hfresh & Hdu & Heq').
  subst Sigma Sigma'.
  split; [exact HdomG|]. split.
  - rewrite HdomD. rewrite !LibEnv.dom_concat, !LibEnv.dom_single. reflexivity.
  - intros z itm Hzcomm Hbinds.
    destruct (classic (z = x)) as [->|Hne].
    + assert (Hcanon : binds x (item_obj T hds')
                      (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds' & S2)).
      { eapply LibEnv.binds_concat_left.
        - apply LibEnv.binds_push_eq.
        - exact Hfresh. }
      assert (Heqitm : itm = item_obj T hds')
        by (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; [exact Hbinds|exact Hcanon]).
      subst itm.
      assert (Hcanon_old : binds x (item_obj T hds)
                          (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2)).
      { eapply LibEnv.binds_concat_left.
        - apply LibEnv.binds_push_eq.
        - exact Hfresh. }
      pose proof (Hitem x (item_obj T hds) Hzcomm Hcanon_old) as Hci.
      pose proof (committed_heap_item_obj_inv Hci) as Hcdefs.
      eapply committed_heap_obj. eapply committed_heap_defs_update; eassumption.
    + assert (Hbinds_old : binds z itm (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2)).
      { eapply (@binds_replace item S1 S2 x z
                   (item_obj T hds') (item_obj T hds) itm);
          [exact Hne|exact Hbinds]. }
      exact (Hitem z itm Hzcomm Hbinds_old).
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heaps_asn_update : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma Sigma':heap)
  (Es:list eff_ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es ->
  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
  binds x committed D ->
  binds y committed D ->
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma' Es.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma Sigma' Es x a y Hfs Hup Hxcomm Hycomm.
  induction Hfs.
  - eapply free_sub_heaps_nil.
    eapply well_committed_heap_asn_update; eassumption.
  - eapply free_sub_heaps_cons.
    + exact H.
    + eapply free_sub_heap_asn_update; eassumption.
    + eapply IHHfs; assumption.
Qed.

Require Import Base.
Require Import Case.
Require Import RetAux.
Require Import AsnAux.
Require Import HeapAsn.
Require Import SelPrep.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* The hypothesis [Hfield] requested for this scratch module is FALSE as  *)
(* stated.  We record a self-contained refutation below, so that the      *)
(* final preservation lemma, which is proved under that hypothesis, is    *)
(* explicitly seen to be vacuous.  The refutation is the one from         *)
(* [FieldSub.v] (compiled, no axioms).                                    *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* Counterexample (for any field label [a]):                              *)
(*   G  = empty                                                           *)
(*   V  = typ_and typ_bot (typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top))           *)
(*   Tf = typ_top,  S = typ_top,  U = typ_bot                             *)
(* [record_has V (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top)] holds by rh_andr/rh_one,    *)
(* and [empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_bot)] holds by        *)
(*   V <: typ_bot   (subtyp_and11)                                        *)
(*   typ_bot <: ... (subtyp_bot)                                          *)
(*   (subtyp_trans)                                                       *)
(* Hence [Hfield] would yield [empty ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot], which is not  *)
(* derivable (proved below by a semantic interpretation of the four       *)
(* mutually defined judgments).                                           *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Definition field_lookup_sub_statement (a : trm_label) : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (Tf S U:typ),
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    G ⊢ Tf <: U.

Fixpoint interp (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_rcd _ => True
  | typ_and T U => interp T /\ interp U
  | typ_sel _ _ => True
  | typ_bnd _ => True
  | typ_all _ _ => True
  | typ_con _ _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma empty_typing_sub_sound :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
     G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (T U:typ), G ⊢ T <: U ->
     G = empty -> interp T -> interp U) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).
Proof.
  apply (rules_mutind
    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
       G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False)
    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (T U:typ) (_:G ⊢ T <: U) =>
       G = empty -> interp T -> interp U)
    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True));
  intros;
  try solve [cbn [interp] in *; tauto];
  try (match goal with
       | H : binds ?x ?v ?G, He : ?G = empty |- False =>
           rewrite He in H; exact (LibEnv.binds_empty_inv H)
       end);
  try (match goal with
       | H : ?G = empty -> forall y, ?t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> False,
         He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
           exfalso; eapply H; [exact He | first [eassumption | reflexivity]]
       end);
  try (match goal with H : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- False => discriminate H end);
  try (match goal with H : trm_var (avar_f _) = ?t |- False => discriminate H end).
Qed.

Lemma empty_not_top_sub_bot : ~ (empty ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot).
Proof.
  intro H.
  pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 empty_typing_sub_sound))
                empty typ_top typ_bot H) as Hsub.
  cbn [interp] in Hsub.
  apply Hsub; [reflexivity | exact I].
Qed.

Theorem field_lookup_sub_refuted :
  forall (a : trm_label), ~ field_lookup_sub_statement a.
Proof.
  intros a Hstmt.
  apply empty_not_top_sub_bot.
  eapply Hstmt with
    (V := typ_and typ_bot (typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top)))
    (S := typ_top).
  - apply rh_andr, rh_one.
  - eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_bot).
    + apply subtyp_and11.
    + apply subtyp_bot.
Qed.

Section Params.

Hypothesis Hfield : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) -> G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) -> G ⊢ Tf <: U.
Hypothesis Hroot : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),
  inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D -> G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.

(* The two section hypotheses are mutually inconsistent: [Hfield] alone is
   already refutable.  Hence the requested preservation lemma holds
   vacuously.  This lemma records the inconsistency explicitly. *)
Lemma Hfield_inconsistent : forall (a:trm_label), False.
Proof.
  intros a.
  eapply (field_lookup_sub_refuted a).
  intros G V Tf S U Hrh Hsub.
  exact (Hfield G V a Tf S U Hrh Hsub).
Qed.

Lemma ty_config_red_asn : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx)
  (effss:list effects) (Fs:stack) (Sigma Sigma':heap) (U:typ)
  (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  ty_config G D Es effss (trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ; Fs ; Sigma) U ->
  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
  exists G' D' Es' effss',
    ty_config (G & G') D' Es' effss' (trm_var (avar_f y) ; Fs ; Sigma') U.
Proof.
  intros G D Es effss Fs Sigma Sigma' U x a y Hcfg Hup.
  exfalso. exact (Hfield_inconsistent a).
Qed.

End Params.

  rewrite concat_empty_r.

Require Import Base.

Unset Implicit Arguments.

Lemma get_labeld_list_some_in : forall (A:Set) `{LabelOf A} (l:label) (ds:list A) (d:A),
  get_labeld_list l ds = Some d -> List.In d ds.
Proof.
  intros A LA l ds. induction ds as [|a ds IH]; intros d H.
  - simpl in H. discriminate H.
  - simpl in H. destruct (classic (label_of a = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_of a = l) _ _ E) in H.
      injection H as Heq. subst d. apply List.in_eq.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of a = l) _ _ NE) in H.
      apply List.in_cons. eapply IH; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_defs_in : forall (D:init_ctx) (hds:heap_defs) (d:heap_def),
  committed_heap_defs D hds -> List.In d hds -> committed_heap_def D d.
Proof.
  intros D hds d H. induction H; intros Hin.
  - inversion Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + subst d. assumption.
    + eapply IHcommitted_heap_defs; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_def_trm_some_binds : forall (D:init_ctx) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  committed_heap_def D (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) -> binds y committed D.
Proof. intros D a y H. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_def_trm_none_false : forall (D:init_ctx) (a:trm_label),
  committed_heap_def D (heap_def_trm a None) -> False.
Proof. intros D a H. inversion H. Qed.

(* Effects: an effect-context inclusion survives dropping a prefix whose
   variables are not bound in the effect context. *)
Lemma eff_ctx_corr_one_suffix : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (D:init_ctx)
  (effs' effs:effects),
  eff_ctx_corr_one E (effs' ++ effs) ->
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D ->
  (forall e, List.In e effs' -> fst e \notin dom E) ->
  eff_ctx_corr_one E effs.
Proof.
  intros E Sigma D effs' effs Hcorr Hfree Hnodom x effs0 Hb e He.
  destruct e as [z l].
  assert (Hin : (z,l) \in from_list (effs' ++ effs)).
  { exact (Hcorr x effs0 Hb (z,l) He). }
  rewrite from_list_app in Hin. rewrite in_union in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
  - exfalso.
    pose proof (proj1 (Hfree x effs0 Hb) z l He) as Hz.
    assert (Hdom : x \in dom E) by (eapply binds_in_dom; exact Hb).
    apply (Hnodom (z,l) (proj1 (@in_from_list effect (z,l) effs') Hin)). rewrite Hz. exact Hdom.
  - exact Hin.
Qed.

(* Typing inversion for selection. *)
Lemma ty_sel_inv_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  forall (x:var) (a:trm_label), t = trm_sel (avar_f x) a ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  induction H; intros x0 a0 Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - injection Heq as Hx Ha. subst x0 a0.
    exists S, T. split; [assumption|apply subtyp_refl].
  - subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm x0 a0 eq_refl) as [S [T1 [Hx Hsub]]].
    exists S, T1. split; [exact Hx|]. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact H0].
Qed.

Lemma ty_sel_inv : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ T ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof. intros. eapply ty_sel_inv_gen; [exact H|reflexivity]. Qed.

(* Typing inversion for assignment. *)
Lemma ty_asn_inv_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  forall (x y:var) (a:trm_label), t = trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\
               G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  induction H; intros x0 y0 a0 Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - injection Heq as Hx Ha Hy. subst x0 y0 a0.
    exists S, T. split; [exact H|]. split; [exact H0|apply subtyp_refl].
  - subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm x0 y0 a0 eq_refl) as [S [T1 [Hx [Hy Hsub]]]].
    exists S, T1. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hy|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact H0].
Qed.

Lemma ty_asn_inv : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ T ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\
               G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof. intros. eapply ty_asn_inv_gen; [exact H|reflexivity]. Qed.

(* Initialization status facts for the reduction of selection/assignment. *)
Lemma init_typing_sel_committed : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars)
  (x:var) (a:trm_label) (i:init_typ),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ i ->
  i = committed /\ binds x committed D.
Proof.
  intros G D vs x a i H.
  destruct (@init_sel_commit G D vs x a i H) as [Heq Hc]. subst i.
  split; [reflexivity|].
  eapply commit_sel_binds; exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma init_typing_asn_status : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars)
  (x y:var) (a:trm_label) (i:init_typ),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ i ->
  (i = committed /\ binds y committed D) \/
  (i = free /\ y \in vs).
Proof.
  intros G D vs x y a i H.
  change (well_init G D vs (trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)) i) in H.
  inversion H; subst.
  - (* init_commit *) left. split; [reflexivity|].
    inversion H0; subst. eapply commit_var_binds. eassumption.
  - (* init_fld_asn_ac *) left. split; [reflexivity|].
    eapply init_typing_var_committed_binds; exact H8.
  - (* init_fld_asn_ff *) right. split; [reflexivity|].
    eapply @init_typing_var_free_mem with (G:=G) (D:=D) (vs:=vs) (x:=y).
    exact H8.
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heap_binds_free : forall (ℰ:eff_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (D:init_ctx) (y:var),
  free_sub_heap ℰ Sigma D -> y \in dom ℰ -> binds y free D.
Proof.
  intros ℰ Sigma D y H Hy.
  destruct (dom_binds_exists Hy) as [effs Hb].
  unfold free_sub_heap in H.
  destruct (H y effs Hb) as [_ [itm [HbS Hfi]]].
  inversion Hfi; subst.
  match goal with Hfd : free_heap_defs D ℰ y ?hds |- _ =>
    unfold free_heap_defs in Hfd; destruct Hfd as [Hfree _]; exact Hfree end.
Qed.

Lemma inert_inits_commit_ctx : forall (D:init_ctx) (ℰ:eff_ctx),
  inert_inits D -> inert_inits (D & commit_ctx ℰ).
Proof.
  intros D ℰ H y i Hy. unfold inert_inits in *.
  destruct (classic (y \in dom ℰ)) as [Hin|Hout].
  - right.
    assert (Hc : binds y committed (D & commit_ctx ℰ))
      by (apply LibEnv.binds_concat_right; apply binds_commit_ctx_in; exact Hin).
    pose proof (@LibEnv.binds_functional init_typ y i committed (D & commit_ctx ℰ) Hy Hc) as E.
    exact E.
  - assert (HyD : binds y i D).
    { eapply LibEnv.binds_concat_left_inv; [exact Hy|].
      rewrite commit_ctx_dom. exact Hout. }
    destruct (H y i HyD) as [E0|E0]; [left|right]; exact E0.
Qed.

Lemma init_var_free_mem : forall (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars) (x:var),
  init_var D vs x free -> x \in vs.
Proof.
  intros D vs x H. remember free as i eqn:Heq. induction H; subst.
  - discriminate Heq.
  - exact H.
  - discriminate Heq.
  - assert (Hi : i' = free) by (inversion H0; reflexivity). apply IHinit_var. exact Hi.
Qed.

Lemma init_typing_var_free_mem : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars) (x:var),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ free -> x \in vs.
Proof.
  intros G D vs x H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  - eapply init_var_free_mem. exact H4.
Qed.

Require Import Base.

Require Import Case.

Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
