Unset Implicit Arguments.

Lemma init_sub_trans : forall (a b c:init_typ),
  init_sub a b -> init_sub b c -> init_sub a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst;
    auto using init_sub_refl, init_sub_comm_unspec, init_sub_free_unspec.
Qed.

Lemma init_var_status_binds : forall (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars) (y:var) (i:init_typ),
  init_var D vs y i ->
  exists i0, binds y i0 D /\ init_sub i0 i /\ (y \in vs \/ i0 = committed).
Proof.
  intros D vs y i H. induction H.
  - exists committed. split; [exact H|split]; [apply init_sub_refl|right; reflexivity].
  - exists free. split; [exact H0|split]; [apply init_sub_refl|left; exact H].
  - exists unspecified. split; [exact H0|split]; [apply init_sub_refl|left; exact H].
  - destruct IHinit_var as [i0 [Hb [Hsub Hcase]]].
    exists i0. split; [exact Hb|split]; [|exact Hcase].
    eapply init_sub_trans; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma init_typing_var_status : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars) (y:var) (i:init_typ),
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ i ->
  exists i0, binds y i0 D /\ init_sub i0 i /\ (y \in vs \/ i0 = committed).
Proof.
  intros G D vs y i H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  - eapply init_var_status_binds. exact H4.
  - assert (Hb : binds y committed D) by (eapply init_typing_var_committed_binds; exact H).
    exists committed. split; [exact Hb|split]; [apply init_sub_refl|right; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma vs_union_id : forall (vs:vars) (y:var), y \in vs -> vs \u \{y} = vs.
Proof.
  intros vs y Hy. apply fset_extens.
  - intros z Hz. rewrite in_union in Hz. destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + exact Hz.
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hz. subst z. exact Hy.
  - intros z Hz. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma init_open_any_status : forall (L:fset var) (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars)
  (S:typ) (t:trm) (i' i:init_typ) (y:var),
  (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
     G & x0 ~ S ⸴ D & x0 ~ i ⸴ (vs \u \{x0}) ⊢i open x0 t ∶ i') ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S ->
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ i ->
  G ⸴ D ⸴ vs ⊢i open y t ∶ i'.
Proof.
  intros L G D vs S t i' i y Hbody Hty Hinit.
  destruct (@init_typing_var_status G D vs y i Hinit) as [i0 [Hbinds [Hsub Hcase]]].
  destruct (@var_fresh (((((((L \u dom G) \u fv_env G) \u fv t) \u fv S) \u dom D) \u vs) \u \{y})) as [x0 Hx0].
  pose proof (notin_union_r1 Hx0) as Hx1.
  pose proof (notin_union_r1 Hx1) as Hx2.
  pose proof (notin_union_r1 Hx2) as Hx3.
  pose proof (notin_union_r1 Hx3) as Hx4.
  pose proof (notin_union_r1 Hx4) as Hx5.
  pose proof (notin_union_r1 Hx5) as Hx6.
  pose proof (notin_union_r1 Hx6) as HxL.
  pose proof (notin_union_r2 Hx6) as HxdomG.
  pose proof (notin_union_r2 Hx5) as Hxfvenv.
  pose proof (notin_union_r2 Hx4) as Hxt.
  pose proof (notin_union_r2 Hx3) as HxS.
  pose proof (notin_union_r2 Hx2) as HxdomD.
  pose proof (notin_union_r2 Hx1) as Hxvs.
  pose proof (notin_union_r2 Hx0) as Hxy.
  assert (HxemptyG : x0 # (empty:ctx)) by (rewrite (@dom_empty typ); apply notin_empty).
  assert (HxemptyD : x0 # (empty:init_ctx)) by (rewrite (@dom_empty init_typ); apply notin_empty).
  assert (Hbody0 : G & x0 ~ S ⸴ D & x0 ~ i ⸴ (vs \u \{x0}) ⊢i open x0 t ∶ i')
    by (apply Hbody; exact HxL).
  assert (Hbody0' : G & x0 ~ S & empty ⸴ D & x0 ~ i & empty ⸴ (vs \u \{x0}) ⊢i open x0 t ∶ i').
  { rewrite concat_empty_r. rewrite concat_empty_r. exact Hbody0. }
  assert (HpreS : (G & subst_env x0 y (empty:ctx)) ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ subst_var x0 y S).
  { rewrite map_empty. rewrite concat_empty_r.
    rewrite (@fv_subst_typ S x0 y HxS). exact Hty. }
  assert (Hb' : binds y i0 (D & empty)) by (rewrite concat_empty_r; exact Hbinds).
  pose proof (@GenSubst.init_subst i i0 Hsub
                (G & x0 ~ S & empty) (D & x0 ~ i & empty)
                (vs \u \{x0}) (open x0 t) i' Hbody0'
                G (empty:ctx) D (empty:init_ctx) x0 y S
                eq_refl eq_refl HxemptyG HxemptyD Hxfvenv HpreS Hb') as Hres.
  rewrite (@map_empty typ typ (subst_var x0 y)) in Hres.
  rewrite (@concat_empty_r typ G) in Hres.
  rewrite (@concat_empty_r init_typ D) in Hres.
  assert (Hvs : subst_var x0 y (vs \u \{x0}) = vs \u \{y})
    by (apply subst_var_union_self; exact Hxvs).
  assert (Hres2 : G ⸴ D ⸴ (vs \u \{y}) ⊢i open y t ∶ i').
  { rewrite (@subst_intro_trm t x0 y 0 Hxt).
    rewrite <- Hvs.
    exact Hres. }
  destruct Hcase as [Hy|Hcomm].
  - rewrite <- (@vs_union_id vs y Hy). exact Hres2.
  - subst i0.
    assert (Hrm : G ⸴ D ⸴ ((vs \u \{y}) \- \{y}) ⊢i open y t ∶ i').
    { eapply init_typing_vs_remove_committed; [exact Hbinds|exact Hres2]. }
    eapply init_typing_vs_weaken with (vs := ((vs \u \{y}) \- \{y})).
    + intros z Hz. rewrite FsetImpl.in_remove in Hz. destruct Hz as [Hin Hne].
      rewrite in_union in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin]; [exact Hin|].
      exfalso. apply Hne. exact Hin.
    + exact Hrm.
Qed.

Lemma ty_config_let_var_any : forall (L:fset var) (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx)
  (ℰ:eff_ctx) (ℰs:list eff_ctx) (Fs:stack) (Sigma:heap) (U S T2:typ)
  (i i':init_typ) (effs_frame effs_tail:effects) (effss_tail:list effects)
  (t:trm) (y:var),
  inert G -> inert_inits D -> heap_correspond G Sigma ->
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma (ℰ :: ℰs) ->
  ty_stack G D (ℰ :: ℰs) Fs T2 i' ((effs_tail :: effss_tail)%list) U ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S ->
  G ⸴ D ⸴ dom ℰ ⊢i trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ i ->
  (forall x0, x0 \notin L -> G & x0 ~ S ⊢ open x0 t ∶ T2) ->
  (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
     G & x0 ~ S ⸴ D & x0 ~ i ⸴ (dom ℰ \u \{x0}) ⊢i open x0 t ∶ i') ->
  (forall x0, x0 \notin L -> eff_trm (open x0 t) effs_frame) ->
  eff_ctx_corr (ℰ :: ℰs) (((effs_frame ++ effs_tail)%list :: effss_tail)%list) ->
  exists G' D' Es' effss',
    ty_config (G & G') D' Es' effss' (open y t ; Fs ; Sigma) U.
Proof.
  intros L G D ℰ ℰs Fs Sigma U S T2 i i' effs_frame effs_tail effss_tail t y
         Hinert Hinits Hhc Hfs Hstack Hty Hinit Hbody_ty Hbody_init Hbody_eff Hcorr.
  assert (Hty' : G ⊢ open y t ∶ T2).
  { eapply ty_trm_open_any; [exact Hbody_ty|exact Hty]. }
  assert (Heff' : eff_trm (open y t) effs_frame).
  { eapply eff_trm_llit_open; exact Hbody_eff. }
  assert (Hinit' : G ⸴ D ⸴ dom ℰ ⊢i open y t ∶ i').
  { eapply init_open_any_status; [exact Hbody_init|exact Hty|exact Hinit]. }
  exists (empty:ctx), D, (ℰ :: ℰs),
    (((effs_frame ++ effs_tail)%list :: effss_tail)%list).
  rewrite concat_empty_r.
  eapply (@ty_config_c G D Sigma ℰ ℰs Fs (open y t) T2 i' U effs_frame effs_tail effss_tail).
  - exact Hinert.
  - exact Hinits.
  - exact Hhc.
  - exact Hfs.
  - exact Hstack.
  - exact Hty'.
  - exact Heff'.
  - exact Hinit'.
  - exact Hcorr.
Qed.

Lemma eff_trm_var_nil : forall (a:avar) (effs:effects),
  eff_trm (trm_var a) effs -> effs = nil.
Proof.
  intros a effs H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ty_config_red_let_var : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx)
  (effss:list effects) (Fs:stack) (Sigma:heap) (U:typ) (t:trm) (y:var),
  ty_config G D Es effss (trm_var (avar_f y) ; (frame_let t :: Fs)%list ; Sigma) U ->
  exists G' D' Es' effss',
    ty_config (G & G') D' Es' effss' (open y t ; Fs ; Sigma) U.
Proof.
  intros G D Es effss Fs Sigma U t y Hcfg.
  destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D Es effss (trm_var (avar_f y))
              ((frame_let t :: Fs)%list) Sigma U Hcfg) as
    (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effsH & effs' & effss0 &
     HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr).
  destruct (ty_stack_let_inv Hstack) as
    (ℰ0 & ℰs0 & L & T2 & i' & effs0 & effss_tail & effs_frame &
     HeqEs' & HeqEffs' & Hstack_tail & Hbody_ty & Hbody_init & Hbody_eff).
  inversion HeqEs'; subst.
  injection HeqEffs' as HeqH HeqT. subst effsH effss0.

Proof.

  - exact H.

Proof.

  - eapply init_var_committed_binds. exact H4.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping.

Require Import Effects Initialization InitLookup.

Implicit Types (i : init_typ) (t : trm) (l : lit).

Inductive all_comm_unspec : inits -> Prop :=
| all_comm_unspec_nil : all_comm_unspec nil
| all_comm_unspec_cons : forall i is',
    (i = committed) \/ (i = unspecified) ->
    all_comm_unspec is' ->
    all_comm_unspec (cons i is').

Inductive well_committed : CommitTyping trm :=

| commit_var : forall Gamma Delta x,
    binds x committed Delta ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c (trm_var (avar_f x))

| commit_all_elim : forall Gamma Delta x z,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f z) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_app (avar_f x) (avar_f z)

| commit_new : forall Gamma Delta x avs Ts is' T,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_con Ts is' T ->
    all_comm_unspec is' ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c avs ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_new (avar_f x) avs

| commit_rcd_elim : forall Gamma Delta x a,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_sel (avar_f x) a

| commit_fld_asn : forall Gamma Delta x i y a,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f y) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)

| commit_let : forall L Gamma Delta t u T,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c t ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ committed ⊢c open x u) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_let T t u

| commit_llit : forall L Gamma Delta l u T,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c l ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ committed ⊢c open x u) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_lit T l u

with well_committed_avars : CommitTyping avars :=
     | committed_nil : forall Gamma Delta,
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c nil

     | committed_cons : forall Gamma Delta x avs,
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c (trm_var (avar_f x)) ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c avs ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c (cons (avar_f x) avs)

with well_committed_lit : CommitTyping lit :=

     | commit_all_intro : forall L Gamma Delta T t,
         (forall x, x \notin L ->
               Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ committed ⊢c open x t) ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c lit_fun T t

     | commit_con_intro : forall L Gamma Delta Ts is' T i ds t,
         length is' = length_s Ts ->
         (forall x ys,
             length ys = length_s Ts ->
             fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys) ->
             has_effs (open_vars (cons x ys) t) (def_eff x ds)) ->
         (forall x ys,
             length ys = length_s Ts ->
             fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys) ->
             (Gamma & (ys ~** (to_list Ts))
              & (x ~ open_vars (cons x ys) T) ⸴ Delta
              & (ys ~** is') & (x ~ free) ⸴ (from_list ys) \u \{ x}
                                          ⊢i (open_vars (cons x ys) t) ∶ i)) ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c lit_con Ts is' T ds t

with well_init : InitTyping trm :=

| init_var_binds : forall Gamma Delta vs x i,

    init_var Delta vs x i ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ i

| init_commit : forall Gamma Delta t vs,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c t ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i t ∶ committed

| init_new_free : forall Gamma Delta vs x avs Ts is' T,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c trm_var (avar_f x) ->
    Gamma ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_con Ts is' T ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i avs :: is' ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_new (avar_f x) avs ∶ free

| init_fld_asn_ac : forall Gamma Delta vs x i y a,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ i ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ committed ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ committed

| init_fld_asn_ff : forall Gamma Delta vs x y a,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ free ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ free ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ free

| init_let : forall L Gamma Delta vs t u T i i',
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i t ∶ i ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ i ⸴ vs \u \{ x} ⊢i open x u ∶ i') ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_let T t u ∶ i'

| init_llit : forall L Gamma Delta vs l u T i,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c l ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ T ⸴ Delta & x ~ committed ⸴ vs ⊢i open x u ∶ i) ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i trm_lit T l u ∶ i

with well_inits : InitTypings avars :=
     | well_inits_nil : forall Gamma Delta vs,
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i nil :: nil

     | well_inits_cons : forall Gamma Delta vs x i avs is',
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i (trm_var (avar_f x)) ∶ i ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i avs :: is' ->
         Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ vs ⊢i (cons (avar_f x) avs) :: (cons i is').

Require Import Base.
Require Import Case.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.

Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* A record component reachable by field selection. *)
Inductive has_field : typ -> trm_label -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| hf_one : forall (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
    has_field (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U)) a S U
| hf_andl : forall (T U:typ) (a:trm_label) (S Uf:typ),
    has_field T a S Uf -> has_field (typ_and T U) a S Uf
| hf_andr : forall (T U:typ) (a:trm_label) (S Uf:typ),
    has_field U a S Uf -> has_field (typ_and T U) a S Uf.

Lemma has_field_record_has : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
  has_field T a S U -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U).
Proof.
  intros T a S U H. induction H.
  - apply rh_one.
  - apply rh_andl. assumption.
  - apply rh_andr. assumption.
Qed.

(* Types built from top and records by intersection. *)
Inductive rc : typ -> Prop :=
| rc_top : rc typ_top
| rc_rcd : forall (D:dec), rc (typ_rcd D)
| rc_and : forall (T U:typ), rc T -> rc U -> rc (typ_and T U).

Lemma rc_not_bot : forall (T:typ), rc T -> T = typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intro E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_sel : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), T = typ_sel a A -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros a A E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_all : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (S U:typ), T = typ_all S U -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros S0 U0 E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_con : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (X:typ),
  T = typ_con Ts is' X -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros Ts is' X E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (X:typ), T = typ_bnd X -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros X E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma record_typ_rc : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label),
  record_typ T ls -> rc T.
Proof.
  intros T ls H. induction H.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - apply rc_and; [assumption|apply rc_rcd].
Qed.

Lemma record_type_rc : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> rc T.
Proof. intros T [ls H]. exact (@record_typ_rc T ls H). Qed.

Lemma rc_subtyp : forall (G:ctx) (T U:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: U -> rc T -> rc U.
Proof.
  intros G T U H. induction H; intros Hrc.
  - apply rc_top.
  - exfalso. eapply rc_not_bot; [exact Hrc|reflexivity].
  - exact Hrc.
  - apply IHsubtyp0. apply IHsubtyp. exact Hrc.
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hrc; subst. assumption.
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hrc; subst. assumption.
  - (* and2 *) apply rc_and; [apply IHsubtyp|apply IHsubtyp0]; exact Hrc.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - inversion Hrc; try discriminate.
  - inversion Hrc; try discriminate.
  - inversion Hrc; try discriminate.
Qed.

(* Field extraction for rc types. *)
Lemma rc_field : forall (G:ctx) (T R:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: R ->
  rc T ->
  forall (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
    R = typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    exists Sf Uf, has_field T a Sf Uf /\ G ⊢ S <: Sf /\ G ⊢ Uf <: U.
Proof.
  intros G T R Hsub. induction Hsub; intros Hrc a S U Heq.
  - (* top *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* bot *) exfalso. eapply rc_not_bot; eassumption.
  - (* refl *) inversion Heq; subst.
    exists S, U. split; [apply hf_one|split; apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* trans *) subst.
    assert (HrcS : rc S) by (eapply rc_subtyp; eassumption).
    eapply IHHsub2; [exact HrcS|reflexivity].
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hrc; subst.
    eapply IHsubtyp; [exact H1|reflexivity].
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hrc; subst.
    eapply IHsubtyp; [exact H2|reflexivity].
  - (* and2 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* fld *) inversion Heq; subst.
    exists T2, U1. split.
    + apply hf_one.
    + split; assumption.
  - (* typ *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* sel2 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* sel1 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* all *) discriminate Heq.
Qed.

Lemma defs_update_not_none : forall (hds hds':heap_defs)
  (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  (forall d1 d2, List.In d1 hds' -> List.In d2 hds' ->
    label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2) ->
  ~ List.In (heap_def_trm a None) hds'.
Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y Hup Huniq Hnone.
  assert (Hsome : List.In (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) hds')
    by (eapply defs_update_some_in; exact Hup).
  pose proof (Huniq _ _ Hsome Hnone eq_refl) as Heq.
  inversion Heq.
Qed.

Lemma ty_heap_defs_label_unique : forall (G:ctx) (hds:heap_defs) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ hds ∶ T ->
  forall d1 d2, List.In d1 hds -> List.In d2 hds ->
    label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2.
Proof.
  intros G hds T H. change (ty_defs G hds T) in H. induction H.
  - intros d1 d2 I1 I2 Heq. simpl in I1, I2.
    destruct I1 as [->|I1]; [|inversion I1].
    destruct I2 as [->|I2]; [reflexivity|inversion I2].
  - intros d1 d2 I1 I2 Heq. simpl in I1, I2.
    destruct I1 as [->|I1]; destruct I2 as [->|I2].
    + reflexivity.
    + match goal with
      | Hnot : labels_hasnt ?ds (label_of ?d), I2 : List.In d2 ?ds |- _ =>
        exfalso;
        eapply (@labels_hasnt_sound heap_def HeapDefLabelOf ds (label_of d) Hnot d2 I2);
        rewrite <- Heq; reflexivity
      end.
    + match goal with
      | Hnot : labels_hasnt ?ds (label_of ?d), I1 : List.In d1 ?ds |- _ =>
        exfalso;
        eapply (@labels_hasnt_sound heap_def HeapDefLabelOf ds (label_of d) Hnot d1 I1);
        rewrite Heq; reflexivity
      end.
    + match goal with
      | IH : forall d1 d2, List.In d1 ?ds -> List.In d2 ?ds ->
               label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2 |- _ =>
        eapply IH; eassumption
      end.
Qed.

    + intro H. apply List.in_cons. apply IH. exact H.
    + destruct o.

Qed.

(** * Free sub heaps *)

Lemma free_sub_heaps_well_committed : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (Es:list eff_ctx),
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es -> well_committed_heap G D Sigma.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma Es H. induction H.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heaps_cons_inv : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (E:eff_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx),
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma (E :: Es) ->
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D /\ free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma E Es H. inversion H; subst.
  split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heap_item : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (D:init_ctx) (x:var) (effs:effects),
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D ->
  binds x effs E ->
  exists itm, binds x itm Sigma /\ free_heap_item D E x itm.
Proof.
  intros E Sigma D x effs Hf Hb. unfold free_sub_heap in Hf.
  destruct (Hf x effs Hb) as [_ [itm [Hbind Hitem]]].
  exists itm. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma free_heap_item_obj_inv : forall (D:init_ctx) (E:eff_ctx) (y:var) (T:typ) (hds:heap_defs),
  free_heap_item D E y (item_obj T hds) -> free_heap_defs D E y hds.
Proof. intros D E y T hds H. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

(** * Committed heaps *)

Lemma well_committed_heap_item : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (itm:item),

  end.

| free_sub_heaps_nil : forall Gamma Delta Sigma,

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Effects HeapEffects.

Require Import HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed.

Definition free_heap_defs (Delta : init_ctx) (ℰ : eff_ctx)
           (y : var) (hds : heap_defs) :=

  binds y free Delta /\

  binds y (heap_defs_effs y hds)  ℰ /\

  forall x, (x \in heap_defs_points_to hds) ->
       well_pointed Delta ℰ x.

Inductive free_heap_item : init_ctx -> eff_ctx -> var -> item -> Prop :=

| free_heap_obj : forall Delta ℰ y T hds,
    free_heap_defs Delta ℰ y hds ->
    free_heap_item Delta ℰ y (item_obj T hds).

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Updating any effect context that contains the assigned variable      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition ctx_upd (x:var) (e':effects) (E:eff_ctx) : eff_ctx :=
  if classic (x \in dom E) then E & x ~ e' else E.

Lemma ctx_upd_in : forall (x:var) (e':effects) (E:eff_ctx),
  x \in dom E -> ctx_upd x e' E = E & x ~ e'.
Proof.
  intros x e' E H. unfold ctx_upd.
  destruct (classic (x \in dom E)) as [Hx|Hx]; [reflexivity|contradiction].
Qed.

Lemma ctx_upd_notin : forall (x:var) (e':effects) (E:eff_ctx),
  x \notin dom E -> ctx_upd x e' E = E.
Proof.
  intros x e' E H. unfold ctx_upd.
  destruct (classic (x \in dom E)) as [Hx|Hx]; [contradiction|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma dom_ctx_upd : forall (x:var) (e':effects) (E:eff_ctx),
  dom (ctx_upd x e' E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros x e' E. unfold ctx_upd.
  destruct (classic (x \in dom E)) as [Hx|Hx].
  - apply dom_push_in. exact Hx.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma list_dom_union_map_ctx_upd : forall (Es:list eff_ctx) (x:var) (e':effects),
  list_dom_union (List.map (ctx_upd x e') Es) = list_dom_union Es.
Proof.
  induction Es as [|E Es IH]; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  rewrite IH, dom_ctx_upd. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heap_fresh : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (D:init_ctx),
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D ->
  forall (z:var) (effsz:effects), binds z effsz E ->
  forall p, p \in from_list effsz -> fst p = z.
Proof.
  intros E Sigma D H z effsz Hb p Hp.
  unfold free_sub_heap in H.
  destruct (H z effsz Hb) as [Hf _].
  destruct p as [y a]. simpl. apply (Hf y a Hp).
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heaps_in_free : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap)
  (Es:list eff_ctx) (E:eff_ctx),
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es -> List.In E Es ->
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma Es E H. induction H; intros Hin.
  - inversion Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [->|Hin]; [exact H0|eapply IHfree_sub_heaps; exact Hin].
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heap_bound_effs : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Sigma:heap)
  (D:init_ctx) (x:var) (T:typ) (hds:heap_defs),
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D ->
  binds x (item_obj T hds) Sigma ->
  x \in dom E ->
  binds x (heap_defs_effs x hds) E.
Proof.
  intros E Sigma D x T hds Hfree HbS HxE.
  destruct (dom_binds_exists HxE) as [effs Hb].
  destruct (Hfree x effs Hb) as [_ [itm [HbItm Hitem]]].
  assert (Heq : itm = item_obj T hds)
    by (eapply LibEnv.binds_functional; eassumption).
  subst itm. inversion Hitem; subst.
  match goal with
  | Hfd : free_heap_defs _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
      unfold free_heap_defs in Hfd; destruct Hfd as [_ [Hbe _]]; exact Hbe
  end.
Qed.

Lemma free_sub_heaps_update_ctx : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx)
  (Sigma:heap) (Es:list eff_ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var)
  (T:typ) (hds hds':heap_defs) (S1 S2:heap) (e':effects),
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es ->
  (binds x committed D -> binds y committed D) ->
  Sigma = S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2 ->
  x # S2 ->
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  e' = heap_defs_effs x hds' ->
  (forall E, List.In E Es -> x \in dom E ->
     well_pointed D (ctx_upd x e' E) y) ->
  free_sub_heaps G D (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds' & S2)
    (List.map (ctx_upd x e') Es).
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma Es. induction Es as [|E Es IH];
    intros x a y T hds hds' S1 S2 e' Hfs Hcond Heq Hfresh Hdu He' Hwp.
  - inversion Hfs; subst. simpl. eapply free_sub_heaps_nil.
    eapply (@well_committed_heap_update G D
              (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2) x a y T hds hds' S1 S2).
    all: try eassumption; try reflexivity.
  - inversion Hfs as [|G0 D0 S0 E1 Es1 Hall Hfree Htail]; subst.
    simpl. eapply free_sub_heaps_cons.
    + rewrite dom_ctx_upd, list_dom_union_map_ctx_upd. exact Hall.
    + destruct (classic (x \in dom E)) as [HxE|HxE].
      * rewrite ctx_upd_in by exact HxE.
        eapply free_sub_heap_update_x.
        -- exact Hfree.
        -- eapply LibEnv.binds_middle_eq. exact Hfresh.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- exact Hfresh.
        -- exact Hdu.
        -- exact HxE.
        -- exact (Hwp E (List.in_eq _ _) HxE).
      * rewrite ctx_upd_notin by exact HxE.
        eapply free_sub_heap_update_notin.
        -- exact Hfree.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- exact Hfresh.
        -- exact Hdu.
        -- exact HxE.
    + eapply IH.
      * exact Htail.
      * exact Hcond.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact Hfresh.
      * exact Hdu.
      * exact He'.
      * intros E' Hin Hx. eapply Hwp; [apply List.in_cons; exact Hin|exact Hx].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Effect-context correspondence is preserved by an update             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma eff_ctx_corr_one_update_sub : forall (E:eff_ctx) (effs:effects)
  (x:var) (e e':effects),
  eff_ctx_corr_one E effs ->
  binds x e E ->
  (forall p, p \in from_list e' -> p \in from_list e) ->
  eff_ctx_corr_one (ctx_upd x e' E) effs.
Proof.
  intros E effs x e e' Hcorr Hb Hsub.
  assert (HxE : x \in dom E) by (eapply binds_in_dom; exact Hb).
  rewrite ctx_upd_in by exact HxE.
  unfold eff_ctx_corr_one in *.
  intros z effsz Hz p Hp.
  destruct (LibEnv.binds_push_inv Hz) as [[Heqz Heqe]|[Hne Hzb]].
  - subst z effsz. apply (Hcorr x e Hb p). apply Hsub. exact Hp.
  - apply (Hcorr z effsz Hzb p Hp).
Qed.

Lemma eff_ctx_corr_map_ctx_upd : forall (Es:list eff_ctx) (effss:list effects)
  (x:var) (e e':effects),
  eff_ctx_corr Es effss ->
  (forall E, List.In E Es -> x \in dom E -> binds x e E) ->
  (forall p, p \in from_list e' -> p \in from_list e) ->
  eff_ctx_corr (List.map (ctx_upd x e') Es) effss.
Proof.
  intros Es effss x e e' H. induction H; intros Hb Hsub.
  - simpl. apply eff_ctx_corr_nil.
  - simpl. eapply eff_ctx_corr_cons.
    + eapply IHeff_ctx_corr.
      * intros E0 Hin Hx. apply Hb. apply List.in_cons. exact Hin. exact Hx.
      * exact Hsub.
    + destruct (classic (x \in dom ℰ)) as [Hx|Hx].
      * rewrite ctx_upd_in by exact Hx.
        eapply eff_ctx_corr_one_update_sub;
          [exact H0| apply Hb; [apply List.in_eq|exact Hx] |exact Hsub].
      * rewrite ctx_upd_notin by exact Hx. exact H0.
Qed.

Lemma envs_dom_eq_map_ctx_upd : forall (Es:list eff_ctx) (x:var) (e:effects),
  envs_dom_eq Es (List.map (ctx_upd x e) Es).
Proof.
  intros Es x e. split.
  - rewrite List.length_map. reflexivity.
  - intros n E E' Hn Hm.
    rewrite nth_error_map in Hm.
    destruct (nth_error Es n) as [E0|] eqn:Heq; [|simpl in Hm; discriminate Hm].
    simpl in Hm. injection Hm as HE'. subst E'.
    rewrite Heq in Hn. injection Hn as HE. subst E.
    apply dom_ctx_upd.
Qed.

(* A def at label [a] gives a balanced record component for [a]. *)
Lemma heap_defs_record_has_of_update : forall (G:ctx)
  (hds hds':heap_defs) (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  G ⊢ hds ∶ T ->
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  exists Tf, record_has T (dec_trm a Tf Tf).
Proof.
  intros G hds hds' T a y Hhds Hdu.
  destruct (@defs_update_label_in hds hds' a y Hdu) as [d [Hin Hlab]].
  destruct (@ty_heap_defs_correspond G hds T Hhds) as (ls & Hrt & Hfwd & Hbwd).
  destruct (Hfwd d Hin) as [D [Hrh Hdty]].
  inversion Hdty; subst.
  - simpl in Hlab. discriminate Hlab.
  - exists T0. exact Hrh.
  - exists T0. exact Hrh.
Qed.

Lemma in_list_dom_union : forall (A:Type) (Es:list (env A)) (x:var),
  x \in list_dom_union Es <-> exists E, List.In E Es /\ x \in dom E.
Proof.
  intros A Es. induction Es as [|E Es IH]; intros x.
  - cbn. split.
    + intros H. exfalso. exact (in_empty_inv H).
    + intros [E' [Hin _]]. inversion Hin.
  - cbn. rewrite in_union. split.
    + intros [H|H].
      * exists E. split; [apply List.in_eq|exact H].
      * destruct (proj1 (IH x) H) as [E' [Hin Hdom]].
        exists E'. split; [apply List.in_cons; exact Hin|exact Hdom].
    + intros [E' [Hin Hdom]]. destruct Hin as [->|Hin].
      * left. exact Hdom.
      * right. apply (proj2 (IH x)). exists E'. split; assumption.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax.

Reserved Notation "G '⊢!' x '∶' T '⪼' U" (at level 40, x at level 59).

Inductive precise_flow : var -> ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=

  | pf_bind : forall x G T,
      binds x T G ->
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ T

  | pf_open : forall x G T U,
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ typ_bnd U ->
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ open x U

  | pf_and1 : forall x G T U1 U2,
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ typ_and U1 U2 ->
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ U1

  | pf_and2 : forall x G T U1 U2,
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ typ_and U1 U2 ->
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ U2

where "G '⊢!' x '∶' T '⪼' U" := (precise_flow x G T U).

Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.

Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* A record component reachable by field selection. *)
Inductive has_field : typ -> trm_label -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| hf_one : forall (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
    has_field (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U)) a S U
| hf_andl : forall (T U:typ) (a:trm_label) (S Uf:typ),
    has_field T a S Uf -> has_field (typ_and T U) a S Uf
| hf_andr : forall (T U:typ) (a:trm_label) (S Uf:typ),
    has_field U a S Uf -> has_field (typ_and T U) a S Uf.

Lemma has_field_record_has : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
  has_field T a S U -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U).
Proof.
  intros T a S U H. induction H.
  - apply rh_one.
  - apply rh_andl. assumption.
  - apply rh_andr. assumption.
Qed.

(* Types built from top and records by intersection. *)
Inductive rc : typ -> Prop :=
| rc_top : rc typ_top
| rc_rcd : forall (D:dec), rc (typ_rcd D)
| rc_and : forall (T U:typ), rc T -> rc U -> rc (typ_and T U).

Lemma rc_not_bot : forall (T:typ), rc T -> T = typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intro E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_sel : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), T = typ_sel a A -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros a A E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_all : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (S U:typ), T = typ_all S U -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros S0 U0 E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_con : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (X:typ),
  T = typ_con Ts is' X -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros Ts is' X E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (X:typ), T = typ_bnd X -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros X E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma record_typ_rc : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label),
  record_typ T ls -> rc T.
Proof.
  intros T ls H. induction H.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - apply rc_and; [assumption|apply rc_rcd].
Qed.

Lemma record_type_rc : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> rc T.
Proof. intros T [ls H]. exact (@record_typ_rc T ls H). Qed.

Lemma rc_subtyp : forall (G:ctx) (T U:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: U -> rc T -> rc U.
Proof.
  intros G T U H. induction H; intros Hrc.
  - apply rc_top.
  - exfalso. eapply rc_not_bot; [exact Hrc|reflexivity].
  - exact Hrc.
  - apply IHsubtyp0. apply IHsubtyp. exact Hrc.
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hrc; subst. assumption.
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hrc; subst. assumption.
  - (* and2 *) apply rc_and; [apply IHsubtyp|apply IHsubtyp0]; exact Hrc.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - inversion Hrc; try discriminate.
  - inversion Hrc; try discriminate.
  - inversion Hrc; try discriminate.
Qed.

(* Field extraction for rc types. *)
Lemma rc_field : forall (G:ctx) (T R:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: R ->
  rc T ->
  forall (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
    R = typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    exists Sf Uf, has_field T a Sf Uf /\ G ⊢ S <: Sf /\ G ⊢ Uf <: U.
Proof.
  intros G T R Hsub. induction Hsub; intros Hrc a S U Heq.
  - (* top *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* bot *) exfalso. eapply rc_not_bot; eassumption.
  - (* refl *) inversion Heq; subst.
    exists S, U. split; [apply hf_one|split; apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* trans *) subst.
    assert (HrcS : rc S) by (eapply rc_subtyp; eassumption).
    eapply IHHsub2; [exact HrcS|reflexivity].
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hrc; subst.
    eapply IHsubtyp; [exact H1|reflexivity].
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hrc; subst.
    eapply IHsubtyp; [exact H2|reflexivity].
  - (* and2 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* fld *) inversion Heq; subst.
    exists T2, U1. split.
    + apply hf_one.
    + split; assumption.
  - (* typ *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* sel2 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* sel1 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* all *) discriminate Heq.
Qed.

Require Import AsnHelpers.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* Preservation for assignment.                                           *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* Two restricted field-subtyping hypotheses are used.  The unrestricted   *)
(* version of [Hfield] is false (see FieldSub.v); the [record_type]        *)
(* premise is needed.  [Hfield_in] is the contravariant counterpart,       *)
(* needed to retype the assigned variable at the field type read off the  *)
(* heap.  [Hroot] is the canonical-forms/root-subtyping fact for inert     *)
(* contexts.                                                              *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Section Params.

Hypothesis Hfield : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ Tf <: U.

Hypothesis Hfield_in : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ S <: Tf.

Hypothesis Hroot : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),
  inert G ->
  binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->
  G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.

Lemma ty_config_red_asn : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx)
  (effss:list effects) (Fs:stack) (Sigma Sigma':heap) (U:typ)
  (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  ty_config G D Es effss (trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ; Fs ; Sigma) U ->
  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
  exists G' D' Es' effss',
    ty_config (G & G') D' Es' effss' (trm_var (avar_f y) ; Fs ; Sigma') U.
Proof.
  intros G D Es effss Fs Sigma Sigma' U x a y Hcfg Hup.
  destruct Hup as (T & hds & hds' & S1 & S2 & HeqS & Hfresh & Hdu & HeqS').
  subst Sigma Sigma'.
  destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D Es effss
              (trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)) Fs
              (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2) U Hcfg) as
    (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effsS & effsT & effss0 &
     HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr).
  subst Es effss.
  (* Assignment inversion. *)
  destruct (@ty_asn_inv G x a y Ts Hty) as (Sa & T0 & HxTy & HyTy & HT0sub).
  (* The heap object bound at [x]. *)
  assert (HbS : binds x (item_obj T hds)
                  (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2)).
  { eapply LibEnv.binds_middle_eq. exact Hfresh. }
  destruct (@heap_correspond_obj G (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2) x T hds
              Hhc HbS) as [HxG Hhds].
  (* Record subtyping at [x]. *)
  assert (Hsubrec : G ⊢ open x T <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a Sa T0)).
  { eapply Hroot; [exact Hinert|exact HxG|exact HxTy]. }
  (* A balanced component at label [a] exists in the old heap. *)
  destruct (@heap_defs_record_has_of_update G hds hds' (open x T) a y
              Hhds Hdu) as [Tf Hrh].
  assert (Hrec : record_type (open x T)).
  { eapply ty_heap_defs_record_type. exact Hhds. }
  assert (HSaTf : G ⊢ Sa <: Tf).
  { eapply Hfield_in; [exact Hrec|exact Hrh|exact Hsubrec]. }
  assert (HTfT0 : G ⊢ Tf <: T0).
  { eapply Hfield; [exact Hrec|exact Hrh|exact Hsubrec]. }
  assert (HSaTs : G ⊢ Sa <: Ts).
  { eapply subtyp_trans; [exact HSaTf|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; [exact HTfT0|exact HT0sub]. }
  assert (HyTf : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ Tf).
  { eapply ty_sub; [exact HyTy|exact HSaTf]. }
  assert (HyTs : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ Ts).
  { eapply ty_sub; [exact HyTy|exact HSaTs]. }
  (* Retype the heap and keep heap correspondence. *)
  assert (Hhds' : G ⊢ hds' ∶ open x T).
  { eapply (@ty_heap_defs_update G hds (open x T) Hhds a y hds' Hdu Tf Hrh HyTf). }
  assert (Hhc' : heap_correspond G (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds' & S2)).
  { eapply (@heap_correspond_update G S1 S2 x T hds hds' a y
              Hfresh Hhc Hdu Hhds'). }
  assert (Huniq : forall d1 d2, List.In d1 hds' -> List.In d2 hds' ->
                    label_of d1 = label_of d2 -> d1 = d2).
  { eapply (@ty_heap_defs_label_unique G hds' (open x T) Hhds'). }
  (* The head effect context and its tail. *)
  destruct (@free_sub_heaps_cons_inv G D (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2)
              ℰ ℰs Hfs) as [HfreeHead Htail].
  destruct (@free_sub_heaps_all_notin G D (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2)
              ℰ ℰs Hfs) as Hall.
  (* Status of the assigned variable [y]. *)
  destruct (@init_typing_asn_status G D (dom ℰ) x y a ii Hinit)
    as [[Hii Hycomm]|[Hii Hyvs]].
  - (* [y] is committed. *)
    subst ii.
    assert (Hcond : binds x committed D -> binds y committed D)
      by (intros _; exact Hycomm).
    assert (Hwp : forall E, List.In E (ℰ :: ℰs) -> x \in dom E ->
                     well_pointed D (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds') E) y).
    { intros E Hin HxE. left. exact Hycomm. }
    assert (HinitY : G ⸴ D ⸴ dom (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds') ℰ)
                       ⊢i trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ committed).
    { eapply init_commit. eapply commit_var. exact Hycomm. }
    (* Free subheaps. *)
    assert (HfsNew : free_sub_heaps G D (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds' & S2)
                       (List.map (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds'))
                                 (ℰ :: ℰs))).
    { eapply (@free_sub_heaps_update_ctx G D
                (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2) (ℰ :: ℰs) x a y T hds hds'
                S1 S2 (heap_defs_effs x hds'));
        [exact Hfs|exact Hcond|reflexivity|exact Hfresh|exact Hdu|
         reflexivity|exact Hwp]. }
    (* Stack typing only depends on domains. *)
    assert (HstackNew : ty_stack G D
              (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds') ℰ ::
                 List.map (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds')) ℰs)
              Fs Ts committed (effsS :: effss0) U).
    { eapply ty_stack_dom_eq.
      - apply envs_dom_eq_map_ctx_upd.
      - exact Hstack. }
    (* Effect-context correspondence. *)
    destruct (@eff_ctx_corr_inv ℰ ℰs ((effsT ++ effsS)%list) effss0 Hcorr)
      as [HcorrTail HcorrHead].
    assert (HcorrTail' : eff_ctx_corr
              (List.map (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds')) ℰs) effss0).
    { eapply eff_ctx_corr_map_ctx_upd.
      - exact HcorrTail.
      - intros E Hin HxE. eapply free_sub_heap_bound_effs.
        + eapply free_sub_heaps_in_free; [exact Htail|exact Hin].
        + exact HbS.
        + exact HxE.
      - intros p Hp. rewrite in_from_list in Hp |- *.
        eapply heap_defs_effs_update_in; [exact Hdu|exact Hp]. }
    assert (HcorrHead' : eff_ctx_corr_one
              (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds') ℰ) effsS).
    { destruct (@eff_trm_asn_inv x y a effsT Heff) as [Hnil|Hcons].
      - subst effsT. simpl in HcorrHead.
        destruct (excluded_middle_informative (x \in dom ℰ)) as [HxE|HxE].
        + eapply eff_ctx_corr_one_ctx_upd_at with (e:=heap_defs_effs x hds).
          * exact HxE.
          * exact HcorrHead.
          * eapply free_sub_heap_fresh. exact HfreeHead.
          * intros p Hin. inversion Hin.
          * intros p Hp Hin. inversion Hin.
          * intros p Hp. rewrite in_from_list in Hp |- *.
            eapply heap_defs_effs_update_in; [exact Hdu|exact Hp].
          * eapply free_sub_heap_bound_effs;
              [exact HfreeHead|exact HbS|exact HxE].
        + eapply eff_ctx_corr_one_ctx_upd_notin;
            [exact HxE|exact HcorrHead].
      - subst effsT. simpl in HcorrHead.
        destruct (excluded_middle_informative (x \in dom ℰ)) as [HxE|HxE].
        + eapply eff_ctx_corr_one_ctx_upd_at with (e:=heap_defs_effs x hds).
          * exact HxE.
          * exact HcorrHead.
          * eapply free_sub_heap_fresh. exact HfreeHead.
          * intros p Hin. rewrite in_from_list in Hin. simpl in Hin.
            destruct p as [z l]. simpl in *. destruct Hin as [Heq|[]].
            injection Heq as -> ->. reflexivity.
          * intros p Hp Hin.
            rewrite in_from_list in Hp. rewrite in_from_list in Hin.
            simpl in Hin. destruct p as [z l]. simpl in *.
            destruct Hin as [Heq|[]]. injection Heq as Hx Ha. subst z l.
            exact (@defs_update_not_none hds hds' a y Hdu Huniq
                     (@heap_defs_effs_in_inv x a hds' Hp)).
          * intros p Hp. rewrite in_from_list in Hp |- *.
            eapply heap_defs_effs_update_in; [exact Hdu|exact Hp].
          * eapply free_sub_heap_bound_effs;
              [exact HfreeHead|exact HbS|exact HxE].
        + eapply eff_ctx_corr_one_ctx_upd_notin; [exact HxE|].
          eapply eff_ctx_corr_one_suffix;
            [exact HcorrHead|exact HfreeHead|].
          intros ee Hin. simpl in Hin.
          destruct Hin as [Heq|[]]. injection Heq as -> ->. simpl.
          exact HxE. }
    assert (HcorrNew : eff_ctx_corr
              (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds') ℰ ::
                 List.map (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds')) ℰs)
              (effsS :: effss0)).
    { eapply eff_ctx_corr_cons.
      - exact HcorrTail'.
      - exact HcorrHead'. }
    (* Build the reduced configuration. *)
    exists (empty:ctx), D,
      (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds') ℰ ::
         List.map (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds')) ℰs),
      (effsS :: effss0).
    rewrite concat_empty_r.
    eapply ty_config_c.
    + exact Hinert.
    + exact Hinits.
    + exact Hhc'.
    + exact HfsNew.
    + exact HstackNew.
    + exact HyTs.
    + apply eff_ignore.
    + exact HinitY.
    + exact HcorrNew.
  - (* [y] is free, hence [x] is free and belongs to the head. *)
    subst ii.
    assert (HxE : x \in dom ℰ).
    { change (well_init G D (dom ℰ)
                (trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)) free) in Hinit.
      inversion Hinit; subst.
      match goal with
      | Hxf : G ⸴ D ⸴ dom ℰ ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ free |- _ =>
          eapply init_typing_var_free_mem; exact Hxf
      end. }
    assert (Hxfree : binds x free D).
    { eapply free_sub_heap_binds_free; [exact HfreeHead|exact HxE]. }
    assert (Hyfree : binds y free D).
    { eapply free_sub_heap_binds_free; [exact HfreeHead|exact Hyvs]. }
    assert (Hcond : binds x committed D -> binds y committed D).
    { intro Hxc. exfalso.
      pose proof (@LibEnv.binds_functional init_typ x free committed D
                    Hxfree Hxc) as Hcontra.
      discriminate Hcontra. }
    assert (Hwp : forall E, List.In E (ℰ :: ℰs) -> x \in dom E ->
                     well_pointed D (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds') E) y).
    { intros E Hin HxE0.
      destruct Hin as [->|Hin].
      - right. split.
        + rewrite dom_ctx_upd. exact Hyvs.
        + exact Hyfree.
      - exfalso.
        assert (HxU : x \in list_dom_union ℰs).
        { rewrite in_list_dom_union. exists E. split; [exact Hin|exact HxE0]. }
        exact (Hall x HxE HxU). }
    assert (HinitY : G ⸴ D ⸴ dom (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds') ℰ)
                       ⊢i trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ free).
    { eapply init_var_binds. eapply init_var_free.
      - rewrite dom_ctx_upd. exact Hyvs.
      - exact Hyfree. }
    assert (HfsNew : free_sub_heaps G D (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds' & S2)
                       (List.map (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds'))
                                 (ℰ :: ℰs))).
    { eapply (@free_sub_heaps_update_ctx G D
                (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2) (ℰ :: ℰs) x a y T hds hds'
                S1 S2 (heap_defs_effs x hds'));
        [exact Hfs|exact Hcond|reflexivity|exact Hfresh|exact Hdu|
         reflexivity|exact Hwp]. }
    assert (HstackNew : ty_stack G D
              (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds') ℰ ::
                 List.map (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds')) ℰs)
              Fs Ts free (effsS :: effss0) U).
    { eapply ty_stack_dom_eq.
      - apply envs_dom_eq_map_ctx_upd.
      - exact Hstack. }
    destruct (@eff_ctx_corr_inv ℰ ℰs ((effsT ++ effsS)%list) effss0 Hcorr)
      as [HcorrTail HcorrHead].
    assert (HcorrTail' : eff_ctx_corr
              (List.map (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds')) ℰs) effss0).
    { eapply eff_ctx_corr_map_ctx_upd.
      - exact HcorrTail.
      - intros E Hin HxE0. eapply free_sub_heap_bound_effs.
        + eapply free_sub_heaps_in_free; [exact Htail|exact Hin].
        + exact HbS.
        + exact HxE0.
      - intros p Hp. rewrite in_from_list in Hp |- *.
        eapply heap_defs_effs_update_in; [exact Hdu|exact Hp]. }
    assert (HcorrHead' : eff_ctx_corr_one
              (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds') ℰ) effsS).
    { destruct (@eff_trm_asn_inv x y a effsT Heff) as [Hnil|Hcons].
      - subst effsT. simpl in HcorrHead.
        eapply eff_ctx_corr_one_ctx_upd_at with (e:=heap_defs_effs x hds).
        + exact HxE.
        + exact HcorrHead.
        + eapply free_sub_heap_fresh. exact HfreeHead.
        + intros p Hin. inversion Hin.
        + intros p Hp Hin. inversion Hin.
        + intros p Hp. rewrite in_from_list in Hp |- *.
          eapply heap_defs_effs_update_in; [exact Hdu|exact Hp].
        + eapply free_sub_heap_bound_effs;
            [exact HfreeHead|exact HbS|exact HxE].
      - subst effsT. simpl in HcorrHead.
        eapply eff_ctx_corr_one_ctx_upd_at with (e:=heap_defs_effs x hds).
        + exact HxE.
        + exact HcorrHead.
        + eapply free_sub_heap_fresh. exact HfreeHead.
        + intros p Hin. rewrite in_from_list in Hin. simpl in Hin.
          destruct p as [z l]. simpl in *. destruct Hin as [Heq|[]].
          injection Heq as -> ->. reflexivity.
        + intros p Hp Hin.
          rewrite in_from_list in Hp. rewrite in_from_list in Hin.
          simpl in Hin. destruct p as [z l]. simpl in *.
          destruct Hin as [Heq|[]]. injection Heq as Hx Ha. subst z l.
          exact (@defs_update_not_none hds hds' a y Hdu Huniq
                   (@heap_defs_effs_in_inv x a hds' Hp)).
        + intros p Hp. rewrite in_from_list in Hp |- *.
          eapply heap_defs_effs_update_in; [exact Hdu|exact Hp].
        + eapply free_sub_heap_bound_effs;
            [exact HfreeHead|exact HbS|exact HxE]. }
    assert (HcorrNew : eff_ctx_corr
              (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds') ℰ ::
                 List.map (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds')) ℰs)
              (effsS :: effss0)).
    { eapply eff_ctx_corr_cons.
      - exact HcorrTail'.
      - exact HcorrHead'. }
    exists (empty:ctx), D,
      (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds') ℰ ::
         List.map (ctx_upd x (heap_defs_effs x hds')) ℰs),
      (effsS :: effss0).
    rewrite concat_empty_r.
    eapply ty_config_c.
    + exact Hinert.
    + exact Hinits.
    + exact Hhc'.
    + exact HfsNew.
    + exact HstackNew.
    + exact HyTs.
    + apply eff_ignore.
    + exact HinitY.
    + exact HcorrNew.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing.

Implicit Types (Gamma G : ctx) (T U : typ) (x y z : var) (t : trm).

Inductive ty_def : DecTyping def :=

| ty_def_typ : forall G A T,
    G ⊢ def_typ A T ∶d dec_typ A T T

| ty_def_trm : forall G a t T,
    G ⊢ def_trm a ∶d dec_trm a T T.

Existing Instance ty_def.

Inductive ty_trm : Typing trm :=

| ty_var : forall G x T,
    binds x T G ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T

| ty_all_elim : forall G x z S T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_all S T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ S ->
    G ⊢ trm_app (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ∶ open z T

| ty_new : forall G x avs xs Ts is' T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_con Ts is' T ->
    G ⊢ avs :: Ts ->
    vars_of_avars xs avs ->
    G ⊢ trm_new (avar_f x) avs ∶ typ_bnd (open_rec_vars 1 xs T)

| ty_rcd_elim : forall G x a S T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T) ->
    G ⊢ trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ T

| ty_fld_asn : forall G x y a S T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T) ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S ->
    G ⊢ trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ T

| ty_let : forall L G t u T U,
    G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open x u ∶ U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_let T t u ∶ U

| ty_llit : forall L G l u T U,
    G ⊢ l ∶ T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open x u ∶ U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_lit T l u ∶ U

| ty_rec_intro : forall G x T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T

| ty_rec_elim : forall G x T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x T

| ty_and_intro : forall G x T U,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_and T U

| ty_sub : forall G (t : trm) T U,
    G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    G ⊢ T <: U ->
    G ⊢ t ∶ U

with ty_lit : Typing lit :=

| ty_all_intro : forall L G T t U,
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open x t ∶ open x U) ->
    G ⊢ lit_fun T t ∶ typ_all T U

| ty_con_intro : forall L G Ts is' T ds t T',
    (forall x ys,
        length ys = length_s Ts ->
        fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys) ->
        G & (ys ~** (to_list Ts))
        & (x ~ open_vars (cons x ys) T)
            ⊢ (open_vars (cons x ys) ds)
            ∶ (open_vars (cons x ys) T)) ->
    (forall x ys,
        length ys = length_s Ts ->
        fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys) ->
        (G & (ys ~** (to_list Ts)) & (x ~ open_vars (cons x ys) T)
            ⊢ (open_vars (cons x ys) t)
            ∶ (open_vars (cons x ys) T'))) ->
    G ⊢ lit_con Ts is' T ds t ∶ typ_con Ts is' T

with subtyp : Subtyping :=

| subtyp_top: forall G T,
    G ⊢ T <: typ_top

| subtyp_bot: forall G T,
    G ⊢ typ_bot <: T

| subtyp_refl: forall G T,
    G ⊢ T <: T

| subtyp_trans: forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T ->
    G ⊢ T <: U ->
    G ⊢ S <: U

| subtyp_and11: forall G T U,
    G ⊢ typ_and T U <: T

| subtyp_and12: forall G T U,
    G ⊢ typ_and T U <: U

| subtyp_and2: forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T ->
    G ⊢ S <: U ->
    G ⊢ S <: typ_and T U

| subtyp_fld: forall G a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    G ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G ⊢ U1 <: U2 ->
    G ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_trm a T2 U1) <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a T1 U2)

| subtyp_typ: forall G A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    G ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)

| subtyp_sel2: forall G x A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G ⊢ S <: typ_sel (avar_f x) A

| subtyp_sel1: forall G x A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) A <: T

| subtyp_all: forall L G S1 T1 S2 T2,
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       G & x ~ S2 ⊢ open x T1 <: open x T2) ->
    G ⊢ typ_all S1 T1 <: typ_all S2 T2

with ty_avars : Typings (list avar) :=
     | typ_avars_nil : forall G,
         G ⊢ nil :: typs_nil

     | typ_avars_cons : forall G x T avs Ts,
         G ⊢ (trm_var (avar_f x)) ∶ T ->
         G ⊢ avs :: Ts ->
         G ⊢ (cons (avar_f x) avs) :: (typs_cons T Ts).

Existing Instance ty_trm.

Existing Instance ty_avars.

Existing Instance subtyp.

Existing Instance ty_lit | 1.

Scheme ts_ty_trm_mut := Induction for ty_trm Sort Prop
with   ts_subtyp     := Induction for subtyp Sort Prop
with   ts_ty_avars   := Induction for ty_avars Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme ts_mutind from ts_ty_trm_mut, ts_subtyp, ts_ty_avars.

Scheme rules_trm_mut    := Induction for ty_trm Sort Prop
with   rules_lit_mut    := Induction for ty_lit Sort Prop
with   rules_subtyp     := Induction for subtyp Sort Prop
with   rules_avars_mut  := Induction for ty_avars Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme rules_mutind from rules_trm_mut, rules_lit_mut,
rules_subtyp, rules_avars_mut.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Typing.

Implicit Types (ds : defs) (hds : heap_defs).

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ A T T)
| rd_trm : forall a T, record_dec (dec_trm a T T).

Inductive record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->

Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* Supporting machinery: record-shaped (rc) types.                        *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* [rc] is the class of types built from top and record types by          *)
(* intersection.  These are exactly the types that can appear as the      *)
(* body of an inert [typ_bnd] binding.  The key property is that           *)
(* subtyping maps rc types to rc types, which excludes arbitrary          *)
(* selections, bottoms, and bound types from appearing in rc positions.   *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Inductive rc : typ -> Prop :=
| rc_top : rc typ_top
| rc_rcd : forall (D:dec), rc (typ_rcd D)
| rc_and : forall (T U:typ), rc T -> rc U -> rc (typ_and T U).

Lemma rc_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (X:typ), T = typ_bnd X -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros X E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_bot : forall (T:typ), rc T -> T = typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intro E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_sel : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label),
  T = typ_sel a A -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros a A E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma record_typ_rc : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label),
  record_typ T ls -> rc T.
Proof.
  intros T ls H. induction H.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - apply rc_and; [assumption|apply rc_rcd].
Qed.

Lemma record_type_rc : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> rc T.
Proof. intros T [ls H]. exact (@record_typ_rc T ls H). Qed.

Lemma rc_subtyp : forall (G:ctx) (T U:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: U -> rc T -> rc U.
Proof.
  intros G T U H. induction H; intros Hrc.
  - apply rc_top.
  - exfalso. eapply rc_not_bot; [exact Hrc|reflexivity].
  - exact Hrc.
  - apply IHsubtyp0. apply IHsubtyp. exact Hrc.
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hrc; subst. assumption.
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hrc; subst. assumption.
  - (* and2 *) apply rc_and; [apply IHsubtyp|apply IHsubtyp0]; exact Hrc.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - inversion Hrc; try discriminate.
  - inversion Hrc; try discriminate.
  - inversion Hrc; try discriminate.
Qed.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* The equal-bound structure of record types.                             *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* This is the structural fact that ultimately rules out the sel-chain    *)
(* counterexamples: every component of a record type is a [record_dec],   *)
(* i.e. its two bounds are syntactically equal.  Hence a variable bound    *)
(* to [typ_bnd U] with [record_type U] cannot simultaneously acquire two  *)
(* record typings of the same type label whose upper bounds differ        *)
(* (which is exactly what the [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] flow would      *)
(* require in order to manufacture a record supertype of [typ_top]).      *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Lemma record_typ_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros T ls D Hrt. induction Hrt as
    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ]; intros Hrh.
  - (* rt_one *) inversion Hrh; subst. assumption.
  - (* rt_cons: T = typ_and T0 (typ_rcd D0) *) inversion Hrh; subst.
    + (* component in T0 *) eapply IH. eassumption.
    + (* component is the right record *) assumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (D:dec),
  record_type T -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros T D [ls Hrt] Hrh. eapply (@record_typ_has_dec T ls D); eassumption.
Qed.

(* If a record type has a member with label [a], the corresponding dec has
   equal bounds.  Used below in the discussion of the sel-chain. *)
Lemma record_type_has_equal_bounds : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
  record_type T -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U) -> S = U.
Proof.
  intros T a S U Hrt Hrh.
  pose proof (@record_type_has_dec T (dec_trm a S U) Hrt Hrh) as Hdec.
  inversion Hdec; subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* The companion fact suggested as a possible helper is FALSE.            *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* One might hope that under [inert G] and [binds x (typ_bnd U) G] the    *)
(* only bound type ever ascribed to [x] is [U] itself, or at least that   *)
(* [G ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T] forces [T = U].  This fails: enlarging the bounds   *)
(* of a record member (contravariantly in the lower bound) yields a        *)
(* different record body [T] which is still a valid recursive type.       *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* We machine-check the counterexample:                                    *)
(*   U = {A : top..top}          T = {A : bot..top}                       *)
(*   G = empty & x ~ typ_bnd U                                            *)
(* [inert G] holds because [record_type U] holds; [x] is typed both at    *)
(* [typ_bnd U] (by [ty_var]) and at [typ_bnd T] (open [x] at [U], widen   *)
(* the record with [subtyp_typ], and apply [ty_rec_intro]); and [T <> U]. *)
(* This is why the final lemma cannot be obtained from any uniqueness      *)
(* property of the [typ_bnd] target of [x].                               *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Lemma bnd_companion_not_unique : forall (A:typ_label),
  exists (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T:typ),
    inert G /\ binds x (typ_bnd U) G /\ record_type U /\
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T /\ T <> U.
Proof.
  intros A.
  pose (U := typ_rcd (dec_typ A typ_top typ_top)).
  pose (T := typ_rcd (dec_typ A typ_bot typ_top)).
  pose (x : var := 0).
  assert (HrtU : record_type U).
  { subst U. exists \{label_of (dec_typ A typ_top typ_top)\}. apply rt_one.
    - apply rd_typ.
    - reflexivity. }
  assert (Hx : x # (empty:ctx)).
  { subst x. rewrite (@dom_empty typ). apply notin_empty. }
  pose (G := empty & x ~ typ_bnd U).
  assert (Hbnd : binds x (typ_bnd U) G).
  { subst G. apply binds_push_eq. }
  assert (Hinert : inert G).
  { subst G. eapply inert_all.
    - apply inert_empty.
    - apply inert_typ_bnd. exact HrtU.
    - exact Hx. }
  assert (HopenU : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x U).
  { apply ty_rec_elim. apply ty_var. exact Hbnd. }
  assert (Hsub : G ⊢ open x U <: open x T).
  { subst U T. cbn. eapply subtyp_typ.
    - apply subtyp_bot.
    - apply subtyp_refl. }
  assert (HopenT : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x T).
  { eapply ty_sub; [exact HopenU|exact Hsub]. }
  assert (HbndT : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T).
  { eapply ty_rec_intro. exact HopenT. }
  exists G, x, U, T. repeat split; try assumption.
  (* T <> U *)
  subst U T. intro Heq. inversion Heq. subst. discriminate.
Qed.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* Status of the main statement [ty_var_record_sub].                      *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* The statement is TRUE, but the proof is not a short structural         *)
(* inversion.  Below is a precise account of what is needed and why the   *)
(* obvious routes fail.                                                    *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* 1. Why inertness is essential.                                          *)
(*    Without inertness the statement is false.  Take                        *)
(*        G = empty & x ~ typ_bot                                          *)
(*    (or more generally a non-record, non-inert binding).  Then            *)
(*    [x : typ_bot] by [ty_var], and [typ_bot <: typ_rcd D] by             *)
(*    [subtyp_bot], so [x : typ_rcd D] is derivable, while [open x U]      *)
(*    (for [U] not a subtype of [typ_rcd D]) need not be.  Inertness       *)
(*    rules this out because [inert_typ] admits only [typ_all],            *)
(*    [typ_con], and [typ_bnd] of a record type, and only record types of  *)
(*    the latter kind can flow to a record.  (With an inert-but-not-record *)
(*    binding [x ~ typ_and (typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_bnd V) (typ_bnd V)))   *)
(*    (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S (typ_rcd D)))] one also gets a counterexample: *)
(*    the two components, via [and11]/[and12] and [subtyp_sel2]/           *)
(*    [subtyp_sel1], witness [typ_bnd V <: typ_rcd D].  A [record_type]    *)
(*    forbids two members with the same label, which is precisely the      *)
(*    gap closed by inertness.)                                            *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* 2. The typing induction and the "Real" motive.                          *)
(*    Induct on the typing derivation [G ⊢ x ∶ T] and prove, for the       *)
(*    fixed binding [binds x (typ_bnd U) G] with [record_type U],          *)
(*        Real(T) := forall R, rc R -> G ⊢ T <: R -> G ⊢ open x U <: R.   *)
(*    The main conclusion is [Real (typ_rcd D)] at R = typ_rcd D via       *)
(*    [subtyp_refl] (and [rc_rcd]).  The [ty_sub] case is handled by       *)
(*    transitivity of subtyping: from [T0 <: T] and [T <: R] get           *)
(*    [T0 <: R] and apply the induction hypothesis [Real(T0)].             *)
(*    The [ty_and_intro] case needs a decomposition: from                  *)
(*    [typ_and T1 T2 <: R] with [rc R], derive [T1 <: R] or [T2 <: R] and  *)
(*    apply the IH; this is the "and-target split".  The variable base     *)
(*    cases need the bnd/rc separation described next.                    *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* 3. The remaining obstruction: bnd/rc separation.                        *)
(*    For the [ty_var] and [ty_rec_intro] cases one has to show, for all   *)
(*    [W] and all [rc R], that [G ⊢ typ_bnd W <: R] yields                 *)
(*    [G ⊢ open x W <: R].  This is true, but it cannot be proved by a     *)
(*    direct induction on the subtyping derivation: the [subtyp_trans]     *)
(*    case passes through an intermediate [S] with no known shape, and    *)
(*    the [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] rules go through record typings of  *)
(*    auxiliary variables [z].  The auxiliary record typing is itself a    *)
(*    subderivation of the subtyping premise and hence of the whole        *)
(*    typing derivation, so a mutual induction over [ty_trm] and           *)
(*    [subtyp] (using [rules_mutind]) is the correct vehicle: the sel      *)
(*    premises are then handled by the typing induction hypothesis, and    *)
(*    the only genuinely circular-looking sel chains are broken by the      *)
(*    equal-bound fact [record_type_has_equal_bounds] above.  The exact    *)
(*    mutual statement must moreover track the [typ_bnd] body / iterated   *)
(*    opening correspondence (a type-directed motive which maps            *)
(*    [typ_bnd W] to [Real (open x W)]), because [ty_rec_elim]'s premise   *)
(*    has type [typ_bnd W] whereas its conclusion is [open x W].           *)
(*                                                                        *)
(*    The plausible shortcut "every typing [x : typ_rcd D] is a supertype *)
(*    of a [precise_flow] tip of the binding" is FALSE in general:         *)
(*    [ty_rec_intro] can produce [x : typ_bnd W] which is not below any    *)
(*    flow tip (flow tips of [typ_bnd U] live inside [open x U] and its    *)
(*    components and cannot be below a [typ_bnd]).  It is only for         *)
(*    *record-like* conclusions that a flow-based argument can work, and   *)
(*    that restriction is exactly what the mutual induction above encodes. *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* 4. Why the statement is nevertheless true.                              *)
(*    A counterexample would require an inert context [G] with            *)
(*    [binds x (typ_bnd U) G], [record_type U], and a derivation of        *)
(*    [G ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd D] with [G ⊢ open x U ≮ typ_rcd D].  Since          *)
(*    [x ∶ typ_rcd D] cannot be obtained by [ty_var] (the binding is a     *)
(*    [typ_bnd]) or by [ty_and_intro] (whose conclusion is an              *)
(*    intersection), the only possible sources are recursive elimination   *)
(*    [ty_rec_elim] and widening [ty_sub].  Recursive elimination can      *)
(*    only open the binding's record structure, and widening to a record   *)
(*    target must respect the equal bounds of the record components        *)
(*    ([record_type_has_dec]).  Any detour through [subtyp_sel2]/          *)
(*    [subtyp_sel1] requires two record typings of one variable at the     *)
(*    same label with incompatible upper bounds; record types cannot       *)
(*    supply this, and inertness guarantees the variable's binding is a    *)
(*    record type.  Detours through [typ_bot] would require an [x]-type    *)
(*    below [typ_bot]; no such type is reachable from a record-typed       *)
(*    binding (every reachable source is [rc], and [rc]-to-[typ_bot] is    *)
(*    impossible by [rc_subtyp]).  Thus no counterexample exists.          *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* In summary: the lemma is provable in principle, but a fully checked     *)
(* proof requires the mutual [rules_mutind] induction of item 3 with the   *)
(* type-directed body/opening invariant; the straightforward inversion     *)
(* and the flow-tip shortcut both fail for exactly the reasons above.      *)
(* No [Admitted]/[Axiom] is used in this file.                             *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

(* A last consistency check: the supporting lemmas above are all proved. *)
Check record_type_has_dec.
Check bnd_companion_not_unique.
