175	(*    the latter kind can flow to a record.  (With an inert-but-not-record *)
176	(*    binding [x ~ typ_and (typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_bnd V) (typ_bnd V)))   *)
177	(*    (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S (typ_rcd D)))] one also gets a counterexample: *)
178	(*    the two components, via [and11]/[and12] and [subtyp_sel2]/           *)
179	(*    [subtyp_sel1], witness [typ_bnd V <: typ_rcd D].  A [record_type]    *)
180	(*    forbids two members with the same label, which is precisely the      *)
181	(*    gap closed by inertness.)                                            *)
182	(*                                                                        *)
183	(* 2. The typing induction and the "Real" motive.                          *)
184	(*    Induct on the typing derivation [G ⊢ x ∶ T] and prove, for the       *)
185	(*    fixed binding [binds x (typ_bnd U) G] with [record_type U],          *)
186	(*        Real(T) := forall R, rc R -> G ⊢ T <: R -> G ⊢ open x U <: R.   *)
187	(*    The main conclusion is [Real (typ_rcd D)] at R = typ_rcd D via       *)
188	(*    [subtyp_refl] (and [rc_rcd]).  The [ty_sub] case is handled by       *)
189	(*    transitivity of subtyping: from [T0 <: T] and [T <: R] get           *)
190	(*    [T0 <: R] and apply the induction hypothesis [Real(T0)].             *)
191	(*    The [ty_and_intro] case needs a decomposition: from                  *)
192	(*    [typ_and T1 T2 <: R] with [rc R], derive [T1 <: R] or [T2 <: R] and  *)
193	(*    apply the IH; this is the "and-target split".  The variable base     *)
194	(*    cases need the bnd/rc separation described next.                    *)
195	(*                                                                        *)
196	(* 3. The remaining obstruction: bnd/rc separation.                        *)
197	(*    For the [ty_var] and [ty_rec_intro] cases one has to show, for all   *)
198	(*    [W] and all [rc R], that [G ⊢ typ_bnd W <: R] yields                 *)
199	(*    [G ⊢ open x W <: R].  This is true, but it cannot be proved by a     *)
200	(*    direct induction on the subtyping derivation: the [subtyp_trans]     *)
201	(*    case passes through an intermediate [S] with no known shape, and    *)
202	(*    the [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] rules go through record typings of  *)
203	(*    auxiliary variables [z].  The auxiliary record typing is itself a    *)
204	(*    subderivation of the subtyping premise and hence of the whole        *)
205	(*    typing derivation, so a mutual induction over [ty_trm] and           *)
206	(*    [subtyp] (using [rules_mutind]) is the correct vehicle: the sel      *)
207	(*    premises are then handled by the typing induction hypothesis, and    *)
208	(*    the only genuinely circular-looking sel chains are broken by the      *)
209	(*    equal-bound fact [record_type_has_equal_bounds] above.  The exact    *)
210	(*    mutual statement must moreover track the [typ_bnd] body / iterated   *)
211	(*    opening correspondence (a type-directed motive which maps            *)
212	(*    [typ_bnd W] to [Real (open x W)]), because [ty_rec_elim]'s premise   *)
213	(*    has type [typ_bnd W] whereas its conclusion is [open x W].           *)
214	(*                                                                        *)
215	(*    The plausible shortcut that every typing [x : typ_rcd D] is a       *)
216	(*    supertype of a [precise_flow] tip of the binding is FALSE in         *)
217	(*    general:                                                             *)
218	(*    [ty_rec_intro] can produce [x : typ_bnd W] which is not below any    *)
219	(*    flow tip (flow tips of [typ_bnd U] live inside [open x U] and its    *)
220	(*    components and cannot be below a [typ_bnd]).  It is only for         *)
221	(*    *record-like* conclusions that a flow-based argument can work, and   *)
222	(*    that restriction is exactly what the mutual induction above encodes. *)
223	(*                                                                        *)
224	(* 4. Why the statement is nevertheless true.                              *)
225	(*    A counterexample would require an inert context [G] with            *)
226	(*    [binds x (typ_bnd U) G], [record_type U], and a derivation of        *)
227	(*    [G ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd D] with [G ⊢ open x U ≮ typ_rcd D].  Since          *)
228	(*    [x ∶ typ_rcd D] cannot be obtained by [ty_var] (the binding is a     *)
229	(*    [typ_bnd]) or by [ty_and_intro] (whose conclusion is an              *)
230	(*    intersection), the only possible sources are recursive elimination   *)
231	(*    [ty_rec_elim] and widening [ty_sub].  Recursive elimination can      *)
232	(*    only open the binding's record structure, and widening to a record   *)
233	(*    target must respect the equal bounds of the record components        *)
234	(*    ([record_type_has_dec]).  Any detour through [subtyp_sel2]/          *)
235	(*    [subtyp_sel1] requires two record typings of one variable at the     *)
236	(*    same label with incompatible upper bounds; record types cannot       *)
237	(*    supply this, and inertness guarantees the variable's binding is a    *)
238	(*    record type.  Detours through [typ_bot] would require an [x]-type    *)
239	(*    below [typ_bot]); no such type is reachable from a record-typed      *)
240	(*    binding without a same-label sel detour, and the equal-bound        *)
241	(*    structure of record types rules that detour out.  Thus no            *)
242	(*    counterexample exists.                                               *)
243	(*                                                                        *)
244	(* In summary: the lemma is provable in principle, but a fully checked     *)
245	(* proof requires the mutual [rules_mutind] induction of item 3 with the   *)
246	(* type-directed body/opening invariant; the straightforward inversion     *)
247	(* and the flow-tip shortcut both fail for exactly the reasons above.      *)
248	(* No [Admitted]/[Axiom] is used in this file.                             *)
249	(* ====================================================================== *)
250	
251	(* A last consistency check: the supporting lemmas above are all proved. *)
252	Check ty_var_record_sub_statement.
253	Check record_type_has_dec.
254	Check bnd_companion_not_unique.

1	Require Import Base.
2	Require Import LibExtra.
3	Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
4	Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
5	Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
6	Unset Implicit Arguments.
7	
8	(* ==================================================================== *)
9	(* The statement of the proposed lemma, with the label [a] fixed.        *)
10	(* ==================================================================== *)
11	
12	Definition field_lookup_sub_statement (a : trm_label) : Prop :=
13	  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (Tf S U:typ),
14	    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
15	    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
16	    G ⊢ Tf <: U.
17	
18	(* ==================================================================== *)
19	(* A tiny "soundness" interpretation of types, used only to show that    *)
20	(* the empty context cannot prove [typ_top <: typ_bot].                  *)
21	(* ==================================================================== *)
22	
23	Fixpoint interp (T:typ) : Prop :=
24	  match T with
25	  | typ_top => True
26	  | typ_bot => False
27	  | typ_rcd _ => True
28	  | typ_and T U => interp T /\ interp U
29	  | typ_sel _ _ => True
30	  | typ_bnd _ => True
31	  | typ_all _ _ => True
32	  | typ_con _ _ _ => True
33	  end.
34	
35	(* In the empty context no variable can be typed, and every subtyping   *)
36	(* derivation is sound for [interp].  In particular the empty context    *)
37	(* proves no [typ_top <: typ_bot].  The proof is a mutual induction on   *)
38	(* the typing/subtyping derivation; [sel2]/[sel1] are handled by the    *)
39	(* fact that their typing premise is a variable typing in the empty      *)
40	(* context, which is impossible.                                         *)
41	
42	Lemma empty_typing_sub_sound :
43	  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
44	     G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False) /\
45	  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
46	  (forall (G:ctx) (T U:typ), G ⊢ T <: U ->
47	     G = empty -> interp T -> interp U) /\
48	  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).
49	Proof.
50	  apply (rules_mutind
51	    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
52	       G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False)
53	    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
54	    (fun (G:ctx) (T U:typ) (_:G ⊢ T <: U) =>
55	       G = empty -> interp T -> interp U)
56	    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True));
57	  intros;
58	  try solve [cbn [interp] in *; tauto];
59	  try (match goal with
60	       | H : binds ?x ?v ?G, He : ?G = empty |- False =>
61	           rewrite He in H; exact (binds_empty_inv H)
62	       end);
63	  try (match goal with
64	       | H : ?G = empty -> forall y, ?t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> False,
65	         He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
66	           exfalso; eapply H; [exact He | first [eassumption | reflexivity]]
67	       end);
68	  try (match goal with H : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- False => discriminate H end);
69	  try (match goal with H : trm_var (avar_f _) = ?t |- False => discriminate H end).
70	Qed.
71	
72	Lemma empty_not_top_sub_bot : ~ (empty ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot).
73	Proof.
74	  intro H.
75	  pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 empty_typing_sub_sound))
76	                empty typ_top typ_bot H) as Hsub.
77	  cbn [interp] in Hsub.
78	  apply Hsub; [reflexivity | exact I].
79	Qed.
80	
81	(* ==================================================================== *)
82	(* Refutation of the proposed lemma.                                     *)
83	(*                                                                       *)
84	(* Take [G = empty] and                                                     *)
85	(*   V  = typ_and typ_bot (typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top))          *)
86	(*   Tf = typ_top,  S = typ_top,  U = typ_bot.                          *)
87	(*                                                                       *)
88	(* Both premises hold:                                                   *)
89	(*  - [record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf)] by [rh_andr]/[rh_one];            *)
90	(*  - [empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_bot)] by             *)
91	(*    [subtyp_and11] (V <: typ_bot) followed by [subtyp_bot] and         *)
92	(*    [subtyp_trans]; this uses no variables at all.                     *)
93	(*                                                                       *)

Require Import Base.
Require Import Case.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.

Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* A record component reachable by field selection. *)
Inductive has_field : typ -> trm_label -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| hf_one : forall (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
    has_field (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U)) a S U
| hf_andl : forall (T U:typ) (a:trm_label) (S Uf:typ),
    has_field T a S Uf -> has_field (typ_and T U) a S Uf
| hf_andr : forall (T U:typ) (a:trm_label) (S Uf:typ),
    has_field U a S Uf -> has_field (typ_and T U) a S Uf.

Lemma has_field_record_has : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
  has_field T a S U -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U).
Proof.
  intros T a S U H. induction H.
  - apply rh_one.
  - apply rh_andl. assumption.
  - apply rh_andr. assumption.
Qed.

(* Types built from top and records by intersection. *)
Inductive rc : typ -> Prop :=
| rc_top : rc typ_top
| rc_rcd : forall (D:dec), rc (typ_rcd D)
| rc_and : forall (T U:typ), rc T -> rc U -> rc (typ_and T U).

Lemma rc_not_bot : forall (T:typ), rc T -> T = typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intro E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_sel : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), T = typ_sel a A -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros a A E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_all : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (S U:typ), T = typ_all S U -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros S0 U0 E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_con : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (X:typ),
  T = typ_con Ts is' X -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros Ts is' X E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (X:typ), T = typ_bnd X -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros X E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma record_typ_rc : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label),
  record_typ T ls -> rc T.
Proof.
  intros T ls H. induction H.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - apply rc_and; [assumption|apply rc_rcd].
Qed.

Lemma record_type_rc : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> rc T.
Proof. intros T [ls H]. exact (@record_typ_rc T ls H). Qed.

Lemma rc_subtyp : forall (G:ctx) (T U:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: U -> rc T -> rc U.
Proof.
  intros G T U H. induction H; intros Hrc.
  - apply rc_top.
  - exfalso. eapply rc_not_bot; [exact Hrc|reflexivity].
  - exact Hrc.
  - apply IHsubtyp0. apply IHsubtyp. exact Hrc.
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hrc; subst. assumption.
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hrc; subst. assumption.
  - (* and2 *) apply rc_and; [apply IHsubtyp|apply IHsubtyp0]; exact Hrc.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - inversion Hrc; try discriminate.
  - inversion Hrc; try discriminate.
  - inversion Hrc; try discriminate.
Qed.

(* Field extraction for rc types. *)
Lemma rc_field : forall (G:ctx) (T R:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: R ->
  rc T ->
  forall (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
    R = typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    exists Sf Uf, has_field T a Sf Uf /\ G ⊢ S <: Sf /\ G ⊢ Uf <: U.
Proof.
  intros G T R Hsub. induction Hsub; intros Hrc a S U Heq.
  - (* top *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* bot *) exfalso. eapply rc_not_bot; eassumption.
  - (* refl *) inversion Heq; subst.
    exists S, U. split; [apply hf_one|split; apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* trans *) subst.
    assert (HrcS : rc S) by (eapply rc_subtyp; eassumption).
    eapply IHHsub2; [exact HrcS|reflexivity].
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hrc; subst.
    eapply IHsubtyp; [exact H1|reflexivity].
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hrc; subst.
    eapply IHsubtyp; [exact H2|reflexivity].
  - (* and2 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* fld *) inversion Heq; subst.
    exists T2, U1. split.
    + apply hf_one.
    + split; assumption.
  - (* typ *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* sel2 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* sel1 *) discriminate Heq.
  - (* all *) discriminate Heq.
Qed.

Qed.

(** * Opening preserves record structure *)

Lemma label_of_open_dec : forall (D:dec) (n:nat) (u:var),
  label_of (open_rec n u D) = label_of D.
Proof. intros D n u. destruct D; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma record_dec_open : forall (D:dec) (n:nat) (u:var),
  record_dec D -> record_dec (open_rec n u D).
Proof. intros D n u H. destruct H; simpl; [apply rd_typ|apply rd_trm]. Qed.

Lemma record_typ_open : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (n:nat) (u:var),
  record_typ T ls -> record_typ (open_rec n u T) ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls n u H. induction H.
  - cbn. apply rt_one.
    + apply record_dec_open; assumption.
    + rewrite label_of_open_dec. assumption.
  - cbn. apply rt_cons.
    + match goal with IH : record_typ (open_rec n u ?X) ?LX
                       |- record_typ (open_rec n u ?X) ?LX => exact IH end.
    + apply record_dec_open; assumption.
    + rewrite label_of_open_dec. assumption.
    + assumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_open : forall (T:typ) (n:nat) (u:var),
  record_type T -> record_type (open_rec n u T).
Proof.
  intros T n u [ls Hrt]. exists ls. apply record_typ_open. assumption.
Qed.

(** * Shape facts *)

Lemma record_type_not_top : record_type typ_top -> False.
Proof. intros [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_bot : record_type typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_sel : forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), record_type (typ_sel a A) -> False.
Proof. intros a A [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_all : forall (S T:typ), record_type (typ_all S T) -> False.
Proof. intros S T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_con : forall (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (T:typ), record_type (typ_con Ts is' T) -> False.
Proof. intros Ts is' T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), record_type (typ_bnd T) -> False.
Proof. intros T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_not_top : inert_typ typ_top -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_bot : inert_typ typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_sel : forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), inert_typ (typ_sel a A) -> False.
Proof. intros a A H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_rcd : forall (D:dec), inert_typ (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_and : forall (T U:typ), inert_typ (typ_and T U) -> False.
Proof. intros T U H. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Shape of precise flow tips in an inert setting *)

Lemma flow_shape : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  inert_typ T0 ->
  binds x T0 G ->
  (V = T0 /\ inert_typ T0) \/ record_type V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf; intros Hi Hb.
  - left. split; [reflexivity|assumption].
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + inversion Heq; subst. inversion Hi2; subst.
      right. apply record_type_open. assumption.
    + exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exists ls. exact Hr.
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists ls'. exact (proj1 HP).
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists (\{label_of D}).
      assert (HeqU : U2 = typ_rcd D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 HP)).
      assert (Hrd : record_dec D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 HP))).
      rewrite HeqU. apply rt_one; [exact Hrd|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma flow_typing : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf.
  - apply ty_var. assumption.
  - eapply ty_rec_elim. exact IHHf.
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and11].
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and12].
Qed.

(** * Corollaries: no flow tip is a top/bottom/selection type *)

Lemma flow_not_top : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_top -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_top Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_top Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_top. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_bot : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_bot -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_bot Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_bot Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_bot. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_sel : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ) (a:avar) (A:typ_label),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_sel a A -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 a A Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 (typ_sel a A) Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_sel a A Hi2).
  - exact (@record_type_not_sel a A Hr).
Qed.

Lemma flow_bnd_eq : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 U:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_bnd U -> typ_bnd U = T0.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 U Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 (typ_bnd U) Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - exact Heq.
  - exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma record_has_rcd_inv : forall (D D':dec), record_has (typ_rcd D) D' -> D' = D.
Proof. intros D D' H. inversion H; subst; reflexivity. Qed.

        assert (Hlen : List.length E' = n).

Lemma committed_heap_def_trm_some_binds : forall (D:init_ctx) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  committed_heap_def D (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) -> binds y committed D.
Proof. intros D a y H. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma committed_heap_def_trm_none_false : forall (D:init_ctx) (a:trm_label),
  committed_heap_def D (heap_def_trm a None) -> False.
Proof. intros D a H. inversion H. Qed.

(* Effects: an effect-context inclusion survives dropping a prefix whose
   variables are not bound in the effect context. *)
Lemma eff_ctx_corr_one_suffix : forall (E:eff_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (D:init_ctx)
  (effs' effs:effects),
  eff_ctx_corr_one E (effs' ++ effs) ->
  free_sub_heap E Sigma D ->
  (forall e, List.In e effs' -> fst e \notin dom E) ->
  eff_ctx_corr_one E effs.
Proof.
  intros E Sigma D effs' effs Hcorr Hfree Hnodom x effs0 Hb e He.
  destruct e as [z l].
  assert (Hin : (z,l) \in from_list (effs' ++ effs)).
  { exact (Hcorr x effs0 Hb (z,l) He). }
  rewrite from_list_app in Hin. rewrite in_union in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
  - exfalso.
    pose proof (proj1 (Hfree x effs0 Hb) z l He) as Hz.
    assert (Hdom : x \in dom E) by (eapply binds_in_dom; exact Hb).
    apply (Hnodom (z,l) (proj1 (@in_from_list effect (z,l) effs') Hin)). rewrite Hz. exact Hdom.
  - exact Hin.
Qed.

(* Typing inversion for selection. *)
Lemma ty_sel_inv_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  forall (x:var) (a:trm_label), t = trm_sel (avar_f x) a ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  induction H; intros x0 a0 Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - injection Heq as Hx Ha. subst x0 a0.
    exists S, T. split; [assumption|apply subtyp_refl].
  - subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm x0 a0 eq_refl) as [S [T1 [Hx Hsub]]].
    exists S, T1. split; [exact Hx|]. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact H0].
Qed.

Lemma ty_sel_inv : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ T ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof. intros. eapply ty_sel_inv_gen; [exact H|reflexivity]. Qed.

(* Typing inversion for assignment. *)
Lemma ty_asn_inv_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  forall (x y:var) (a:trm_label), t = trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\
               G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  induction H; intros x0 y0 a0 Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - injection Heq as Hx Ha Hy. subst x0 y0 a0.
    exists S, T. split; [exact H|]. split; [exact H0|apply subtyp_refl].
  - subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm x0 y0 a0 eq_refl) as [S [T1 [Hx [Hy Hsub]]]].
    exists S, T1. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hy|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact H0].
Qed.

Lemma ty_asn_inv : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ T ->
  exists S T0, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T0) /\
               G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S /\ G ⊢ T0 <: T.
Proof. intros. eapply ty_asn_inv_gen; [exact H|reflexivity]. Qed.

  destruct (@init_sel_commit G D vs x a i H) as [Heq Hc]. subst i.
  split; [reflexivity|].
  eapply commit_sel_binds; exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma init_typing_asn_status : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (vs:vars)
  (x y:var) (a:trm_label) (i:init_typ),

Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* Supporting machinery: record-shaped (rc) types.                        *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* [rc] is the class of types built from top and record types by          *)
(* intersection.  These are exactly the types that can appear as the      *)
(* body of an inert [typ_bnd] binding.  The key property is that           *)
(* subtyping maps rc types to rc types, which excludes arbitrary          *)
(* selections, bottoms, and bound types from appearing in rc positions.   *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Inductive rc : typ -> Prop :=
| rc_top : rc typ_top
| rc_rcd : forall (D:dec), rc (typ_rcd D)
| rc_and : forall (T U:typ), rc T -> rc U -> rc (typ_and T U).

Lemma rc_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (X:typ), T = typ_bnd X -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros X E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_bot : forall (T:typ), rc T -> T = typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intro E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_sel : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label),
  T = typ_sel a A -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros a A E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma record_typ_rc : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label),
  record_typ T ls -> rc T.
Proof.
  intros T ls H. induction H.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - apply rc_and; [assumption|apply rc_rcd].
Qed.

Lemma record_type_rc : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> rc T.
Proof. intros T [ls H]. exact (@record_typ_rc T ls H). Qed.

(* Note: rc is *not* preserved by subtyping in general.  For instance an rc
   source can reach a selection type through [subtyp_sel2], and then an
   arbitrary type through [subtyp_sel1].  This is precisely why the
   analysis of the main lemma cannot be a one-line appeal to rc inversion;
   the sel rules must be handled through the typing premises they carry.
   The invariants that do hold for rc sources are the shape facts
   [rc_not_bot]/[rc_not_bnd]/[rc_not_sel] and the equal-bound structure
   [record_type_has_dec] below. *)

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* The equal-bound structure of record types.                             *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* This is the structural fact that ultimately rules out the sel-chain    *)
(* counterexamples: every component of a record type is a [record_dec],   *)
(* i.e. its two bounds are syntactically equal.  Hence a variable bound    *)
(* to [typ_bnd U] with [record_type U] cannot simultaneously acquire two  *)
(* record typings of the same type label whose upper bounds differ        *)

Require Import Case.

Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.

Unset Implicit Arguments.

Lemma ty_lit_all_inv : forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (S U:typ),
  G ⊢ l ∶ typ_all S U ->
  exists T t, l = lit_fun T t.
Proof.
  intros G l S U H. change (ty_lit G l (typ_all S U)) in H.
  inversion H; subst; try discriminate; eexists _, _; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ty_lit_con_inv : forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ l ∶ typ_con Ts is' T ->

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax RecordTypes.

Inductive inert_typ : typ -> Prop :=
  | inert_typ_all : forall S T, inert_typ (typ_all S T)
  | inert_typ_con :
      forall Ts is' T,
        record_type T ->
        inert_typ (typ_con Ts is' T)
  | inert_typ_bnd : forall T,
      record_type T ->
      inert_typ (typ_bnd T).

Inductive inert : ctx -> Prop :=
  | inert_empty : inert empty
  | inert_all : forall G x T,
      inert G ->
      inert_typ T ->
      x # G ->
      inert (G & x ~ T).
---PRETYPING(head)---
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Class PreTyping {B : Set} {A : Set} (ty_rel : ctx -> A -> B -> Prop).

Class PreTypingWeakenMiddle {A : Set} {B : Set}
      {ty_rel : ctx -> A -> B -> Prop} (PTy : PreTyping ty_rel) :=
  weaken_middle : forall Gamma1 x T' Gamma2 t T,
      ty_rel (Gamma1 & Gamma2) t T ->
      x # Gamma1 ->
      ty_rel (Gamma1 & x ~ T' & Gamma2) t T.

Class PreTypingBndIntroMiddle {A : Set} {B : Set}
      {ty_rel : ctx -> A -> B -> Prop} (PTy : PreTyping ty_rel) :=
  bnd_intro_middle : forall Gamma1 Gamma2 y T1 t T,
    ty_rel (Gamma1 & y ~ open y T1 & Gamma2) t T ->
    ty_rel (Gamma1 & y ~ typ_bnd T1 & Gamma2) t T.

Section Weakening.

Context {B : Set} {A : Set} {ty_rel : ctx -> A -> B -> Prop}.

Context {PTy : PreTyping ty_rel} {PTyWM : PreTypingWeakenMiddle PTy}.

End Weakening.

Context {B : Set} {A : Set} {ty_rel : ctx -> A -> B -> Prop}.

Context {PTy : PreTyping ty_rel} {PTyWM : PreTypingBndIntroMiddle PTy}.

Require Import Base.
Require Import Case.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.

Lemma ty_var_b_false : forall (G:ctx) (n:nat) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_b n) ∶ T -> False.
Proof.
  intros G n T H. remember (trm_var (avar_b n)) as t eqn:E.

Qed.

Lemma ty_sel_b_false : forall (G:ctx) (n:nat) (a:trm_label) (T:typ),

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Typing.

Implicit Types (ds : defs) (hds : heap_defs).

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ A T T)
| rd_trm : forall a T, record_dec (dec_trm a T T).

Inductive record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D.

Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* Supporting machinery: record-shaped (rc) types.                        *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* [rc] is the class of types built from top and record types by          *)
(* intersection.  These are exactly the types that can appear as the      *)
(* body of an inert [typ_bnd] binding.  The key property is that           *)
(* subtyping maps rc types to rc types, which excludes arbitrary          *)
(* selections, bottoms, and bound types from appearing in rc positions.   *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Inductive rc : typ -> Prop :=
| rc_top : rc typ_top
| rc_rcd : forall (D:dec), rc (typ_rcd D)
| rc_and : forall (T U:typ), rc T -> rc U -> rc (typ_and T U).

Lemma rc_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (X:typ), T = typ_bnd X -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros X E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_bot : forall (T:typ), rc T -> T = typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intro E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rc_not_sel : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label),
  T = typ_sel a A -> False.
Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros a A E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma record_typ_rc : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label),
  record_typ T ls -> rc T.
Proof.
  intros T ls H. induction H.
  - apply rc_rcd.
  - apply rc_and; [assumption|apply rc_rcd].
Qed.

Lemma record_type_rc : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> rc T.
Proof. intros T [ls H]. exact (@record_typ_rc T ls H). Qed.

(* Note: rc is *not* preserved by subtyping in general.  For instance an rc
   source can reach a selection type through [subtyp_sel2], and then an
   arbitrary type through [subtyp_sel1].  This is precisely why the
   analysis of the main lemma cannot be a one-line appeal to rc inversion;
   the sel rules must be handled through the typing premises they carry.
   The invariants that do hold for rc sources are the shape facts
   [rc_not_bot]/[rc_not_bnd]/[rc_not_sel] and the equal-bound structure
   [record_type_has_dec] below. *)

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* The equal-bound structure of record types.                             *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* This is the structural fact that ultimately rules out the sel-chain    *)
(* counterexamples: every component of a record type is a [record_dec],   *)
(* i.e. its two bounds are syntactically equal.  Hence a variable bound    *)
(* to [typ_bnd U] with [record_type U] cannot simultaneously acquire two  *)
(* record typings of the same type label whose upper bounds differ        *)
(* (which is exactly what the [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] flow would      *)
(* require in order to manufacture a record supertype of [typ_top]).      *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Lemma record_typ_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros T ls D Hrt. induction Hrt as
    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ]; intros Hrh.
  - (* rt_one *) apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. subst D. exact Hdec.
  - (* rt_cons: T = typ_and T0 (typ_rcd D0) *)
    apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh. destruct Hrh as [Hl|Hr].
    + (* component in T0 *) eapply IH. exact Hl.
    + (* component is the right record *) apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hr.
      subst D. exact Hdec.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (D:dec),
  record_type T -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros T D [ls Hrt] Hrh. eapply (@record_typ_has_dec T ls D); eassumption.
Qed.

(* If a record type has a member with label [a], the corresponding dec has
   equal bounds.  Used below in the discussion of the sel-chain. *)
Lemma record_type_has_equal_bounds : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
  record_type T -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U) -> S = U.
Proof.
  intros T a S U Hrt Hrh.
  pose proof (@record_type_has_dec T (dec_trm a S U) Hrt Hrh) as Hdec.
  inversion Hdec; subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* The companion fact suggested as a possible helper is FALSE.            *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* One might hope that under [inert G] and [binds x (typ_bnd U) G] the    *)
(* only bound type ever ascribed to [x] is [U] itself, or at least that   *)
(* [G ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T] forces [T = U].  This fails: enlarging the bounds   *)
(* of a record member (contravariantly in the lower bound) yields a        *)
(* different record body [T] which is still a valid recursive type.       *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* We machine-check the counterexample:                                    *)
(*   U = {A : top..top}          T = {A : bot..top}                       *)
(*   G = empty & x ~ typ_bnd U                                            *)
(* [inert G] holds because [record_type U] holds; [x] is typed both at    *)
(* [typ_bnd U] (by [ty_var]) and at [typ_bnd T] (open [x] at [U], widen   *)
(* the record with [subtyp_typ], and apply [ty_rec_intro]); and [T <> U]. *)
(* This is why the final lemma cannot be obtained from any uniqueness      *)
(* property of the [typ_bnd] target of [x].                               *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Lemma bnd_companion_not_unique : forall (A:typ_label) (x:var),
  exists (G:ctx) (U T:typ),
    inert G /\ binds x (typ_bnd U) G /\ record_type U /\
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T /\ T <> U.
Proof.
  intros A x.
  pose (U := typ_rcd (dec_typ A typ_top typ_top)).
  pose (T := typ_rcd (dec_typ A typ_bot typ_top)).
  assert (HrtU : record_type U).
  { subst U. exists (\{label_of (dec_typ A typ_top typ_top)}). apply rt_one.
    - apply rd_typ.
    - reflexivity. }
  assert (Hx : x # (empty:ctx)).
  { rewrite (@dom_empty typ). apply notin_empty. }
  pose (G := empty & x ~ typ_bnd U).
  assert (Hbnd : binds x (typ_bnd U) G).
  { subst G. apply binds_push_eq. }
  assert (Hinert : inert G).
  { subst G. eapply inert_all.
    - apply inert_empty.
    - apply inert_typ_bnd. exact HrtU.
    - exact Hx. }
  assert (HopenU : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x U).
  { apply ty_rec_elim. apply ty_var. exact Hbnd. }
  assert (Hsub : G ⊢ open x U <: open x T).
  { subst U T. cbn. eapply subtyp_typ.
    - apply subtyp_bot.
    - apply subtyp_refl. }
  assert (HopenT : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x T).
  { eapply ty_sub; [exact HopenU|exact Hsub]. }
  assert (HbndT : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T).
  { eapply ty_rec_intro. exact HopenT. }
  exists G, U, T. repeat split; try assumption.
  (* T <> U *)
  subst U T. intro Heq. inversion Heq.
Qed.

(* The exact target formula, recorded but deliberately NOT asserted as a
   lemma: it is not proved in this file.  See the explanation below. *)
Definition ty_var_record_sub_statement : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),
    inert G ->
    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->
    G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* Status of the main statement [ty_var_record_sub].                      *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* The statement is TRUE, but the proof is not a short structural         *)
(* inversion.  Below is a precise account of what is needed and why the   *)
(* obvious routes fail.                                                    *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* 1. Why inertness is essential.                                          *)
(*    Without inertness the statement is false.  Take                        *)
(*        G = empty & x ~ typ_bot                                          *)
(*    (or more generally a non-record, non-inert binding).  Then            *)
(*    [x : typ_bot] by [ty_var], and [typ_bot <: typ_rcd D] by             *)
(*    [subtyp_bot], so [x : typ_rcd D] is derivable, while [open x U]      *)
(*    (for [U] not a subtype of [typ_rcd D]) need not be.  Inertness       *)
(*    rules this out because [inert_typ] admits only [typ_all],            *)
(*    [typ_con], and [typ_bnd] of a record type, and only record types of  *)
(*    the latter kind can flow to a record.  (With an inert-but-not-record *)
(*    binding [x ~ typ_and (typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_bnd V) (typ_bnd V)))   *)
(*    (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S (typ_rcd D)))] one also gets a counterexample: *)
(*    the two components, via [and11]/[and12] and [subtyp_sel2]/           *)
(*    [subtyp_sel1], witness [typ_bnd V <: typ_rcd D].  A [record_type]    *)
(*    forbids two members with the same label, which is precisely the      *)
(*    gap closed by inertness.)                                            *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* 2. The typing induction and the "Real" motive.                          *)
(*    Induct on the typing derivation [G ⊢ x ∶ T] and prove, for the       *)
(*    fixed binding [binds x (typ_bnd U) G] with [record_type U],          *)
(*        Real(T) := forall R, rc R -> G ⊢ T <: R -> G ⊢ open x U <: R.   *)
(*    The main conclusion is [Real (typ_rcd D)] at R = typ_rcd D via       *)
(*    [subtyp_refl] (and [rc_rcd]).  The [ty_sub] case is handled by       *)
(*    transitivity of subtyping: from [T0 <: T] and [T <: R] get           *)
(*    [T0 <: R] and apply the induction hypothesis [Real(T0)].             *)
(*    The [ty_and_intro] case needs a decomposition: from                  *)
(*    [typ_and T1 T2 <: R] with [rc R], derive [T1 <: R] or [T2 <: R] and  *)
(*    apply the IH; this is the "and-target split".  The variable base     *)
(*    cases need the bnd/rc separation described next.                    *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* 3. The remaining obstruction: bnd/rc separation.                        *)
(*    For the [ty_var] and [ty_rec_intro] cases one has to show, for all   *)
(*    [W] and all [rc R], that [G ⊢ typ_bnd W <: R] yields                 *)
(*    [G ⊢ open x W <: R].  This is true, but it cannot be proved by a     *)
(*    direct induction on the subtyping derivation: the [subtyp_trans]     *)
(*    case passes through an intermediate [S] with no known shape, and    *)
(*    the [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] rules go through record typings of  *)
(*    auxiliary variables [z].  The auxiliary record typing is itself a    *)
(*    subderivation of the subtyping premise and hence of the whole        *)
(*    typing derivation, so a mutual induction over [ty_trm] and           *)
(*    [subtyp] (using [rules_mutind]) is the correct vehicle: the sel      *)
(*    premises are then handled by the typing induction hypothesis, and    *)
(*    the only genuinely circular-looking sel chains are broken by the      *)
(*    equal-bound fact [record_type_has_equal_bounds] above.  The exact    *)
(*    mutual statement must moreover track the [typ_bnd] body / iterated   *)
(*    opening correspondence (a type-directed motive which maps            *)
(*    [typ_bnd W] to [Real (open x W)]), because [ty_rec_elim]'s premise   *)
(*    has type [typ_bnd W] whereas its conclusion is [open x W].           *)
(*                                                                        *)
(*    The plausible shortcut that every typing [x : typ_rcd D] is a       *)
(*    supertype of a [precise_flow] tip of the binding is FALSE in         *)
(*    general:                                                             *)
(*    [ty_rec_intro] can produce [x : typ_bnd W] which is not below any    *)
(*    flow tip (flow tips of [typ_bnd U] live inside [open x U] and its    *)
(*    components and cannot be below a [typ_bnd]).  It is only for         *)
(*    *record-like* conclusions that a flow-based argument can work, and   *)
(*    that restriction is exactly what the mutual induction above encodes. *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* 4. Why the statement is nevertheless true.                              *)
(*    A counterexample would require an inert context [G] with            *)
(*    [binds x (typ_bnd U) G], [record_type U], and a derivation of        *)
(*    [G ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd D] with [G ⊢ open x U ≮ typ_rcd D].  Since          *)
(*    [x ∶ typ_rcd D] cannot be obtained by [ty_var] (the binding is a     *)
(*    [typ_bnd]) or by [ty_and_intro] (whose conclusion is an              *)
(*    intersection), the only possible sources are recursive elimination   *)
(*    [ty_rec_elim] and widening [ty_sub].  Recursive elimination can      *)
(*    only open the binding's record structure, and widening to a record   *)
(*    target must respect the equal bounds of the record components        *)
(*    ([record_type_has_dec]).  Any detour through [subtyp_sel2]/          *)
(*    [subtyp_sel1] requires two record typings of one variable at the     *)
(*    same label with incompatible upper bounds; record types cannot       *)
(*    supply this, and inertness guarantees the variable's binding is a    *)
(*    record type.  Detours through [typ_bot] would require an [x]-type    *)
(*    below [typ_bot]); no such type is reachable from a record-typed      *)
(*    binding without a same-label sel detour, and the equal-bound        *)
(*    structure of record types rules that detour out.  Thus no            *)
(*    counterexample exists.                                               *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* In summary: the lemma is provable in principle, but a fully checked     *)
(* proof requires the mutual [rules_mutind] induction of item 3 with the   *)
(* type-directed body/opening invariant; the straightforward inversion     *)
(* and the flow-tip shortcut both fail for exactly the reasons above.      *)
(* No [Admitted]/[Axiom] is used in this file.                             *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

(* A last consistency check: the supporting lemmas above are all proved. *)
Check ty_var_record_sub_statement.
Check record_type_has_dec.
Check bnd_companion_not_unique.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect.

Inductive init_typ : Set :=
  | committed : init_typ
  | free : init_typ
  | unspecified : init_typ.

Notation inits := (list init_typ).

Notation init_ctx := (env init_typ).

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_all  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_con  : typs -> inits -> typ -> typ

with typs : Set :=
  | typs_nil : typs
  | typs_cons : typ -> typs -> typs

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_trm  : trm_label -> typ -> typ -> dec.

Scheme typ_mut  := Induction for typ Sort Prop
with   typs_mut := Induction for typs Sort Prop
with   dec_mut  := Induction for dec Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typ_mutind from typ_mut, typs_mut, dec_mut.

Fixpoint typs_to_list (Ts : typs) : list typ :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => nil
  | typs_cons T Ts' => (T :: typs_to_list Ts')%list
  end.

Instance TypsToList : ToList typ typs := typs_to_list.

Arguments TypsToList _ /.

Fixpoint typs_of_list (xs : list typ) : typs :=
  match xs with
  | nil => typs_nil
  | (T :: Ts')%list => typs_cons T (typs_of_list Ts')
  end.

Instance TypsOfList : OfList typ typs := typs_of_list.

Arguments TypsOfList _ /.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L    => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_all T1 T2  => typ_all (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_con Ts is' T =>
    typ_con
      (open_rec_typs k u Ts)
      is'
      (open_rec_typ (S (length_s Ts) + k) u T)

  end with
open_rec_typs (k : nat) (u : var) (Ts : typs) : typs :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => typs_nil
  | typs_cons T Ts =>
    typs_cons (open_rec_typ k u T)
              (open_rec_typs k u Ts)
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_trm m T U => dec_trm m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance TypsOpenable : Openable typs := open_rec_typs.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L    => (fv x)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_all T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_con Ts is' T   => (fv_typs Ts) \u (fv_typ T)
  end with
fv_typs (Ts : typs) : vars :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => \{}
  | typs_cons T Ts => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typs Ts)
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_trm m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  end.

Instance TypFreeVar : FreeVar typ := fv_typ.

Instance TypsFreeVar : FreeVar typs := fv_typs.

Instance DecFreeVar : FreeVar dec := fv_dec.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (u: var) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (subst_dec z u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_sel x L    => typ_sel (subst_var z u x) L
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (subst_typ z u T)
  | typ_all T U    => typ_all (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | typ_con Ts is' T   => typ_con (subst_typs z u Ts) is' (subst_typ z u T)
  end with
subst_typs (z: var) (u: var) (Ts: typs) { struct Ts } : typs :=
===VARS===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Notation avars := (list avar).

Instance AvarOpenable : Openable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n = i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarFreeVar : FreeVar avar :=
  fun a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => \{}
    | avar_f x => \{x}
    end.

Instance AvarSubstVar : SubstVar avar :=
  fun (x: var) (y: var) (a: avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f z => (avar_f (If z = x then y else z))
    end.

Instance AvarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax AvarOpenable AvarFreeVar AvarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarDecideFv : DecideFv AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => false
    | avar_f y => (If x = y then true else false)
    end.

Instance AvarClosing : Closing AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun (n : nat) (x : var) (a : avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f y => (If y = x then avar_b n else avar_f y)
    end.

Inductive vars_of_avars : list var -> list avar -> Prop :=
| vars_of_avars_nil : vars_of_avars nil nil
| vars_of_avars_cons : forall x vs avs,
    vars_of_avars vs avs ->
    vars_of_avars (cons x vs) (cons (avar_f x) avs).

Require Import TransformCollect.

Instance AvarsCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax ListAbstractSyntax :=
  fun {C} df f comb => List.fold_right (fun a acc => comb (f a) acc) df.

Instance AvarsTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax ListAbstractSyntax :=
  fun f a n => List.map (fun b => (f b n)) a.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax.

Reserved Notation "G '⊢!' x '∶' T '⪼' U" (at level 40, x at level 59).

Inductive precise_flow : var -> ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=

  | pf_bind : forall x G T,
      binds x T G ->
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ T

  | pf_open : forall x G T U,
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ typ_bnd U ->
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ open x U

  | pf_and1 : forall x G T U1 U2,
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ typ_and U1 U2 ->
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ U1

  | pf_and2 : forall x G T U1 U2,
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ typ_and U1 U2 ->
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ U2

where "G '⊢!' x '∶' T '⪼' U" := (precise_flow x G T U).
=== BASE flow region ===

Qed.

(** * Shape facts *)

Lemma record_type_not_top : record_type typ_top -> False.
Proof. intros [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_bot : record_type typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_sel : forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), record_type (typ_sel a A) -> False.
Proof. intros a A [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_all : forall (S T:typ), record_type (typ_all S T) -> False.
Proof. intros S T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_con : forall (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (T:typ), record_type (typ_con Ts is' T) -> False.
Proof. intros Ts is' T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), record_type (typ_bnd T) -> False.
Proof. intros T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_not_top : inert_typ typ_top -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_bot : inert_typ typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_sel : forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), inert_typ (typ_sel a A) -> False.
Proof. intros a A H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_rcd : forall (D:dec), inert_typ (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_and : forall (T U:typ), inert_typ (typ_and T U) -> False.
Proof. intros T U H. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Shape of precise flow tips in an inert setting *)

Lemma flow_shape : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  inert_typ T0 ->
  binds x T0 G ->
  (V = T0 /\ inert_typ T0) \/ record_type V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf; intros Hi Hb.
  - left. split; [reflexivity|assumption].
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + inversion Heq; subst. inversion Hi2; subst.
      right. apply record_type_open. assumption.
    + exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exists ls. exact Hr.
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists ls'. exact (proj1 HP).
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists (\{label_of D}).
      assert (HeqU : U2 = typ_rcd D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 HP)).
      assert (Hrd : record_dec D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 HP))).
      rewrite HeqU. apply rt_one; [exact Hrd|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma flow_typing : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf.
  - apply ty_var. assumption.
  - eapply ty_rec_elim. exact IHHf.
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and11].
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and12].
Qed.

(** * Corollaries: no flow tip is a top/bottom/selection type *)

Lemma flow_not_top : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_top -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_top Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_top Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_top. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_bot : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_bot -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_bot Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_bot Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_bot. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_sel : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ) (a:avar) (A:typ_label),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_sel a A -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 a A Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 (typ_sel a A) Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_sel a A Hi2).
  - exact (@record_type_not_sel a A Hr).
Qed.

Lemma flow_bnd_eq : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 U:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_bnd U -> typ_bnd U = T0.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 U Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 (typ_bnd U) Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - exact Heq.
  - exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma record_has_rcd_inv : forall (D D':dec), record_has (typ_rcd D) D' -> D' = D.
Proof. intros D D' H. inversion H; subst; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma record_has_and_inv : forall (T U:typ) (D:dec),
  record_has (typ_and T U) D -> record_has T D \/ record_has U D.
Proof. intros T U D H. inversion H; subst; [left|right]; assumption. Qed.

Lemma defs_update_label_in : forall (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  exists d, List.In d hds /\ label_of d = label_trm a.
Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y H. induction H.
  - exists (heap_def_trm a o). split; [apply List.in_eq|reflexivity].
  - destruct IHdefs_update as [d0 [Hin Hl]]. exists d0.
    split; [apply List.in_cons; exact Hin|exact Hl].
Qed.

Lemma labels_hasnt_update : forall (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (l:label),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  labels_hasnt hds l ->
  labels_hasnt hds' l.
Proof.

Rename all introduced vars to unique names after induction: `intros n a0 E`, use `a0` in injection? The equation target uses a0? Actually statement target `trm_sel (avar_b n) a`; after intros with a0, E: t=trm_sel(avar_b n)a0. Injection gives avar equality; no a reference. Just avoid conflict by names `n0 a0` etc. For sel line22 `intros n0 a0 E`. Base bullet E type will have n0,a0; injection names Hav Ha. Ty_sub IH expects same n0 a0; exact E. Good.
For asn bx `n0 a0 z0`; bz `x0 a0 n0`; app `n0 z0`; `f0 n0`; new `n0 avs0`. Patch.

These flow lemmas correspond to a precise typing. But the target lemmas concern arbitrary typing (not precise flow). The flow development might be useful for sel detours. However, our targets are about typ_all and typ_con.

Note Base.v uses `Unset Implicit Arguments`? It starts `Set Implicit Arguments.` No! Wait Base.v line 1 is `Set Implicit Arguments.` and the lemmas are explicitly applied with @. Hmm, the scratch files Base.v etc. use Set Implicit Arguments? Let me check: line 1 of Base.v was `Set Implicit Arguments.`. But the other scratch files (RootSub.v, Case.v, LitInv.v, AppPrep.v) use `Unset Implicit Arguments.`. The memory says "IMPORTANT: the whole injected Inj block is wrapped in Unset Implicit Arguments. ... because the block was developed in a scratch file without Set Implicit Arguments". So Base.v has Set Implicit Arguments, Case etc. Unset.

For our new file, "Use the standard import header" presumably the header pattern from RootSub.v: Require Base etc. Should we use `Unset Implicit Arguments.` or `Set`? We need to think about how definitions elaborate. Since Base is imported, its lemmas have implicit arguments per whatever scoping was active when they were defined? In Coq, Implicit Arguments setting is a per-environment flag? Actually `Set Implicit Arguments` affects declaration elaboration; arguments subsequent to a maximally inserted implicit are implicit. Once a lemma is defined, its implicit arguments are fixed. So Base lemmas have implicit arguments based on Set. Later files unset to make explicit. Our file can choose. Let's use "Unset Implicit Arguments." like the newer scratch files to make application explicit and predictable. But notation may depend. We'll see.

Now, the main challenge: prove the three lemmas. We can use any lemmas in Base/Case/etc. Perhaps there is a useful lemma already: `inert_binds_inert_typ` at line 2514, `ty_defs`, etc. Let me look at Base.v around the section defining inert_binds_inert_typ and maybe other helpful inversions. Hypothesis Hbind_all : forall (G:ctx) (f:var) (T0:typ) (S U:typ),
  inert G ->
  binds f T0 G ->
  inert_typ T0 ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f f) ∶ typ_all S U ->
  exists Sf Uf, T0 = typ_all Sf Uf /\
                G ⊢ typ_all Sf Uf <: typ_all S U.

Hypothesis Hall_inv : forall (G:ctx) (Sf Uf S U:typ),
  inert G ->
  G ⊢ typ_all Sf Uf <: typ_all S U ->
  exists L, G ⊢ S <: Sf /\
            (forall x, x \notin L -> G & x ~ Sf ⊢ open x Uf <: open x U).

Lemma ty_config_red_app : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx)
  (effss:list effects) (Fs:stack) (Sigma:heap) (U:typ)
  (f z:var) (Tf:typ) (tf:trm),
  ty_config G D Es effss (trm_app (avar_f f) (avar_f z) ; Fs ; Sigma) U ->
  binds f (item_lit (lit_fun Tf tf)) Sigma ->
  exists G' D' Es' effss',
    ty_config (G & G') D' Es' effss' (open z tf ; Fs ; Sigma) U.
Proof.
  intros G D Es effss Fs Sigma U f z Tf tf Hcfg Hbitem.
  destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D Es effss (trm_app (avar_f f) (avar_f z)) Fs Sigma U Hcfg) as
    (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effs & effs' & effss0 &
     HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr).
  assert (Heffnil : effs' = nil) by (eapply eff_trm_app_nil; exact Heff).
  subst effs'. cbn in Hcorr. cbn in HeqEffs.
  destruct (@ty_app_inv G f z Ts Hty) as [S [Ut [Hfapp [HzS HopenSub]]]].
  destruct (@heap_correspond_lit G Sigma f (lit_fun Tf tf) Hhc Hbitem) as [T0 [HfG HlitTy]].
  assert (HinertT0 : inert_typ T0) by (eapply inert_binds_inert_typ; eassumption).
  destruct (@Hbind_all G f T0 S Ut Hinert HfG HinertT0 Hfapp)
    as [Sf [Uf [HeqT0 HsubAll]]].
  destruct (@ty_lit_fun_type_inv G Tf tf T0 HlitTy) as [Ubody HeqBody].
  assert (HeqAll : typ_all Tf Ubody = typ_all Sf Uf) by (rewrite <- HeqBody; exact HeqT0).
  injection HeqAll as HeqSf HeqUf. subst Sf Uf.
  rewrite HeqBody in HlitTy.
  assert (HbodyTy : exists L, forall x, x \notin L ->
            G & x ~ Tf ⊢ open x tf ∶ open x Ubody)
    by (eapply ty_lit_fun_body; exact HlitTy).
  destruct HbodyTy as [Lb HbodyTy].
  destruct (@Hall_inv G Tf Ubody S Ut Hinert HsubAll) as [La [HSsub HbodySub]].
  assert (HzTf : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ Tf)
    by (eapply ty_sub; [exact HzS|exact HSsub]).
  assert (HopenTy : G ⊢ open z tf ∶ open z Ubody)
    by (eapply @ty_all_intro_open with (L:=Lb) (G:=G) (S:=Tf) (U:=Ubody) (t:=tf) (a:=z);
        [exact HbodyTy|exact HzTf]).
  assert (HopenSubU : G ⊢ open z Ubody <: open z Ut)
    by (eapply @subtyp_all_inst with (L:=La) (G:=G) (S2:=Tf) (U1:=Ubody) (U2:=Ut) (z:=z);
        [exact HbodySub|exact HzTf]).
  assert (HopenUt : G ⊢ open z Ubody <: open z Ut) by exact HopenSubU.
  assert (HyTs : G ⊢ open z tf ∶ Ts).
  { eapply ty_sub; [exact HopenTy|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; [exact HopenSubU|exact HopenSub]. }
  destruct (@init_app_commit G D (dom ℰ) f z ii Hinit) as [Hi Hcapp].
  subst ii.
  destruct (@commit_app_binds G D f z Hcapp) as [Hfcomm Hzcomm].
  pose proof (@free_sub_heaps_well_committed G D Sigma (ℰ :: ℰs) Hfs) as Hwc.
  pose proof (@well_committed_heap_item G D Sigma f (item_lit (lit_fun Tf tf)) Hwc Hfcomm Hbitem) as Hci.
  pose proof (@committed_heap_item_lit_inv G D (lit_fun Tf tf) Hci) as Hclit.
  destruct (@commit_lit_fun_body G D Tf tf Hclit) as [Lc HcommitBody].
  assert (HcommitOpen : G ⸴ D ⊢c open z tf)
    by (eapply @commit_all_intro_open with (L:=Lc) (G:=G) (D:=D) (S:=Tf) (t:=tf) (a:=z);
        [exact HcommitBody|exact HzTf|exact Hzcomm]).
  exists (empty:ctx), D, (ℰ :: ℰs), (effs :: effss0).
  rewrite concat_empty_r.
  eapply (@ty_config_c G D Sigma ℰ ℰs Fs (open z tf) Ts committed U nil effs effss0).
  - exact Hinert.
  - exact Hinits.
  - exact Hhc.
  - exact Hfs.
  - exact Hstack.
  - exact HyTs.
  - apply eff_ignore.
  - eapply init_commit. exact HcommitOpen.
  - exact Hcorr.
Qed.

Lemma ty_app_inv_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  forall (f z:var), t = trm_app (avar_f f) (avar_f z) ->
  exists S U, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f f) ∶ typ_all S U /\
              G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ S /\ G ⊢ open z U <: T.
Proof.
  intros G t T H. induction H; intros f0 z0 Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - injection Heq as Hf Hz. subst f0 z0.
    exists S, T. split; [exact H|]. split; [exact H0|apply subtyp_refl].
  - subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm f0 z0 eq_refl) as [Sa [Ua [Hf [Hz Hsub]]]].
    exists Sa, Ua. split; [exact Hf|]. split; [exact Hz|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact H0].
Qed.

Lemma ty_app_inv : forall (G:ctx) (f z:var) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_app (avar_f f) (avar_f z) ∶ T ->
  exists S U, G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f f) ∶ typ_all S U /\
              G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ S /\ G ⊢ open z U <: T.
Proof. intros. eapply ty_app_inv_gen; [exact H|reflexivity]. Qed.

Lemma ty_new_inv_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  forall (f:var) (avs:avars), t = trm_new (avar_f f) avs ->
  exists Ts is' X xs,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f f) ∶ typ_con Ts is' X /\
    G ⊢ avs :: Ts /\ vars_of_avars xs avs /\
    G ⊢ typ_bnd (open_rec_vars 1 xs X) <: T.
Proof.
  intros G t T H. induction H; intros f0 avs0 Heq; try discriminate Heq.
  - injection Heq as Hf Havs. subst f0 avs0.
    exists Ts, is', T, xs. split; [exact H|]. split; [exact H0|]. split; [exact H1|apply subtyp_refl].
  - subst.
    destruct (IHty_trm f0 avs0 eq_refl) as [Ts [is' [X [xs [Hf [Havs [Hvars Hsub]]]]]]].
    exists Ts, is', X, xs. split; [exact Hf|]. split; [exact Havs|]. split; [exact Hvars|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact H0].
Qed.

Lemma ty_new_inv : forall (G:ctx) (f:var) (avs:avars) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ trm_new (avar_f f) avs ∶ T ->
  exists Ts is' X xs,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f f) ∶ typ_con Ts is' X /\
    G ⊢ avs :: Ts /\ vars_of_avars xs avs /\
    G ⊢ typ_bnd (open_rec_vars 1 xs X) <: T.
Proof. intros. eapply ty_new_inv_gen; [exact H|reflexivity]. Qed.

Lemma eff_trm_app_nil : forall (f z:var) (effs:effects),
  ⊢e trm_app (avar_f f) (avar_f z) ∶ effs -> effs = nil.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma eff_trm_new_nil : forall (f:var) (avs:avars) (effs:effects),
  ⊢e trm_new (avar_f f) avs ∶ effs -> effs = nil.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ty_lit_fun_body : forall (G:ctx) (Tf Uf:typ) (tf:trm),
  G ⊢ lit_fun Tf tf ∶ typ_all Tf Uf ->
  exists L, forall x, x \notin L -> G & x ~ Tf ⊢ open x tf ∶ open x Uf.
Proof.
  intros G Tf Uf tf H. change (ty_lit G (lit_fun Tf tf) (typ_all Tf Uf)) in H.
  inversion H; subst. eexists. eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma commit_lit_fun_body : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Tf:typ) (tf:trm),
  G ⸴ D ⊢c lit_fun Tf tf ->
  exists L, forall x, x \notin L -> G & x ~ Tf ⸴ D & x ~ committed ⊢c open x tf.
Proof.
  intros G D Tf tf H. change (well_committed_lit G D (lit_fun Tf tf)) in H.
  inversion H; subst. eexists. eassumption.
Qed.

Require Import Case.
Require Import RetAux.
Require Import AsnAux.
Require Import HeapAsn.
Require Import SelPrep.
Require Import LitInv.
Require Import AppPrep.
Require Import NoBavar.
Require Import HeapSplit.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.

Unset Implicit Arguments.

Section Params.

Hypothesis Hsel_heap : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Sigma:heap) (Es:list eff_ctx)
  (x:var) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
  inert G ->
  heap_correspond G Sigma ->
  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma Es ->
  binds x committed D ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  exists T hds y, binds x (item_obj T hds) Sigma /\
                  labels_has hds (heap_def_trm a (Some y)).

Hypothesis Hasn_heap : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (S U:typ),
  heap_correspond G Sigma ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  exists T hds hds', binds x (item_obj T hds) Sigma /\ defs_update hds a y hds'.

Hypothesis Happ_heap : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (f:var) (S U:typ),
  inert G ->
  heap_correspond G Sigma ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f f) ∶ typ_all S U ->
  exists Tf tf, binds f (item_lit (lit_fun Tf tf)) Sigma.

Hypothesis Hnew_heap : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (f:var) (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (X:typ),
  inert G ->
  heap_correspond G Sigma ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f f) ∶ typ_con Ts is' X ->
  exists Ts0 is0 X0 ds t,
    binds f (item_lit (lit_con Ts0 is0 X0 ds t)) Sigma /\
    Ts0 = Ts /\ is0 = is' /\ X0 = X.

Lemma progress_from_cases : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (EsC:list eff_ctx)
  (EsE:list effects) (t:trm) (s:stack) (Sigma:heap) (U:typ),
  ty_config G D EsC EsE (t ; s ; Sigma) U ->
  answer (t ; s ; Sigma) \/
  exists s' Sigma' t', (t ; s ; Sigma) ↦ (t' ; s' ; Sigma').
Proof.
  intros G D EsC EsE t s Sigma U Hcfg.
  destruct t as [a | a m | a m b | a b | a avs | T t1 t2 | T l t1].
  - (* trm_var *)
    destruct a as [n|y].
    + destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D EsC EsE (trm_var (avar_b n)) s Sigma U Hcfg) as
        (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effs & effs' & effss0 &
         HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr).
      exfalso. eapply ty_var_b_false; exact Hty.
    + left. eapply progress_trm_var; exact Hcfg.
  - (* trm_sel *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D EsC EsE (trm_sel (avar_b n) m) s Sigma U Hcfg) as
        (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effs & effs' & effss0 &
         HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr).
      exfalso. eapply ty_sel_b_false; exact Hty.
    + destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D EsC EsE (trm_sel (avar_f x) m) s Sigma U Hcfg) as
        (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effs & effs' & effss0 &
         HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr).
      destruct (@ty_sel_inv G x m Ts Hty) as [S [T0 [Hxrec Hsub]]].
      destruct (@init_typing_sel_committed G D (dom ℰ) x m ii Hinit) as [Hi Hxcomm].
      destruct (@Hsel_heap G D Sigma (ℰ :: ℰs) x m S T0 Hinert Hhc Hfs Hxcomm Hxrec)
        as [T [hds [y [Hbinds Hlab]]]].
      right. exists s, Sigma, (trm_var (avar_f y)). eapply red_sel; eassumption.
  - (* trm_asn *)
    destruct a as [n|x]; [|destruct b as [n2|y]];
      try (destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D EsC EsE
              (trm_asn (avar_b n) m (avar_b n2)) s Sigma U Hcfg) as
             (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effs & effs' & effss0 &
              HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr);
           exfalso; eapply ty_asn_bx_false; exact Hty);
      try (destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D EsC EsE
              (trm_asn (avar_b n) m (avar_f y)) s Sigma U Hcfg) as
             (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effs & effs' & effss0 &
              HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr);
           exfalso; eapply ty_asn_bx_false; exact Hty);
      try (destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D EsC EsE
              (trm_asn (avar_f x) m (avar_b n2)) s Sigma U Hcfg) as
             (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effs & effs' & effss0 &
              HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr);
           exfalso; eapply ty_asn_bz_false; exact Hty).
    (* avar_f x, avar_f y *)
    destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D EsC EsE (trm_asn (avar_f x) m (avar_f y)) s Sigma U Hcfg) as
      (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effs & effs' & effss0 &
       HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr).
    destruct (@ty_asn_inv G x m y Ts Hty) as [S [T0 [Hxrec [HyS Hsub]]]].
    destruct (@Hasn_heap G Sigma x m y S T0 Hhc Hxrec) as [T [hds [hds' [Hbinds Hdu]]]].
    destruct (@binds_split_fresh item Sigma x (item_obj T hds) Hbinds) as [S1 [S2 [Heq Hfresh]]].
    right. exists s, (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds' & S2), (trm_var (avar_f y)).
    eapply red_asn. unfold heap_update.
    exists T, hds, hds', S1, S2. repeat split; try assumption; try reflexivity.
  - (* trm_app *)
    destruct a as [n|f]; [|destruct b as [n2|z]];
      try (destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D EsC EsE
              (trm_app (avar_b n) (avar_b n2)) s Sigma U Hcfg) as
             (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effs & effs' & effss0 &
              HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr);
           exfalso; eapply ty_app_bf_false; exact Hty);
      try (destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D EsC EsE
              (trm_app (avar_b n) (avar_f z)) s Sigma U Hcfg) as
             (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effs & effs' & effss0 &
              HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr);
           exfalso; eapply ty_app_bf_false; exact Hty);
      try (destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D EsC EsE
              (trm_app (avar_f f) (avar_b n2)) s Sigma U Hcfg) as
             (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effs & effs' & effss0 &
              HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr);
           exfalso; eapply ty_app_bz_false; exact Hty).
    destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D EsC EsE (trm_app (avar_f f) (avar_f z)) s Sigma U Hcfg) as
      (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effs & effs' & effss0 &
       HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr).
    destruct (@ty_app_inv G f z Ts Hty) as [S [Ut [Hfapp [HzS Hsub]]]].
    destruct (@Happ_heap G Sigma f S Ut Hinert Hhc Hfapp) as [Tf [tf Hbinds]].
    right. exists s, Sigma, (open z tf). eapply red_app; exact Hbinds.
  - (* trm_new *)
    destruct a as [n|f];
      try (destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D EsC EsE (trm_new (avar_b n) avs) s Sigma U Hcfg) as
             (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effs & effs' & effss0 &
              HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr);
           exfalso; eapply ty_new_bf_false; exact Hty).
    destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D EsC EsE (trm_new (avar_f f) avs) s Sigma U Hcfg) as
      (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effs & effs' & effss0 &
       HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr).
    destruct (@ty_new_inv G f avs Ts Hty) as [Tsc [isc [Xc [xs [Hfapp [Havs [Hvars Hsub]]]]]]].
    destruct (@Hnew_heap G Sigma f Tsc isc Xc Hinert Hhc Hfapp)
      as [Ts0 [is0 [X0 [ds [tb [Hbinds [HTs [His HX]]]]]]]].
    subst Ts0 is0 X0.
    assert (HlenAvs : List.length avs = length_s Tsc).
    { eapply ty_avars_length; exact Havs. }
    assert (HlenXs : List.length xs = length_s Tsc).
    { rewrite <- HlenAvs. eapply vars_of_avars_length; exact Hvars. }
    destruct (@var_fresh (dom Sigma \u fv (open_rec_vars 1 xs ds))) as [x Hx].
    pose proof (notin_union_r1 Hx) as HxSigma.
    pose proof (notin_union_r2 Hx) as Hxfv.
    right. exists (frame_ret x :: s),
      (Sigma & x ~ (item_obj (open_rec_vars 1 xs Xc)
                    (open_vars (cons x xs) (heap_defs_of_defs ds)))),
      (open_vars (cons x xs) tb).
    eapply red_new with (Ts:=Tsc) (is':=isc) (T:=Xc) (ds:=ds) (t:=tb)
                       (Sigma:=Sigma) (x:=x) (c:=f) (ys:=xs) (avs:=avs) (fs:=s).
    + exact HxSigma.
    + exact Hxfv.
    + exact Hbinds.
    + exact HlenXs.
    + exact Hvars.
  - (* trm_let *) right. eapply progress_trm_let; exact Hcfg.
  - (* trm_lit *) right. eapply progress_trm_lit; exact Hcfg.
Qed.

End Params.

  forall G', env_sim G' G -> G' ⊢ t ∶ T.

Corollary ty_lit_env_sim : forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T ->
  forall G', env_sim G' G -> G' ⊢ l ∶ T.
Proof. intros G l T H G' He. exact (proj1 (proj2 typing_env_sim_mut) G l T H G' He). Qed.

Corollary subtyp_env_sim : forall (G:ctx) (T U:typ), G ⊢ T <: U ->
  forall G', env_sim G' G -> G' ⊢ T <: U.
Proof. intros G T U H G' He. exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 typing_env_sim_mut)) G T U H G' He). Qed.

Corollary ty_avars_env_sim : forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts ->
  forall G', env_sim G' G -> G' ⊢ avs :: Ts.
Proof. intros G avs Ts H G' He. exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 typing_env_sim_mut)) G avs Ts H G' He). Qed.

Lemma Gc_typing_sub_sound :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
     G = Gc -> forall y, t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> y = x0 /\ Inv T) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U ->
     G = Gc -> (interp S -> interp U) /\ (Inv S -> Inv U)) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).
Proof.
  apply (rules_mutind
    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
       G = Gc -> forall y, t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> y = x0 /\ Inv T)
    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (_:G ⊢ S <: U) =>
       G = Gc -> (interp S -> interp U) /\ (Inv S -> Inv U))
    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True)).
  - (* ty_var *)
    intros G x T b H y E. subst G.
    assert (Exy : x = y) by (apply trm_var_eq; exact E). subst y.
    apply binds_single_inv in b. destruct b as [Ex ET].
    subst x. subst T.
    split.
    + reflexivity.
    + apply inv_rcd_typ, inv_rcd_trm.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros G x z S T p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_new *) intros G x avs xs Ts is' T p IH1 p2 IH2 p3 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_rcd_elim *) intros G x a0 S T p IH1 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_fld_asn *) intros G x y0 a0 S T p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_let *) intros L G t u T U p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_llit *) intros L G l u T U p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *)
    intros G x T p IH H y E.
    assert (Exy : x = y) by (apply trm_var_eq; exact E). subst y.
    destruct (IH H x eq_refl) as [Ex Hinv].
    subst x. split; [reflexivity | apply inv_bnd; exact Hinv].
  - (* ty_rec_elim *)
    intros G x T p IH H y E.

    intros G t T U p IH1 s IH2 H y E.

    + intros HI. inversion HI; subst; assumption.

    destruct (IH1 H) as [Hi1 Hi2]. destruct (IH2 H) as [Hj1 Hj2].

    intros G a0 T1 T2 U1 U2 s IH1 s0 IH2 H.

  - (* typ_avars_cons *) intros; exact I.

(* In [Gc] the empty-bounds subtyping [top <: bot] is not derivable. *)
Lemma Gc_not_top_sub_bot : ~ (Gc ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot).
Proof.
  intro Hsub.
  pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (Gc_typing_sub_sound)))
                Gc typ_top typ_bot Hsub eq_refl) as Hconj.
  destruct Hconj as [Hi _].
  cbn [interp] in Hi.
  exact (Hi I).
Qed.

  specialize (Hstmt Gc Vc typ_top S0 typ_bot).
  assert (Hconc : Gc ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot).

    ~ field_lookup_sub_record_statement a.
Proof.

  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (Tf S:typ),
    record_type V ->
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S S) ->
    G ⊢ Tf <: S.

Theorem field_lookup_sub_record_eq_refuted :
  forall (a : trm_label) (A : typ_label),
    ~ field_lookup_sub_record_eq_statement a.
Proof.
  intros a A Hstmt.
  specialize (Hstmt (Gc a A typ_bot) (Vc a) typ_top typ_bot).
  assert (Hconc : Gc a A typ_bot ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot).

    - exact (record_has_Vc a).
    - exact (sub_Vc_Targc a A typ_bot). }
