(* Variant: [rc V] (closure of records/top under intersections) instead *)
(* of [record_type V].  This hypothesis is weaker, and the same         *)
(* counterexample satisfies it.                                         *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Inductive rc : typ -> Prop :=
| rc_top : rc typ_top
| rc_rcd : forall (D:dec), rc (typ_rcd D)
| rc_and : forall (T U:typ), rc T -> rc U -> rc (typ_and T U).

Definition field_lookup_sub_rc_statement (a : trm_label) : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (Tf S U:typ),
    rc V ->
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    G ⊢ Tf <: U.

Lemma rc_Vc : forall (a:trm_label), rc (Vc a).
Proof. intros a. unfold Vc. apply rc_rcd. Qed.

Theorem field_lookup_sub_rc_refuted :
  forall (a : trm_label) (A : typ_label),
    ~ field_lookup_sub_rc_statement a.
Proof.
  intros a A Hstmt.
  specialize (Hstmt (Gc a A typ_top) (Vc a) typ_top typ_top typ_bot).
  assert (Hconc : Gc a A typ_top ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot).

    - exact (rc_Vc a).
    - exact (record_has_Vc a).
    - exact (sub_Vc_Targc a A typ_top). }
  exact (Gc_not_top_sub_bot a A typ_top Hconc).
Qed.

Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Require Import RootSub.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* Real.v : the canonical-forms lemma for inert [typ_bnd] bindings.       *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* We give the exact target statement, isolate the genuine blocker        *)
(* (the [typ_rcd] case), and prove without any axioms that:               *)
(*   (1) the [typ_rcd] case implies the general [rc] statement, and       *)
(*   (2) the general [rc] statement implies the requested corollary.      *)
(* The [typ_rcd] case itself is the canonical-forms statement recorded in *)
(* RootSub.v; it is not proved here (no Admitted/Abort is used).          *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Small supporting facts.                                                *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* Under inertness a [typ_bnd] binding carries a record type.  (This is
   the fact recorded in the task statement; it follows from inversion of
   [inert_typ] after [inert_binds_inert_typ].) *)
Lemma inert_bnd_record_type : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ),
  inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U.
Proof.
  intros G x U Hi Hb.
  pose proof (@inert_binds_inert_typ G x (typ_bnd U) Hi Hb) as Ht.
  inversion Ht; subst. assumption.
Qed.

(* Left/right projections of an intersection target. *)
Lemma subtyp_and_left : forall (G:ctx) (T U V:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: typ_and U V -> G ⊢ T <: U.
Proof. intros. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact H|apply subtyp_and11]. Qed.

Lemma subtyp_and_right : forall (G:ctx) (T U V:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: typ_and U V -> G ⊢ T <: V.
Proof. intros. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact H|apply subtyp_and12]. Qed.

(* Inversions of the [rc] closure (used by the reduction below). *)
Lemma rc_top_inv : forall (T:typ), rc T -> T = typ_top -> True.
Proof. intros. exact I. Qed.

Lemma rc_and_inv : forall (T:typ), rc T ->
  forall (U V:typ), T = typ_and U V -> rc U /\ rc V.
Proof.
  intros T H. induction H; intros U V Heq.
  - discriminate Heq.
  - discriminate Heq.
  - inversion Heq; subst. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* A [typ_rcd] is never a [typ_bnd]. *)
Lemma typ_rcd_not_bnd : forall (D:dec) (U:typ), typ_rcd D <> typ_bnd U.
Proof. intros D U Heq. inversion Heq. Qed.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* The isolated blocker.                                                  *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* This is the [typ_rcd] instance of the target theorem, with an          *)
(* arbitrary typing type [T].  It is exactly the canonical-forms          *)
(* statement for records in an inert context: every record supertype of   *)
(* a well-typed variable is above the recursive opening of the binding.   *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* RootSub.v explains why this cannot be obtained by a one-line inversion *)
(* of subtyping (the [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] detour).  It is TRUE     *)
(* but is the remaining open subgoal of this development.                 *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Definition rcd_case_statement : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T:typ) (D:dec),
    inert G ->
    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
    record_type U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
    G ⊢ T <: typ_rcd D ->
    G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* Reduction: the [typ_rcd] case implies the general [rc] statement.      *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* The proof is a straightforward induction on the [rc] witness, using    *)
(* only transitivity and the intersection projections for the [rc_and]    *)
(* case.  Hence the *only* unproved content is [rcd_case_statement].      *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Section FromRcd.

Hypothesis Hrcd : rcd_case_statement.

Lemma real_from_rcd : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T:typ),
  inert G ->
  binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
  record_type U ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
  forall (R:typ), rc R -> G ⊢ T <: R -> G ⊢ open x U <: R.
Proof.
  intros G x U T Hi Hb Hrt Hty R HR.
  induction HR as [| D | R1 R2 HR1 IH1 HR2 IH2]; intros Hsub.
  - (* rc_top *) apply subtyp_top.
  - (* rc_rcd *) eapply Hrcd; eassumption.
  - (* rc_and *) apply subtyp_and2.
    + apply IH1. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub | apply subtyp_and11].
    + apply IH2. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub | apply subtyp_and12].
Qed.

(* The exact theorem requested by the task, conditional on the isolated
   [typ_rcd] case. *)
Theorem ty_var_bnd_real_of_rcd : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T R:typ),
  inert G ->
  binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
  record_type U ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
  rc R ->
  G ⊢ T <: R ->
  G ⊢ open x U <: R.
Proof.
  intros G x U T R Hi Hb Hrt Hty HR Hsub.
  eapply real_from_rcd; eassumption.
Qed.

(* The requested corollary, conditional on the isolated [typ_rcd] case. *)
Lemma ty_var_record_sub_of_rcd : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),
  inert G ->
  binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->
  G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.
Proof.
  intros G x U D Hi Hb Hty.
  pose proof (@inert_bnd_record_type G x U Hi Hb) as Hrt.
  eapply Hrcd with (T := typ_rcd D) (D := D); eassumption.
Qed.

End FromRcd.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* The unconditional statements (recorded, not asserted as lemmas).       *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* Since [rcd_case_statement] is exactly the open canonical-forms goal,   *)
(* the unconditional theorem is stated here for reference.  It is not     *)
(* proved, and no inconsistency is introduced: these are Definitions.     *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Definition ty_var_bnd_real_statement : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T R:typ),
    inert G ->
    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
    record_type U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
    rc R ->
    G ⊢ T <: R ->
    G ⊢ open x U <: R.

Definition ty_var_record_sub_statement : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),
    inert G ->
    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->
    G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.

(* The two statements above are *exactly* the reductions we proved:
   the only gap is [rcd_case_statement].  This is recorded by the
   following implications, which check that nothing else is missing. *)

Lemma ty_var_bnd_real_of_rcd_statement :
  rcd_case_statement -> ty_var_bnd_real_statement.
Proof.
  intros Hrcd G x U T R Hi Hb Hrt Hty HR Hsub.
  eapply ty_var_bnd_real_of_rcd; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma ty_var_record_sub_of_rcd_statement :
  rcd_case_statement -> ty_var_record_sub_statement.
Proof.
  intros Hrcd G x U D Hi Hb Hty.
  eapply ty_var_record_sub_of_rcd; eassumption.
Qed.

(* Conversely, the [rc] statement specializes to the [typ_rcd] case, so
   the two formulations are equivalent modulo the [rc_rcd] constructor. *)
Lemma rcd_of_ty_var_bnd_real :
  ty_var_bnd_real_statement -> rcd_case_statement.
Proof.
  intros Hall G x U T D Hi Hb Hrt Hty Hsub.
  eapply Hall; [exact Hi | exact Hb | exact Hrt | exact Hty | apply rc_rcd | exact Hsub].
Qed.

Lemma rcd_of_ty_var_record_sub :
  ty_var_record_sub_statement ->
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),
    inert G ->
    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
    record_type U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->
    G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.
Proof.
  intros Hall G x U D Hi Hb Hrt Hty.
  eapply Hall; eassumption.
Qed.

Check ty_var_bnd_real_statement.
Check ty_var_record_sub_statement.
Check rcd_case_statement.
Check ty_var_bnd_real_of_rcd.
Check ty_var_record_sub_of_rcd.

Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* The inert-restricted field-subtyping variants.                        *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* The two target lemmas are [field_cov_inert] and [field_contr_inert].   *)
(* Below we prove:                                                        *)
(*   (1) inertness really does exclude the bad asymmetric type-member    *)
(*       binding used in FieldSub2.v;                                      *)
(*   (2) both target lemmas in full, under the (stronger than inert)      *)
(*       assumption that the context derives no record typing of a        *)
(*       variable at a type member [dec_typ A S T].  This hypothesis is   *)
(*       exactly what is needed to make selections impossible; it is      *)
(*       satisfied by the empty context, giving both lemmas for [empty].  *)
(*   (3) the precise remaining subgoal for the general inert case: the    *)
(*       coherence of the type-member bounds of an inert [typ_bnd]        *)
(*       binding (see the comment at the end of the file).                *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* (1) The bad binding is impossible under inertness.                     *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma inert_no_rcd_binds : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (D:dec),
  inert G -> binds x (typ_rcd D) G -> False.
Proof.
  intros G x D Hi Hb.
  pose proof (@inert_binds_inert_typ G x (typ_rcd D) Hi Hb) as Ht.
  exact (@inert_typ_not_rcd D Ht).
Qed.

Lemma inert_no_bad_type_member_binds : forall (G:ctx) (x:var)
    (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
  inert G -> binds x (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) G -> False.
Proof.
  intros. eapply inert_no_rcd_binds; eassumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Structural facts about record types.                                   *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma record_typ_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros T ls D Hrt. induction Hrt as
    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ]; intros Hrh.
  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. subst D. exact Hdec.
  - apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh. destruct Hrh as [Hl|Hr].
    + eapply IH. exact Hl.
    + apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hr. subst D. exact Hdec.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (D:dec),
  record_type T -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros T D [ls Hrt] Hrh. eapply (@record_typ_has_dec T ls D); eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_has_equal_bounds : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
  record_type T -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U) -> S = U.
Proof.
  intros T a S U Hrt Hrh.
  pose proof (@record_type_has_dec T (dec_trm a S U) Hrt Hrh) as Hdec.
  inversion Hdec; subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Two [record_has] members of a record type with the same label are the
   same member.  This is the uniqueness needed to turn the equal-bound
   fact for one member into the bounds bracket for every member. *)

Lemma record_typ_trm_unique : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (a:trm_label)
    (T1 U1 T2 U2:typ),
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_has T (dec_trm a T1 U1) ->
  record_has T (dec_trm a T2 U2) ->
  T1 = T2 /\ U1 = U2.
Proof.
  intros T ls a T1 U1 T2 U2 Hrt.
  induction Hrt as [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ];
    intros H1 H2.
  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
    apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
    rewrite H1 in H2. inversion H2. auto.
  - apply record_has_and_inv in H1.
    apply record_has_and_inv in H2.
    destruct H1 as [H1|H1]; destruct H2 as [H2|H2].
    + eapply IH; eassumption.
    + (* H1 in T0, H2 in the right component *)
      exfalso.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T1 U1) H1) as Hin.
      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1) = l).
      { rewrite H2. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
    + (* H1 in the right component, H2 in T0 *)
      exfalso.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T2 U2) H2) as Hin.
      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2) = l).
      { rewrite H1. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
    + (* both in the right component *)
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
      rewrite H1 in H2. inversion H2. auto.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_bracket : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf:typ),
  record_type V -> record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has V (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
    G ⊢ Sl <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: Su.
Proof.
  intros G V a Tf [ls Hrt] Hrh Sl Su Hrh2.
  pose proof (@record_typ_trm_unique V ls a Tf Tf Sl Su Hrt Hrh Hrh2)
    as [E1 E2].
  subst. split; apply subtyp_refl.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_nobot : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> True.
Proof. intros; exact I. Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* A "no bottom in the record/intersection structure" predicate and the   *)
(* label-indexed bracket predicate.                                       *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* [compat G a Al Au T] says: T contains no bottom in the positions       *)
(* traversed by [record_has], and every [a]-member of T brackets the      *)
(* (source) bounds [Al..Au].  This predicate is designed so that it is    *)
(* preserved by subtyping in the absence of selection flows, while still  *)
(* being false at [typ_bot].  The [nobot] component is what makes the     *)
(* [and11]/[and12] cases (and the [subtyp_bot] case) go through.          *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Fixpoint nobot (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_and T1 T2 => nobot T1 /\ nobot T2
  | _ => True
  end.

Definition bracket (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has T (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
    G ⊢ Sl <: Al /\ G ⊢ Au <: Su.

Definition compat (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
  nobot T /\ bracket G a Al Au T.

(* The context hypothesis that selection flows are impossible. *)
Definition no_ty_member_typings (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (x:var) (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
    ~ (G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)).

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Preservation of [compat] by subtyping, in a context with no type-member *)
(* record typings (so that [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] can never fire).    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma compat_closure : forall (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au:typ) (S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  G ⊢ S <: U ->
  compat G a Al Au S ->
  compat G a Al Au U.
Proof.
  intros G a Al Au S U Hns Hsub.
  induction Hsub; intros Hc; cbn [compat nobot bracket] in *.
  - (* subtyp_top *) split; [exact I|]. intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_bot *) destruct Hc as [Hn _]. exact (False_rect _ Hn).
  - (* subtyp_refl *) exact Hc.
  - (* subtyp_trans *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb].
    apply IHHsubtyp2. apply IHHsubtyp1. split; [exact Hn|exact Hb].
  - (* subtyp_and11 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
    + exact (proj1 Hn).
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andl. exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_and12 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
    + exact (proj2 Hn).
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andr. exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
    assert (IH1 := IHHsubtyp1 Hc).
    assert (IH2 := IHHsubtyp2 Hc).
    destruct IH1 as [Hn1 Hb1]. destruct IH2 as [Hn2 Hb2]. split.
    + split; assumption.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh.
      destruct Hrh as [Hrh|Hrh]; [apply Hb1|apply Hb2]; exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_fld *)
    destruct Hc as [_ Hb]. split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh.
      inversion Hrh; subst.
      pose proof (proj1 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hlow.
      pose proof (proj2 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hup.
      split; [eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption|eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption].
  - (* subtyp_typ *) split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. discriminate Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_sel2 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_sel1 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_all *) split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The main field lemmas under [no_ty_member_typings].                    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Theorem field_cov_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.

  pose proof (@record_type_bracket G V a Tf Hrt Hrh) as Hb.
  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
                Hns Hsub (conj I Hb)) as Hfinal.

Theorem field_contr_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ S <: Tf.

  pose proof (@record_type_bracket G V a Tf Hrt Hrh) as Hb.
  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))

Theorem field_pair_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),

  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->

  - eapply field_cov_no_ty_member; eassumption.

Lemma empty_typing_var_false : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T -> G = empty -> forall (x:var), t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  pose proof (proj1 (rules_mutind
    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
       G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False)
    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (_:G ⊢ S <: U) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True)))
    as Hty.
  - exact (Hty G t T H).
  - (* typing rules *)
    intros; try (match goal with
                 | b : binds ?x ?v ?G, He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
                     rewrite He in b; exact (binds_empty_inv b)
                 | IH : ?G = empty -> forall y, ?t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> False,
                   He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
                     exfalso; eapply IH; [exact He | first [eassumption | reflexivity]]
                 | H : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- False => discriminate H
                 | H : trm_var (avar_f _) = ?t |- False => discriminate H
                 end).
  - (* literal rules *) intros; exact I.
  - (* subtyping rules *) intros; exact I.
  - (* avar rules *) intros; exact I.
Qed.

Proof.

The ty_sub case works: Safe(T') and T' <: T gives Safe(T) by trans. ty_var needs Safe(T0). and_intro needs Safe(typ_and T1 T2) from Safe(T1), Safe(T2) via projection. rec_intro: need Safe(typ_bnd W) from Safe(open f W) — here the semantic shape of supertypes of typ_bnd W needs to be derived from supertypes of open f W. rec_elim: need Safe(open f W) from Safe(typ_bnd W). These bnd closure properties need a meta-lemma about subtyping and recursive types:
 (i) For all V, if typ_bnd W <: V then ...? and if open f W <: V...
Maybe the right relation is to use the *same* Safe for both typ_bnd W and open f W by defining Safe(T) with an extra clause:
Safe(T) := (forall V, G ⊢ T <: V -> Shape(V)) /\ 
           (forall W, T = typ_bnd W -> forall V, G ⊢ open f W <: V -> Shape(V)) /\
           (forall W, T = typ_bnd W -> Safe(open f W))? 
But then Safe(open f W) requires open f W's supertypes too, and rec_elim needs Safe(open f W) from Safe(typ_bnd W) which we can get from a clause. rec_intro needs Safe(typ_bnd W) from Safe(open f W): define a clause in Safe(T): if T = open f W then Safe(typ_bnd W). But then Safe becomes recursive on types (open/close), potentially cyclic. For a derivation, rec_intro/elim alternate finitely, but the semantic Safe has a coinductive flavor. Could define Safe via a *least* inductive closure matching the typing rules, plus upward closure. Let's define an inductive relation `Reach(T)` (types reachable as var f's type by the syntax rules, with subtyping closure) and prove its properties by induction... but subtyping closure as a constructor would make proofs need semantic analysis.

Define:
Inductive Reach : typ -> Prop :=
| reach_T0 : Reach T0
| reach_sub : forall T V, Reach T -> G ⊢ T <: V -> Reach V
| reach_and : forall T U, Reach T -> Reach U -> Reach (typ_and T U)
| reach_bnd_intro : forall W, Reach (open f W) -> Reach (typ_bnd W)
| reach_bnd_elim : forall W, Reach (typ_bnd W) -> Reach (open f W).

Then prove by induction on Reach: if Reach(V) and V=all then T0=all ... and if V=con then T0=con...
- reach_T0: T0 itself; need T0=all if T0=all (trivial) and T0 con if T0 con.
- reach_sub: Reach(T), T <: V, V=all. IH gives properties of T only if T shape all/con. If T is all, then T0=all and T0 <: T; then T <: V gives T0 <: V. Good! If T is con and V=all, IH gives T0=con... but also T0 is fixed; no contradiction unless T0=all too. Wait IH for Reach(T): if T=con then T0=con. That doesn't contradict V=all. We need to know con <: all impossible. So reach_sub case fails unless Reach(T) implies T <: V shape constraints for all T. We need an invariant: if Reach(T) and T <: V and V=all then ... We can strengthen IH to: for all V, T <: V -> Shape(V). Then reach_sub case: from Reach(T) IH gives forall V, T <: V -> Shape(V); apply to V. Good. But then reach_and case needs the projection lemma as before. reach_bnd_intro/elim need bnd closure. Still hard.

However, maybe Reach's `reach_sub` constructor with the *same* IH "forall V, T <: V -> Shape(V)" is exactly Safe, and we can prove the cases:
- reach_and: Safe(T1), Safe(T2) -> Safe(and). Need projection.
- reach_bnd_intro: Safe(open f W) -> Safe(typ_bnd W). Need: for all V, typ_bnd W <: V -> Shape(V). Can we derive from Safe(open f W)? We know for all V, open f W <: V -> Shape(V). Need relation typ_bnd W <: V => open f W <: V? Under inert G maybe true? For V all/con, if typ_bnd W <: V then V is all/con; can we show open f W <: V? If typ_bnd W <: all then... Hmm, this is a subtyping property independent of Safe. Maybe prove `subtyp_bnd_open`: for all V with V=all or con, G ⊢ typ_bnd W <: V -> G ⊢ open f W <: V? Actually if typ_bnd W <: V is derivable, maybe V = typ_top or ...; with inert G, perhaps no. But safe(open f W) doesn't help derive open f W <: V from typ_bnd W <: V.

Likewise reach_bnd_elim: Safe(typ_bnd W) -> Safe(open f W): need for all V, open f W <: V -> Shape(V), from Safe(typ_bnd W): for all V, typ_bnd W <: V -> Shape(V). Need open f W <: V => typ_bnd W <: V? Not generally (open f W is a record/type; typ_bnd W might not subtype it). Under inert, maybe typ_bnd W and open f W are related? There's no subtyping between them. Hmm.

Wait, in ty_rec_elim, the *typing* premise is var f ∶ typ_bnd W, and conclusion var f ∶ open f W. In the semantic Safe formulation, we need Safe(open f W). But from Safe(typ_bnd W), is it derivable? Safe(typ_bnd W) says all supertypes of typ_bnd W satisfy Shape. We need all supertypes of open f W satisfy Shape. These are different sets. But maybe the variable typing premise also gives us more: the fact that f is typed at typ_bnd W means W is related to T0 via Safe; e.g., if T0=typ_all or typ_con, typ_bnd W is unreachable, so this case is vacuous for our targets. If T0=typ_bnd U, then open f W may reach all/con only if ... Perhaps we can split on T0's inert shape at the top and handle typ_bnd T0 separately with the record machinery. Since our lemmas 1 and 3 concern T0=all/con only? No: lemma 1 assumes inert_typ T0 and concludes T0=typ_all Sf Uf; if T0=typ_bnd, the conclusion is false unless var can't be typed at all. So lemma 1 must show typ_bnd T0 is impossible. Similarly lemma 3 for T0=typ_all/typ_bnd impossible. Thus we need the vacuity facts for typ_bnd/typ_con sources relative to all targets.

Maybe we can prove those vacuity facts separately and simply:
- If T0 = typ_con Ts is' X (record X) and G inert, then G ⊢ var f ∶ typ_all S U is impossible.
- If T0 = typ_bnd X (record X), then G ⊢ var f ∶ typ_all S U is impossible.
These can be proven by a shape analysis where the "Safe" predicate is: target is typ_all => False (for these T0). That might be easier because we only need contradiction. Let's define for T0=typ_con: SafeCon(T) := (T = typ_all S U -> False) /\ (T = typ_con Ts is' X -> T0 = typ_con Ts is' X). For T0=typ_con, could a typ_con binding be typed at typ_con? Maybe only if equal? Possibly typ_con Ts' is'' X' with X' record and X' subtyping X? typ_con subtyping: no rules except refl/trans, so typ_con <: typ_con only if syntactically equal? Actually trans through sel could relate typ_con to typ_sel and back to typ_con with equal bounds? A record member with equal bound typ_con Ts' is'' X'... x could sel2 to x.A and sel1 back; but to get typ_con equal, the bound must be typ_con. So any reachable typ_con is the same T0. Statement 3 says so. Similarly, no all.

This is maybe tractable with the mutual induction but still requires projection/bnd closure for the "false" cases.

Given the difficulty, maybe there's a much simpler observation: In an inert context, can a variable's binding T0 be anything other than the type ascribed by ty_var? The bnd_companion counterexample shows yes for typ_bnd. But for typ_all and typ_con, maybe *all* ascriptions are exactly T0? Let's test with typ_all T0 = typ_all Sf Uf. Can f be typed at a *different* typ_all S U? Only if T0 <: that, via subtyp_all. So if subtyping all can change domain/body, yes. But T0 itself is typ_all. For typ_con T0, no subtyping rules except refl/trans/sel detours, so maybe exactly T0.

Maybe we can exploit the fact that T0 = typ_all Sf Uf for lemma 1: we only need to handle the case T0=typ_all in detail; other cases are contradictions. Could use `subtyp_all_inv_inert` (statement 2) to get the witness once we know T0=typ_all. So lemma 1 reduces to: (a) if T0=typ_all Sf Uf, T0 <: typ_all S U (need from typing), and (b) T0 inert not typ_all -> false.

To get T0 <: typ_all S U from the typing derivation, we might prove a general lemma:
`ty_var_subtyp`: if binds f T0 G and G ⊢ var f ∶ V, and G inert, and T0 inert, then either T0 <: V or (T0=typ_bnd ... and V=typ_bnd...) or V is typ_and... For V=typ_all, T0 <: V. This is a semantic shape lemma again.

Let's try using `induction` on the typing derivation *with a general target and the assumption binds*, but only ask for a disjunction over the possible *shape of the type* that is inductive. We can define an inductive predicate `Rel(T0,V)` that is the least relation closed under the typing rules and subtyping:
Inductive Reach (as above). Then prove `Reach(V)` from the typing derivation *by construction*: ty_var -> reach_T0; ty_rec_intro -> reach_bnd_intro; ty_rec_elim -> reach_bnd_elim; ty_and_intro -> reach_and; ty_sub -> reach_sub. This is exactly the typing induction, and Reach is defined to match. Then prove the desired properties of Reach. The Reach relation is *defined* so that the typing induction is trivial. The hard part is analyzing Reach. But maybe analyzing Reach is easier because it's an inductive predicate over types with constructors that mirror typing, and we can do *structural induction on Reach* with a stronger and more tailored invariant. Still the reach_sub constructor is the killer.

Could we avoid `reach_sub` by proving a separate "subtyping preserves Reach's essential property" and use that to eliminate reach_sub? Define a property `Good(T)` (not involving subtyping) such that:
- Good(T0)
- Good(T1),Good(T2) -> Good(and T1 T2)
- Good(open f W) <-> Good(typ_bnd W)
- Good(T) -> T <: V -> Good(V)   (* preservation *)
- Good(T) -> if T=all then T0=all & T0<:T; if T=con then T0=con. (shape)
Then the typing induction gives Good(V). Preservation is a subtyping lemma; shape is straightforward. The challenge is defining Good with these properties. Good could be defined as the *largest* predicate satisfying the shape and closure conditions, but proving preservation requires the sel rules.

Let's try to define Good in terms of an interpretation of types as "sets of labels/members" that is preserved by subtyping. Actually, the natural semantic interpretation of a *closed* context: the only obstruction to all/con shapes is that sel detours might produce type members. Under inertness, a variable's binding type T0 determines an *object* with a record body. Maybe Good(T) can be "T is in the subtyping cone of T0 via the canonical shape", and preservation is the statement that the subtyping cone maps into Good. That's circular.

==== FieldInert.v ====
Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* The inert-restricted field-subtyping variants.                        *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* The two target lemmas are [field_cov_inert] and [field_contr_inert].   *)
(* Below we prove:                                                        *)
(*   (1) inertness really does exclude the bad asymmetric type-member    *)
(*       binding used in FieldSub2.v;                                      *)
(*   (2) both target lemmas in full, under the (stronger than inert)      *)
(*       assumption that the context derives no record typing of a        *)
(*       variable at a type member [dec_typ A S T].  This hypothesis is   *)
(*       exactly what is needed to make selections impossible; it is      *)
(*       satisfied by the empty context, giving both lemmas for [empty].  *)
(*   (3) the precise remaining subgoal for the general inert case: the    *)
(*       coherence of the type-member bounds of an inert [typ_bnd]        *)
(*       binding (see the comment at the end of the file).                *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* (1) The bad binding is impossible under inertness.                     *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma inert_no_rcd_binds : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (D:dec),
  inert G -> binds x (typ_rcd D) G -> False.
Proof.
  intros G x D Hi Hb.
  pose proof (@inert_binds_inert_typ G x (typ_rcd D) Hi Hb) as Ht.
  exact (@inert_typ_not_rcd D Ht).
Qed.

Lemma inert_no_bad_type_member_binds : forall (G:ctx) (x:var)
    (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
  inert G -> binds x (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) G -> False.
Proof.
  intros. eapply inert_no_rcd_binds; eassumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Structural facts about record types.                                   *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma record_typ_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros T ls D Hrt. induction Hrt as
    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ]; intros Hrh.
  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. subst D. exact Hdec.
  - apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh. destruct Hrh as [Hl|Hr].
    + eapply IH. exact Hl.
    + apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hr. subst D. exact Hdec.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (D:dec),
  record_type T -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros T D [ls Hrt] Hrh. eapply (@record_typ_has_dec T ls D); eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_has_equal_bounds : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
  record_type T -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U) -> S = U.
Proof.
  intros T a S U Hrt Hrh.
  pose proof (@record_type_has_dec T (dec_trm a S U) Hrt Hrh) as Hdec.
  inversion Hdec; subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Two [record_has] members of a record type with the same label are the
   same member.  This is the uniqueness needed to turn the equal-bound
   fact for one member into the bounds bracket for every member. *)

Lemma record_typ_trm_unique : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (a:trm_label)
    (T1 U1 T2 U2:typ),
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_has T (dec_trm a T1 U1) ->
  record_has T (dec_trm a T2 U2) ->
  T1 = T2 /\ U1 = U2.
Proof.
  intros T ls a T1 U1 T2 U2 Hrt.
  induction Hrt as [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ];
    intros H1 H2.
  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
    apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
    assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
    { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
    inversion E. auto.
  - apply record_has_and_inv in H1.
    apply record_has_and_inv in H2.
    destruct H1 as [H1|H1]; destruct H2 as [H2|H2].
    + eapply IH; eassumption.
    + (* H1 in T0, H2 in the right component *)
      exfalso.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T1 U1) H1) as Hin.
      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1) = l).
      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2)).
        - cbn. reflexivity.
        - rewrite H2. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
    + (* H1 in the right component, H2 in T0 *)
      exfalso.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T2 U2) H2) as Hin.
      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2) = l).
      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1)).
        - cbn. reflexivity.
        - rewrite H1. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
    + (* both in the right component *)
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
      assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
      { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
      inversion E. auto.
Qed.
==== Real.v head ====
Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Require Import RootSub.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* Real.v : the canonical-forms lemma for inert [typ_bnd] bindings.       *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* We give the exact target statement, isolate the genuine blocker        *)
(* (the [typ_rcd] case), and prove without any axioms that:               *)
(*   (1) the [typ_rcd] case implies the general [rc] statement, and       *)
(*   (2) the general [rc] statement implies the requested corollary.      *)
(* The [typ_rcd] case itself is the canonical-forms statement recorded in *)
(* RootSub.v; it is not proved here (no Admitted/Abort is used).          *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Small supporting facts.                                                *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* Under inertness a [typ_bnd] binding carries a record type.  (This is
   the fact recorded in the task statement; it follows from inversion of
   [inert_typ] after [inert_binds_inert_typ].) *)
Lemma inert_bnd_record_type : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ),
  inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U.
Proof.
  intros G x U Hi Hb.
  pose proof (@inert_binds_inert_typ G x (typ_bnd U) Hi Hb) as Ht.
  inversion Ht; subst. assumption.
Qed.

(* Left/right projections of an intersection target. *)
Lemma subtyp_and_left : forall (G:ctx) (T U V:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: typ_and U V -> G ⊢ T <: U.
Proof. intros. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact H|apply subtyp_and11]. Qed.

Lemma subtyp_and_right : forall (G:ctx) (T U V:typ),
  G ⊢ T <: typ_and U V -> G ⊢ T <: V.
Proof. intros. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact H|apply subtyp_and12]. Qed.

(* Inversion of the [rc] intersection constructor. *)
Lemma rc_and_inv : forall (T:typ), rc T ->
  forall (U V:typ), T = typ_and U V -> rc U /\ rc V.
Proof.
  intros T H. induction H as [| D | A B HA HB]; intros U V Heq.
  - discriminate Heq.
  - discriminate Heq.
  - inversion Heq; subst. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* A [typ_rcd] is never a [typ_bnd]. *)
Lemma typ_rcd_not_bnd : forall (D:dec) (U:typ), typ_rcd D <> typ_bnd U.
Proof. intros D U Heq. inversion Heq. Qed.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* The isolated blocker.                                                  *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* This is the [typ_rcd] instance of the target theorem, with an          *)
(* arbitrary typing type [T].  It is exactly the canonical-forms          *)
(* statement for records in an inert context: every record supertype of   *)
(* a well-typed variable is above the recursive opening of the binding.   *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* RootSub.v explains why this cannot be obtained by a one-line inversion *)
(* of subtyping (the [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] detour).  It is TRUE     *)
(* but is the remaining open subgoal of this development.                 *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Definition rcd_case_statement : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T:typ) (D:dec),
    inert G ->
    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
    record_type U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
    G ⊢ T <: typ_rcd D ->
    G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* Reduction: the [typ_rcd] case implies the general [rc] statement.      *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* The proof is a straightforward induction on the [rc] witness, using    *)
(* only transitivity and the intersection projections for the [rc_and]    *)
(* case.  Hence the *only* unproved content is [rcd_case_statement].      *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Section FromRcd.

Hypothesis Hrcd : rcd_case_statement.

Lemma real_from_rcd : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T:typ),
  inert G ->
  binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
  record_type U ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->

Definition rcd_case_statement : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T:typ) (D:dec),
    inert G ->
    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
    record_type U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
    G ⊢ T <: typ_rcd D ->
    G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* Reduction: the [typ_rcd] case implies the general [rc] statement.      *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* The proof is a straightforward induction on the [rc] witness, using    *)
(* only transitivity and the intersection projections for the [rc_and]    *)
(* case.  Hence the *only* unproved content is [rcd_case_statement].      *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Section FromRcd.

Hypothesis Hrcd : rcd_case_statement.

Lemma real_from_rcd : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T:typ),
  inert G ->
  binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
  record_type U ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
  forall (R:typ), rc R -> G ⊢ T <: R -> G ⊢ open x U <: R.
Proof.
  intros G x U T Hi Hb Hrt Hty R HR.
  induction HR as [| D | R1 R2 HR1 IH1 HR2 IH2]; intros Hsub.
  - (* rc_top *) apply subtyp_top.
  - (* rc_rcd *) eapply Hrcd; eassumption.
  - (* rc_and *) apply subtyp_and2.
    + apply IH1. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub | apply subtyp_and11].
    + apply IH2. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub | apply subtyp_and12].
Qed.

(* The exact theorem requested by the task, conditional on the isolated
   [typ_rcd] case. *)
Theorem ty_var_bnd_real_of_rcd : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T R:typ),
  inert G ->
  binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
  record_type U ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
  rc R ->
  G ⊢ T <: R ->
  G ⊢ open x U <: R.
Proof.
  intros G x U T R Hi Hb Hrt Hty HR Hsub.
  eapply real_from_rcd; eassumption.
Qed.

(* The requested corollary, conditional on the isolated [typ_rcd] case. *)
Lemma ty_var_record_sub_of_rcd : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),
  inert G ->
  binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->
  G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.
Proof.
  intros G x U D Hi Hb Hty.
  pose proof (@inert_bnd_record_type G x U Hi Hb) as Hrt.
  eapply Hrcd with (T := typ_rcd D) (D := D).
  - exact Hi.
  - exact Hb.
  - exact Hrt.
  - exact Hty.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
Qed.

End FromRcd.

Definition bracket (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has T (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
    G ⊢ Sl <: Al /\ G ⊢ Au <: Su.

Definition compat (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
  nobot T /\ bracket G a Al Au T.

(* The context hypothesis that selection flows are impossible. *)
Definition no_ty_member_typings (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (x:var) (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
    ~ (G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)).

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Preservation of [compat] by subtyping, in a context with no type-member *)
(* record typings (so that [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] can never fire).    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma compat_closure : forall (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au:typ) (S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  G ⊢ S <: U ->
  compat G a Al Au S ->
  compat G a Al Au U.
Proof.
  intros G a Al Au S U Hns Hsub.
  induction Hsub; intros Hc; cbn [compat nobot bracket] in *.
  - (* subtyp_top *) split; [exact I|]. intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_bot *) destruct Hc as [Hn _]. exact (False_rect _ Hn).
  - (* subtyp_refl *) exact Hc.
  - (* subtyp_trans *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb].
    apply IHHsubtyp2. apply IHHsubtyp1. split; [exact Hn|exact Hb].
  - (* subtyp_and11 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
    + exact (proj1 Hn).
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andl. exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_and12 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
    + exact (proj2 Hn).
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andr. exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
    assert (IH1 := IHHsubtyp1 Hc).
    assert (IH2 := IHHsubtyp2 Hc).
    destruct IH1 as [Hn1 Hb1]. destruct IH2 as [Hn2 Hb2]. split.
    + split; assumption.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh.
      destruct Hrh as [Hrh|Hrh]; [apply Hb1|apply Hb2]; exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_fld *)
    destruct Hc as [_ Hb]. split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh.
      inversion Hrh; subst.
      pose proof (proj1 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hlow.
      pose proof (proj2 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hup.
      split; [eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption|eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption].
  - (* subtyp_typ *) split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. discriminate Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_sel2 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_sel1 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_all *) split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The main field lemmas under [no_ty_member_typings].                    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Theorem field_cov_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.
  intros G V a Tf S U Hns Hrt Hrh Hsub.
  pose proof (@record_type_bracket G V a Tf Hrt Hrh) as Hb.
  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
                Hns Hsub (conj I Hb)) as Hfinal.
  destruct Hfinal as [_ HbU].
  exact (proj2 (HbU S U (rh_one (dec_trm a S U)))).
Qed.

Theorem field_contr_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ S <: Tf.
Proof.
  intros G V a Tf S U Hns Hrt Hrh Hsub.
  pose proof (@record_type_bracket G V a Tf Hrt Hrh) as Hb.
  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
                Hns Hsub (conj I Hb)) as Hfinal.
  destruct Hfinal as [_ HbU].
  exact (proj1 (HbU S U (rh_one (dec_trm a S U)))).
Qed.

Qed.

Lemma record_type_bracket : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf:typ),
  record_type V -> record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has V (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
    G ⊢ Sl <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: Su.
Proof.
  intros G V a Tf [ls Hrt] Hrh Sl Su Hrh2.
  pose proof (@record_typ_trm_unique V ls a Tf Tf Sl Su Hrt Hrh Hrh2)
    as [E1 E2].
  subst. split; apply subtyp_refl.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_nobot : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> True.
Proof. intros; exact I. Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* A "no bottom in the record/intersection structure" predicate and the   *)
(* label-indexed bracket predicate.                                       *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* [compat G a Al Au T] says: T contains no bottom in the positions       *)
(* traversed by [record_has], and every [a]-member of T brackets the      *)
(* (source) bounds [Al..Au].  This predicate is designed so that it is    *)
(* preserved by subtyping in the absence of selection flows, while still  *)
(* being false at [typ_bot].  The [nobot] component is what makes the     *)
(* [and11]/[and12] cases (and the [subtyp_bot] case) go through.          *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Fixpoint nobot (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_and T1 T2 => nobot T1 /\ nobot T2
  | _ => True
  end.

Definition bracket (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has T (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
    G ⊢ Sl <: Al /\ G ⊢ Au <: Su.

Definition compat (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
  nobot T /\ bracket G a Al Au T.

(* The context hypothesis that selection flows are impossible. *)
Definition no_ty_member_typings (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (x:var) (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
    ~ (G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)).

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Preservation of [compat] by subtyping, in a context with no type-member *)
(* record typings (so that [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] can never fire).    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma compat_closure : forall (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au:typ) (S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  G ⊢ S <: U ->
  compat G a Al Au S ->
  compat G a Al Au U.
Proof.
  intros G a Al Au S U Hns Hsub.
  induction Hsub; intros Hc; cbn [compat nobot bracket] in *.
  - (* subtyp_top *) split; [exact I|]. intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_bot *) destruct Hc as [Hn _]. exact (False_rect _ Hn).
  - (* subtyp_refl *) exact Hc.
  - (* subtyp_trans *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb].
    apply IHHsubtyp2. apply IHHsubtyp1. split; [exact Hn|exact Hb].
  - (* subtyp_and11 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
    + exact (proj1 Hn).
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andl. exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_and12 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
    + exact (proj2 Hn).
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andr. exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
    assert (IH1 := IHHsubtyp1 Hc).
    assert (IH2 := IHHsubtyp2 Hc).
    destruct IH1 as [Hn1 Hb1]. destruct IH2 as [Hn2 Hb2]. split.
    + split; assumption.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh.
      destruct Hrh as [Hrh|Hrh]; [apply Hb1|apply Hb2]; exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_fld *)
    destruct Hc as [_ Hb]. split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh.
      inversion Hrh; subst.
      pose proof (proj1 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hlow.
      pose proof (proj2 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hup.
      split; [eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption|eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption].
  - (* subtyp_typ *) split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. discriminate Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_sel2 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_sel1 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_all *) split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The main field lemmas under [no_ty_member_typings].                    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Theorem field_cov_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.
  intros G V a Tf S U Hns Hrt Hrh Hsub.
  pose proof (@record_type_bracket G V a Tf Hrt Hrh) as Hb.
  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
                Hns Hsub (conj I Hb)) as Hfinal.
  destruct Hfinal as [_ HbU].
  exact (proj2 (HbU S U (rh_one (dec_trm a S U)))).
Qed.

Theorem field_contr_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ S <: Tf.
Proof.
  intros G V a Tf S U Hns Hrt Hrh Hsub.
  pose proof (@record_type_bracket G V a Tf Hrt Hrh) as Hb.
  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
                Hns Hsub (conj I Hb)) as Hfinal.
  destruct Hfinal as [_ HbU].
  exact (proj1 (HbU S U (rh_one (dec_trm a S U)))).
Qed.

(* The combined pair statement. *)
Theorem field_pair_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ S <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.
  intros. split.
  - eapply field_contr_no_ty_member; eassumption.
  - eapply field_cov_no_ty_member; eassumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The empty context satisfies the hypothesis, so both lemmas hold there. *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma empty_typing_var_false : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T -> G = empty -> forall (x:var), t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  pose proof (proj1 (rules_mutind
    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
       G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False)
    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (_:G ⊢ S <: U) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True)))
    as Hty.
  - exact (Hty G t T H).
  - (* typing rules *)
    intros; try (match goal with
                 | b : binds ?x ?v ?G, He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
                     rewrite He in b; exact (binds_empty_inv b)
                 | IH : ?G = empty -> forall y, ?t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> False,
                   He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
                     exfalso; eapply IH; [exact He | first [eassumption | reflexivity]]
                 | H : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- False => discriminate H
                 | H : trm_var (avar_f _) = ?t |- False => discriminate H
                 end).
  - (* literal rules *) intros; exact I.
  - (* subtyping rules *) intros; exact I.
  - (* avar rules *) intros; exact I.
Qed.

Lemma no_ty_member_typings_empty : no_ty_member_typings empty.
Proof.
  intros x A S T Hty.
  eapply (@empty_typing_var_false empty (trm_var (avar_f x))
            (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T))); [exact Hty|reflexivity|reflexivity].
Qed.

Theorem field_cov_inert_empty : forall (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
  inert empty ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  empty ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.
  intros. eapply field_cov_no_ty_member; [exact no_ty_member_typings_empty|eassumption..].
Qed.

Theorem field_contr_inert_empty : forall (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
  inert empty ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  empty ⊢ S <: Tf.
Proof.
  intros. eapply field_contr_no_ty_member; [exact no_ty_member_typings_empty|eassumption..].
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Status of the general inert statements and the precise remaining       *)
(* subgoal.                                                               *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* Under [inert G] the only missing ingredient is the following           *)
(* coherence property for type members of an inert [typ_bnd] binding.     *)
(*                                                                        *)
(*   TypeMemberCoherence:                                                 *)
(*     forall G x U A S1 T1 S2 T2,                                        *)
(*       inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U ->             *)
(*       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) ->            *)
(*       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2) ->            *)
(*       S1 <: T2.                                                        *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* Indeed [record_type] gives a unique equal bound [W] at the label [A]   *)
(* in [U]; after opening, any record typing of [x] at [dec_typ A S T]    *)
(* must be obtained by widening a flow tip of [open x U], which forces    *)
(* S <: W <: T.  Two typings therefore give S1 <: W <: T2.  This is       *)
(* exactly the type-member analogue of the two field lemmas we prove      *)
(* above, and it has the same proof shape (the [compat] preservation      *)
(* argument of [compat_closure], with [bracket] replaced by a             *)
(* type-label bracket and the [sel2]/[sel1] cases discharged by the       *)
(* typing induction instead of by vacuity).  The general inert versions   *)
(* of [field_cov_inert]/[field_contr_inert] then follow by the             *)
(* [compat] closure argument, defining [compat] on [typ_sel] types via    *)
(* the canonical member bound [W] of the variable's inert binding.        *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* The obstruction is genuinely a mutual induction: in                    *)
(* [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] the typing premise is not a subderivation  *)
(* of the subtyping tree, so the induction must be taken over             *)
(* [rules_mutind] (typing and subtyping simultaneously), with a typing    *)
(* motive producing [TypeMemberCoherence].  The [ty_sub] case of that     *)
(* motive needs the [compat] preservation above for a *type-label*        *)
(* bracket, and the [ty_rec_intro]/[ty_rec_elim] cases need the           *)
(* body/opening correspondence [typ_bnd W -> open x W].  The auxiliary    *)
(* negative result [bnd_companion_not_unique] (RootSub.v) shows that      *)
(* the body [W] cannot be recovered by uniqueness, which is why the       *)
(* motive has to be type-directed.                                        *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Check field_cov_no_ty_member.
Check field_contr_no_ty_member.
Check field_pair_no_ty_member.
Check field_cov_inert_empty.
Check field_contr_inert_empty.
Check inert_no_bad_type_member_binds.

Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* The inert-restricted field-subtyping variants.                        *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* The two target lemmas are [field_cov_inert] and [field_contr_inert].   *)
(* Below we prove:                                                        *)
(*   (1) inertness really does exclude the bad asymmetric type-member    *)
(*       binding used in FieldSub2.v;                                      *)
(*   (2) both target lemmas in full, under the (stronger than inert)      *)
(*       assumption that the context derives no record typing of a        *)
(*       variable at a type member [dec_typ A S T].  This hypothesis is   *)
(*       exactly what is needed to make selections impossible; it is      *)
(*       satisfied by the empty context, giving both lemmas for [empty].  *)
(*   (3) the precise remaining subgoal for the general inert case: the    *)
(*       coherence of the type-member bounds of an inert [typ_bnd]        *)
(*       binding (see the comment at the end of the file).                *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* (1) The bad binding is impossible under inertness.                     *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma inert_no_rcd_binds : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (D:dec),
  inert G -> binds x (typ_rcd D) G -> False.
Proof.
  intros G x D Hi Hb.
  pose proof (@inert_binds_inert_typ G x (typ_rcd D) Hi Hb) as Ht.
  exact (@inert_typ_not_rcd D Ht).
Qed.

Lemma inert_no_bad_type_member_binds : forall (G:ctx) (x:var)
    (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
  inert G -> binds x (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) G -> False.
Proof.
  intros. eapply inert_no_rcd_binds; eassumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Structural facts about record types.                                   *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma record_typ_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros T ls D Hrt. induction Hrt as
    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ]; intros Hrh.
  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. subst D. exact Hdec.
  - apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh. destruct Hrh as [Hl|Hr].
    + eapply IH. exact Hl.
    + apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hr. subst D. exact Hdec.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (D:dec),
  record_type T -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros T D [ls Hrt] Hrh. eapply (@record_typ_has_dec T ls D); eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_has_equal_bounds : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
  record_type T -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U) -> S = U.
Proof.
  intros T a S U Hrt Hrh.
  pose proof (@record_type_has_dec T (dec_trm a S U) Hrt Hrh) as Hdec.
  inversion Hdec; subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Two [record_has] members of a record type with the same label are the
   same member.  This is the uniqueness needed to turn the equal-bound
   fact for one member into the bounds bracket for every member. *)

Lemma record_typ_trm_unique : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (a:trm_label)
    (T1 U1 T2 U2:typ),
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_has T (dec_trm a T1 U1) ->
  record_has T (dec_trm a T2 U2) ->
  T1 = T2 /\ U1 = U2.
Proof.
  intros T ls a T1 U1 T2 U2 Hrt.
  induction Hrt as [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ];
    intros H1 H2.
  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
    apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
    assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
    { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
    inversion E. auto.
  - apply record_has_and_inv in H1.
    apply record_has_and_inv in H2.
    destruct H1 as [H1|H1]; destruct H2 as [H2|H2].
    + eapply IH; eassumption.
    + (* H1 in T0, H2 in the right component *)
      exfalso.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T1 U1) H1) as Hin.
      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1) = l).
      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2)).
        - cbn. reflexivity.
        - rewrite H2. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
    + (* H1 in the right component, H2 in T0 *)
      exfalso.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T2 U2) H2) as Hin.
      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2) = l).
      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1)).
        - cbn. reflexivity.
        - rewrite H1. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
    + (* both in the right component *)
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
      assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
      { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
      inversion E. auto.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_bracket : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf:typ),
  record_type V -> record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has V (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
    G ⊢ Sl <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: Su.
Proof.
  intros G V a Tf [ls Hrt] Hrh Sl Su Hrh2.
  pose proof (@record_typ_trm_unique V ls a Tf Tf Sl Su Hrt Hrh Hrh2)
    as [E1 E2].
  subst. split; apply subtyp_refl.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_nobot : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> True.
Proof. intros; exact I. Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* A "no bottom in the record/intersection structure" predicate and the   *)
(* label-indexed bracket predicate.                                       *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* [compat G a Al Au T] says: T contains no bottom in the positions       *)
(* traversed by [record_has], and every [a]-member of T brackets the      *)
(* (source) bounds [Al..Au].  This predicate is designed so that it is    *)
(* preserved by subtyping in the absence of selection flows, while still  *)
(* being false at [typ_bot].  The [nobot] component is what makes the     *)
(* [and11]/[and12] cases (and the [subtyp_bot] case) go through.          *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Fixpoint nobot (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_and T1 T2 => nobot T1 /\ nobot T2
  | _ => True
  end.

Definition bracket (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has T (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
    G ⊢ Sl <: Al /\ G ⊢ Au <: Su.

Definition compat (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
  nobot T /\ bracket G a Al Au T.

(* The context hypothesis that selection flows are impossible. *)
Definition no_ty_member_typings (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (x:var) (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
    ~ (G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)).

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Preservation of [compat] by subtyping, in a context with no type-member *)
(* record typings (so that [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] can never fire).    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma compat_closure : forall (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au:typ) (S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  G ⊢ S <: U ->
  compat G a Al Au S ->
  compat G a Al Au U.
Proof.
  intros G a Al Au S U Hns Hsub.
  induction Hsub; intros Hc; cbn [compat nobot bracket] in *.
  - (* subtyp_top *) split; [exact I|]. intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_bot *) destruct Hc as [Hn _]. exact (False_rect _ Hn).
  - (* subtyp_refl *) exact Hc.
  - (* subtyp_trans *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb].
    apply IHHsub0.
    + exact Hns.
    + apply IHHsub; [exact Hns | split; [exact Hn|exact Hb]].
  - (* subtyp_and11 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
    + exact (proj1 Hn).
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andl. exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_and12 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
    + exact (proj2 Hn).
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andr. exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
    assert (IH1 := IHHsub Hns Hc).
    assert (IH2 := IHHsub0 Hns Hc).
    destruct IH1 as [Hn1 Hb1]. destruct IH2 as [Hn2 Hb2]. split.
    + split; assumption.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh.
      destruct Hrh as [Hrh|Hrh]; [apply Hb1|apply Hb2]; exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_fld *)
    destruct Hc as [_ Hb]. split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh.
      inversion Hrh; subst.
      pose proof (proj1 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hlow.
      pose proof (proj2 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hup.
      split; [eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption|eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption].
  - (* subtyp_typ *) split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. discriminate Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_sel2 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_sel1 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_all *) split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The main field lemmas under [no_ty_member_typings].                    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Theorem field_cov_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.
  intros G V a Tf S U Hns Hrt Hrh Hsub.
  pose proof (@record_type_bracket G V a Tf Hrt Hrh) as Hb.
  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
                Hns Hsub (conj I Hb)) as Hfinal.
  destruct Hfinal as [_ HbU].
  exact (proj2 (HbU S U (rh_one (dec_trm a S U)))).
Qed.

Theorem field_contr_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ S <: Tf.
Proof.
  intros G V a Tf S U Hns Hrt Hrh Hsub.
  pose proof (@record_type_bracket G V a Tf Hrt Hrh) as Hb.
  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
                Hns Hsub (conj I Hb)) as Hfinal.
  destruct Hfinal as [_ HbU].
  exact (proj1 (HbU S U (rh_one (dec_trm a S U)))).
Qed.

(* The combined pair statement. *)
Theorem field_pair_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ S <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.
  intros. split.
  - eapply field_contr_no_ty_member; eassumption.
  - eapply field_cov_no_ty_member; eassumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The empty context satisfies the hypothesis, so both lemmas hold there. *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma empty_typing_var_false : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T -> G = empty -> forall (x:var), t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  pose proof (proj1 (rules_mutind
    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
       G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False)
    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (_:G ⊢ S <: U) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True)))
    as Hty.
  - exact (Hty G t T H).
  - (* typing rules *)
    intros; try (match goal with
                 | b : binds ?x ?v ?G, He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
                     rewrite He in b; exact (binds_empty_inv b)
                 | IH : ?G = empty -> forall y, ?t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> False,
                   He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
                     exfalso; eapply IH; [exact He | first [eassumption | reflexivity]]
                 | H : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- False => discriminate H
                 | H : trm_var (avar_f _) = ?t |- False => discriminate H
                 end).
  - (* literal rules *) intros; exact I.
  - (* subtyping rules *) intros; exact I.
  - (* avar rules *) intros; exact I.
Qed.

Lemma no_ty_member_typings_empty : no_ty_member_typings empty.
Proof.
  intros x A S T Hty.
  eapply (@empty_typing_var_false empty (trm_var (avar_f x))
            (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T))); [exact Hty|reflexivity|reflexivity].
Qed.

Theorem field_cov_inert_empty : forall (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
  inert empty ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  empty ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.
  intros. eapply field_cov_no_ty_member; [exact no_ty_member_typings_empty|eassumption..].
Qed.

Theorem field_contr_inert_empty : forall (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
  inert empty ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  empty ⊢ S <: Tf.
Proof.
  intros. eapply field_contr_no_ty_member; [exact no_ty_member_typings_empty|eassumption..].
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Status of the general inert statements and the precise remaining       *)
(* subgoal.                                                               *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* Under [inert G] the only missing ingredient is the following           *)
(* coherence property for type members of an inert [typ_bnd] binding.     *)
(*                                                                        *)
(*   TypeMemberCoherence:                                                 *)
(*     forall G x U A S1 T1 S2 T2,                                        *)
(*       inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U ->             *)
(*       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) ->            *)
(*       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2) ->            *)
(*       S1 <: T2.                                                        *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* Indeed [record_type] gives a unique equal bound [W] at the label [A]   *)
(* in [U]; after opening, any record typing of [x] at [dec_typ A S T]    *)
(* must be obtained by widening a flow tip of [open x U], which forces    *)
(* S <: W <: T.  Two typings therefore give S1 <: W <: T2.  This is       *)
(* exactly the type-member analogue of the two field lemmas we prove      *)
(* above, and it has the same proof shape (the [compat] preservation      *)
(* argument of [compat_closure], with [bracket] replaced by a             *)
(* type-label bracket and the [sel2]/[sel1] cases discharged by the       *)
(* typing induction instead of by vacuity).  The general inert versions   *)
(* of [field_cov_inert]/[field_contr_inert] then follow by the             *)
(* [compat] closure argument, defining [compat] on [typ_sel] types via    *)
(* the canonical member bound [W] of the variable's inert binding.        *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* The obstruction is genuinely a mutual induction: in                    *)
(* [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] the typing premise is not a subderivation  *)
(* of the subtyping tree, so the induction must be taken over             *)
(* [rules_mutind] (typing and subtyping simultaneously), with a typing    *)
(* motive producing [TypeMemberCoherence].  The [ty_sub] case of that     *)
(* motive needs the [compat] preservation above for a *type-label*        *)
(* bracket, and the [ty_rec_intro]/[ty_rec_elim] cases need the           *)
(* body/opening correspondence [typ_bnd W -> open x W].  The auxiliary    *)
(* negative result [bnd_companion_not_unique] (RootSub.v) shows that      *)
(* the body [W] cannot be recovered by uniqueness, which is why the       *)
(* motive has to be type-directed.                                        *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Check field_cov_no_ty_member.
Check field_contr_no_ty_member.
Check field_pair_no_ty_member.
Check field_cov_inert_empty.
Check field_contr_inert_empty.
Check inert_no_bad_type_member_binds.
