Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* Restricted statement under investigation.                            *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Definition field_lookup_sub_record_statement (a : trm_label) : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (Tf S U:typ),
    record_type V ->
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    G ⊢ Tf <: U.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* A variable name; [var] is an abstract parameter, but [var_fresh]     *)
(* provides one.  The term label [a] and the type-member label [A] are  *)
(* abstract parameters too; the refutation below is parametric in them. *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Definition x0 : var := proj1_sig (var_fresh \{}).

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* A soundness interpretation of types for the fixed context            *)
(*   G0 = x0 : typ_rcd (dec_typ A V Targ)                               *)
(* where V and Targ are closed record types.  The interpretation is     *)
(* the same simple one used in FieldSub.v: only [typ_bot] is false.     *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Fixpoint interp (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_rcd _ => True
  | typ_and T U => interp T /\ interp U
  | typ_sel _ _ => True
  | typ_bnd _ => True
  | typ_all _ _ => True
  | typ_con _ _ _ => True
  end.

(* [Inv T] records that a type is a "safe" type for the variable [x0]:
   it is true under [interp], every record type member [dec_typ] has a
   safe upper bound, and bound types are recursively safe at their
   opening.  It has no constructor for [typ_bot]. *)

Inductive Inv : typ -> Prop :=
| inv_top : Inv typ_top
| inv_rcd_trm : forall (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
    Inv (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
| inv_rcd_typ : forall (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
    Inv T -> Inv (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T))
| inv_and : forall (T U:typ),
    Inv T -> Inv U -> Inv (typ_and T U)
| inv_sel : forall (x:avar) (A:typ_label),
    Inv (typ_sel x A)
| inv_bnd : forall (T:typ),
    Inv (open x0 T) -> Inv (typ_bnd T)
| inv_all : forall (S T:typ), Inv (typ_all S T)
| inv_con : forall (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (T:typ),
    Inv (typ_con Ts is' T).

Lemma Inv_sound : forall (T:typ), Inv T -> interp T.
Proof.
  intros T H. induction H; cbn [interp]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Inv_rcd_typ_inv : forall (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
  Inv (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) -> Inv T.
Proof.
  intros A S T H. inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Inv_bnd_inv : forall (T:typ),
  Inv (typ_bnd T) -> Inv (open x0 T).
Proof.
  intros T H. inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Inv_not_bot : forall (T:typ), T = typ_bot -> Inv T -> False.
Proof.
  intros T E H. subst T. inversion H.
Qed.

Lemma trm_var_eq : forall (x y:var),
  trm_var (avar_f x) = trm_var (avar_f y) -> x = y.
Proof.
  intros x y E. inversion E; subst; reflexivity.
Qed.

Section Counterexample.

Variables (a : trm_label) (A : typ_label) (S0 : typ).

(* The source record type: a genuine [record_type] (indeed a closed one). *)
Definition Vc : typ := typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top).

(* The target record type; its upper bound is fixed to [typ_bot], while  *)
(* its lower bound [S0] is a parameter (needed for the S = U variant).    *)
Definition Targc : typ := typ_rcd (dec_trm a S0 typ_bot).

(* The (bad-bounds) binding of [x0]. *)
Definition RVc : typ := typ_rcd (dec_typ A Vc Targc).

Definition Gc : ctx := x0 ~ RVc.

Lemma record_type_Vc : record_type Vc.
Proof.
  unfold Vc.
  exists (\{label_trm a}).
  eapply rt_one.
  - apply rd_trm.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_has_Vc : record_has Vc (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top).
Proof.
  unfold Vc. apply rh_one.
Qed.

Lemma binds_Gc : binds x0 RVc Gc.
Proof. unfold Gc. apply binds_single_eq. Qed.

(* Vc <: x0.A via sel2, and x0.A <: Targc via sel1, hence Vc <: Targc. *)
Lemma sub_Vc_Targc : Gc ⊢ Vc <: Targc.
Proof.
  eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_sel (avar_f x0) A).
  - eapply subtyp_sel2. apply ty_var. exact binds_Gc.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1. apply ty_var. exact binds_Gc.
Qed.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* Main soundness/typing-invariant induction for the context [Gc].      *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Lemma Gc_typing_sub_sound :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
     G = Gc -> forall y, t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> y = x0 /\ Inv T) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U ->
     G = Gc -> (interp S -> interp U) /\ (Inv S -> Inv U)) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).
Proof.
  apply (rules_mutind
    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
       G = Gc -> forall y, t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> y = x0 /\ Inv T)
    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (_:G ⊢ S <: U) =>
       G = Gc -> (interp S -> interp U) /\ (Inv S -> Inv U))
    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True)).
  - (* ty_var *)
    intros G x T b H y E. subst G.
    assert (Exy : x = y) by (apply trm_var_eq; exact E). subst y.
    apply binds_single_inv in b. destruct b as [Ex ET].
    subst x. subst T.
    split.
    + reflexivity.
    + apply inv_rcd_typ, inv_rcd_trm.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros G x z S T p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_new *) intros G x avs xs Ts is' T p IH1 p2 IH2 p3 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_rcd_elim *) intros G x a0 S T p IH1 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_fld_asn *) intros G x y0 a0 S T p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_let *) intros L G t u T U p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_llit *) intros L G l u T U p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *)
    intros G x T p IH H y E.
    assert (Exy : x = y) by (apply trm_var_eq; exact E). subst y.
    destruct (IH H x eq_refl) as [Ex Hinv].
    subst x. split; [reflexivity | apply inv_bnd; exact Hinv].
  - (* ty_rec_elim *)
    intros G x T p IH H y E.
    assert (Exy : x = y) by (apply trm_var_eq; exact E). subst y.
    destruct (IH H x eq_refl) as [Ex Hinv].
    subst x. split; [reflexivity | apply Inv_bnd_inv in Hinv; exact Hinv].
  - (* ty_and_intro *)
    intros G x T U p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E.
    assert (Exy : x = y) by (apply trm_var_eq; exact E). subst y.
    destruct (IH1 H x eq_refl) as [Ex Hinv1].
    destruct (IH2 H x eq_refl) as [_ Hinv2].
    subst x. split; [reflexivity | apply inv_and; assumption].
  - (* ty_sub *)
    intros G t T U p IH1 s IH2 H y E.
    destruct (IH1 H y E) as [Ex HinvT].
    split; [exact Ex | apply (proj2 (IH2 H)); exact HinvT].
  - (* ty_all_intro *) intros; exact I.
  - (* ty_con_intro *) intros; exact I.
  - (* subtyp_top *)
    intros G T H. split; [intros _; exact I | intros _; apply inv_top].
  - (* subtyp_bot *)
    intros G T H. split.
    + intros HI. cbn [interp] in HI. destruct HI.
    + intros HI. inversion HI.
  - (* subtyp_refl *)
    intros G T H. split; intros; assumption.
  - (* subtyp_trans *)
    intros G S T U s IH1 s0 IH2 H.
    destruct (IH1 H) as [Hi1 Hi2]. destruct (IH2 H) as [Hj1 Hj2].
    split; intros; [apply Hj1, Hi1 | apply Hj2, Hi2]; assumption.
  - (* subtyp_and11 *)
    intros G T U H. split.
    + intros HI. cbn [interp] in HI. tauto.
    + intros HI. inversion HI; subst; assumption.
  - (* subtyp_and12 *)
    intros G T U H. split.
    + intros HI. cbn [interp] in HI. tauto.
    + intros HI. inversion HI; subst; assumption.
  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
    intros G S T U s IH1 s0 IH2 H.
    destruct (IH1 H) as [Hi1 Hi2]. destruct (IH2 H) as [Hj1 Hj2].
    split.
    + intros HS. split; [apply Hi1 | apply Hj1]; exact HS.
    + intros HS. apply inv_and; [apply Hi2 | apply Hj2]; exact HS.
  - (* subtyp_fld *)
    intros G a0 T1 T2 U1 U2 s IH1 s0 IH2 H.
    split; intros; [exact I | apply inv_rcd_trm].
  - (* subtyp_typ *)
    intros G A0 S1 T1 S2 T2 s IH1 s0 IH2 H.
    split.
    + intros _; exact I.
    + intros HI. apply Inv_rcd_typ_inv in HI.
      apply inv_rcd_typ. apply (proj2 (IH2 H)). exact HI.
  - (* subtyp_sel2 *)
    intros G x A0 S T p IHty H.
    split; intros; [exact I | apply inv_sel].
  - (* subtyp_sel1 *)
    intros G x A0 S T p IHty H.
    destruct (IHty H x eq_refl) as [_ Hinv].
    apply Inv_rcd_typ_inv in Hinv.
    split; intros; [apply Inv_sound; exact Hinv | exact Hinv].
  - (* subtyp_all *)
    intros L G S1 T1 S2 T2 s IH1 s0 IH2 H.
    split; intros; [exact I | apply inv_all].
  - (* typ_avars_nil *) intros; exact I.
  - (* typ_avars_cons *) intros; exact I.
Qed.

(* In [Gc] the empty-bounds subtyping [top <: bot] is not derivable. *)
Lemma Gc_not_top_sub_bot : ~ (Gc ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot).
Proof.
  intro Hsub.
  pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (Gc_typing_sub_sound)))
                Gc typ_top typ_bot Hsub eq_refl) as Hconj.
  destruct Hconj as [Hi _].
  cbn [interp] in Hi.
  exact (Hi I).
Qed.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* The counterexample refutes the restricted statement.                 *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Theorem field_lookup_sub_record_refuted :
  ~ field_lookup_sub_record_statement a.
Proof.
  intro Hstmt.
  specialize (Hstmt Gc Vc typ_top S0 typ_bot).
  assert (Hconc : Gc ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot).
  { eapply Hstmt.
    - exact record_type_Vc.
    - exact record_has_Vc.
    - exact sub_Vc_Targc. }
  exact (Gc_not_top_sub_bot Hconc).
Qed.

End Counterexample.

(* The statement fails for every term-label and every element of the    *)
(* abstract type-label parameter (which is what is needed to build a    *)
(* context with a type member).                                         *)
Theorem field_lookup_sub_record_refuted_all :
  forall (a : trm_label) (A : typ_label),
    ~ field_lookup_sub_record_statement a.
Proof.
  intros a A. exact (field_lookup_sub_record_refuted a A typ_top).
Qed.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* Variant: the target record has equal bounds (S = U).  The same       *)
(* bad-bounds context refutes it.                                       *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Definition field_lookup_sub_record_eq_statement (a : trm_label) : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (Tf S:typ),
    record_type V ->
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S S) ->
    G ⊢ Tf <: S.

Theorem field_lookup_sub_record_eq_refuted :
  forall (a : trm_label) (A : typ_label),
    ~ field_lookup_sub_record_eq_statement a.
Proof.
  intros a A Hstmt.
  specialize (Hstmt (Gc a A typ_bot) (Vc a) typ_top typ_bot).
  assert (Hconc : Gc a A typ_bot ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot).
  { eapply Hstmt.
    - exact (record_type_Vc a).
    - exact (record_has_Vc a).
    - exact (sub_Vc_Targc a A typ_bot). }
  exact (Gc_not_top_sub_bot a A typ_bot Hconc).
Qed.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* Variant: [rc V] (closure of records/top under intersections) instead *)
(* of [record_type V].  This hypothesis is weaker, and the same         *)
(* counterexample satisfies it.                                         *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Inductive rc : typ -> Prop :=
| rc_top : rc typ_top
| rc_rcd : forall (D:dec), rc (typ_rcd D)
| rc_and : forall (T U:typ), rc T -> rc U -> rc (typ_and T U).

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* The statement of the proposed lemma, with the label [a] fixed.        *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Definition field_lookup_sub_statement (a : trm_label) : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (Tf S U:typ),
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    G ⊢ Tf <: U.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* A tiny "soundness" interpretation of types, used only to show that    *)
(* the empty context cannot prove [typ_top <: typ_bot].                  *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Fixpoint interp (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_rcd _ => True
  | typ_and T U => interp T /\ interp U
  | typ_sel _ _ => True
  | typ_bnd _ => True
  | typ_all _ _ => True
  | typ_con _ _ _ => True
  end.

(* In the empty context no variable can be typed, and every subtyping   *)
(* derivation is sound for [interp].  In particular the empty context    *)
(* proves no [typ_top <: typ_bot].  The proof is a mutual induction on   *)
(* the typing/subtyping derivation; [sel2]/[sel1] are handled by the    *)
(* fact that their typing premise is a variable typing in the empty      *)
(* context, which is impossible.                                         *)

Lemma empty_typing_sub_sound :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
     G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (T U:typ), G ⊢ T <: U ->
     G = empty -> interp T -> interp U) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).
Proof.
  apply (rules_mutind
    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
       G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False)
    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (T U:typ) (_:G ⊢ T <: U) =>
       G = empty -> interp T -> interp U)
    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True));
  intros;
  try solve [cbn [interp] in *; tauto];
  try (match goal with
       | H : binds ?x ?v ?G, He : ?G = empty |- False =>
           rewrite He in H; exact (binds_empty_inv H)
       end);
  try (match goal with
       | H : ?G = empty -> forall y, ?t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> False,
         He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
           exfalso; eapply H; [exact He | first [eassumption | reflexivity]]
       end);
  try (match goal with H : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- False => discriminate H end);
  try (match goal with H : trm_var (avar_f _) = ?t |- False => discriminate H end).
Qed.

Lemma empty_not_top_sub_bot : ~ (empty ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot).
Proof.
  intro H.
  pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 empty_typing_sub_sound))
                empty typ_top typ_bot H) as Hsub.
  cbn [interp] in Hsub.
  apply Hsub; [reflexivity | exact I].
Qed.

(* Refutation of the proposed lemma.                                     *)
(*                                                                       *)
(* Take [G = empty] and                                                     *)
(*   V  = typ_and typ_bot (typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top))          *)
(*   Tf = typ_top,  S = typ_top,  U = typ_bot.                          *)
(*                                                                       *)
(* Both premises hold:                                                   *)
(*  - [record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf)] by [rh_andr]/[rh_one];            *)
(*  - [empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_bot)] by             *)
(*    [subtyp_and11] (V <: typ_bot) followed by [subtyp_bot] and         *)
(*    [subtyp_trans]; this uses no variables at all.                     *)
(*                                                                       *)
(* But the conclusion would be [empty ⊢ typ_top <: typ_bot], which is    *)
(* refuted by [empty_not_top_sub_bot].  Thus the lemma is false.         *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Theorem field_lookup_sub_refuted :
  forall (a : trm_label), ~ field_lookup_sub_statement a.
Proof.
  intros a Hstmt.
  apply empty_not_top_sub_bot.
  eapply Hstmt with
    (V := typ_and typ_bot (typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top)))
    (S := typ_top).
  - apply rh_andr, rh_one.
  - eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_bot).
    + apply subtyp_and11.
    + apply subtyp_bot.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Typing.

Implicit Types (ds : defs) (hds : heap_defs).

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ A T T)
| rd_trm : forall a T, record_dec (dec_trm a T T).

Inductive record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D.

Section HasntNotIn.

Context {A : Set} `{LA : LabelOf A} `{DTA : DecTyping A}.

Context {DTL : DecTypingLabels DTA}.

End HasntNotIn.

Section RecordHasTyDefs.

Context {A : Set} `{LA : LabelOf A} `{DTA : DecTyping A}.

End RecordHasTyDefs.
======INERT======
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax RecordTypes.

Inductive inert_typ : typ -> Prop :=
  | inert_typ_all : forall S T, inert_typ (typ_all S T)
  | inert_typ_con :
      forall Ts is' T,
        record_type T ->
        inert_typ (typ_con Ts is' T)
  | inert_typ_bnd : forall T,
      record_type T ->
      inert_typ (typ_bnd T).

Inductive inert : ctx -> Prop :=
  | inert_empty : inert empty
  | inert_all : forall G x T,
      inert G ->
      inert_typ T ->
      x # G ->
      inert (G & x ~ T).

22	(*       binding (see the comment at the end of the file).                *)
23	(* ====================================================================== *)
24	
25	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
26	(* (1) The bad binding is impossible under inertness.                     *)
27	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
28	
29	Lemma inert_no_rcd_binds : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (D:dec),
30	  inert G -> binds x (typ_rcd D) G -> False.
31	Proof.
32	  intros G x D Hi Hb.
33	  pose proof (@inert_binds_inert_typ G x (typ_rcd D) Hi Hb) as Ht.
34	  exact (@inert_typ_not_rcd D Ht).
35	Qed.
36	
37	Lemma inert_no_bad_type_member_binds : forall (G:ctx) (x:var)
38	    (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
39	  inert G -> binds x (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) G -> False.
40	Proof.
41	  intros. eapply inert_no_rcd_binds; eassumption.
42	Qed.
43	
44	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
45	(* Structural facts about record types.                                   *)
46	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
47	
48	Lemma record_typ_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
49	  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
50	Proof.
51	  intros T ls D Hrt. induction Hrt as
52	    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ]; intros Hrh.
53	  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. subst D. exact Hdec.
54	  - apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh. destruct Hrh as [Hl|Hr].
55	    + eapply IH. exact Hl.
56	    + apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hr. subst D. exact Hdec.
57	Qed.
58	
59	Lemma record_type_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (D:dec),
60	  record_type T -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
61	Proof.
62	  intros T D [ls Hrt] Hrh. eapply (@record_typ_has_dec T ls D); eassumption.
63	Qed.
64	
65	Lemma record_type_has_equal_bounds : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
66	  record_type T -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U) -> S = U.
67	Proof.
68	  intros T a S U Hrt Hrh.
69	  pose proof (@record_type_has_dec T (dec_trm a S U) Hrt Hrh) as Hdec.
70	  inversion Hdec; subst. reflexivity.
71	Qed.
72	
73	(* Two [record_has] members of a record type with the same label are the
74	   same member.  This is the uniqueness needed to turn the equal-bound
75	   fact for one member into the bounds bracket for every member. *)
76	
77	Lemma record_typ_trm_unique : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (a:trm_label)
78	    (T1 U1 T2 U2:typ),
79	  record_typ T ls ->
80	  record_has T (dec_trm a T1 U1) ->
81	  record_has T (dec_trm a T2 U2) ->
82	  T1 = T2 /\ U1 = U2.
83	Proof.
84	  intros T ls a T1 U1 T2 U2 Hrt.
85	  induction Hrt as [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ];
86	    intros H1 H2.
87	  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
88	    apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
89	    assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
90	    { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
91	    inversion E. auto.
92	  - apply record_has_and_inv in H1.
93	    apply record_has_and_inv in H2.
94	    destruct H1 as [H1|H1]; destruct H2 as [H2|H2].
95	    + eapply IH; eassumption.
96	    + (* H1 in T0, H2 in the right component *)
97	      exfalso.
98	      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
99	      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T1 U1) H1) as Hin.
100	      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1) = l).
101	      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2)).
102	        - cbn. reflexivity.
103	        - rewrite H2. symmetry. exact Heq. }
104	      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
105	    + (* H1 in the right component, H2 in T0 *)
106	      exfalso.
107	      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
108	      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T2 U2) H2) as Hin.
109	      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2) = l).
110	      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1)).
111	        - cbn. reflexivity.
112	        - rewrite H1. symmetry. exact Heq. }
113	      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
114	    + (* both in the right component *)
115	      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
116	      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
117	      assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
118	      { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
119	      inversion E. auto.
120	Qed.
121	
122	Lemma record_type_bracket : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf:typ),
123	  record_type V -> record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
124	  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has V (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
125	    G ⊢ Sl <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: Su.
126	Proof.
127	  intros G V a Tf [ls Hrt] Hrh Sl Su Hrh2.
128	  pose proof (@record_typ_trm_unique V ls a Tf Tf Sl Su Hrt Hrh Hrh2)
129	    as [E1 E2].
130	  subst. split; apply subtyp_refl.
131	Qed.
132	
133	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
134	(* A "no bottom in the record/intersection structure" predicate and the   *)
135	(* label-indexed bracket predicate.                                       *)
136	(*                                                                        *)
137	(* [compat G a Al Au T] says: T contains no bottom in the positions       *)
138	(* traversed by [record_has], and every [a]-member of T brackets the      *)
139	(* (source) bounds [Al..Au].  This predicate is designed so that it is    *)
140	(* preserved by subtyping in the absence of selection flows, while still  *)
141	(* being false at [typ_bot].  The [nobot] component is what makes the     *)
142	(* [and11]/[and12] cases (and the [subtyp_bot] case) go through.          *)
143	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
144	
145	Fixpoint nobot (T:typ) : Prop :=
146	  match T with
147	  | typ_bot => False
148	  | typ_and T1 T2 => nobot T1 /\ nobot T2
149	  | _ => True
150	  end.
151	
152	Definition bracket (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
153	  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has T (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
154	    G ⊢ Sl <: Al /\ G ⊢ Au <: Su.
155	
156	Definition compat (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
157	  nobot T /\ bracket G a Al Au T.
158	
159	(* The context hypothesis that selection flows are impossible. *)
160	Definition no_ty_member_typings (G:ctx) : Prop :=
161	  forall (x:var) (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
162	    ~ (G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)).
163	
164	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
165	(* Preservation of [compat] by subtyping, in a context with no type-member *)
166	(* record typings (so that [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] can never fire).    *)
167	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
168	
169	Lemma compat_closure : forall (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au:typ) (S U:typ),
170	  no_ty_member_typings G ->
171	  G ⊢ S <: U ->
172	  compat G a Al Au S ->
173	  compat G a Al Au U.
174	Proof.
175	  intros G a Al Au S U Hns Hsub.
176	  induction Hsub; intros Hc; cbn [compat nobot bracket] in *.
177	  - (* subtyp_top *) split; [exact I|]. intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
178	  - (* subtyp_bot *) destruct Hc as [Hn _]. exact (False_rect _ Hn).
179	  - (* subtyp_refl *) exact Hc.
180	  - (* subtyp_trans *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb].
181	    apply IHHsub0.
182	    + exact Hns.
183	    + apply IHHsub; [exact Hns | split; [exact Hn|exact Hb]].
184	  - (* subtyp_and11 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
185	    + exact (proj1 Hn).
186	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andl. exact Hrh.
187	  - (* subtyp_and12 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
188	    + exact (proj2 Hn).
189	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andr. exact Hrh.
190	  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
191	    assert (IH1 := IHHsub Hns Hc).
192	    assert (IH2 := IHHsub0 Hns Hc).
193	    destruct IH1 as [Hn1 Hb1]. destruct IH2 as [Hn2 Hb2]. split.
194	    + split; assumption.
195	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh.
196	      destruct Hrh as [Hrh|Hrh]; [apply Hb1|apply Hb2]; exact Hrh.
197	  - (* subtyp_fld *)
198	    destruct Hc as [_ Hb]. split.
199	    + exact I.
200	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh.
201	      inversion Hrh; subst.
202	      pose proof (proj1 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hlow.
203	      pose proof (proj2 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hup.
204	      split; [eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption|eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption].
205	  - (* subtyp_typ *) split.
206	    + exact I.
207	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. discriminate Hrh.
208	  - (* subtyp_sel2 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
209	  - (* subtyp_sel1 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
210	  - (* subtyp_all *) split.
211	    + exact I.
212	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
213	Qed.
214	
215	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
216	(* The main field lemmas under [no_ty_member_typings].                    *)
217	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
218	
219	Theorem field_cov_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
220	    (Tf S U:typ),
221	  no_ty_member_typings G ->
222	  record_type V ->
223	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
224	  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
225	  G ⊢ Tf <: U.
226	Proof.
227	  intros G V a Tf S U Hns Hrt Hrh Hsub.
228	  pose proof (@record_type_bracket G V a Tf Hrt Hrh) as Hb.
229	  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
230	                Hns Hsub (conj I Hb)) as Hfinal.
231	  destruct Hfinal as [_ HbU].
232	  exact (proj2 (HbU S U (rh_one (dec_trm a S U)))).
233	Qed.
234	
235	Theorem field_contr_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
236	    (Tf S U:typ),
237	  no_ty_member_typings G ->
238	  record_type V ->
239	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
240	  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
241	  G ⊢ S <: Tf.
242	Proof.
243	  intros G V a Tf S U Hns Hrt Hrh Hsub.
244	  pose proof (@record_type_bracket G V a Tf Hrt Hrh) as Hb.
245	  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
246	                Hns Hsub (conj I Hb)) as Hfinal.
247	  destruct Hfinal as [_ HbU].
248	  exact (proj1 (HbU S U (rh_one (dec_trm a S U)))).
249	Qed.
250	
251	(* The combined pair statement. *)
252	Theorem field_pair_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
253	    (Tf S U:typ),
254	  no_ty_member_typings G ->
255	  record_type V ->
256	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
257	  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
258	  G ⊢ S <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: U.
259	Proof.
260	  intros. split.
261	  - eapply field_contr_no_ty_member; eassumption.
262	  - eapply field_cov_no_ty_member; eassumption.
263	Qed.
264	
265	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
266	(* The empty context satisfies the hypothesis, so both lemmas hold there. *)
267	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
268	
269	Lemma empty_typing_var_false : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
270	  G ⊢ t ∶ T -> G = empty -> forall (x:var), t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False.
271	Proof.
272	  intros G t T H.
273	  pose proof (proj1 (rules_mutind
274	    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
275	       G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False)
276	    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
277	    (fun (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (_:G ⊢ S <: U) => True)
278	    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True)))
279	    as Hty.
280	  - exact (Hty G t T H).
281	  - (* typing rules *)
282	    intros; try (match goal with
283	                 | b : binds ?x ?v ?G, He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
284	                     rewrite He in b; exact (binds_empty_inv b)
285	                 | IH : ?G = empty -> forall y, ?t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> False,
286	                   He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
287	                     exfalso; eapply IH; [exact He | first [eassumption | reflexivity]]
288	                 | H : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- False => discriminate H
289	                 | H : trm_var (avar_f _) = ?t |- False => discriminate H
290	                 end).
291	  - (* literal rules *) intros; exact I.
292	  - (* subtyping rules *) intros; exact I.
293	  - (* avar rules *) intros; exact I.
294	Qed.
295	
296	Lemma no_ty_member_typings_empty : no_ty_member_typings empty.
297	Proof.
298	  intros x A S T Hty.
299	  eapply (@empty_typing_var_false empty (trm_var (avar_f x))
300	            (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T))); [exact Hty|reflexivity|reflexivity].
301	Qed.
302	
303	Theorem field_cov_inert_empty : forall (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
304	  inert empty ->
305	  record_type V ->
306	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
307	  empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
308	  empty ⊢ Tf <: U.
309	Proof.
310	  intros. eapply field_cov_no_ty_member; [exact no_ty_member_typings_empty|eassumption..].
311	Qed.
312	
313	Theorem field_contr_inert_empty : forall (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
314	  inert empty ->
315	  record_type V ->
316	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
317	  empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
318	  empty ⊢ S <: Tf.
319	Proof.
320	  intros. eapply field_contr_no_ty_member; [exact no_ty_member_typings_empty|eassumption..].
321	Qed.
322	
323	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
324	(* Status of the general inert statements and the precise remaining       *)
325	(* subgoal.                                                               *)
326	(*                                                                        *)
327	(* Under [inert G] the only missing ingredient is the following           *)
328	(* coherence property for type members of an inert [typ_bnd] binding.     *)
329	(*                                                                        *)
330	(*   TypeMemberCoherence:                                                 *)
331	(*     forall G x U A S1 T1 S2 T2,                                        *)
332	(*       inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U ->             *)
333	(*       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) ->            *)
334	(*       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2) ->            *)
335	(*       S1 <: T2.                                                        *)
336	(*                                                                        *)
337	(* Indeed [record_type] gives a unique equal bound [W] at the label [A]   *)
338	(* in [U]; after opening, any record typing of [x] at [dec_typ A S T]    *)
339	(* must be obtained by widening a flow tip of [open x U], which forces    *)
340	(* S <: W <: T.  Two typings therefore give S1 <: W <: T2.  This is       *)
341	(* exactly the type-member analogue of the two field lemmas we prove      *)
342	(* above, and it has the same proof shape (the [compat] preservation      *)
343	(* argument of [compat_closure], with [bracket] replaced by a             *)
344	(* type-label bracket and the [sel2]/[sel1] cases discharged by the       *)
345	(* typing induction instead of by vacuity).  The general inert versions   *)
346	(* of [field_cov_inert]/[field_contr_inert] then follow by the             *)
347	(* [compat] closure argument, defining [compat] on [typ_sel] types via    *)
348	(* the canonical member bound [W] of the variable's inert binding.        *)
349	(*                                                                        *)
350	(* The obstruction is genuinely a mutual induction: in                    *)
351	(* [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] the typing premise is not a subderivation  *)
352	(* of the subtyping tree, so the induction must be taken over             *)
353	(* [rules_mutind] (typing and subtyping simultaneously), with a typing    *)
354	(* motive producing [TypeMemberCoherence].  The [ty_sub] case of that     *)
355	(* motive needs the [compat] preservation above for a *type-label*        *)
356	(* bracket, and the [ty_rec_intro]/[ty_rec_elim] cases need the           *)
357	(* body/opening correspondence [typ_bnd W -> open x W].  The auxiliary    *)
358	(* negative result [bnd_companion_not_unique] (RootSub.v) shows that      *)
359	(* the body [W] cannot be recovered by uniqueness, which is why the       *)
360	(* motive has to be type-directed.                                        *)
361	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
362	
363	Check field_cov_no_ty_member.
364	Check field_contr_no_ty_member.
365	Check field_pair_no_ty_member.
366	Check field_cov_inert_empty.
367	Check field_contr_inert_empty.
368	Check inert_no_bad_type_member_binds.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing.

Implicit Types (Gamma G : ctx) (T U : typ) (x y z : var) (t : trm).

Inductive ty_def : DecTyping def :=

| ty_def_typ : forall G A T,
    G ⊢ def_typ A T ∶d dec_typ A T T

| ty_def_trm : forall G a t T,
    G ⊢ def_trm a ∶d dec_trm a T T.

Existing Instance ty_def.

Inductive ty_trm : Typing trm :=

| ty_var : forall G x T,
    binds x T G ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T

| ty_all_elim : forall G x z S T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_all S T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ S ->
    G ⊢ trm_app (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ∶ open z T

| ty_new : forall G x avs xs Ts is' T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_con Ts is' T ->
    G ⊢ avs :: Ts ->
    vars_of_avars xs avs ->
    G ⊢ trm_new (avar_f x) avs ∶ typ_bnd (open_rec_vars 1 xs T)

| ty_rcd_elim : forall G x a S T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T) ->
    G ⊢ trm_sel (avar_f x) a ∶ T

| ty_fld_asn : forall G x y a S T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T) ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S ->
    G ⊢ trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ T

| ty_let : forall L G t u T U,
    G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open x u ∶ U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_let T t u ∶ U

| ty_llit : forall L G l u T U,
    G ⊢ l ∶ T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open x u ∶ U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_lit T l u ∶ U

| ty_rec_intro : forall G x T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T

| ty_rec_elim : forall G x T,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x T

| ty_and_intro : forall G x T U,
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_and T U

| ty_sub : forall G (t : trm) T U,
    G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    G ⊢ T <: U ->
    G ⊢ t ∶ U

with ty_lit : Typing lit :=

| ty_all_intro : forall L G T t U,
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open x t ∶ open x U) ->
    G ⊢ lit_fun T t ∶ typ_all T U

| ty_con_intro : forall L G Ts is' T ds t T',
    (forall x ys,
        length ys = length_s Ts ->
        fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys) ->
        G & (ys ~** (to_list Ts))
        & (x ~ open_vars (cons x ys) T)
            ⊢ (open_vars (cons x ys) ds)
            ∶ (open_vars (cons x ys) T)) ->
    (forall x ys,
        length ys = length_s Ts ->
        fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys) ->
        (G & (ys ~** (to_list Ts)) & (x ~ open_vars (cons x ys) T)
            ⊢ (open_vars (cons x ys) t)
            ∶ (open_vars (cons x ys) T'))) ->
    G ⊢ lit_con Ts is' T ds t ∶ typ_con Ts is' T

with subtyp : Subtyping :=

| subtyp_top: forall G T,
    G ⊢ T <: typ_top

| subtyp_bot: forall G T,
    G ⊢ typ_bot <: T

| subtyp_refl: forall G T,
    G ⊢ T <: T

| subtyp_trans: forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T ->
    G ⊢ T <: U ->
    G ⊢ S <: U

| subtyp_and11: forall G T U,
    G ⊢ typ_and T U <: T

| subtyp_and12: forall G T U,
    G ⊢ typ_and T U <: U

| subtyp_and2: forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T ->
    G ⊢ S <: U ->
    G ⊢ S <: typ_and T U

| subtyp_fld: forall G a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    G ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->

(*       satisfied by the empty context, giving both lemmas for [empty].  *)
(*   (3) the precise remaining subgoal for the general inert case: the    *)
(*       coherence of the type-member bounds of an inert [typ_bnd]        *)
(*       binding (see the comment at the end of the file).                *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* (1) The bad binding is impossible under inertness.                     *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma inert_no_rcd_binds : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (D:dec),
  inert G -> binds x (typ_rcd D) G -> False.
Proof.
  intros G x D Hi Hb.
  pose proof (@inert_binds_inert_typ G x (typ_rcd D) Hi Hb) as Ht.
  exact (@inert_typ_not_rcd D Ht).
Qed.

Lemma inert_no_bad_type_member_binds : forall (G:ctx) (x:var)
    (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
  inert G -> binds x (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) G -> False.
Proof.
  intros. eapply inert_no_rcd_binds; eassumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Structural facts about record types.                                   *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma record_typ_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros T ls D Hrt. induction Hrt as
    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ]; intros Hrh.
  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. subst D. exact Hdec.
  - apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh. destruct Hrh as [Hl|Hr].
    + eapply IH. exact Hl.
    + apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hr. subst D. exact Hdec.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (D:dec),
  record_type T -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros T D [ls Hrt] Hrh. eapply (@record_typ_has_dec T ls D); eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_has_equal_bounds : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
  record_type T -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U) -> S = U.
Proof.
  intros T a S U Hrt Hrh.
  pose proof (@record_type_has_dec T (dec_trm a S U) Hrt Hrh) as Hdec.
  inversion Hdec; subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Two [record_has] members of a record type with the same label are the
   same member.  This is the uniqueness needed to turn the equal-bound
   fact for one member into the bounds bracket for every member. *)

Lemma record_typ_trm_unique : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (a:trm_label)
    (T1 U1 T2 U2:typ),
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_has T (dec_trm a T1 U1) ->
  record_has T (dec_trm a T2 U2) ->
  T1 = T2 /\ U1 = U2.
Proof.
  intros T ls a T1 U1 T2 U2 Hrt.
  induction Hrt as [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ];
    intros H1 H2.
  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
    apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
    assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
    { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
    inversion E. auto.
  - apply record_has_and_inv in H1.
    apply record_has_and_inv in H2.
    destruct H1 as [H1|H1]; destruct H2 as [H2|H2].
    + eapply IH; eassumption.
    + (* H1 in T0, H2 in the right component *)
      exfalso.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T1 U1) H1) as Hin.
      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1) = l).
      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2)).
        - cbn. reflexivity.
        - rewrite H2. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
    + (* H1 in the right component, H2 in T0 *)
      exfalso.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T2 U2) H2) as Hin.
      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2) = l).
      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1)).
        - cbn. reflexivity.
        - rewrite H1. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
    + (* both in the right component *)
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
      assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
      { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
      inversion E. auto.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_bracket : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf:typ),
  record_type V -> record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has V (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
    G ⊢ Sl <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: Su.
Proof.
  intros G V a Tf [ls Hrt] Hrh Sl Su Hrh2.
  pose proof (@record_typ_trm_unique V ls a Tf Tf Sl Su Hrt Hrh Hrh2)
    as [E1 E2].
  subst. split; apply subtyp_refl.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* A "no bottom in the record/intersection structure" predicate and the   *)
(* label-indexed bracket predicate.                                       *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* [compat G a Al Au T] says: T contains no bottom in the positions       *)
(* traversed by [record_has], and every [a]-member of T brackets the      *)
(* (source) bounds [Al..Au].  This predicate is designed so that it is    *)
(* preserved by subtyping in the absence of selection flows, while still  *)
(* being false at [typ_bot].  The [nobot] component is what makes the     *)
(* [and11]/[and12] cases (and the [subtyp_bot] case) go through.          *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Fixpoint nobot (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_and T1 T2 => nobot T1 /\ nobot T2
  | _ => True
  end.

Definition bracket (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has T (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
    G ⊢ Sl <: Al /\ G ⊢ Au <: Su.

Definition compat (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
  nobot T /\ bracket G a Al Au T.

Lemma record_typ_nobot : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label),
  record_typ T ls -> nobot T.
Proof.
  intros T ls Hrt. induction Hrt as
    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ].
  - cbn [nobot]. exact I.
  - cbn [nobot]. split; [exact IH|exact I].
Qed.

Lemma record_type_nobot : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> nobot T.
Proof.
  intros T [ls Hrt]. eapply @record_typ_nobot; eassumption.
Qed.

(* The context hypothesis that selection flows are impossible. *)
Definition no_ty_member_typings (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (x:var) (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
    ~ (G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)).

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Preservation of [compat] by subtyping, in a context with no type-member *)
(* record typings (so that [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] can never fire).    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma compat_closure : forall (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au:typ) (S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  G ⊢ S <: U ->
  compat G a Al Au S ->
  compat G a Al Au U.
Proof.
  intros G a Al Au S U Hns Hsub.
  induction Hsub; intros Hc; cbn [compat nobot bracket] in *.
  - (* subtyp_top *) split; [exact I|]. intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_bot *) destruct Hc as [Hn _]. exact (False_rect _ Hn).
  - (* subtyp_refl *) exact Hc.
  - (* subtyp_trans *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb].
    apply IHHsub0.
    + exact Hns.
    + apply IHHsub; [exact Hns | split; [exact Hn|exact Hb]].
  - (* subtyp_and11 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
    + exact (proj1 Hn).
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andl. exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_and12 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
    + exact (proj2 Hn).
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andr. exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
    assert (IH1 := IHHsub Hns Hc).
    assert (IH2 := IHHsub0 Hns Hc).
    destruct IH1 as [Hn1 Hb1]. destruct IH2 as [Hn2 Hb2]. split.
    + split; assumption.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh.
      destruct Hrh as [Hrh|Hrh]; [apply Hb1|apply Hb2]; exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_fld *)
    destruct Hc as [_ Hb]. split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh.
      inversion Hrh; subst.
      pose proof (proj1 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hlow.
      pose proof (proj2 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hup.
      split; [eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption|eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption].
  - (* subtyp_typ *) split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. discriminate Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_sel2 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_sel1 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_all *) split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The main field lemmas under [no_ty_member_typings].                    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Theorem field_cov_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.
  intros G V a Tf S U Hns Hrt Hrh Hsub.
  pose proof (@record_type_bracket G V a Tf Hrt Hrh) as Hb.
  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
                Hns Hsub (conj I Hb)) as Hfinal.
  destruct Hfinal as [_ HbU].
  exact (proj2 (HbU S U (rh_one (dec_trm a S U)))).
Qed.

Theorem field_contr_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ S <: Tf.
Proof.
  intros G V a Tf S U Hns Hrt Hrh Hsub.
  pose proof (@record_type_bracket G V a Tf Hrt Hrh) as Hb.
  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
                Hns Hsub (conj I Hb)) as Hfinal.
  destruct Hfinal as [_ HbU].
  exact (proj1 (HbU S U (rh_one (dec_trm a S U)))).
Qed.

(* The combined pair statement. *)
Theorem field_pair_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ S <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.
  intros. split.
  - eapply field_contr_no_ty_member; eassumption.
  - eapply field_cov_no_ty_member; eassumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The empty context satisfies the hypothesis, so both lemmas hold there. *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma empty_typing_var_false : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T -> G = empty -> forall (x:var), t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  pose proof (proj1 (rules_mutind
    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
       G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False)
    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (_:G ⊢ S <: U) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True)))
    as Hty.
  - exact (Hty G t T H).
  - (* typing rules *)
    intros; try (match goal with
                 | b : binds ?x ?v ?G, He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
                     rewrite He in b; exact (binds_empty_inv b)
                 | IH : ?G = empty -> forall y, ?t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> False,
                   He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
                     exfalso; eapply IH; [exact He | first [eassumption | reflexivity]]
                 | H : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- False => discriminate H
                 | H : trm_var (avar_f _) = ?t |- False => discriminate H
                 end).
  - (* literal rules *) intros; exact I.
  - (* subtyping rules *) intros; exact I.
  - (* avar rules *) intros; exact I.
Qed.

Lemma no_ty_member_typings_empty : no_ty_member_typings empty.
Proof.
  intros x A S T Hty.
  eapply (@empty_typing_var_false empty (trm_var (avar_f x))
            (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T))); [exact Hty|reflexivity|reflexivity].
Qed.

Theorem field_cov_inert_empty : forall (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
  inert empty ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  empty ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.
  intros. eapply field_cov_no_ty_member; [exact no_ty_member_typings_empty|eassumption..].
Qed.

Theorem field_contr_inert_empty : forall (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
  inert empty ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  empty ⊢ S <: Tf.
Proof.
  intros. eapply field_contr_no_ty_member; [exact no_ty_member_typings_empty|eassumption..].
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Status of the general inert statements and the precise remaining       *)
(* subgoal.                                                               *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* Under [inert G] the only missing ingredient is the following           *)
(* coherence property for type members of an inert [typ_bnd] binding.     *)
(*                                                                        *)
(*   TypeMemberCoherence:                                                 *)
(*     forall G x U A S1 T1 S2 T2,                                        *)
(*       inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U ->             *)
(*       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) ->            *)
(*       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2) ->            *)
(*       S1 <: T2.                                                        *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* Indeed [record_type] gives a unique equal bound [W] at the label [A]   *)
(* in [U]; after opening, any record typing of [x] at [dec_typ A S T]    *)
(* must be obtained by widening a flow tip of [open x U], which forces    *)
(* S <: W <: T.  Two typings therefore give S1 <: W <: T2.  This is       *)
(* exactly the type-member analogue of the two field lemmas we prove      *)
(* above, and it has the same proof shape (the [compat] preservation      *)
(* argument of [compat_closure], with [bracket] replaced by a             *)
(* type-label bracket and the [sel2]/[sel1] cases discharged by the       *)
(* typing induction instead of by vacuity).  The general inert versions   *)
(* of [field_cov_inert]/[field_contr_inert] then follow by the             *)
(* [compat] closure argument, defining [compat] on [typ_sel] types via    *)
(* the canonical member bound [W] of the variable's inert binding.        *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* The obstruction is genuinely a mutual induction: in                    *)
(* [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] the typing premise is not a subderivation  *)
(* of the subtyping tree, so the induction must be taken over             *)
(* [rules_mutind] (typing and subtyping simultaneously), with a typing    *)
(* motive producing [TypeMemberCoherence].  The [ty_sub] case of that     *)
(* motive needs the [compat] preservation above for a *type-label*        *)
(* bracket, and the [ty_rec_intro]/[ty_rec_elim] cases need the           *)
(* body/opening correspondence [typ_bnd W -> open x W].  The auxiliary    *)
(* negative result [bnd_companion_not_unique] (RootSub.v) shows that      *)
(* the body [W] cannot be recovered by uniqueness, which is why the       *)
(* motive has to be type-directed.                                        *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Check field_cov_no_ty_member.
Check field_contr_no_ty_member.
Check field_pair_no_ty_member.
Check field_cov_inert_empty.
Check field_contr_inert_empty.
Check inert_no_bad_type_member_binds.

9	Inductive inert_typ : typ -> Prop :=

11	  | inert_typ_con :

13	        record_type T ->

20	  | inert_empty : inert empty
21	  | inert_all : forall G x T,

23	      inert_typ T ->

11	Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
12	| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ A T T)
13	| rd_trm : forall a T, record_dec (dec_trm a T T).
14	
15	Inductive record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
16	| rt_one : forall D l,
17	  record_dec D ->
18	  l = label_of D ->
19	  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
20	| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
21	  record_typ T ls ->
22	  record_dec D ->
23	  l = label_of D ->
24	  l \notin ls ->
25	  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

32	| rh_andl : forall T U D,
33	    record_has T D ->

1	Require Import Base.
2	Require Import LibExtra.
3	Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
4	Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
5	Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
6	Unset Implicit Arguments.
7	
8	(* ====================================================================== *)
9	(* Supporting machinery: record-shaped (rc) types.                        *)
10	(*                                                                        *)
11	(* [rc] is the class of types built from top and record types by          *)
12	(* intersection.  These are exactly the types that can appear as the      *)
13	(* body of an inert [typ_bnd] binding.  The key property is that           *)
14	(* subtyping maps rc types to rc types, which excludes arbitrary          *)
15	(* selections, bottoms, and bound types from appearing in rc positions.   *)
16	(* ====================================================================== *)
17	
18	Inductive rc : typ -> Prop :=
19	| rc_top : rc typ_top
20	| rc_rcd : forall (D:dec), rc (typ_rcd D)
21	| rc_and : forall (T U:typ), rc T -> rc U -> rc (typ_and T U).
22	
23	Lemma rc_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (X:typ), T = typ_bnd X -> False.
24	Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros X E; discriminate E. Qed.
25	
26	Lemma rc_not_bot : forall (T:typ), rc T -> T = typ_bot -> False.
27	Proof. intros T H. induction H; intro E; discriminate E. Qed.
28	
29	Lemma rc_not_sel : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label),
30	  T = typ_sel a A -> False.
31	Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros a A E; discriminate E. Qed.
32	
33	Lemma record_typ_rc : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label),
34	  record_typ T ls -> rc T.
35	Proof.
36	  intros T ls H. induction H.
37	  - apply rc_rcd.
38	  - apply rc_and; [assumption|apply rc_rcd].
39	Qed.
40	
41	Lemma record_type_rc : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> rc T.
42	Proof. intros T [ls H]. exact (@record_typ_rc T ls H). Qed.
43	
44	(* Note: rc is *not* preserved by subtyping in general.  For instance an rc
45	   source can reach a selection type through [subtyp_sel2], and then an
46	   arbitrary type through [subtyp_sel1].  This is precisely why the
47	   analysis of the main lemma cannot be a one-line appeal to rc inversion;
48	   the sel rules must be handled through the typing premises they carry.
49	   The invariants that do hold for rc sources are the shape facts
50	   [rc_not_bot]/[rc_not_bnd]/[rc_not_sel] and the equal-bound structure
51	   [record_type_has_dec] below. *)
52	
53	(* ====================================================================== *)
54	(* The equal-bound structure of record types.                             *)
55	(*                                                                        *)
56	(* This is the structural fact that ultimately rules out the sel-chain    *)
57	(* counterexamples: every component of a record type is a [record_dec],   *)
58	(* i.e. its two bounds are syntactically equal.  Hence a variable bound    *)
59	(* to [typ_bnd U] with [record_type U] cannot simultaneously acquire two  *)
60	(* record typings of the same type label whose upper bounds differ        *)
61	(* (which is exactly what the [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] flow would      *)
62	(* require in order to manufacture a record supertype of [typ_top]).      *)
63	(* ====================================================================== *)
64	
65	Lemma record_typ_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
66	  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
67	Proof.
68	  intros T ls D Hrt. induction Hrt as
69	    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ]; intros Hrh.
70	  - (* rt_one *) apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. subst D. exact Hdec.
71	  - (* rt_cons: T = typ_and T0 (typ_rcd D0) *)
72	    apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh. destruct Hrh as [Hl|Hr].
73	    + (* component in T0 *) eapply IH. exact Hl.
74	    + (* component is the right record *) apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hr.
75	      subst D. exact Hdec.
76	Qed.
77	
78	Lemma record_type_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (D:dec),
79	  record_type T -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
80	Proof.
81	  intros T D [ls Hrt] Hrh. eapply (@record_typ_has_dec T ls D); eassumption.
82	Qed.
83	
84	(* If a record type has a member with label [a], the corresponding dec has
85	   equal bounds.  Used below in the discussion of the sel-chain. *)
86	Lemma record_type_has_equal_bounds : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
87	  record_type T -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U) -> S = U.
88	Proof.
89	  intros T a S U Hrt Hrh.
90	  pose proof (@record_type_has_dec T (dec_trm a S U) Hrt Hrh) as Hdec.
91	  inversion Hdec; subst. reflexivity.
92	Qed.
93	
94	(* ====================================================================== *)
95	(* The companion fact suggested as a possible helper is FALSE.            *)
96	(*                                                                        *)
97	(* One might hope that under [inert G] and [binds x (typ_bnd U) G] the    *)
98	(* only bound type ever ascribed to [x] is [U] itself, or at least that   *)
99	(* [G ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T] forces [T = U].  This fails: enlarging the bounds   *)
100	(* of a record member (contravariantly in the lower bound) yields a        *)
101	(* different record body [T] which is still a valid recursive type.       *)
102	(*                                                                        *)
103	(* We machine-check the counterexample:                                    *)
104	(*   U = {A : top..top}          T = {A : bot..top}                       *)
105	(*   G = empty & x ~ typ_bnd U                                            *)
106	(* [inert G] holds because [record_type U] holds; [x] is typed both at    *)
107	(* [typ_bnd U] (by [ty_var]) and at [typ_bnd T] (open [x] at [U], widen   *)
108	(* the record with [subtyp_typ], and apply [ty_rec_intro]); and [T <> U]. *)
109	(* This is why the final lemma cannot be obtained from any uniqueness      *)
110	(* property of the [typ_bnd] target of [x].                               *)
111	(* ====================================================================== *)
112	
113	Lemma bnd_companion_not_unique : forall (A:typ_label) (x:var),
114	  exists (G:ctx) (U T:typ),
115	    inert G /\ binds x (typ_bnd U) G /\ record_type U /\
116	    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T /\ T <> U.
117	Proof.
118	  intros A x.
119	  pose (U := typ_rcd (dec_typ A typ_top typ_top)).
120	  pose (T := typ_rcd (dec_typ A typ_bot typ_top)).
121	  assert (HrtU : record_type U).
122	  { subst U. exists (\{label_of (dec_typ A typ_top typ_top)}). apply rt_one.
123	    - apply rd_typ.
124	    - reflexivity. }
125	  assert (Hx : x # (empty:ctx)).
126	  { rewrite (@dom_empty typ). apply notin_empty. }
127	  pose (G := empty & x ~ typ_bnd U).
128	  assert (Hbnd : binds x (typ_bnd U) G).
129	  { subst G. apply binds_push_eq. }
130	  assert (Hinert : inert G).
131	  { subst G. eapply inert_all.
132	    - apply inert_empty.
133	    - apply inert_typ_bnd. exact HrtU.
134	    - exact Hx. }
135	  assert (HopenU : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x U).
136	  { apply ty_rec_elim. apply ty_var. exact Hbnd. }
137	  assert (Hsub : G ⊢ open x U <: open x T).
138	  { subst U T. cbn. eapply subtyp_typ.
139	    - apply subtyp_bot.
140	    - apply subtyp_refl. }
141	  assert (HopenT : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x T).
142	  { eapply ty_sub; [exact HopenU|exact Hsub]. }
143	  assert (HbndT : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T).
144	  { eapply ty_rec_intro. exact HopenT. }
145	  exists G, U, T. repeat split; try assumption.
146	  (* T <> U *)
147	  subst U T. intro Heq. inversion Heq.
148	Qed.
149	
150	(* The exact target formula, recorded but deliberately NOT asserted as a
151	   lemma: it is not proved in this file.  See the explanation below. *)
152	Definition ty_var_record_sub_statement : Prop :=
153	  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),
154	    inert G ->
155	    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
156	    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->
157	    G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.
158	
159	(* ====================================================================== *)
160	(* Status of the main statement [ty_var_record_sub].                      *)
161	(*                                                                        *)
162	(* The statement is TRUE, but the proof is not a short structural         *)
163	(* inversion.  Below is a precise account of what is needed and why the   *)
164	(* obvious routes fail.                                                    *)
165	(*                                                                        *)
166	(* 1. Why inertness is essential.                                          *)
167	(*    Without inertness the statement is false.  Take                        *)
168	(*        G = empty & x ~ typ_bot                                          *)
169	(*    (or more generally a non-record, non-inert binding).  Then            *)
170	(*    [x : typ_bot] by [ty_var], and [typ_bot <: typ_rcd D] by             *)
171	(*    [subtyp_bot], so [x : typ_rcd D] is derivable, while [open x U]      *)
172	(*    (for [U] not a subtype of [typ_rcd D]) need not be.  Inertness       *)
173	(*    rules this out because [inert_typ] admits only [typ_all],            *)
174	(*    [typ_con], and [typ_bnd] of a record type, and only record types of  *)
175	(*    the latter kind can flow to a record.  (With an inert-but-not-record *)
176	(*    binding [x ~ typ_and (typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_bnd V) (typ_bnd V)))   *)
177	(*    (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S (typ_rcd D)))] one also gets a counterexample: *)
178	(*    the two components, via [and11]/[and12] and [subtyp_sel2]/           *)
179	(*    [subtyp_sel1], witness [typ_bnd V <: typ_rcd D].  A [record_type]    *)
180	(*    forbids two members with the same label, which is precisely the      *)
181	(*    gap closed by inertness.)                                            *)
182	(*                                                                        *)
183	(* 2. The typing induction and the "Real" motive.                          *)
184	(*    Induct on the typing derivation [G ⊢ x ∶ T] and prove, for the       *)
185	(*    fixed binding [binds x (typ_bnd U) G] with [record_type U],          *)
186	(*        Real(T) := forall R, rc R -> G ⊢ T <: R -> G ⊢ open x U <: R.   *)
187	(*    The main conclusion is [Real (typ_rcd D)] at R = typ_rcd D via       *)
188	(*    [subtyp_refl] (and [rc_rcd]).  The [ty_sub] case is handled by       *)
189	(*    transitivity of subtyping: from [T0 <: T] and [T <: R] get           *)
190	(*    [T0 <: R] and apply the induction hypothesis [Real(T0)].             *)
191	(*    The [ty_and_intro] case needs a decomposition: from                  *)
192	(*    [typ_and T1 T2 <: R] with [rc R], derive [T1 <: R] or [T2 <: R] and  *)
193	(*    apply the IH; this is the "and-target split".  The variable base     *)
194	(*    cases need the bnd/rc separation described next.                    *)
195	(*                                                                        *)
196	(* 3. The remaining obstruction: bnd/rc separation.                        *)
197	(*    For the [ty_var] and [ty_rec_intro] cases one has to show, for all   *)
198	(*    [W] and all [rc R], that [G ⊢ typ_bnd W <: R] yields                 *)
199	(*    [G ⊢ open x W <: R].  This is true, but it cannot be proved by a     *)
200	(*    direct induction on the subtyping derivation: the [subtyp_trans]     *)
201	(*    case passes through an intermediate [S] with no known shape, and    *)
202	(*    the [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] rules go through record typings of  *)
203	(*    auxiliary variables [z].  The auxiliary record typing is itself a    *)
204	(*    subderivation of the subtyping premise and hence of the whole        *)
205	(*    typing derivation, so a mutual induction over [ty_trm] and           *)
206	(*    [subtyp] (using [rules_mutind]) is the correct vehicle: the sel      *)
207	(*    premises are then handled by the typing induction hypothesis, and    *)
208	(*    the only genuinely circular-looking sel chains are broken by the      *)
209	(*    equal-bound fact [record_type_has_equal_bounds] above.  The exact    *)
210	(*    mutual statement must moreover track the [typ_bnd] body / iterated   *)
211	(*    opening correspondence (a type-directed motive which maps            *)
212	(*    [typ_bnd W] to [Real (open x W)]), because [ty_rec_elim]'s premise   *)
213	(*    has type [typ_bnd W] whereas its conclusion is [open x W].           *)
214	(*                                                                        *)
215	(*    The plausible shortcut that every typing [x : typ_rcd D] is a       *)
216	(*    supertype of a [precise_flow] tip of the binding is FALSE in         *)
217	(*    general:                                                             *)
218	(*    [ty_rec_intro] can produce [x : typ_bnd W] which is not below any    *)
219	(*    flow tip (flow tips of [typ_bnd U] live inside [open x U] and its    *)
220	(*    components and cannot be below a [typ_bnd]).  It is only for         *)
221	(*    *record-like* conclusions that a flow-based argument can work, and   *)
222	(*    that restriction is exactly what the mutual induction above encodes. *)
223	(*                                                                        *)
224	(* 4. Why the statement is nevertheless true.                              *)
225	(*    A counterexample would require an inert context [G] with            *)
226	(*    [binds x (typ_bnd U) G], [record_type U], and a derivation of        *)
227	(*    [G ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd D] with [G ⊢ open x U ≮ typ_rcd D].  Since          *)
228	(*    [x ∶ typ_rcd D] cannot be obtained by [ty_var] (the binding is a     *)
229	(*    [typ_bnd]) or by [ty_and_intro] (whose conclusion is an              *)
230	(*    intersection), the only possible sources are recursive elimination   *)
231	(*    [ty_rec_elim] and widening [ty_sub].  Recursive elimination can      *)
232	(*    only open the binding's record structure, and widening to a record   *)
233	(*    target must respect the equal bounds of the record components        *)
234	(*    ([record_type_has_dec]).  Any detour through [subtyp_sel2]/          *)
235	(*    [subtyp_sel1] requires two record typings of one variable at the     *)
236	(*    same label with incompatible upper bounds; record types cannot       *)
237	(*    supply this, and inertness guarantees the variable's binding is a    *)
238	(*    record type.  Detours through [typ_bot] would require an [x]-type    *)
239	(*    below [typ_bot]); no such type is reachable from a record-typed      *)
240	(*    binding without a same-label sel detour, and the equal-bound        *)
241	(*    structure of record types rules that detour out.  Thus no            *)
242	(*    counterexample exists.                                               *)
243	(*                                                                        *)
244	(* In summary: the lemma is provable in principle, but a fully checked     *)
245	(* proof requires the mutual [rules_mutind] induction of item 3 with the   *)
246	(* type-directed body/opening invariant; the straightforward inversion     *)
247	(* and the flow-tip shortcut both fail for exactly the reasons above.      *)
248	(* No [Admitted]/[Axiom] is used in this file.                             *)
249	(* ====================================================================== *)
250	
251	(* A last consistency check: the supporting lemmas above are all proved. *)
252	Check ty_var_record_sub_statement.
253	Check record_type_has_dec.
254	Check bnd_companion_not_unique.

1	Require Import Base.
2	Require Import LibExtra.
3	Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
4	Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
5	Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
6	Require Import RootSub.
7	Unset Implicit Arguments.
8	
9	(* ====================================================================== *)
10	(* Real.v : the canonical-forms lemma for inert [typ_bnd] bindings.       *)
11	(*                                                                        *)
12	(* We give the exact target statement, isolate the genuine blocker        *)
13	(* (the [typ_rcd] case), and prove without any axioms that:               *)
14	(*   (1) the [typ_rcd] case implies the general [rc] statement, and       *)
15	(*   (2) the general [rc] statement implies the requested corollary.      *)
16	(* The [typ_rcd] case itself is the canonical-forms statement recorded in *)
17	(* RootSub.v; it is not proved here (no Admitted/Abort is used).          *)
18	(* ====================================================================== *)
19	
20	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
21	(* Small supporting facts.                                                *)
22	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
23	
24	(* Under inertness a [typ_bnd] binding carries a record type.  (This is
25	   the fact recorded in the task statement; it follows from inversion of
26	   [inert_typ] after [inert_binds_inert_typ].) *)
27	Lemma inert_bnd_record_type : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ),
28	  inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U.
29	Proof.
30	  intros G x U Hi Hb.
31	  pose proof (@inert_binds_inert_typ G x (typ_bnd U) Hi Hb) as Ht.
32	  inversion Ht; subst. assumption.
33	Qed.
34	
35	(* Left/right projections of an intersection target. *)
36	Lemma subtyp_and_left : forall (G:ctx) (T U V:typ),
37	  G ⊢ T <: typ_and U V -> G ⊢ T <: U.
38	Proof. intros. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact H|apply subtyp_and11]. Qed.
39	
40	Lemma subtyp_and_right : forall (G:ctx) (T U V:typ),
41	  G ⊢ T <: typ_and U V -> G ⊢ T <: V.
42	Proof. intros. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact H|apply subtyp_and12]. Qed.
43	
44	(* Inversion of the [rc] intersection constructor. *)
45	Lemma rc_and_inv : forall (T:typ), rc T ->
46	  forall (U V:typ), T = typ_and U V -> rc U /\ rc V.
47	Proof.
48	  intros T H. induction H as [| D | A B HA HB]; intros U V Heq.
49	  - discriminate Heq.
50	  - discriminate Heq.
51	  - inversion Heq; subst. split; assumption.
52	Qed.
53	
54	(* A [typ_rcd] is never a [typ_bnd]. *)
55	Lemma typ_rcd_not_bnd : forall (D:dec) (U:typ), typ_rcd D <> typ_bnd U.
56	Proof. intros D U Heq. inversion Heq. Qed.
57	
58	(* ====================================================================== *)
59	(* The isolated blocker.                                                  *)
60	(*                                                                        *)
61	(* This is the [typ_rcd] instance of the target theorem, with an          *)
62	(* arbitrary typing type [T].  It is exactly the canonical-forms          *)
63	(* statement for records in an inert context: every record supertype of   *)
64	(* a well-typed variable is above the recursive opening of the binding.   *)
65	(*                                                                        *)
66	(* RootSub.v explains why this cannot be obtained by a one-line inversion *)
67	(* of subtyping (the [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] detour).  It is TRUE     *)
68	(* but is the remaining open subgoal of this development.                 *)
69	(* ====================================================================== *)
70	
71	Definition rcd_case_statement : Prop :=
72	  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T:typ) (D:dec),
73	    inert G ->
74	    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
75	    record_type U ->
76	    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
77	    G ⊢ T <: typ_rcd D ->
78	    G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.
79	
80	(* ====================================================================== *)
81	(* Reduction: the [typ_rcd] case implies the general [rc] statement.      *)
82	(*                                                                        *)
83	(* The proof is a straightforward induction on the [rc] witness, using    *)
84	(* only transitivity and the intersection projections for the [rc_and]    *)
85	(* case.  Hence the *only* unproved content is [rcd_case_statement].      *)
86	(* ====================================================================== *)
87	
88	Section FromRcd.
89	
90	Hypothesis Hrcd : rcd_case_statement.
91	
92	Lemma real_from_rcd : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T:typ),
93	  inert G ->
94	  binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
95	  record_type U ->
96	  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
97	  forall (R:typ), rc R -> G ⊢ T <: R -> G ⊢ open x U <: R.
98	Proof.
99	  intros G x U T Hi Hb Hrt Hty R HR.
100	  induction HR as [| D | R1 R2 HR1 IH1 HR2 IH2]; intros Hsub.
101	  - (* rc_top *) apply subtyp_top.
102	  - (* rc_rcd *) eapply Hrcd; eassumption.
103	  - (* rc_and *) apply subtyp_and2.
104	    + apply IH1. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub | apply subtyp_and11].
105	    + apply IH2. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub | apply subtyp_and12].
106	Qed.
107	
108	(* The exact theorem requested by the task, conditional on the isolated
109	   [typ_rcd] case. *)
110	Theorem ty_var_bnd_real_of_rcd : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T R:typ),
111	  inert G ->
112	  binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
113	  record_type U ->
114	  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
115	  rc R ->
116	  G ⊢ T <: R ->
117	  G ⊢ open x U <: R.
118	Proof.
119	  intros G x U T R Hi Hb Hrt Hty HR Hsub.
120	  eapply real_from_rcd; eassumption.
121	Qed.
122	
123	(* The requested corollary, conditional on the isolated [typ_rcd] case. *)
124	Lemma ty_var_record_sub_of_rcd : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),
125	  inert G ->
126	  binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
127	  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->
128	  G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.
129	Proof.
130	  intros G x U D Hi Hb Hty.
131	  pose proof (@inert_bnd_record_type G x U Hi Hb) as Hrt.
132	  eapply Hrcd with (T := typ_rcd D) (D := D).
133	  - exact Hi.
134	  - exact Hb.
135	  - exact Hrt.
136	  - exact Hty.
137	  - apply subtyp_refl.
138	Qed.
139	
140	End FromRcd.
141	
142	(* ====================================================================== *)
143	(* The unconditional statements (recorded, not asserted as lemmas).       *)
144	(*                                                                        *)
145	(* Since [rcd_case_statement] is exactly the open canonical-forms goal,   *)
146	(* the unconditional theorem is stated here for reference.  It is not     *)
147	(* proved, and no inconsistency is introduced: these are Definitions.     *)
148	(* ====================================================================== *)
149	
150	Definition ty_var_bnd_real_statement : Prop :=
151	  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T R:typ),
152	    inert G ->
153	    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
154	    record_type U ->
155	    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
156	    rc R ->
157	    G ⊢ T <: R ->
158	    G ⊢ open x U <: R.
159	
160	Definition ty_var_record_sub_statement : Prop :=
161	  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),
162	    inert G ->
163	    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
164	    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->
165	    G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.
166	
167	(* The two statements above are *exactly* the reductions we proved:
168	   the only gap is [rcd_case_statement].  This is recorded by the
169	   following implications, which check that nothing else is missing. *)
170	
171	Lemma ty_var_bnd_real_of_rcd_statement :
172	  rcd_case_statement -> ty_var_bnd_real_statement.
173	Proof.
174	  intros Hrcd G x U T R Hi Hb Hrt Hty HR Hsub.
175	  eapply ty_var_bnd_real_of_rcd; eassumption.
176	Qed.
177	
178	Lemma ty_var_record_sub_of_rcd_statement :
179	  rcd_case_statement -> ty_var_record_sub_statement.
180	Proof.
181	  intros Hrcd G x U D Hi Hb Hty.
182	  eapply ty_var_record_sub_of_rcd; eassumption.
183	Qed.
184	
185	(* Conversely, the [rc] statement specializes to the [typ_rcd] case, so
186	   the two formulations are equivalent modulo the [rc_rcd] constructor. *)
187	Lemma rcd_of_ty_var_bnd_real :
188	  ty_var_bnd_real_statement -> rcd_case_statement.
189	Proof.
190	  intros Hall G x U T D Hi Hb Hrt Hty Hsub.
191	  eapply Hall; [exact Hi | exact Hb | exact Hrt | exact Hty | apply rc_rcd | exact Hsub].
192	Qed.
193	
194	Lemma rcd_of_ty_var_record_sub :
195	  ty_var_record_sub_statement ->
196	  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),
197	    inert G ->
198	    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
199	    record_type U ->
200	    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->
201	    G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.
202	Proof.
203	  intros Hall G x U D Hi Hb Hrt Hty.
204	  eapply Hall; eassumption.
205	Qed.
206	
207	Check ty_var_bnd_real_statement.
208	Check ty_var_record_sub_statement.
209	Check rcd_case_statement.
210	Check ty_var_bnd_real_of_rcd.
211	Check ty_var_record_sub_of_rcd.
