Proof. intros T U H. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Shape of precise flow tips in an inert setting *)

Lemma flow_shape : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  inert_typ T0 ->
  binds x T0 G ->
  (V = T0 /\ inert_typ T0) \/ record_type V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf; intros Hi Hb.
  - left. split; [reflexivity|assumption].
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + inversion Heq; subst. inversion Hi2; subst.
      right. apply record_type_open. assumption.
    + exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exists ls. exact Hr.
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists ls'. exact (proj1 HP).
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists (\{label_of D}).
      assert (HeqU : U2 = typ_rcd D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 HP)).
      assert (Hrd : record_dec D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 HP))).
      rewrite HeqU. apply rt_one; [exact Hrd|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma flow_typing : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf.
  - apply ty_var. assumption.
  - eapply ty_rec_elim. exact IHHf.
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and11].
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and12].
Qed.

(** * Corollaries: no flow tip is a top/bottom/selection type *)

Lemma flow_not_top : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_top -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_top Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_top Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_top. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_bot : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_bot -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_bot Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_bot Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_bot. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_sel : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ) (a:avar) (A:typ_label),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_sel a A -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 a A Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 (typ_sel a A) Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_sel a A Hi2).
  - exact (@record_type_not_sel a A Hr).
Qed.

Lemma flow_bnd_eq : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 U:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_bnd U -> typ_bnd U = T0.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 U Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 (typ_bnd U) Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - exact Heq.
  - exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma record_has_rcd_inv : forall (D D':dec), record_has (typ_rcd D) D' -> D' = D.
Proof. intros D D' H. inversion H; subst; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma record_has_and_inv : forall (T U:typ) (D:dec),
  record_has (typ_and T U) D -> record_has T D \/ record_has U D.
Proof. intros T U D H. inversion H; subst; [left|right]; assumption. Qed.

Lemma defs_update_label_in : forall (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  exists d, List.In d hds /\ label_of d = label_trm a.
Proof.

8	(* ====================================================================== *)
9	(* The inert-restricted field-subtyping variants.                        *)
10	(*                                                                        *)
11	(* The two target lemmas are [field_cov_inert] and [field_contr_inert].   *)
12	(* Below we prove:                                                        *)
13	(*   (1) inertness really does exclude the bad asymmetric type-member    *)
14	(*       binding used in FieldSub2.v;                                      *)
15	(*   (2) both target lemmas in full, under the (stronger than inert)      *)
16	(*       assumption that the context derives no record typing of a        *)
17	(*       variable at a type member [dec_typ A S T].  This hypothesis is   *)
18	(*       exactly what is needed to make selections impossible; it is      *)
19	(*       satisfied by the empty context, giving both lemmas for [empty].  *)
20	(*   (3) the precise remaining subgoal for the general inert case: the    *)
21	(*       coherence of the type-member bounds of an inert [typ_bnd]        *)
22	(*       binding (see the comment at the end of the file).                *)
23	(* ====================================================================== *)
24	
25	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
26	(* (1) The bad binding is impossible under inertness.                     *)
27	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
28	
29	Lemma inert_no_rcd_binds : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (D:dec),
30	  inert G -> binds x (typ_rcd D) G -> False.
31	Proof.
32	  intros G x D Hi Hb.
33	  pose proof (@inert_binds_inert_typ G x (typ_rcd D) Hi Hb) as Ht.
34	  exact (@inert_typ_not_rcd D Ht).
35	Qed.
36	
37	Lemma inert_no_bad_type_member_binds : forall (G:ctx) (x:var)
38	    (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
39	  inert G -> binds x (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) G -> False.
40	Proof.
41	  intros. eapply inert_no_rcd_binds; eassumption.
42	Qed.
43	
44	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
45	(* Structural facts about record types.                                   *)
46	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
47	
48	Lemma record_typ_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
49	  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
50	Proof.
51	  intros T ls D Hrt. induction Hrt as
52	    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ]; intros Hrh.
53	  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. subst D. exact Hdec.
54	  - apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh. destruct Hrh as [Hl|Hr].
55	    + eapply IH. exact Hl.
56	    + apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hr. subst D. exact Hdec.
57	Qed.
58	
59	Lemma record_type_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (D:dec),
60	  record_type T -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
61	Proof.
62	  intros T D [ls Hrt] Hrh. eapply (@record_typ_has_dec T ls D); eassumption.
63	Qed.
64	
65	Lemma record_type_has_equal_bounds : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
66	  record_type T -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U) -> S = U.
67	Proof.
68	  intros T a S U Hrt Hrh.
69	  pose proof (@record_type_has_dec T (dec_trm a S U) Hrt Hrh) as Hdec.
70	  inversion Hdec; subst. reflexivity.
71	Qed.
72	
73	(* Two [record_has] members of a record type with the same label are the
74	   same member.  This is the uniqueness needed to turn the equal-bound
75	   fact for one member into the bounds bracket for every member. *)
76	
77	Lemma record_typ_trm_unique : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (a:trm_label)
78	    (T1 U1 T2 U2:typ),
79	  record_typ T ls ->
80	  record_has T (dec_trm a T1 U1) ->
81	  record_has T (dec_trm a T2 U2) ->
82	  T1 = T2 /\ U1 = U2.
83	Proof.
84	  intros T ls a T1 U1 T2 U2 Hrt.
85	  induction Hrt as [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ];
86	    intros H1 H2.
87	  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
88	    apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
89	    assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
90	    { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
91	    inversion E. auto.
92	  - apply record_has_and_inv in H1.
93	    apply record_has_and_inv in H2.
94	    destruct H1 as [H1|H1]; destruct H2 as [H2|H2].
95	    + eapply IH; eassumption.
96	    + (* H1 in T0, H2 in the right component *)
97	      exfalso.
98	      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
99	      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T1 U1) H1) as Hin.
100	      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1) = l).
101	      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2)).
102	        - cbn. reflexivity.
103	        - rewrite H2. symmetry. exact Heq. }
104	      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
105	    + (* H1 in the right component, H2 in T0 *)
106	      exfalso.
107	      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
108	      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T2 U2) H2) as Hin.
109	      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2) = l).
110	      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1)).
111	        - cbn. reflexivity.
112	        - rewrite H1. symmetry. exact Heq. }
113	      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
114	    + (* both in the right component *)
115	      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
116	      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
117	      assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
118	      { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
119	      inversion E. auto.
120	Qed.
121	
122	Lemma record_type_bracket : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf:typ),
123	  record_type V -> record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
124	  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has V (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
125	    G ⊢ Sl <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: Su.
126	Proof.
127	  intros G V a Tf [ls Hrt] Hrh Sl Su Hrh2.
128	  pose proof (@record_typ_trm_unique V ls a Tf Tf Sl Su Hrt Hrh Hrh2)
129	    as [E1 E2].
130	  subst. split; apply subtyp_refl.
131	Qed.
132	
133	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
134	(* A "no bottom in the record/intersection structure" predicate and the   *)
135	(* label-indexed bracket predicate.                                       *)
136	(*                                                                        *)
137	(* [compat G a Al Au T] says: T contains no bottom in the positions       *)
138	(* traversed by [record_has], and every [a]-member of T brackets the      *)
139	(* (source) bounds [Al..Au].  This predicate is designed so that it is    *)
140	(* preserved by subtyping in the absence of selection flows, while still  *)
141	(* being false at [typ_bot].  The [nobot] component is what makes the     *)
142	(* [and11]/[and12] cases (and the [subtyp_bot] case) go through.          *)
143	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
144	
145	Fixpoint nobot (T:typ) : Prop :=
146	  match T with
147	  | typ_bot => False
148	  | typ_and T1 T2 => nobot T1 /\ nobot T2
149	  | _ => True
150	  end.
151	
152	Definition bracket (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
153	  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has T (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
154	    G ⊢ Sl <: Al /\ G ⊢ Au <: Su.
155	
156	Definition compat (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
157	  nobot T /\ bracket G a Al Au T.
158	
159	Lemma record_typ_nobot : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label),
160	  record_typ T ls -> nobot T.
161	Proof.
162	  intros T ls Hrt. induction Hrt as
163	    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ].
164	  - cbn [nobot]. exact I.
165	  - cbn [nobot]. split; [exact IH|exact I].
166	Qed.
167	
168	Lemma record_type_nobot : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> nobot T.
169	Proof.
170	  intros T [ls Hrt]. eapply @record_typ_nobot; eassumption.
171	Qed.
172	
173	(* The context hypothesis that selection flows are impossible. *)
174	Definition no_ty_member_typings (G:ctx) : Prop :=
175	  forall (x:var) (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
176	    ~ (G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)).
177	
178	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
179	(* Preservation of [compat] by subtyping, in a context with no type-member *)
180	(* record typings (so that [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] can never fire).    *)
181	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
182	
183	Lemma compat_closure : forall (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au:typ) (S U:typ),
184	  no_ty_member_typings G ->
185	  G ⊢ S <: U ->
186	  compat G a Al Au S ->
187	  compat G a Al Au U.
188	Proof.
189	  intros G a Al Au S U Hns Hsub.
190	  induction Hsub; intros Hc; cbn [compat nobot bracket] in *.
191	  - (* subtyp_top *) split; [exact I|]. intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
192	  - (* subtyp_bot *) destruct Hc as [Hn _]. exact (False_rect _ Hn).
193	  - (* subtyp_refl *) exact Hc.
194	  - (* subtyp_trans *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb].
195	    apply IHHsub0.
196	    + exact Hns.
197	    + apply IHHsub; [exact Hns | split; [exact Hn|exact Hb]].
198	  - (* subtyp_and11 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
199	    + exact (proj1 Hn).
200	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andl. exact Hrh.
201	  - (* subtyp_and12 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
202	    + exact (proj2 Hn).
203	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andr. exact Hrh.
204	  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
205	    assert (IH1 := IHHsub Hns Hc).
206	    assert (IH2 := IHHsub0 Hns Hc).
207	    destruct IH1 as [Hn1 Hb1]. destruct IH2 as [Hn2 Hb2]. split.
208	    + split; assumption.
209	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh.
210	      destruct Hrh as [Hrh|Hrh]; [apply Hb1|apply Hb2]; exact Hrh.
211	  - (* subtyp_fld *)
212	    destruct Hc as [_ Hb]. split.
213	    + exact I.
214	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh.
215	      inversion Hrh; subst.
216	      pose proof (proj1 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hlow.
217	      pose proof (proj2 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hup.
218	      split; [eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption|eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption].
219	  - (* subtyp_typ *) split.
220	    + exact I.
221	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. discriminate Hrh.
222	  - (* subtyp_sel2 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
223	  - (* subtyp_sel1 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
224	  - (* subtyp_all *) split.
225	    + exact I.
226	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
227	Qed.
228	
229	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
230	(* The main field lemmas under [no_ty_member_typings].                    *)
231	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
232	
233	Theorem field_cov_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
234	    (Tf S U:typ),
235	  no_ty_member_typings G ->
236	  record_type V ->
237	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
238	  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
239	  G ⊢ Tf <: U.
240	Proof.
241	  intros G V a Tf S U Hns Hrt Hrh Hsub.
242	  pose proof (@record_type_bracket G V a Tf Hrt Hrh) as Hb.
243	  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
244	                Hns Hsub (conj (@record_type_nobot V Hrt) Hb)) as Hfinal.
245	  destruct Hfinal as [_ HbU].
246	  exact (proj2 (HbU S U (rh_one (dec_trm a S U)))).
247	Qed.
248	
249	Theorem field_contr_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
250	    (Tf S U:typ),
251	  no_ty_member_typings G ->
252	  record_type V ->
253	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
254	  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
255	  G ⊢ S <: Tf.
256	Proof.
257	  intros G V a Tf S U Hns Hrt Hrh Hsub.
258	  pose proof (@record_type_bracket G V a Tf Hrt Hrh) as Hb.
259	  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
260	                Hns Hsub (conj (@record_type_nobot V Hrt) Hb)) as Hfinal.
261	  destruct Hfinal as [_ HbU].
262	  exact (proj1 (HbU S U (rh_one (dec_trm a S U)))).
263	Qed.
264	
265	(* The combined pair statement. *)
266	Theorem field_pair_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
267	    (Tf S U:typ),
268	  no_ty_member_typings G ->
269	  record_type V ->
270	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
271	  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
272	  G ⊢ S <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: U.
273	Proof.
274	  intros. split.
275	  - eapply field_contr_no_ty_member; eassumption.
276	  - eapply field_cov_no_ty_member; eassumption.
277	Qed.
278	
279	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
280	(* The empty context satisfies the hypothesis, so both lemmas hold there. *)
281	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
282	
283	Lemma empty_typing_var_false_mut :
284	  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
285	     G = empty -> forall (x:var), t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False) /\
286	  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
287	  (forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U -> True) /\
288	  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).
289	Proof.
290	  apply (rules_mutind
291	    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
292	       G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False)
293	    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
294	    (fun (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (_:G ⊢ S <: U) => True)
295	    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True));
296	  intros;
297	  try (match goal with
298	       | b : binds ?x ?v ?G, He : ?G = empty |- False =>
299	           rewrite He in b; exact (binds_empty_inv b)
300	       end);
301	  try (match goal with
302	       | IH : ?G = empty -> forall y, ?t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> False,
303	         He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
304	           exfalso; eapply IH; [exact He | first [eassumption | reflexivity]]
305	       end);
306	  try (match goal with H : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- False => discriminate H end);
307	  try (match goal with H : trm_var (avar_f _) = ?t |- False => discriminate H end);
308	  auto.
309	Qed.
310	
311	Lemma empty_typing_var_false : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
312	  G ⊢ t ∶ T -> G = empty -> forall (x:var), t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False.
313	Proof.
314	  intros G t T H. exact (proj1 empty_typing_var_false_mut G t T H).
315	Qed.
316	
317	Lemma no_ty_member_typings_empty : no_ty_member_typings empty.
318	Proof.
319	  intros x A S T Hty.
320	  eapply (@empty_typing_var_false empty (trm_var (avar_f x))
321	            (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T))); [exact Hty|reflexivity|reflexivity].
322	Qed.
323	
324	Theorem field_cov_inert_empty : forall (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
325	  inert empty ->
326	  record_type V ->
327	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
328	  empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
329	  empty ⊢ Tf <: U.
330	Proof.
331	  intros. eapply field_cov_no_ty_member; [exact no_ty_member_typings_empty|eassumption..].
332	Qed.
333	
334	Theorem field_contr_inert_empty : forall (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
335	  inert empty ->
336	  record_type V ->
337	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
338	  empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
339	  empty ⊢ S <: Tf.
340	Proof.
341	  intros. eapply field_contr_no_ty_member; [exact no_ty_member_typings_empty|eassumption..].
342	Qed.
343	
344	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
345	(* A larger class of inert contexts: those whose bindings are all         *)
346	(* [typ_all] or [typ_con] (no [typ_bnd] at all).  In such a context no     *)
347	(* variable can ever be typed at a record type with a type member, so     *)
348	(* [no_ty_member_typings] holds and both field lemmas apply.              *)
349	(*                                                                        *)
350	(* The proof is a mutual induction over typing and subtyping.  The         *)
351	(* invariant [ntr x T] says that [T] is built (with intersections) from   *)
352	(* top, universal/existential object types, [typ_bnd] whose opening is    *)
353	(* [ntr], and record types whose visible members are all term members.    *)
354	(* There is deliberately no clause for [typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)]: this is *)
355	(* exactly the bad shape.  Selection rules can never fire because their   *)
356	(* typing premise would have to produce such a shape.                     *)
357	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
358	
359	Definition all_con_ctx (G:ctx) : Prop :=
360	  forall (x:var) (B:typ), binds x B G ->
361	    (exists S T, B = typ_all S T) \/
362	    (exists Ts is' T, B = typ_con Ts is' T).
363	
364	Inductive ntr (x:var) : typ -> Prop :=
365	| ntr_top : ntr x typ_top
366	| ntr_all : forall (S T:typ), ntr x (typ_all S T)
367	| ntr_con : forall (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (T:typ), ntr x (typ_con Ts is' T)
368	| ntr_and : forall (T U:typ), ntr x T -> ntr x U -> ntr x (typ_and T U)
369	| ntr_bnd : forall (T:typ), ntr x (open x T) -> ntr x (typ_bnd T)
370	| ntr_rcd_trm : forall (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
371	    ntr x (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U)).
372	
373	Lemma trm_var_inj : forall (x y:var),
374	  trm_var (avar_f x) = trm_var (avar_f y) -> x = y.
375	Proof. intros x y E. inversion E. reflexivity. Qed.
376	
377	Lemma all_con_ntr_mut :
378	  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
379	     all_con_ctx G -> forall (x:var), t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> ntr x T) /\
380	  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
381	  (forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U ->
382	     all_con_ctx G -> forall (x:var), ntr x S -> ntr x U) /\
383	  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).

53	    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
54	    (fun (G:ctx) (T U:typ) (_:G ⊢ T <: U) =>
55	       G = empty -> interp T -> interp U)
56	    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True));
57	  intros;

59	  try (match goal with

61	           rewrite He in H; exact (binds_empty_inv H)

Qed.

550	  eapply field_contr_no_ty_member.
551	  - intros x A0 S0 T0 Hty.
552	    exact (bnd_ok_no_ty_member_typings G Hok x A0 S0 T0 Hty).
553	  - exact Hrt. - exact Hrh. - exact Hsub.
554	Qed.
555	
556	Theorem field_pair_inert_bnd_ok : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
557	    (Tf S U:typ),
558	  inert G ->
559	  bnd_ok_ctx G ->
560	  record_type V ->
561	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
562	  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
563	  G ⊢ S <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: U.
564	Proof.
565	  intros. split.
566	  - eapply field_contr_inert_bnd_ok; eassumption.
567	  - eapply field_cov_inert_bnd_ok; eassumption.
568	Qed.
569	
570	(* The [all_con_ctx] invariant of the shorter version is the special case
571	   of [bnd_ok_ctx] with no bound bindings. *)
572	Definition all_con_ctx (G:ctx) : Prop :=
573	  forall (x:var) (B:typ), binds x B G ->
574	    (exists S T, B = typ_all S T) \/
575	    (exists Ts is' T, B = typ_con Ts is' T).
576	
577	Lemma all_con_ctx_bnd_ok : forall (G:ctx),
578	  all_con_ctx G -> bnd_ok_ctx G.
579	Proof.
580	  intros G H x B Hb.
581	  destruct (H x B Hb) as [Hl|Hr].
582	  - left. exact Hl.
583	  - right. left. exact Hr.
584	Qed.
585	
586	Theorem field_cov_inert_all_con : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
587	    (Tf S U:typ),
588	  inert G ->
589	  all_con_ctx G ->
590	  record_type V ->
591	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
592	  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
593	  G ⊢ Tf <: U.
594	Proof.
595	  intros G V a Tf S U Hi Hac Hrt Hrh Hsub.
596	  eapply field_cov_inert_bnd_ok.
597	  - exact Hi.
598	  - exact (all_con_ctx_bnd_ok G Hac).
599	  - exact Hrt. - exact Hrh. - exact Hsub.
600	Qed.
601	
602	Theorem field_contr_inert_all_con : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
603	    (Tf S U:typ),
604	  inert G ->
605	  all_con_ctx G ->
606	  record_type V ->
607	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
608	  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
609	  G ⊢ S <: Tf.
610	Proof.
611	  intros G V a Tf S U Hi Hac Hrt Hrh Hsub.
612	  eapply field_contr_inert_bnd_ok.
613	  - exact Hi.
614	  - exact (all_con_ctx_bnd_ok G Hac).
615	  - exact Hrt. - exact Hrh. - exact Hsub.
616	Qed.
617	
618	Theorem field_pair_inert_all_con : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
619	    (Tf S U:typ),
620	  inert G ->
621	  all_con_ctx G ->
622	  record_type V ->
623	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
624	  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
625	  G ⊢ S <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: U.
626	Proof.
627	  intros. split.
628	  - eapply field_contr_inert_all_con; eassumption.
629	  - eapply field_cov_inert_all_con; eassumption.
630	Qed.
631	
632	(* The exact requested statements, conditional on the (verified for the
633	   classes above) absence of type-member record typings. *)
634	Theorem field_cov_inert_of_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ)
635	    (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
636	  inert G ->
637	  no_ty_member_typings G ->
638	  record_type V ->
639	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
640	  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
641	  G ⊢ Tf <: U.
642	Proof.
643	  intros. eapply field_cov_no_ty_member; eassumption.
644	Qed.
645	
646	Theorem field_contr_inert_of_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ)
647	    (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
648	  inert G ->
649	  no_ty_member_typings G ->
650	  record_type V ->
651	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
652	  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
653	  G ⊢ S <: Tf.
654	Proof.
655	  intros. eapply field_contr_no_ty_member; eassumption.
656	Qed.
657	
658	Theorem field_pair_inert_of_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ)
659	    (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
660	  inert G ->
661	  no_ty_member_typings G ->
662	  record_type V ->
663	  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
664	  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
665	  G ⊢ S <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: U.
666	Proof.
667	  intros. split.
668	  - eapply field_contr_inert_of_no_ty_member; eassumption.
669	  - eapply field_cov_inert_of_no_ty_member; eassumption.
670	Qed.
671	
672	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
673	(* Status of the general inert statements and the precise remaining       *)
674	(* subgoal.                                                               *)
675	(*                                                                        *)
676	(* Under [inert G] the only missing ingredient is the following           *)
677	(* coherence property for type members of an inert [typ_bnd] binding.     *)
678	(*                                                                        *)
679	(*   TypeMemberCoherence:                                                 *)
680	(*     forall G x U A S1 T1 S2 T2,                                        *)
681	(*       inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U ->             *)
682	(*       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) ->            *)
683	(*       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2) ->            *)
684	(*       S1 <: T2.                                                        *)
685	(*                                                                        *)
686	(* Indeed [record_type] gives a unique equal bound [W] at the label [A]   *)
687	(* in [U]; after opening, any record typing of [x] at [dec_typ A S T]    *)
688	(* must be obtained by widening a flow tip of [open x U], which forces    *)
689	(* S <: W <: T.  Two typings therefore give S1 <: W <: T2.  This is       *)
690	(* exactly the type-member analogue of the two field lemmas we prove      *)
691	(* above, and it has the same proof shape (the [compat] preservation      *)
692	(* argument of [compat_closure], with [bracket] replaced by a             *)
693	(* type-label bracket and the [sel2]/[sel1] cases discharged by the       *)
694	(* typing induction instead of by vacuity).  The general inert versions   *)
695	(* of [field_cov_inert]/[field_contr_inert] then follow by the             *)
696	(* [compat] closure argument, defining [compat] on [typ_sel] types via    *)
697	(* the canonical member bound [W] of the variable's inert binding.        *)
698	(*                                                                        *)
699	(* The obstruction is genuinely a mutual induction: in                    *)
700	(* [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] the typing premise is not a subderivation  *)
701	(* of the subtyping tree, so the induction must be taken over             *)
702	(* [rules_mutind] (typing and subtyping simultaneously), with a typing    *)
703	(* motive producing [TypeMemberCoherence].  The [ty_sub] case of that     *)
704	(* motive needs the [compat] preservation above for a *type-label*        *)
705	(* bracket, and the [ty_rec_intro]/[ty_rec_elim] cases need the           *)
706	(* body/opening correspondence [typ_bnd W -> open x W].  The auxiliary    *)
707	(* negative result [bnd_companion_not_unique] (RootSub.v) shows that      *)
708	(* the body [W] cannot be recovered by uniqueness, which is why the       *)
709	(* motive has to be type-directed.                                        *)
710	(*                                                                        *)
711	(* The verified [bnd_ok_ctx] class above covers exactly the sub-case in   *)
712	(* which the bound body [U] has no [dec_typ] members, so that no         *)
713	(* selection typing of [x] can exist.  The remaining gap is [U] with      *)
714	(* equal-bounded [dec_typ] members: selections do exist there (for        *)
715	(* instance [x : open x U] gives a record typing at each member), and     *)
716	(* [TypeMemberCoherence] is what rules out the bad asymmetric            *)
717	(* counterexample in that case.                                           *)
718	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
719	
720	Check field_cov_no_ty_member.
721	Check field_contr_no_ty_member.
722	Check field_pair_no_ty_member.
723	Check field_cov_inert_empty.
724	Check field_contr_inert_empty.
725	Check inert_no_bad_type_member_binds.
726	Check bnd_ok_no_ty_member_typings.
727	Check field_cov_inert_bnd_ok.
728	Check field_contr_inert_bnd_ok.
729	Check field_pair_inert_bnd_ok.
730	Check field_cov_inert_all_con.
731	Check field_contr_inert_all_con.
732	Check field_pair_inert_all_con.
733	Check field_cov_inert_of_no_ty_member.
734	Check field_contr_inert_of_no_ty_member.

mkdir -p /tmp/allcon && cat > /tmp/allcon/Model.v <<'EOF'
Require Import Base.
Require Import RootSub.
Require Import LitInv.
Require Import AppPrep.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

Section TopModel.
Variable x : var.
Variable a : typ_label.

(* The context x : top. *)
Definition Gx : ctx := x ~ typ_top.

(* [P x T] is the typing invariant: a type ascribed to [x] is never a
   type-member record (and recursively, its bound types are safe). *)
Inductive P : typ -> Prop :=
| P_top : P typ_top
| P_sel : forall (v:avar) (A:typ_label), P (typ_sel v A)
| P_all : forall S T, P (typ_all S T)
| P_con : forall Ts is' T, P (typ_con Ts is' T)
| P_rcd_trm : forall (m:trm_label) Sl Su, P (typ_rcd (dec_trm m Sl Su))
| P_and : forall T U, P T -> P U -> P (typ_and T U)
| P_bnd : forall W, P (open x W) -> P (typ_bnd W).

Lemma P_not_bot : P typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma P_not_rcd_typ : forall (A:typ_label) (Sl Su:typ),
  P (typ_rcd (dec_typ A Sl Su)) -> False.
Proof. intros A Sl Su H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma P_bnd_inv : forall W, P (typ_bnd W) -> P (open x W).
Proof. intros W H. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

(* [TopGen x a T] are the types obtainable from [top] and [x.a] by
   intersections.  In the context x : top these are exactly the supertypes
   of [x.a]; in particular no [typ_all] is ever one of them. *)
Inductive TopGen : typ -> Prop :=
| TG_top : TopGen typ_top
| TG_sel : TopGen (typ_sel (avar_f x) a)
| TG_and : forall T U, TopGen T -> TopGen U -> TopGen (typ_and T U).

Lemma TopGen_not_bot : TopGen typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma TopGen_not_rcd : forall D, TopGen (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma TopGen_not_bnd : forall W, TopGen (typ_bnd W) -> False.
Proof. intros W H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma TopGen_not_all : forall S T, TopGen (typ_all S T) -> False.
Proof. intros S T H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma TopGen_not_con : forall Ts is' T, TopGen (typ_con Ts is' T) -> False.
Proof. intros Ts is' T H. inversion H. Qed.

(* Main soundness invariant, by mutual induction on typing/subtyping. *)
Lemma Gx_sound :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
     G = Gx -> forall y, t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> y = x /\ P T) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U ->
     G = Gx -> (P S -> P U) /\ (TopGen S -> TopGen U)) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).
Proof.
  apply (rules_mutind
    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
       G = Gx -> forall y, t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> y = x /\ P T)
    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (_:G ⊢ S <: U) =>
       G = Gx -> (P S -> P U) /\ (TopGen S -> TopGen U))
    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True));
  intros.
  - (* ty_var *)
    rename t into b. intros HG y0 E. subst G.
    inversion E; subst.
    apply binds_single_inv in b. destruct b as [Ex ET]. subst y0. subst T.
    split; [reflexivity|apply P_top].
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros HG y0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_new *) intros HG y0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_rcd_elim *) intros HG y0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_fld_asn *) intros HG y0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_let *) intros HG y0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_llit *) intros HG y0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *)
    intros G y T t IH HG y0 E. subst G. inversion E; subst.
    destruct (IH eq_refl y eq_refl) as [Ey HP].
    split; [exact Ey|rewrite Ey in HP; apply P_bnd; exact HP].
  - (* ty_rec_elim *)
    intros G y T t IH HG y0 E. subst G. inversion E; subst.
    destruct (IH eq_refl y eq_refl) as [Ey HP].
    split; [exact Ey|rewrite Ey in HP; apply P_bnd_inv; exact HP].
  - (* ty_and_intro *)
    intros G y T U t1 IH1 t2 IH2 HG y0 E. subst G. inversion E; subst.
    destruct (IH1 eq_refl y eq_refl) as [Ey HP1].
    destruct (IH2 eq_refl y eq_refl) as [_ HP2].
    split; [exact Ey|rewrite Ey in *; apply P_and; assumption].
  - (* ty_sub *)
    intros G t T U t0 IHt s IHs HG y0 E. subst G.
    destruct (IHt eq_refl y0 E) as [Ey HP].
    destruct (IHs eq_refl) as [HPP _].
    split; [exact Ey|apply HPP; exact HP].
  - (* ty_all_intro *) exact I.
  - (* ty_con_intro *) exact I.
  - (* subtyp_top *)
    intros G T HG. split; intros H; [apply P_top|apply TG_top].
  - (* subtyp_bot *)
    intros G T HG. split; intros H.
    + exfalso. exact (P_not_bot H).
    + exfalso. exact (TopGen_not_bot H).
  - (* subtyp_refl *)
    intros G T HG. split; intros H; assumption.
  - (* subtyp_trans *)
    intros G S T U s IH1 s0 IH2 HG.
    destruct (IH1 HG) as [HP1 HT1]. destruct (IH2 HG) as [HP2 HT2].
    split; intros H.
    + apply HP2, HP1, H.
    + apply HT2, HT1, H.
  - (* subtyp_and11 *)
    intros G T U HG. split; intros H.
    + inversion H; subst; assumption.
    + inversion H; subst; assumption.
  - (* subtyp_and12 *)
    intros G T U HG. split; intros H.
    + inversion H; subst; assumption.
    + inversion H; subst; assumption.
  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
    intros G S T U s IH1 s0 IH2 HG.
    destruct (IH1 HG) as [HP1 HT1]. destruct (IH2 HG) as [HP2 HT2].
    split; intros H.
    + apply P_and; [apply HP1|apply HP2]; exact H.
    + apply TG_and; [apply HT1|apply HT2]; exact H.
  - (* subtyp_fld *)
    intros G m T1 T2 U1 U2 s IH1 s0 IH2 HG.
    split; intros H.
    + apply P_rcd_trm.
    + exfalso. exact (TopGen_not_rcd _ H).
  - (* subtyp_typ *)
    intros G A S1 T1 S2 T2 s IH1 s0 IH2 HG.
    split; intros H.
    + exfalso. eapply P_not_rcd_typ; exact H.
    + exfalso. eapply TopGen_not_rcd; exact H.
  - (* subtyp_sel2 *)
    intros G y A S T t IHty HG.
    exfalso.
    destruct (IHty HG y eq_refl) as [_ HP].
    eapply P_not_rcd_typ; exact HP.
  - (* subtyp_sel1 *)
    intros G y A S T t IHty HG.
    exfalso.
    destruct (IHty HG y eq_refl) as [_ HP].
    eapply P_not_rcd_typ; exact HP.
  - (* subtyp_all *)
    intros L G S1 T1 S2 T2 s IH1 s0 IH2 HG.
    split; intros H.
    + apply P_all.
    + exfalso. exact (TopGen_not_all _ _ H).
  - (* typ_avars_nil *) exact I.
  - (* typ_avars_cons *) exact I.
Qed.

Lemma Gx_typing_sound : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  G = Gx -> forall y, t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> y = x /\ P T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 Gx_sound G t T H H0 y H1). Qed.

Lemma Gx_subtyp_sound : forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U ->
  G = Gx -> (P S -> P U) /\ (TopGen S -> TopGen U).
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 Gx_sound)) G S U H H0). Qed.

Lemma Gx_no_ty_member_record : forall (y:var) (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
  Gx ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) -> False.
Proof.
  intros y A S T Hty.
  destruct (Gx_typing_sound Gx (trm_var (avar_f y)) (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) Hty eq_refl y eq_refl) as [_ HP].
  eapply P_not_rcd_typ; exact HP.
Qed.

(* In the context x : top, [x.a] is never below a universal type. *)
Lemma Gx_sel_not_all : forall (X Y:typ),
  ~ (Gx ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) a <: typ_all X Y).
Proof.
  intros X Y Hsub.
  destruct (proj2 (Gx_subtyp_sound Gx (typ_sel (avar_f x) a) (typ_all X Y) Hsub eq_refl)) as HTG.
  apply (HTG TG_sel).
  (* goal: TopGen (typ_all X Y) *)
  exact (TopGen_not_all X Y (HTG TG_sel)).
Qed.

End TopModel.
EOF

Section Counterexample.
Variable a : typ_label.
Variable Sl : typ.

Definition Sf : typ := typ_top.
Definition Uf : typ := typ_sel (avar_b 0) a.
Definition Ut : typ := typ_all typ_top typ_top.
Definition Sdom : typ := typ_rcd (dec_typ a Sl Ut).

Lemma open_Uf : forall x:var, open x Uf = typ_sel (avar_f x) a.
Proof. intros x. unfold Uf. unfold open. cbn. rewrite If_l; auto. Qed.

Lemma open_Ut : forall x:var, open x Ut = Ut.
Proof. intros x. unfold Ut. cbn. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma open_Sf : forall x:var, open x Sf = Sf.
Proof. intros x. unfold Sf. cbn. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma Sdom_sub_Sf : (empty:ctx) ⊢ Sdom <: Sf.
Proof. unfold Sdom, Sf. apply subtyp_top. Qed.

Lemma body_at_Sdom : forall x:var,
  (empty:ctx) & x ~ Sdom ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) a <: Ut.
Proof.
  intros x.
  assert (Hb : binds x Sdom ((empty:ctx) & x ~ Sdom)) by apply binds_push_eq.
  assert (Hx : (empty:ctx) & x ~ Sdom ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ Sdom)
    by (apply ty_var; exact Hb).
  eapply subtyp_sel1. exact Hx.
Qed.

(* The antecedent of the (stated) inversion lemma. *)
Lemma cex_ante : (empty:ctx) ⊢ typ_all Sf Uf <: typ_all Sdom Ut.
Proof.
  eapply subtyp_all with (L := \{}).
  - apply Sdom_sub_Sf.
  - intros x Hx. rewrite open_Uf. rewrite open_Ut. apply body_at_Sdom.
Qed.

(* The conclusion's body, at the *source* domain [Sf] = top, is false. *)
Lemma body_at_Sf_false : forall x:var,
  ~ ((empty:ctx) & x ~ Sf ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) a <: Ut).
Proof.
  intros x H.
  change (Gx x ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) a <: typ_all typ_top typ_top) in H.
  exact (Gx_sel_not_all x a typ_top typ_top H).
Qed.

(* Therefore the statement [subtyp_all_inv_inert] with the body checked at
   the source domain [Sf] is false. *)
Theorem stated_body_at_Sf_false :
  inert (empty:ctx) /\
  ((empty:ctx) ⊢ typ_all Sf Uf <: typ_all Sdom Ut) /\
  ~ (exists L, (empty:ctx) ⊢ Sdom <: Sf /\
       (forall x, x \notin L ->
          (empty:ctx) & x ~ Sf ⊢ open x Uf <: open x Ut)).
Proof.
  split; [apply inert_empty|split; [apply cex_ante|]].
  intros [L [_ Hbody]].
  destruct (@var_fresh L) as [x Hx].
  specialize (Hbody x Hx).
  rewrite open_Uf in Hbody. rewrite open_Ut in Hbody.
  exact (body_at_Sf_false x Hbody).
Qed.

End Counterexample.

Check stated_body_at_Sf_false.

Instance TypFreeVar : FreeVar typ := fv_typ.

Instance TypsFreeVar : FreeVar typs := fv_typs.

Instance DecFreeVar : FreeVar dec := fv_dec.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (u: var) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (subst_dec z u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_sel x L    => typ_sel (subst_var z u x) L
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (subst_typ z u T)
  | typ_all T U    => typ_all (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | typ_con Ts is' T   => typ_con (subst_typs z u Ts) is' (subst_typ z u T)
  end with
subst_typs (z: var) (u: var) (Ts: typs) { struct Ts } : typs :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => typs_nil
  | typs_cons T Ts => typs_cons (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typs z u Ts)
  end with
subst_dec (z: var) (u: var) (D: dec) { struct D } : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_trm L T U => dec_trm L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  end.

Instance TypSubstVar : SubstVar typ := subst_typ.

Instance TypsSubstVar : SubstVar typs := subst_typs.

Instance DecSubstVar : SubstVar dec := subst_dec.

Instance TypAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax TypOpenable TypFreeVar TypSubstVar := {}.

Instance TypsAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax TypsOpenable TypsFreeVar TypsSubstVar := {}.

Instance DecAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DecOpenable DecFreeVar DecSubstVar := {}.

Instance DecLabelOf : LabelOf dec :=
  fun D =>
      match D with
      | dec_typ L _ _ => label_typ L
      | dec_trm m _ _ => label_trm m
      end.

Fixpoint collect_typ {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (T: typ) : C :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => df
  | typ_bot        => df
  | typ_rcd D      => (collect_dec df f comb D)
  | typ_and T U    => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | typ_sel x L    => (f x)
  | typ_bnd T      => (collect_typ df f comb T)
  | typ_all T1 T2  => comb (collect_typ df f comb T1) (collect_typ df f comb T2)
  | typ_con Ts is' T => comb (collect_typs df f comb Ts) (collect_typ df f comb T)
  end with
collect_typs {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (Ts: typs) : C :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => df
  | typs_cons T Ts => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typs df f comb Ts)
  end with
collect_dec {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (D: dec) : C :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | dec_trm m T U => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  end.

Instance TypCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax TypAbstractSyntax
  := @collect_typ.

Instance TypsCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax TypsAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_typs.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax.

Reserved Notation "G '⊢!' x '∶' T '⪼' U" (at level 40, x at level 59).

Inductive precise_flow : var -> ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=

  | pf_bind : forall x G T,
      binds x T G ->
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ T

  | pf_open : forall x G T U,
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ typ_bnd U ->
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ open x U

  | pf_and1 : forall x G T U1 U2,
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ typ_and U1 U2 ->
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ U1

  | pf_and2 : forall x G T U1 U2,
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ typ_and U1 U2 ->
      G ⊢! x ∶ T ⪼ U2

where "G '⊢!' x '∶' T '⪼' U" := (precise_flow x G T U).

(** * Shape facts *)

Lemma record_type_not_top : record_type typ_top -> False.
Proof. intros [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_bot : record_type typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_sel : forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), record_type (typ_sel a A) -> False.
Proof. intros a A [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_all : forall (S T:typ), record_type (typ_all S T) -> False.
Proof. intros S T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_con : forall (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (T:typ), record_type (typ_con Ts is' T) -> False.
Proof. intros Ts is' T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma record_type_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), record_type (typ_bnd T) -> False.
Proof. intros T [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_not_top : inert_typ typ_top -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_bot : inert_typ typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_sel : forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label), inert_typ (typ_sel a A) -> False.
Proof. intros a A H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_rcd : forall (D:dec), inert_typ (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma inert_typ_not_and : forall (T U:typ), inert_typ (typ_and T U) -> False.
Proof. intros T U H. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Shape of precise flow tips in an inert setting *)

Lemma flow_shape : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  inert_typ T0 ->
  binds x T0 G ->
  (V = T0 /\ inert_typ T0) \/ record_type V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf; intros Hi Hb.
  - left. split; [reflexivity|assumption].
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + inversion Heq; subst. inversion Hi2; subst.
      right. apply record_type_open. assumption.
    + exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exists ls. exact Hr.
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists ls'. exact (proj1 HP).
  - specialize (IHHf Hi Hb). destruct IHHf as [[Heq Hi2]|[ls Hr]].
    + exfalso. inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_and U1 U2 Hi2).
    + right. destruct (@record_typ_and_inv _ _ ls Hr) as [ls' [D HP]].
      exists (\{label_of D}).
      assert (HeqU : U2 = typ_rcd D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 HP)).
      assert (Hrd : record_dec D) by exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 HP))).
      rewrite HeqU. apply rt_one; [exact Hrd|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma flow_typing : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 V:typ),
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ V ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ V.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 V Hf. induction Hf.
  - apply ty_var. assumption.
  - eapply ty_rec_elim. exact IHHf.
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and11].
  - eapply ty_sub; [exact IHHf|apply subtyp_and12].
Qed.

(** * Corollaries: no flow tip is a top/bottom/selection type *)

Lemma flow_not_top : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_top -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_top Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_top Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_top. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_bot : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_bot -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_bot Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_bot Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_bot. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma flow_not_sel : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0:typ) (a:avar) (A:typ_label),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_sel a A -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 a A Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 (typ_sel a A) Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (@inert_typ_not_sel a A Hi2).
  - exact (@record_type_not_sel a A Hr).
Qed.

Lemma flow_bnd_eq : forall (x:var) (G:ctx) (T0 U:typ),
  inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_bnd U -> typ_bnd U = T0.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 U Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 (typ_bnd U) Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - exact Heq.
  - exfalso. eapply record_type_not_bnd. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma record_has_rcd_inv : forall (D D':dec), record_has (typ_rcd D) D' -> D' = D.
Proof. intros D D' H. inversion H; subst; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma record_has_and_inv : forall (T U:typ) (D:dec),
  record_has (typ_and T U) D -> record_has T D \/ record_has U D.
Proof. intros T U D H. inversion H; subst; [left|right]; assumption. Qed.

Lemma defs_update_label_in : forall (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  exists d, List.In d hds /\ label_of d = label_trm a.
Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y H. induction H.

Lemma inert_typ_open_rec : forall (T:typ) (n:nat) (u:var),
  inert_typ T -> inert_typ (open_rec n u T).
Proof.
  intros T n u H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply inert_typ_all.
  - eapply inert_typ_con. eapply record_type_open. eassumption.
  - eapply inert_typ_bnd. eapply record_type_open. eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_open : forall (T:typ) (u:var),
  inert_typ T -> inert_typ (open u T).
Proof. intros. eapply inert_typ_open_rec. exact H. Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_open_rec_vars : forall (T:typ) (k:nat) (ys:list var),
  inert_typ T -> inert_typ (open_rec_vars k ys T).
Proof.
  intros T k ys. revert T k. induction ys; intros T k H.
  - cbn. exact H.
  - cbn. eapply IHys. eapply inert_typ_open_rec. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_open_vars : forall (T:typ) (ys:list var),
  inert_typ T -> inert_typ (open_vars ys T).
Proof. intros. eapply inert_typ_open_rec_vars. exact H. Qed.

Lemma record_typ_open_rec_vars : forall (T:typ) (k:nat) (ys:list var) (ls:fset label),
  record_typ T ls -> record_typ (open_rec_vars k ys T) ls.
Proof.
  intros T k ys ls Hrt. revert T k Hrt.
  induction ys; intros T k Hrt.
  - cbn. exact Hrt.
  - cbn. eapply IHys. eapply record_typ_open. exact Hrt.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_open_rec_vars : forall (T:typ) (k:nat) (ys:list var),
  record_type T -> record_type (open_rec_vars k ys T).
Proof.
  intros T k ys [ls Hrt]. exists ls. eapply record_typ_open_rec_vars. exact Hrt.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_open_vars : forall (T:typ) (ys:list var),
  record_type T -> record_type (open_vars ys T).
Proof. intros. eapply record_type_open_rec_vars. exact H. Qed.

Lemma inert_inits_push_committed : forall (D:init_ctx) (x:var),
  inert_inits D -> inert_inits (D & x ~ committed).
Proof.
  intros D x H y i Hy. unfold inert_inits in *.
  destruct (classic (y = x)) as [->|Hne].
  - apply binds_push_eq_inv in Hy. subst i. right. reflexivity.
  - eapply H. eapply binds_push_neq_inv; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma inert_inits_push_free : forall (D:init_ctx) (x:var),
  inert_inits D -> inert_inits (D & x ~ free).
Proof.
  intros D x H y i Hy. unfold inert_inits in *.
  destruct (classic (y = x)) as [->|Hne].
  - apply binds_push_eq_inv in Hy. subst i. left. reflexivity.
  - eapply H. eapply binds_push_neq_inv; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma inert_push : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (T:typ),
  inert G -> inert_typ T -> x # G -> inert (G & x ~ T).
Proof. intros. eapply inert_all; eassumption. Qed.

Lemma open_rec_avar_inj : forall (n:nat) (u:var) (a1 a2:avar),
  u \notin fv a1 -> u \notin fv a2 ->
  open_rec n u a1 = open_rec n u a2 -> a1 = a2.
Proof.
  intros n u a1 a2 H1 H2 H.
  destruct a1 as [n1|y1]; destruct a2 as [n2|y2]; simpl in *.
  - destruct (Nat.eq_dec n1 n) as [->|E1];
      destruct (Nat.eq_dec n2 n) as [->|E2].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=n = n) _ _ eq_refl) in H.
      inversion H. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=n = n) _ _ eq_refl) in H.
      rewrite (If_r (P:=n = n2) _ _ (fun E => E2 (eq_sym E))) in H.
      discriminate.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=n = n1) _ _ (fun E => E1 (eq_sym E))) in H.
      rewrite (If_l (P:=n = n) _ _ eq_refl) in H.
      discriminate.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=n = n1) _ _ (fun E => E1 (eq_sym E))) in H.
      rewrite (If_r (P:=n = n2) _ _ (fun E => E2 (eq_sym E))) in H.
      inversion H. reflexivity.
  - destruct (Nat.eq_dec n1 n) as [->|E1].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=n = n) _ _ eq_refl) in H.
      inversion H; subst.
      exfalso. apply H2. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=n = n1) _ _ (fun E => E1 (eq_sym E))) in H.
      discriminate.
  - destruct (Nat.eq_dec n2 n) as [->|E2].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=n = n) _ _ eq_refl) in H.
      inversion H; subst.
      exfalso. apply H1. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=n = n2) _ _ (fun E => E2 (eq_sym E))) in H.
      discriminate.
  - inversion H. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_rec_inj_mut :
  (forall (T:typ), forall (n:nat) (u:var) (T2:typ),
      u \notin fv T -> u \notin fv T2 ->
      open_rec n u T = open_rec n u T2 -> T = T2) /\
  (forall (Ts:typs), forall (n:nat) (u:var) (Ts2:typs),
      u \notin fv_typs Ts -> u \notin fv_typs Ts2 ->
      open_rec n u Ts = open_rec n u Ts2 -> Ts = Ts2) /\
  (forall (D:dec), forall (n:nat) (u:var) (D2:dec),
      u \notin fv_dec D -> u \notin fv_dec D2 ->
      open_rec n u D = open_rec n u D2 -> D = D2).
Proof.
  apply (typ_mutind
    (fun T => forall (n:nat) (u:var) (T2:typ),
        u \notin fv T -> u \notin fv T2 ->
        open_rec n u T = open_rec n u T2 -> T = T2)
    (fun Ts => forall (n:nat) (u:var) (Ts2:typs),
        u \notin fv_typs Ts -> u \notin fv_typs Ts2 ->
        open_rec n u Ts = open_rec n u Ts2 -> Ts = Ts2)
    (fun D => forall (n:nat) (u:var) (D2:dec),
        u \notin fv_dec D -> u \notin fv_dec D2 ->
        open_rec n u D = open_rec n u D2 -> D = D2)).
  - intros n u T2 H1 H2 H. destruct T2; simpl in H, H1, H2; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - intros n u T2 H1 H2 H. destruct T2; simpl in H, H1, H2; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - intros d IH n u T2 H1 H2 H. destruct T2; simpl in H, H1, H2; try discriminate.
    injection H as Hd. f_equal. eapply (IH n u); [exact H1|exact H2|exact Hd].
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 n u T2 H1 H2 H.
    destruct T2; simpl in H, H1, H2; try discriminate.
    injection H as H1' H2'. f_equal.
    + eapply (IHt n u); [| |exact H1'].
      * intro K. apply H1. rewrite in_union. left. exact K.
      * intro K. apply H2. rewrite in_union. left. exact K.
    + eapply (IHt0 n u); [| |exact H2'].
      * intro K. apply H1. rewrite in_union. right. exact K.
      * intro K. apply H2. rewrite in_union. right. exact K.
  - intros a A n u T2 H1 H2 H. destruct T2; simpl in H, H1, H2; try discriminate.
    injection H as Ha HA. subst. f_equal.
    eapply open_rec_avar_inj; eassumption.
  - intros t IH n u T2 H1 H2 H. destruct T2; simpl in H, H1, H2; try discriminate.
    injection H as H'. f_equal. eapply (IH (S n) u); [exact H1|exact H2|exact H'].
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 n u T2 H1 H2 H. destruct T2; simpl in H, H1, H2; try discriminate.
    injection H as H1' H2'. f_equal.
    + eapply (IHt n u); [| |exact H1'].
      * intro K. apply H1. rewrite in_union. left. exact K.
      * intro K. apply H2. rewrite in_union. left. exact K.
    + eapply (IHt0 (S n) u); [| |exact H2'].
      * intro K. apply H1. rewrite in_union. right. exact K.
      * intro K. apply H2. rewrite in_union. right. exact K.
  - intros Ts IHts is' T IHt n u T2 H1 H2 H. destruct T2; simpl in H, H1, H2; try discriminate.
    injection H as Hts His HT. subst.
    assert (HeqTs : Ts = t).
    { eapply (IHts n u); [| |exact Hts].
      - intro K. apply H1. rewrite in_union. left. exact K.
      - intro K. apply H2. rewrite in_union. left. exact K. }
    subst t. f_equal.
    eapply (IHt (S (length_s Ts) + n) u);
      [ intro K; apply H1; rewrite in_union; right; exact K
      | intro K; apply H2; rewrite in_union; right; exact K
      | exact HT ].
  - intros n u Ts2 H1 H2 H. destruct Ts2; simpl in H, H1, H2; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - intros t IHt ts IHts n u Ts2 H1 H2 H. destruct Ts2; simpl in H, H1, H2; try discriminate.
    injection H as H1' H2'. f_equal.
    + eapply (IHt n u); [| |exact H1'].
      * intro K. apply H1. rewrite in_union. left. exact K.
      * intro K. apply H2. rewrite in_union. left. exact K.
    + eapply (IHts n u); [| |exact H2'].
      * intro K. apply H1. rewrite in_union. right. exact K.
      * intro K. apply H2. rewrite in_union. right. exact K.
  - intros A t IHt t0 IHt0 n u D2 H1 H2 H. destruct D2; simpl in H, H1, H2; try discriminate.
    injection H as HA H1' H2'. subst. f_equal.
    + eapply (IHt n u); [| |exact H1'].
      * intro K. apply H1. rewrite in_union. left. exact K.
      * intro K. apply H2. rewrite in_union. left. exact K.
    + eapply (IHt0 n u); [| |exact H2'].
      * intro K. apply H1. rewrite in_union. right. exact K.
      * intro K. apply H2. rewrite in_union. right. exact K.
  - intros a t IHt t0 IHt0 n u D2 H1 H2 H. destruct D2; simpl in H, H1, H2; try discriminate.
    injection H as Ha H1' H2'. subst. f_equal.
    + eapply (IHt n u); [| |exact H1'].
      * intro K. apply H1. rewrite in_union. left. exact K.
      * intro K. apply H2. rewrite in_union. left. exact K.
    + eapply (IHt0 n u); [| |exact H2'].
      * intro K. apply H1. rewrite in_union. right. exact K.
      * intro K. apply H2. rewrite in_union. right; exact K.
Qed.

Corollary open_rec_typ_inj : forall (n:nat) (u:var) (T1 T2:typ),
  u \notin fv T1 -> u \notin fv T2 ->
  open_rec n u T1 = open_rec n u T2 -> T1 = T2.
Proof. intros. eapply (proj1 open_rec_inj_mut); eassumption. Qed.

Lemma record_dec_open_rec_inv : forall (n:nat) (u:var) (D:dec),
  u \notin fv D -> record_dec (open_rec n u D) -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros n u D Hf H. destruct D as [A T1 T2|a T1 T2]; simpl in H; simpl in Hf.
  - inversion H; subst.
    assert (Heq : T1 = T2).
    { eapply open_rec_typ_inj.
      - intro K. apply Hf. rewrite in_union. left. exact K.
      - intro K. apply Hf. rewrite in_union. right. exact K.
      - eassumption. }
    subst. apply rd_typ.
  - inversion H; subst.
    assert (Heq : T1 = T2).
    { eapply open_rec_typ_inj.
      - intro K. apply Hf. rewrite in_union. left. exact K.
      - intro K. apply Hf. rewrite in_union. right. exact K.
      - eassumption. }
    subst. apply rd_trm.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_open_rec_inv_mut :
  (forall (T:typ), forall (n:nat) (u:var) (ls:fset label),
      u \notin fv T -> record_typ (open_rec n u T) ls -> record_typ T ls) /\
  (forall (Ts:typs), True) /\ (forall (D:dec), True).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros n u ls Hf Hrt. simpl in Hrt. inversion Hrt.
  - intros n u ls Hf Hrt. simpl in Hrt. inversion Hrt.
  - intros d IH n u ls Hf Hrt. simpl in Hf, Hrt.
    destruct (record_typ_rcd_inv Hrt) as [Hrd Hls].
    assert (HrdD : record_dec d) by (eapply record_dec_open_rec_inv; eassumption).
    rewrite Hls, label_of_open_dec. apply rt_one; [exact HrdD|reflexivity].
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 n u ls Hf Hrt. simpl in Hf, Hrt.
    destruct (record_typ_and_inv Hrt) as [ls' [D [Hrt1 [HeqU [Hrd [Hnin Hls]]]]]].
    destruct t0 as [| |D2|T2 U2|a2 A2|T2|T2 U2|Ts2 is2 T2]; simpl in HeqU; try discriminate.
    injection HeqU as HeqD. simpl in Hf.
    assert (HrdD : record_dec D2).
    { refine (@record_dec_open_rec_inv n u D2 _ _).
      - intro K. apply Hf. rewrite in_union. right. exact K.
      - change (record_dec (open_rec_dec n u D2)). rewrite HeqD. exact Hrd. }
    rewrite Hls, <- HeqD, label_of_open_dec.
    apply rt_cons; [|exact HrdD|reflexivity|].
    + eapply IHt; [|exact Hrt1].
      intro K. apply Hf. rewrite in_union. left. exact K.
    + rewrite <- HeqD, label_of_open_dec in Hnin. exact Hnin.
  - intros a A n u ls Hf Hrt. simpl in Hrt. inversion Hrt.
  - intros t IH n u ls Hf Hrt. simpl in Hrt. inversion Hrt.
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 n u ls Hf Hrt. simpl in Hrt. inversion Hrt.
  - intros Ts IHts is' T IHt n u ls Hf Hrt. simpl in Hrt. inversion Hrt.
  - intros. exact I.
  - intros. exact I.
  - intros. exact I.
  - intros. exact I.
Qed.

Corollary record_typ_open_rec_inv : forall (T:typ) (n:nat) (u:var) (ls:fset label),
  u \notin fv T -> record_typ (open_rec n u T) ls -> record_typ T ls.
Proof. intros. eapply (proj1 record_typ_open_rec_inv_mut); eassumption. Qed.

Corollary record_type_open_rec_inv : forall (T:typ) (n:nat) (u:var),
  u \notin fv T -> record_type (open_rec n u T) -> record_type T.
Proof.
  intros T n u Hf [ls Hrt]. exists ls. eapply record_typ_open_rec_inv; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_rec_avar_subset : forall (n:nat) (u:var) (a:avar) (z:var),
  z \in fv (open_rec n u a) -> z \in fv a \/ z = u.
Proof.
  intros n u a z H. destruct a as [i|y]; simpl in *.
  - destruct (Nat.eq_dec n i) as [E|E].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=n = i) _ _ E) in H. simpl in H. right.
      rewrite in_singleton in H. exact H.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=n = i) _ _ E) in H. left. exact H.
  - left. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_rec_subset_mut :
  (forall (T:typ) (n:nat) (u z:var),
      z \in fv (open_rec n u T) -> z \in fv T \/ z = u) /\
  (forall (Ts:typs) (n:nat) (u z:var),
      z \in fv_typs (open_rec n u Ts) -> z \in fv_typs Ts \/ z = u) /\
  (forall (D:dec) (n:nat) (u z:var),
      z \in fv_dec (open_rec n u D) -> z \in fv_dec D \/ z = u).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros n u z H. simpl in H. rewrite in_empty in H. destruct H.
  - intros n u z H. simpl in H. rewrite in_empty in H. destruct H.
  - intros d IH n u z H. simpl in H. simpl. destruct (IH n u z H) as [K|K]; [left|right]; exact K.
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 n u z H. simpl in H. simpl.
    rewrite in_union in H. rewrite in_union. destruct H as [H|H].
    + destruct (IHt n u z H) as [K|K]; [left; left|right]; exact K.
    + destruct (IHt0 n u z H) as [K|K]; [left; right|right]; exact K.
  - intros a A n u z H. simpl in H. simpl.
    destruct (fv_open_rec_avar_subset n u a z H) as [K|K]; [left|right]; exact K.
  - intros t IH n u z H. simpl in H. simpl.
    destruct (IH (S n) u z H) as [K|K]; [left|right]; exact K.
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 n u z H. simpl in H. simpl.
    rewrite in_union in H. rewrite in_union. destruct H as [H|H].
    + destruct (IHt n u z H) as [K|K]; [left; left|right]; exact K.
    + destruct (IHt0 (S n) u z H) as [K|K]; [left; right|right]; exact K.
  - intros Ts IHts is' T IHt n u z H. simpl in H. simpl.
    rewrite in_union in H. rewrite in_union. destruct H as [H|H].
    + destruct (IHts n u z H) as [K|K]; [left; left|right]; exact K.
    + destruct (IHt (S (length_s Ts) + n) u z H) as [K|K]; [left; right|right]; exact K.
  - intros n u z H. simpl in H. rewrite in_empty in H. destruct H.
  - intros t IHt ts IHts n u z H. simpl in H. simpl.
    rewrite in_union in H. rewrite in_union. destruct H as [H|H].
    + destruct (IHt n u z H) as [K|K]; [left; left|right]; exact K.
    + destruct (IHts n u z H) as [K|K]; [left; right|right]; exact K.
  - intros A t IHt t0 IHt0 n u z H. simpl in H. simpl.
    rewrite in_union in H. rewrite in_union. destruct H as [H|H].
    + destruct (IHt n u z H) as [K|K]; [left; left|right]; exact K.
    + destruct (IHt0 n u z H) as [K|K]; [left; right|right]; exact K.
  - intros a t IHt t0 IHt0 n u z H. simpl in H. simpl.
    rewrite in_union in H. rewrite in_union. destruct H as [H|H].
    + destruct (IHt n u z H) as [K|K]; [left; left|right]; exact K.
    + destruct (IHt0 n u z H) as [K|K]; [left; right|right]; exact K.
Qed.

Corollary fv_open_rec_typ_fresh : forall (T:typ) (n:nat) (u:var) (z:var),
  z \notin fv T -> z <> u -> z \notin fv (open_rec n u T).
Proof.
  intros T n u z Hf Hne K.
  destruct (proj1 fv_open_rec_subset_mut T n u z K) as [Hin|Heq]; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_NoDup : forall (L:vars) (n:nat) (xs:list var),
  fresh L n xs -> NoDup xs.
Proof.
  intros L n xs. revert L n. induction xs; intros L n Hf.
  - apply NoDup_nil.
  - destruct n as [|n']; [cbn in Hf; contradiction|].
    cbn in Hf. destruct Hf as [HxL Htail].
    apply NoDup_cons.
    + intro Hin.
      assert (Hinx : a \in from_list xs) by (rewrite in_from_list; exact Hin).
      assert (Hnot : a \notin L \u \{a}).
      { eapply fresh_from_list_notin; [exact Htail|exact Hinx]. }
      apply Hnot. rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
    + eapply IHxs. exact Htail.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_add_notin : forall (L:vars) (n:nat) (xs:list var) (x:var),
  fresh L n xs -> x \notin from_list xs -> fresh (L \u \{x}) n xs.
Proof.
  intros L n xs. revert L n. induction xs; intros L n x Hf Hnot.
  - destruct n; [cbn; exact I|cbn in Hf; contradiction].
  - destruct n as [|n']; [cbn in Hf; contradiction|].
    cbn in Hf. destruct Hf as [HyL Htail].
    assert (Hxyn : x <> a).
    { intro E. subst x. apply Hnot. rewrite in_from_list. left. reflexivity. }
    cbn. split.
    + intro K. rewrite in_union in K. destruct K as [K|K].
      * apply HyL. exact K.
      * rewrite in_singleton in K. subst a. apply Hxyn. reflexivity.
    + replace ((L \u \{x}) \u \{a}) with ((L \u \{a}) \u \{x}).
      * eapply IHxs.
        -- exact Htail.
        -- intro K. apply Hnot. rewrite in_from_list. right.
           rewrite in_from_list in K. exact K.
      * apply fset_extens.
        -- intros z Hz. repeat rewrite in_union in Hz.
           repeat rewrite in_union. rewrite !in_singleton in *. tauto.
        -- intros z Hz. repeat rewrite in_union in Hz.
           repeat rewrite in_union. rewrite !in_singleton in *. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_open_rec_vars_inv : forall (T:typ) (k:nat) (ys:list var),
  NoDup ys ->
  (forall y, y \in from_list ys -> y \notin fv T) ->
  record_type (open_rec_vars k ys T) -> record_type T.
Proof.
  intros T k ys. revert T k. induction ys; intros T k Hnd Hf Hrt.
  - cbn in Hrt. exact Hrt.
  - simpl in Hrt.
    eapply record_type_open_rec_inv.
    + apply Hf. rewrite from_list_cons. rewrite in_union. left.
      rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
    + apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnotin Hnd'].
      apply (IHys (open_rec k a T) (S k)).
      * exact Hnd'.
      * intros z Hz. eapply fv_open_rec_typ_fresh.
        -- apply Hf. rewrite from_list_cons. rewrite in_union. right. exact Hz.
        -- intro Ez. subst z.
           apply Hnotin. rewrite in_from_list in Hz. exact Hz.
      * exact Hrt.
Qed.

Lemma lit_typ_inert : forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ l ∶ T -> inert_typ T.
Proof.
  intros G l T H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply inert_typ_all.
  - eapply inert_typ_con.
    set (L0 := L \u fv T0).
    destruct (@var_freshes L0 (length_s Ts)) as [ys Hys].
    destruct (@var_fresh (L0 \u from_list ys)) as [x Hx].
    assert (Hx_ys : x \notin from_list ys) by (eapply notin_union_r2; exact Hx).
    assert (Hx_rest : x \notin L0) by (eapply notin_union_r1; exact Hx).
    assert (HxL : x \notin L) by (eapply notin_union_r1; exact Hx_rest).
    assert (Hxfv : x \notin fv T0) by (eapply notin_union_r2; exact Hx_rest).
    assert (HysL : fresh L (length_s Ts) ys) by (eapply fresh_union_r1; exact Hys).
    assert (Hysfv : fresh (fv T0) (length_s Ts) ys) by (eapply fresh_union_r2; exact Hys).
    assert (Hys_nd : NoDup ys) by (eapply fresh_NoDup; exact Hys).
    assert (Hys_notin : forall y, y \in from_list ys -> y \notin fv T0).
    { intros y Hy. eapply fresh_from_list_notin; [exact Hysfv|exact Hy]. }
    assert (Hlen : List.length ys = length_s Ts).
    { rewrite List_length_LibList_length. symmetry. eapply fresh_length. exact Hys. }
    assert (Hfresh_L : fresh L (List.length ys) ys)
      by (eapply fresh_resize; [exact HysL|exact Hlen]).
    assert (Hfresh_Lx : fresh (L \u \{x}) (List.length ys) ys)
      by (eapply fresh_add_notin; [exact Hfresh_L|exact Hx_ys]).
    assert (Hfresh_cons : fresh L (S (length ys)) (cons x ys)).
    { simpl. split; assumption. }
    assert (Hds_ty : exists Gx, Gx ⊢ open_vars (cons x ys) ds ∶ open_vars (cons x ys) T0).
    { eexists. eapply H0; [exact Hlen|exact Hfresh_cons]. }
    destruct Hds_ty as [Gx Hds_ty].
    assert (Hrt_opened : record_type (open_vars (cons x ys) T0)).
    { eapply ty_defs_def_record_type. exact Hds_ty. }
    eapply (@record_type_open_rec_vars_inv T0 0 (cons x ys)).
    + apply NoDup_cons; [rewrite <- in_from_list; exact Hx_ys|exact Hys_nd].
    + intros z Hz. rewrite from_list_cons in Hz. rewrite in_union in Hz.
      destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz].
      * rewrite in_singleton in Hz. subst z. exact Hxfv.
      * eapply Hys_notin; exact Hz.
    + exact Hrt_opened.
Qed.

inert_typ T0 -> binds x T0 G ->
  G ⊢! x ∶ T0 ⪼ typ_top -> False.
Proof.
  intros x G T0 Hi Hb Hf.
  destruct (@flow_shape x G T0 typ_top Hf Hi Hb) as [[Heq Hi2]|Hr].
  - inversion Heq; subst. exact (inert_typ_not_top Hi2).
  - eapply record_type_not_top. exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma record_has_rcd_inv : forall (D D':dec), record_has (typ_rcd D) D' -> D' = D.
Proof. intros D D' H. inversion H; subst; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma record_has_and_inv : forall (T U:typ) (D:dec),
  record_has (typ_and T U) D -> record_has T D \/ record_has U D.
Proof. intros T U D H. inversion H; subst; [left|right]; assumption. Qed.

Lemma defs_update_label_in : forall (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  exists d, List.In d hds /\ label_of d = label_trm a.
Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y H. induction H.
  - exists (heap_def_trm a o). split; [apply List.in_eq|reflexivity].
  - destruct IHdefs_update as [d0 [Hin Hl]]. exists d0.
    split; [apply List.in_cons; exact Hin|exact Hl].
Qed.

Lemma labels_hasnt_update : forall (hds hds':heap_defs) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (l:label),
  defs_update hds a y hds' ->
  labels_hasnt hds l ->
  labels_hasnt hds' l.
Proof.
  intros hds hds' a y l Hup. revert l. induction Hup; intros l Hl.
  - unfold labels_hasnt in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classic (label_trm a = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_trm a = l) _ _ E) in Hl. discriminate.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_trm a = l) _ _ NE) in Hl.
      rewrite (If_r (P:=label_trm a = l) _ _ NE). exact Hl.
  - unfold labels_hasnt in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classic (label_of d = l)) as [E|NE].
    + rewrite (If_l (P:=label_of d = l) _ _ E) in Hl. discriminate.
    + rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of d = l) _ _ NE) in Hl.
      rewrite (If_r (P:=label_of d = l) _ _ NE).
      eapply IHHup. exact Hl.
Qed.

Lemma ty_heap_defs_update : forall (G:ctx) (hds:heap_defs) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ hds ∶ T ->
  forall (a:trm_label) (y:var) (hds':heap_defs),
    defs_update hds a y hds' ->
    forall (Tf:typ),
      record_has T (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
      G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ Tf ->
      G ⊢ hds' ∶ T.
Proof.
  intros G hds T Hds. induction Hds; intros a y hds' Hup Tf Hrh Hy.
  - inversion Hup; subst.
    + assert (HeqD : D = dec_trm a Tf Tf) by
        (symmetry; eapply record_has_rcd_inv; eassumption).
      subst D. eapply ty_defs_one. eapply ty_heap_def_trm_some. exact Hy.
    + match goal with
      | Hx : defs_update nil _ _ _ |- _ => inversion Hx
      end.
  - inversion Hup; subst.
    + (* head updated: d = heap_def_trm a o *)
      assert (HeqD : D = dec_trm a Tf Tf).
      { destruct (@record_has_and_inv T (typ_rcd D) (dec_trm a Tf Tf) Hrh) as [HinTs|HinR].
        - destruct (ty_heap_defs_correspond H) as [ls [_ [_ Hbwd]]].
          destruct (Hbwd (dec_trm a Tf Tf) HinTs) as [d0 [Hin0 Heq0]].
          exfalso. eapply (labels_hasnt_sound H1 d0 Hin0).
          rewrite <- Heq0. reflexivity.
        - symmetry. eapply record_has_rcd_inv. eassumption. }
      subst D. eapply ty_defs_cons.
      * exact H.
      * eapply ty_heap_def_trm_some. exact Hy.
      * simpl. exact H1.
    + (* update in the tail *)
      assert (Htail : defs_update ds a y hds'0) by
        (match goal with Hx : defs_update ds _ _ hds'0 |- _ => exact Hx end).
      eapply ty_defs_cons.
      * eapply IHHds; [exact Htail| |exact Hy].
        destruct (@record_has_and_inv T (typ_rcd D) (dec_trm a Tf Tf) Hrh) as [HinTs|HinR].
        -- exact HinTs.
        -- exfalso.
           assert (HeqD : D = dec_trm a Tf Tf) by
             (symmetry; eapply record_has_rcd_inv; eassumption).
           destruct (@defs_update_label_in ds hds'0 a y Htail) as [d0 [Hin0 Hl0]].
           assert (Hld : label_of d = label_of D) by
             (symmetry; exact (@label_of_ty_heap_def Gamma d D H0)).
           assert (Hla : label_of D = label_trm a) by (rewrite HeqD; reflexivity).
           assert (Heq1 : label_of d0 = label_of d) by (rewrite Hl0, Hld, Hla; reflexivity).
           eapply (labels_hasnt_sound H1 d0 Hin0). exact Heq1.
      * exact H0.
      * eapply labels_hasnt_update; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma ty_stack_let_inv : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx)
    (t0:trm) (Fs:stack) (S:typ) (i:init_typ) (effs:list effects) (U:typ),
  ty_stack G D Es (frame_let t0 :: Fs) S i effs U ->
  exists ℰ ℰs L T i' effs0 effss effs',
    Es = ℰ :: ℰs /\
    effs = ((effs' ++ effs0) :: effss)%list /\
    ty_stack G D (ℰ :: ℰs) Fs T i' (effs0 :: effss) U /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G & x ~ S ⊢ open x t0 ∶ T) /\
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       G & x ~ S ⸴ D & x ~ i ⸴ dom ℰ \u \{x} ⊢i open x t0 ∶ i') /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> ⊢e open x t0 ∶ effs').
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst.
  eexists _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _. repeat split; try reflexivity; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma ty_stack_ret_inv : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx)
    (x0:var) (Fs:stack) (S:typ) (i:init_typ) (effs:list effects) (U:typ),
  ty_stack G D Es (frame_ret x0 :: Fs) S i effs U ->
  (exists ℰ ℰs T effs0 effss,
     Es = ℰ :: ℰs /\
     effs = (effs0 :: effss) /\
     ty_stack G D (ℰ :: ℰs) Fs T free (effs0 :: effss) U /\
     G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x0) ∶ T /\
     G ⸴ D ⸴ dom ℰ ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x0) ∶ free)
  \/
  (exists ℰ ℰs T effss,
     Es = ℰ :: ℰs /\
     effs = (nil :: effss) /\
     ty_stack G D ℰs Fs T committed effss U /\
     G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x0) ∶ T /\
     G ⸴ D ⸴ dom ℰ ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x0) ∶ free).
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst.
  - left. eexists _, _, _, _, _. repeat split; try reflexivity; eassumption.
  - right. eexists _, _, _, _. repeat split; try reflexivity; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_binds : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (T:typ),

Lemma heap_correspond_binds_rev : forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (itm:item),

Proof.

Lemma ty_config_inv : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx) (effss:list effects)
    (t:trm) (s:stack) (Sigma:heap) (U:typ),
  ty_config G D Es effss (t ; s ; Sigma) U ->
  exists ℰ ℰs Fs T i effs effs' effss0,
    Es = ℰ :: ℰs /\
    effss = ((effs' ++ effs) :: effss0)%list /\
    inert G /\
    inert_inits D /\
    heap_correspond G Sigma /\
    free_sub_heaps G D Sigma (ℰ :: ℰs) /\
    ty_stack G D (ℰ :: ℰs) Fs T i (effs :: effss0) U /\
    G ⊢ t ∶ T /\
    ⊢e t ∶ effs' /\
    G ⸴ D ⸴ dom ℰ ⊢i t ∶ i /\
    eff_ctx_corr (ℰ :: ℰs) (List.app effs' effs :: effss0).
Proof.
  intros G D Es effss t s Sigma U H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists ℰ, ℰs, s, T, i, effs, effs', effss0. repeat split; try reflexivity; try eassumption; try (exact (proj1 H5)); try (exact (proj2 H5)).

Lemma eff_ctx_corr_one_ctx_upd_at : forall (E:eff_ctx) (effs' effs:effects)

  (forall p, p \in from_list e' -> p \notin from_list effs') ->

      * exact Hsub.

Lemma heap_defs_record_has_of_update : forall (G:ctx)

Proof.

Hypothesis Hfield : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),

Lemma ty_config_red_sel : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx)
  (effss:list effects) (Fs:stack) (Sigma:heap) (U:typ)
  (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var) (T0:typ) (hds:heap_defs),
  ty_config G D Es effss (trm_sel (avar_f x) a ; Fs ; Sigma) U ->
  binds x (item_obj T0 hds) Sigma ->
  labels_has hds (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) ->
  exists G' D' Es' effss',
    ty_config (G & G') D' Es' effss' (trm_var (avar_f y) ; Fs ; Sigma) U.
Proof.
  intros G D Es effss Fs Sigma U x a y T0 hds Hcfg Hbheap Hlab.
  destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D Es effss (trm_sel (avar_f x) a) Fs Sigma U Hcfg) as
    (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effs & effs' & effss0 &
     HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr).
  assert (Heffnil : effs' = nil) by (eapply eff_trm_sel_nil; exact Heff).
  subst effs'.
  cbn in Hcorr. cbn in HeqEffs.
  destruct (@ty_sel_inv G x a Ts Hty) as [S [Ts0 [Hxrec HsubT]]].
  destruct (@init_typing_sel_committed G D (dom ℰ) x a ii Hinit) as [Hi Heqxcomm].
  subst ii.
  destruct (@heap_correspond_obj G Sigma x T0 hds Hhc Hbheap) as [HxG Hhds].
  assert (Hsubopen : G ⊢ open x T0 <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S Ts0))
    by (eapply Hroot; eassumption).
  pose proof (@labels_has_heap_in hds (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) Hlab) as Hin.
  destruct (@heap_def_typing_rh G hds (open x T0) a y Hhds Hin) as [Tf [Hrh HyTf]].
  pose proof (@ty_heap_defs_record_type G hds (open x T0) Hhds) as Hrt.
  assert (Htfsub : G ⊢ Tf <: Ts0)
    by (eapply Hfield; [exact Hinert|exact Hrt|exact Hrh|exact Hsubopen]).
  assert (HyTs : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ Ts).
  { eapply ty_sub.
    - exact HyTf.
    - eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Htfsub|exact HsubT]. }
  pose proof (@free_sub_heaps_well_committed G D Sigma (ℰ :: ℰs) Hfs) as Hwc.
  pose proof (@well_committed_heap_item G D Sigma x (item_obj T0 hds) Hwc Heqxcomm Hbheap) as Hci.
  pose proof (@committed_heap_item_obj_inv G D T0 hds Hci) as Hcdefs.
  pose proof (@committed_heap_defs_in D hds (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) Hcdefs Hin) as Hcd.
  pose proof (@committed_heap_def_trm_some_binds D a y Hcd) as Hycomm.
  exists (empty:ctx), D, (ℰ :: ℰs), (effs :: effss0).
  rewrite concat_empty_r.
  eapply (@ty_config_c G D Sigma ℰ ℰs Fs (trm_var (avar_f y)) Ts committed U nil effs effss0).
  - exact Hinert.
  - exact Hinits.
  - exact Hhc.
  - exact Hfs.
  - exact Hstack.
  - exact HyTs.
  - apply eff_ignore.
  - eapply init_var_binds. apply init_var_commit. exact Hycomm.
  - exact Hcorr.
Qed.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* Preservation for assignment.                                           *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* Two restricted field-subtyping hypotheses are used, both guarded by    *)
(* [inert G].  The unrestricted and [record_type]-only versions are false *)
(* (see FieldSub.v / FieldSub2.v); however the actual use supplies        *)
(* [inert G] from [ty_config_inv_s], and [V = open x T] whose             *)
(* [record_type] comes from [ty_heap_defs_record_type ... Hhds].          *)
(* [Hcov] is the covariant direction and [Hcontr] the contravariant      *)
(* counterpart, needed to retype the assigned variable at the field type *)
(* read off the heap.  [Hroot] is the canonical-forms/root-subtyping     *)
(* fact for inert contexts.                                              *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Section Params.

Hypothesis Hcov : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
  inert G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ Tf <: U.

Hypothesis Hcontr : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
  inert G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ S <: Tf.

Hypothesis Hroot : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),
  inert G ->
  binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->
  G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.

Lemma ty_config_red_asn : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (Es:list eff_ctx)
  (effss:list effects) (Fs:stack) (Sigma Sigma':heap) (U:typ)
  (x:var) (a:trm_label) (y:var),
  ty_config G D Es effss (trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ; Fs ; Sigma) U ->
  heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
  exists G' D' Es' effss',
    ty_config (G & G') D' Es' effss' (trm_var (avar_f y) ; Fs ; Sigma') U.
Proof.
  intros G D Es effss Fs Sigma Sigma' U x a y Hcfg Hup.
  destruct Hup as (T & hds & hds' & S1 & S2 & HeqS & Hfresh & Hdu & HeqS').
  subst Sigma Sigma'.
  destruct (@ty_config_inv_s G D Es effss
              (trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)) Fs
              (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2) U Hcfg) as
    (ℰ & ℰs & Ts & ii & effsS & effsT & effss0 &
     HeqEs & HeqEffs & Hinert & Hinits & Hhc & Hfs & Hstack & Hty & Heff & Hinit & Hcorr).
  subst Es effss.
  (* Assignment inversion. *)
  destruct (@ty_asn_inv G x a y Ts Hty) as (Sa & T0 & HxTy & HyTy & HT0sub).
  (* The heap object bound at [x]. *)
  assert (HbS : binds x (item_obj T hds)
                  (S1 & x ~ item_obj T hds & S2)).
  { eapply LibEnv.binds_middle_eq. exact Hfresh. }
