Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* The inert-restricted field-subtyping variants.                        *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* The two target lemmas are [field_cov_inert] and [field_contr_inert].   *)
(* Below we prove:                                                        *)
(*   (1) inertness really does exclude the bad asymmetric type-member    *)
(*       binding used in FieldSub2.v;                                      *)
(*   (2) both target lemmas in full, under the (stronger than inert)      *)
(*       assumption that the context derives no record typing of a        *)
(*       variable at a type member [dec_typ A S T].  This hypothesis is   *)
(*       exactly what is needed to make selections impossible; it is      *)
(*       satisfied by the empty context, giving both lemmas for [empty].  *)
(*   (3) the precise remaining subgoal for the general inert case: the    *)
(*       coherence of the type-member bounds of an inert [typ_bnd]        *)
(*       binding (see the comment at the end of the file).                *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* (1) The bad binding is impossible under inertness.                     *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma inert_no_rcd_binds : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (D:dec),
  inert G -> binds x (typ_rcd D) G -> False.
Proof.
  intros G x D Hi Hb.
  pose proof (@inert_binds_inert_typ G x (typ_rcd D) Hi Hb) as Ht.
  exact (@inert_typ_not_rcd D Ht).
Qed.

Lemma inert_no_bad_type_member_binds : forall (G:ctx) (x:var)
    (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
  inert G -> binds x (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) G -> False.
Proof.
  intros. eapply inert_no_rcd_binds; eassumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Structural facts about record types.                                   *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma record_typ_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros T ls D Hrt. induction Hrt as
    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ]; intros Hrh.
  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. subst D. exact Hdec.
  - apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh. destruct Hrh as [Hl|Hr].
    + eapply IH. exact Hl.
    + apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hr. subst D. exact Hdec.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (D:dec),
  record_type T -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros T D [ls Hrt] Hrh. eapply (@record_typ_has_dec T ls D); eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_has_equal_bounds : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
  record_type T -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U) -> S = U.
Proof.
  intros T a S U Hrt Hrh.
  pose proof (@record_type_has_dec T (dec_trm a S U) Hrt Hrh) as Hdec.
  inversion Hdec; subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Two [record_has] members of a record type with the same label are the
   same member.  This is the uniqueness needed to turn the equal-bound
   fact for one member into the bounds bracket for every member. *)

Lemma record_typ_trm_unique : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (a:trm_label)
    (T1 U1 T2 U2:typ),
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_has T (dec_trm a T1 U1) ->
  record_has T (dec_trm a T2 U2) ->
  T1 = T2 /\ U1 = U2.
Proof.
  intros T ls a T1 U1 T2 U2 Hrt.
  induction Hrt as [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ];
    intros H1 H2.
  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
    apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
    assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
    { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
    inversion E. auto.
  - apply record_has_and_inv in H1.
    apply record_has_and_inv in H2.
    destruct H1 as [H1|H1]; destruct H2 as [H2|H2].
    + eapply IH; eassumption.
    + (* H1 in T0, H2 in the right component *)
      exfalso.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T1 U1) H1) as Hin.
      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1) = l).
      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2)).
        - cbn. reflexivity.
        - rewrite H2. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
    + (* H1 in the right component, H2 in T0 *)
      exfalso.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T2 U2) H2) as Hin.
      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2) = l).
      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1)).
        - cbn. reflexivity.
        - rewrite H1. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
    + (* both in the right component *)
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
      assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
      { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
      inversion E. auto.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_bracket : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf:typ),
  record_type V -> record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has V (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
    G ⊢ Sl <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: Su.
Proof.
  intros G V a Tf [ls Hrt] Hrh Sl Su Hrh2.
  pose proof (@record_typ_trm_unique V ls a Tf Tf Sl Su Hrt Hrh Hrh2)
    as [E1 E2].
  subst. split; apply subtyp_refl.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* A "no bottom in the record/intersection structure" predicate and the   *)
(* label-indexed bracket predicate.                                       *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* [compat G a Al Au T] says: T contains no bottom in the positions       *)
(* traversed by [record_has], and every [a]-member of T brackets the      *)
(* (source) bounds [Al..Au].  This predicate is designed so that it is    *)
(* preserved by subtyping in the absence of selection flows, while still  *)
(* being false at [typ_bot].  The [nobot] component is what makes the     *)
(* [and11]/[and12] cases (and the [subtyp_bot] case) go through.          *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Fixpoint nobot (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_and T1 T2 => nobot T1 /\ nobot T2
  | _ => True
  end.

Definition bracket (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has T (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
    G ⊢ Sl <: Al /\ G ⊢ Au <: Su.

Definition compat (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
  nobot T /\ bracket G a Al Au T.

Lemma record_typ_nobot : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label),
  record_typ T ls -> nobot T.
Proof.
  intros T ls Hrt. induction Hrt as
    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ].
  - cbn [nobot]. exact I.
  - cbn [nobot]. split; [exact IH|exact I].
Qed.

Lemma record_type_nobot : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> nobot T.
Proof.
  intros T [ls Hrt]. eapply @record_typ_nobot; eassumption.
Qed.

(* The context hypothesis that selection flows are impossible. *)
Definition no_ty_member_typings (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (x:var) (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
    ~ (G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)).

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Preservation of [compat] by subtyping, in a context with no type-member *)
(* record typings (so that [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] can never fire).    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma compat_closure : forall (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au:typ) (S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  G ⊢ S <: U ->
  compat G a Al Au S ->
  compat G a Al Au U.
Proof.
  intros G a Al Au S U Hns Hsub.
  induction Hsub; intros Hc; cbn [compat nobot bracket] in *.
  - (* subtyp_top *) split; [exact I|]. intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_bot *) destruct Hc as [Hn _]. exact (False_rect _ Hn).
  - (* subtyp_refl *) exact Hc.
  - (* subtyp_trans *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb].
    apply IHHsub0.
    + exact Hns.
    + apply IHHsub; [exact Hns | split; [exact Hn|exact Hb]].
  - (* subtyp_and11 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
    + exact (proj1 Hn).
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andl. exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_and12 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
    + exact (proj2 Hn).
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andr. exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
    assert (IH1 := IHHsub Hns Hc).
    assert (IH2 := IHHsub0 Hns Hc).
    destruct IH1 as [Hn1 Hb1]. destruct IH2 as [Hn2 Hb2]. split.
    + split; assumption.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh.
      destruct Hrh as [Hrh|Hrh]; [apply Hb1|apply Hb2]; exact Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_fld *)
    destruct Hc as [_ Hb]. split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh.
      inversion Hrh; subst.
      pose proof (proj1 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hlow.
      pose proof (proj2 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hup.
      split; [eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption|eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption].
  - (* subtyp_typ *) split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. discriminate Hrh.
  - (* subtyp_sel2 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_sel1 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_all *) split.
    + exact I.
    + intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The main field lemmas under [no_ty_member_typings].                    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Theorem field_cov_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.
  intros G V a Tf S U Hns Hrt Hrh Hsub.
  pose proof (@record_type_bracket G V a Tf Hrt Hrh) as Hb.
  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
                Hns Hsub (conj (@record_type_nobot V Hrt) Hb)) as Hfinal.
  destruct Hfinal as [_ HbU].
  exact (proj2 (HbU S U (rh_one (dec_trm a S U)))).
Qed.

Theorem field_contr_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ S <: Tf.
Proof.
  intros G V a Tf S U Hns Hrt Hrh Hsub.
  pose proof (@record_type_bracket G V a Tf Hrt Hrh) as Hb.
  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
                Hns Hsub (conj (@record_type_nobot V Hrt) Hb)) as Hfinal.
  destruct Hfinal as [_ HbU].
  exact (proj1 (HbU S U (rh_one (dec_trm a S U)))).
Qed.

(* The combined pair statement. *)
Theorem field_pair_no_ty_member : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label)
    (Tf S U:typ),
  no_ty_member_typings G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ S <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.
  intros. split.
  - eapply field_contr_no_ty_member; eassumption.
  - eapply field_cov_no_ty_member; eassumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The empty context satisfies the hypothesis, so both lemmas hold there. *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma empty_typing_var_false_mut :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
     G = empty -> forall (x:var), t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U -> True) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).
Proof.
  apply (rules_mutind
    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
       G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False)
    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (_:G ⊢ S <: U) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True));
  intros;
  try (match goal with
       | b : binds ?x ?v ?G, He : ?G = empty |- False =>
           rewrite He in b; exact (binds_empty_inv b)
       end);
  try (match goal with
       | IH : ?G = empty -> forall y, ?t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> False,
         He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
           exfalso; eapply IH; [exact He | first [eassumption | reflexivity]]
       end);
  try (match goal with H : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- False => discriminate H end);
  try (match goal with H : trm_var (avar_f _) = ?t |- False => discriminate H end);
  auto.
Qed.

Lemma empty_typing_var_false : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ),
  G ⊢ t ∶ T -> G = empty -> forall (x:var), t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G t T H. exact (proj1 empty_typing_var_false_mut G t T H).
Qed.

Lemma no_ty_member_typings_empty : no_ty_member_typings empty.
Proof.
  intros x A S T Hty.
  eapply (@empty_typing_var_false empty (trm_var (avar_f x))
            (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T))); [exact Hty|reflexivity|reflexivity].
Qed.

Theorem field_cov_inert_empty : forall (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
  inert empty ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  empty ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.
  intros. eapply field_cov_no_ty_member; [exact no_ty_member_typings_empty|eassumption..].
Qed.

Theorem field_contr_inert_empty : forall (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
  inert empty ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  empty ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  empty ⊢ S <: Tf.
Proof.
  intros. eapply field_contr_no_ty_member; [exact no_ty_member_typings_empty|eassumption..].
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* A larger class of inert contexts: bindings may be [typ_all], [typ_con], *)
(* or [typ_bnd U] where [U] is a record type with no type-member          *)
(* ([dec_typ]) members at all.  (In particular this excludes the bad      *)
(* asymmetric binding of FieldSub2.v, which is a record with a [dec_typ]  *)
(* member, and it also excludes the equal-bounded [dec_typ] bodies.)      *)
(* In such a context no variable can ever be typed at a record type with  *)
(* a type member, so [no_ty_member_typings] holds and both field lemmas   *)
(* apply.                                                                 *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* The proof is a mutual induction over typing and subtyping.  The         *)
(* invariant [ntr x T] says that [T] is built (with intersections) from   *)
(* top, universal/existential object types, [typ_bnd] whose opening is    *)
(* [ntr], and record types whose visible members are all term members.    *)
(* There is deliberately no clause for [typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)]: this is *)
(* exactly the bad shape.  Selection rules can never fire because their   *)
(* typing premise would have to produce such a shape.                     *)

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* Restricted statement under investigation.                            *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Definition field_lookup_sub_record_statement (a : trm_label) : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (Tf S U:typ),
    record_type V ->
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    G ⊢ Tf <: U.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* A variable name; [var] is an abstract parameter, but [var_fresh]     *)
(* provides one.  The term label [a] and the type-member label [A] are  *)
(* abstract parameters too; the refutation below is parametric in them. *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Definition x0 : var := proj1_sig (var_fresh \{}).

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* A soundness interpretation of types for the fixed context            *)
(*   G0 = x0 : typ_rcd (dec_typ A V Targ)                               *)
(* where V and Targ are closed record types.  The interpretation is     *)
(* the same simple one used in FieldSub.v: only [typ_bot] is false.     *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Fixpoint interp (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_rcd _ => True
  | typ_and T U => interp T /\ interp U
  | typ_sel _ _ => True
  | typ_bnd _ => True
  | typ_all _ _ => True
  | typ_con _ _ _ => True
  end.

(* [Inv T] records that a type is a "safe" type for the variable [x0]:
   it is true under [interp], every record type member [dec_typ] has a
   safe upper bound, and bound types are recursively safe at their
   opening.  It has no constructor for [typ_bot]. *)

Inductive Inv : typ -> Prop :=
| inv_top : Inv typ_top
| inv_rcd_trm : forall (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
    Inv (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
| inv_rcd_typ : forall (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
    Inv T -> Inv (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T))
| inv_and : forall (T U:typ),
    Inv T -> Inv U -> Inv (typ_and T U)
| inv_sel : forall (x:avar) (A:typ_label),
    Inv (typ_sel x A)
| inv_bnd : forall (T:typ),
    Inv (open x0 T) -> Inv (typ_bnd T)
| inv_all : forall (S T:typ), Inv (typ_all S T)
| inv_con : forall (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (T:typ),
    Inv (typ_con Ts is' T).

Lemma Inv_sound : forall (T:typ), Inv T -> interp T.
Proof.
  intros T H. induction H; cbn [interp]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Inv_rcd_typ_inv : forall (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
  Inv (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) -> Inv T.
Proof.
  intros A S T H. inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Inv_bnd_inv : forall (T:typ),
  Inv (typ_bnd T) -> Inv (open x0 T).
Proof.
  intros T H. inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Inv_not_bot : forall (T:typ), T = typ_bot -> Inv T -> False.
Proof.
  intros T E H. subst T. inversion H.
Qed.

Lemma trm_var_eq : forall (x y:var),
  trm_var (avar_f x) = trm_var (avar_f y) -> x = y.
Proof.
  intros x y E. inversion E; subst; reflexivity.
Qed.

Section Counterexample.

Variables (a : trm_label) (A : typ_label) (S0 : typ).

(* The source record type: a genuine [record_type] (indeed a closed one). *)
Definition Vc : typ := typ_rcd (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top).

(* The target record type; its upper bound is fixed to [typ_bot], while  *)
(* its lower bound [S0] is a parameter (needed for the S = U variant).    *)
Definition Targc : typ := typ_rcd (dec_trm a S0 typ_bot).

(* The (bad-bounds) binding of [x0]. *)
Definition RVc : typ := typ_rcd (dec_typ A Vc Targc).

Definition Gc : ctx := x0 ~ RVc.

Lemma record_type_Vc : record_type Vc.
Proof.
  unfold Vc.
  exists (\{label_trm a}).
  eapply rt_one.
  - apply rd_trm.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_has_Vc : record_has Vc (dec_trm a typ_top typ_top).
Proof.
  unfold Vc. apply rh_one.
Qed.

Lemma binds_Gc : binds x0 RVc Gc.
Proof. unfold Gc. apply binds_single_eq. Qed.

(* Vc <: x0.A via sel2, and x0.A <: Targc via sel1, hence Vc <: Targc. *)
Lemma sub_Vc_Targc : Gc ⊢ Vc <: Targc.
Proof.
  eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_sel (avar_f x0) A).
  - eapply subtyp_sel2. apply ty_var. exact binds_Gc.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1. apply ty_var. exact binds_Gc.
Qed.

(* ==================================================================== *)
(* Main soundness/typing-invariant induction for the context [Gc].      *)
(* ==================================================================== *)

Lemma Gc_typing_sub_sound :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
     G = Gc -> forall y, t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> y = x0 /\ Inv T) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U ->
     G = Gc -> (interp S -> interp U) /\ (Inv S -> Inv U)) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).
Proof.
  apply (rules_mutind
    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
       G = Gc -> forall y, t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> y = x0 /\ Inv T)
    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (_:G ⊢ S <: U) =>
       G = Gc -> (interp S -> interp U) /\ (Inv S -> Inv U))
    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True)).
  - (* ty_var *)
    intros G x T b H y E. subst G.
    assert (Exy : x = y) by (apply trm_var_eq; exact E). subst y.
    apply binds_single_inv in b. destruct b as [Ex ET].
    subst x. subst T.
    split.
    + reflexivity.
    + apply inv_rcd_typ, inv_rcd_trm.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros G x z S T p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_new *) intros G x avs xs Ts is' T p IH1 p2 IH2 p3 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_rcd_elim *) intros G x a0 S T p IH1 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_fld_asn *) intros G x y0 a0 S T p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_let *) intros L G t u T U p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_llit *) intros L G l u T U p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *)
    intros G x T p IH H y E.
    assert (Exy : x = y) by (apply trm_var_eq; exact E). subst y.
    destruct (IH H x eq_refl) as [Ex Hinv].
    subst x. split; [reflexivity | apply inv_bnd; exact Hinv].
  - (* ty_rec_elim *)
    intros G x T p IH H y E.
    assert (Exy : x = y) by (apply trm_var_eq; exact E). subst y.
    destruct (IH H x eq_refl) as [Ex Hinv].
    subst x. split; [reflexivity | apply Inv_bnd_inv in Hinv; exact Hinv].
  - (* ty_and_intro *)
    intros G x T U p IH1 p2 IH2 H y E.
    assert (Exy : x = y) by (apply trm_var_eq; exact E). subst y.
    destruct (IH1 H x eq_refl) as [Ex Hinv1].
    destruct (IH2 H x eq_refl) as [_ Hinv2].
    subst x. split; [reflexivity | apply inv_and; assumption].
  - (* ty_sub *)
    intros G t T U p IH1 s IH2 H y E.
    destruct (IH1 H y E) as [Ex HinvT].
    split; [exact Ex | apply (proj2 (IH2 H)); exact HinvT].
  - (* ty_all_intro *) intros; exact I.
  - (* ty_con_intro *) intros; exact I.
  - (* subtyp_top *)
    intros G T H. split; [intros _; exact I | intros _; apply inv_top].
  - (* subtyp_bot *)
    intros G T H. split.
    + intros HI. cbn [interp] in HI. destruct HI.
    + intros HI. inversion HI.
  - (* subtyp_refl *)
    intros G T H. split; intros; assumption.
  - (* subtyp_trans *)
    intros G S T U s IH1 s0 IH2 H.
    destruct (IH1 H) as [Hi1 Hi2]. destruct (IH2 H) as [Hj1 Hj2].
    split; intros; [apply Hj1, Hi1 | apply Hj2, Hi2]; assumption.
  - (* subtyp_and11 *)
    intros G T U H. split.
    + intros HI. cbn [interp] in HI. tauto.
    + intros HI. inversion HI; subst; assumption.
  - (* subtyp_and12 *)
    intros G T U H. split.
    + intros HI. cbn [interp] in HI. tauto.
    + intros HI. inversion HI; subst; assumption.
  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
    intros G S T U s IH1 s0 IH2 H.
    destruct (IH1 H) as [Hi1 Hi2]. destruct (IH2 H) as [Hj1 Hj2].
    split.
    + intros HS. split; [apply Hi1 | apply Hj1]; exact HS.
    + intros HS. apply inv_and; [apply Hi2 | apply Hj2]; exact HS.
  - (* subtyp_fld *)
    intros G a0 T1 T2 U1 U2 s IH1 s0 IH2 H.
    split; intros; [exact I | apply inv_rcd_trm].
  - (* subtyp_typ *)
    intros G A0 S1 T1 S2 T2 s IH1 s0 IH2 H.
    split.
    + intros _; exact I.
    + intros HI. apply Inv_rcd_typ_inv in HI.
      apply inv_rcd_typ. apply (proj2 (IH2 H)). exact HI.
  - (* subtyp_sel2 *)
    intros G x A0 S T p IHty H.
    split; intros; [exact I | apply inv_sel].
  - (* subtyp_sel1 *)
    intros G x A0 S T p IHty H.
    destruct (IHty H x eq_refl) as [_ Hinv].
    apply Inv_rcd_typ_inv in Hinv.
    split; intros; [apply Inv_sound; exact Hinv | exact Hinv].
  - (* subtyp_all *)
    intros L G S1 T1 S2 T2 s IH1 s0 IH2 H.
    split; intros; [exact I | apply inv_all].
  - (* typ_avars_nil *) intros; exact I.
  - (* typ_avars_cons *) intros; exact I.
Qed.

Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.

Unset Implicit Arguments.

Section FinalProgress.

Hypothesis Hroot : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),
  inert G ->
  binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->
  G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.

Hypothesis Hbind_shape : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (D:dec),
  inert G ->
  binds x T0 G ->
  inert_typ T0 ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->
  exists U, T0 = typ_bnd U.

Hypothesis Hfield_exists : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
  inert G ->
  record_type V ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  exists Tf, record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf).

Hypothesis Hcov : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
  inert G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ Tf <: U.

Hypothesis Hcontr : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
  inert G ->
  record_type V ->
  record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
  G ⊢ S <: Tf.

Hypothesis Hbind_all : forall (G:ctx) (f:var) (T0:typ) (S U:typ),
  inert G ->
  binds f T0 G ->
  inert_typ T0 ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f f) ∶ typ_all S U ->
  exists Sf Uf, T0 = typ_all Sf Uf /\
                G ⊢ typ_all Sf Uf <: typ_all S U.

Hypothesis Hbind_con : forall (G:ctx) (f:var) (T0:typ) (Ts:typs) (is':inits) (X:typ),
  inert G ->
  binds f T0 G ->
  inert_typ T0 ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f f) ∶ typ_con Ts is' X ->
  T0 = typ_con Ts is' X.

Theorem progress_from_canon : forall (G:ctx) (D:init_ctx) (EsC:list eff_ctx)
  (EsE:list effects) (t:trm) (s:stack) (Sigma:heap) (U:typ),
  ty_config G D EsC EsE (t ; s ; Sigma) U ->
  answer (t ; s ; Sigma) \/
  exists s' Sigma' t', (t ; s ; Sigma) ↦ (t' ; s' ; Sigma').
Proof.
  intros G D EsC EsE t s Sigma U Hcfg.
  eapply (@progress_from_cases
            (@Hsel_heap_proof G0) (@Hasn_heap_proof) (@Happ_heap_proof) (@Hnew_heap_proof)).
  exact Hcfg.
Qed.

End FinalProgress.

Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* Inert-restricted field subtyping: the exact reduction.                 *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* This file isolates the genuinely inert-restricted field lemmas         *)
(*                                                                        *)
(*   Hcov   : inert G -> record_type V ->                               *)
(*            record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->                          *)
(*            G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) -> G ⊢ Tf <: U,           *)
(*   Hcontr : same hypotheses -> G ⊢ S <: Tf.                            *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* Everything is reduced to two precise residuals:                        *)
(*                                                                        *)
(*   [sel_bracket_aux] : the [subtyp_sel1] coherence step.  If [V] is a   *)
(*     record type with a balanced field [(Tf,Tf)] and [V] is below the   *)
(*     selection [z.A], then every field member of the upper bound [T0]   *)
(*     of a typing [z : {A: S..T0}] is bracketed by [Tf].  This is where  *)
(*     the auxiliary variable [z]'s [typ_bnd Uz] body and its equal-      *)
(*     bounded [dec_typ A W W] member are used.                           *)
(*                                                                        *)
(*   [record_no_bot] : a record type cannot be below [typ_bot].           *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* All other steps are proved below, in particular the [subtyp_trans]     *)
(* case.  The proof avoids the "composition adds a [trans] node" cycle by *)
(* proving a continuation lemma [bracket_cont] which carries the prefix   *)
(* [V <: X] as a hypothesis and recurses only on the structural           *)
(* subderivation [X <: T]; a [trans] node therefore strictly decreases    *)
(* the suffix, while the (possibly re-composed) prefix is only passed     *)
(* along, never re-inducted on.  This is the flattened-path idea: the     *)
(* prefix plays the role of the accumulated path and is not charged to    *)
(* the inductive measure.                                                 *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* We also machine-check that the naive [compat] preservation suggested   *)
(* in the task statement is FALSE under [inert]: the selection rules can  *)
(* jump to [typ_bot], where the [nobot] component fails.  Thus a          *)
(* reachability-aware invariant (the prefix [V <: X] above) is necessary. *)
(* No Admitted/Axiom/Parameter is used.                                   *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Record structure.                                                      *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma record_typ_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros T ls D Hrt. induction Hrt as
    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ]; intros Hrh.
  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. subst D. exact Hdec.
  - apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh. destruct Hrh as [Hl|Hr].
    + eapply IH. exact Hl.
    + apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hr. subst D. exact Hdec.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (D:dec),
  record_type T -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros T D [ls Hrt] Hrh. eapply (@record_typ_has_dec T ls D); eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_has_equal_bounds : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
  record_type T -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U) -> S = U.
Proof.
  intros T a S U Hrt Hrh.
  pose proof (@record_type_has_dec T (dec_trm a S U) Hrt Hrh) as Hdec.
  inversion Hdec; subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_has_typ_equal_bounds : forall (T:typ) (A:typ_label) (S U:typ),
  record_type T -> record_has T (dec_typ A S U) -> S = U.
Proof.
  intros T A S U Hrt Hrh.
  pose proof (@record_type_has_dec T (dec_typ A S U) Hrt Hrh) as Hdec.
  inversion Hdec; subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_trm_unique : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (a:trm_label)
    (T1 U1 T2 U2:typ),
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_has T (dec_trm a T1 U1) ->
  record_has T (dec_trm a T2 U2) ->
  T1 = T2 /\ U1 = U2.
Proof.
  intros T ls a T1 U1 T2 U2 Hrt.
  induction Hrt as [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ];
    intros H1 H2.
  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
    apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
    assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
    { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
    inversion E. auto.
  - apply record_has_and_inv in H1.
    apply record_has_and_inv in H2.
    destruct H1 as [H1|H1]; destruct H2 as [H2|H2].
    + eapply IH; eassumption.
    + exfalso. apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T1 U1) H1) as Hin.
      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1) = l).
      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2)).
        - cbn. reflexivity.
        - rewrite H2. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
    + exfalso. apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T2 U2) H2) as Hin.
      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2) = l).
      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1)).
        - cbn. reflexivity.
        - rewrite H1. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
    + apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
      assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
      { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
      inversion E. auto.
Qed.

(* The type-member analogue, needed to identify the same stored type member
   when a variable receives two record typings at the same type label. *)
Lemma record_typ_typ_unique : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (A:typ_label)
    (S1 T1 S2 T2:typ),
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_has T (dec_typ A S1 T1) ->
  record_has T (dec_typ A S2 T2) ->
  S1 = S2 /\ T1 = T2.
Proof.
  intros T ls A S1 T1 S2 T2 Hrt.
  induction Hrt as [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ];
    intros H1 H2.
  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
    apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
    assert (E : dec_typ A S1 T1 = dec_typ A S2 T2).
    { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
    inversion E. auto.
  - apply record_has_and_inv in H1.
    apply record_has_and_inv in H2.
    destruct H1 as [H1|H1]; destruct H2 as [H2|H2].
    + eapply IH; eassumption.
    + exfalso. apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_typ A S1 T1) H1) as Hin.
      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_typ A S1 T1) = l).
      { transitivity (label_of (dec_typ A S2 T2)).
        - cbn. reflexivity.
        - rewrite H2. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
    + exfalso. apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_typ A S2 T2) H2) as Hin.
      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_typ A S2 T2) = l).
      { transitivity (label_of (dec_typ A S1 T1)).
        - cbn. reflexivity.
        - rewrite H1. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
    + apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
      assert (E : dec_typ A S1 T1 = dec_typ A S2 T2).
      { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
      inversion E. auto.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_trm_unique : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (T1 U1 T2 U2:typ),
  record_type T ->
  record_has T (dec_trm a T1 U1) ->
  record_has T (dec_trm a T2 U2) ->
  T1 = T2 /\ U1 = U2.
Proof.
  intros T a T1 U1 T2 U2 [ls Hrt] H1 H2.
  eapply (@record_typ_trm_unique T ls a T1 U1 T2 U2); eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_typ_unique : forall (T:typ) (A:typ_label) (S1 T1 S2 T2:typ),
  record_type T ->
  record_has T (dec_typ A S1 T1) ->
  record_has T (dec_typ A S2 T2) ->
  S1 = S2 /\ T1 = T2.
Proof.
  intros T A S1 T1 S2 T2 [ls Hrt] H1 H2.
  eapply (@record_typ_typ_unique T ls A S1 T1 S2 T2); eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_bracket : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf:typ),
  record_type V -> record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has V (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
    G ⊢ Sl <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: Su.
Proof.
  intros G V a Tf Hrt Hrh Sl Su Hrh2.
  pose proof (@record_type_trm_unique V a Tf Tf Sl Su Hrt Hrh Hrh2) as [E1 E2].
  subst. split; apply subtyp_refl.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The bracket / compat predicates.                                       *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Fixpoint nobot (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_and T1 T2 => nobot T1 /\ nobot T2
  | _ => True
  end.

Definition bracket (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has T (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
    G ⊢ Sl <: Al /\ G ⊢ Au <: Su.

Definition compat (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
  nobot T /\ bracket G a Al Au T.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The naive compat closure under inert contexts is FALSE.                *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* Counterexample: [G = empty & x ~ typ_bnd {A: bot..bot}].  Then         *)
(* [x : {A: bot..bot}], so [subtyp_sel1] gives                              *)
(*                                                                        *)
(*      [G ⊢ x.A <: bot].                                                  *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* [compat] holds at [x.A] (selections have no [record_has] members, so    *)
(* the bracket part is vacuous and [nobot] is trivially true), but        *)
(* [compat] at [typ_bot] is false because [nobot bot = False].  Thus the   *)
(* suggested completely type-directed preservation of [compat] cannot     *)
(* work: the [sel1] rule jumps from a vacuous bracket at a selection to   *)
(* a target where the [nobot] component fails.  The continuation lemma    *)
(* below therefore carries the reachability hypothesis [V <: X], which    *)
(* is exactly what rules this jump out under inertness.                   *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Definition x0 : var := proj1_sig (var_fresh \{}).

Section CompatCounterexample.

Variable (A:typ_label).
Variable (a:trm_label).

Definition Uz : typ := typ_rcd (dec_typ A typ_bot typ_bot).

Lemma record_type_Uz : record_type Uz.
Proof.
  unfold Uz. exists (\{label_typ A}). apply rt_one.
  - apply rd_typ.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition Gz : ctx := empty & x0 ~ typ_bnd Uz.

Lemma x0_fresh_empty : x0 # (empty:ctx).
Proof. rewrite (@dom_empty typ). apply notin_empty. Qed.

Lemma binds_Gz : binds x0 (typ_bnd Uz) Gz.
Proof. unfold Gz. apply binds_push_eq. exact x0_fresh_empty. Qed.

Lemma inert_Gz : inert Gz.
Proof.
  unfold Gz. eapply inert_all.
  - apply inert_empty.
  - apply inert_typ_bnd. exact record_type_Uz.
  - exact x0_fresh_empty.
Qed.

Lemma typing_Gz : Gz ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x0) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A typ_bot typ_bot).
Proof.
  change (Gz ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x0) ∶ open x0 Uz).
  eapply ty_rec_elim. apply ty_var. exact binds_Gz.
Qed.

Lemma sel1_Gz : Gz ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x0) A <: typ_bot.
Proof.
  eapply subtyp_sel1. exact typing_Gz.
Qed.

Lemma compat_sel_Gz :
  compat Gz a typ_top typ_top (typ_sel (avar_f x0) A).
Proof.
  split.
  - cbn [nobot]. exact I.
  - intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
Qed.

Lemma not_compat_bot_Gz : ~ compat Gz a typ_top typ_top typ_bot.
Proof.
  intros [Hn _]. cbn [nobot] in Hn. exact Hn.
Qed.

End CompatCounterexample.

Lemma compat_not_preserved_inert :
  forall (A:typ_label) (a:trm_label),
    exists (G:ctx) (Al Au S U:typ),
      inert G /\ G ⊢ S <: U /\
      compat G a Al Au S /\ ~ compat G a Al Au U.
Proof.
  intros A a.
  exists Gz, typ_top, typ_top, (typ_sel (avar_f x0) A), typ_bot.
  split; [exact inert_Gz|].
  split; [exact sel1_Gz|].
  split; [exact compat_sel_Gz|exact not_compat_bot_Gz].
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The exact residuals.                                                   *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* The [subtyp_sel1] coherence step: when a record-typed source [V] has   *)
(* been shown below a selection [z.A], the [typ_bnd Uz] binding of [z]    *)
(* and its equal-bounded [dec_typ A W W] member force every field member  *)
(* of the upper bound [T0] of any typing [z : {A: S..T0}] to be           *)
(* bracketed by the source field [Tf].                                     *)

Definition sel_bracket_aux : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf:typ) (z:var)
         (A:typ_label) (S T0:typ),
    inert G ->
    record_type V ->
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_sel (avar_f z) A ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T0) ->
    bracket G a Tf Tf T0.

(* A record type is never below [typ_bot].  This is the other primitive
   fact needed by the continuation lemma (the [subtyp_bot] source is
   [typ_bot] itself, which is incompatible with [record_type]). *)
Definition record_no_bot : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ),
    inert G -> record_type V -> G ⊢ V <: typ_bot -> False.

(* The type-member coherence statement, exactly as recorded at the end of
   FieldInert.v: two record typings of the same inert-bound variable at
   the same type label have coherent bounds. *)

Definition TypeMemberCoherence : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (A:typ_label) (S1 T1 S2 T2:typ),
    inert G ->
    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
    record_type U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2) ->
    G ⊢ S1 <: T2.

(* The stronger shape statement which makes the coherence immediate: any
   record typing of [z] at the type label [A] goes through a stored
   equal-bounded member [dec_typ A W W] of the opening of the binding. *)

Definition typ_member_shape : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (z:var) (U:typ) (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
    inert G ->
    binds z (typ_bnd U) G ->
    record_type U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    exists W, record_has (open z U) (dec_typ A W W) /\
              G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.

(* The exact same-label pair produced by the sel detour: the lower bound
   of one typing and the upper bound of the other both pass through the
   stored equal-bounded member [W]. *)
Lemma typ_member_shape_coherence :
  typ_member_shape -> TypeMemberCoherence.
Proof.
  intros Hshape G x U A S1 T1 S2 T2 Hi Hb Hrt H1 H2.
  destruct (Hshape G x U A S1 T1 Hi Hb Hrt H1) as
    (W1 & Hrh1 & HS1 & HT1).
  destruct (Hshape G x U A S2 T2 Hi Hb Hrt H2) as
    (W2 & Hrh2 & HS2 & HT2).
  pose proof (@record_type_open U x Hrt) as Hrtopen.
  destruct (@record_type_typ_unique (open x U) A W1 W1 W2 W2 Hrtopen
              Hrh1 Hrh2) as [E1 E2].
  subst W2.
  eapply subtyp_trans; [exact HS1|exact HT2].
Qed.

(* The pair formulation of the detour used in the task statement:
   [V <: W] and [W <: T0] for the same stored member [W]. *)
Lemma typ_member_shape_pair :
  typ_member_shape ->
  forall (G:ctx) (z:var) (U:typ) (A:typ_label) (S1 T1 T2:typ),
    inert G ->
    binds z (typ_bnd U) G ->
    record_type U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T2) ->
    exists W, record_has (open z U) (dec_typ A W W) /\
              G ⊢ S1 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T2.
Proof.
  intros Hshape G z U A S1 T1 T2 Hi Hb Hrt H1 H2.
  destruct (Hshape G z U A S1 T1 Hi Hb Hrt H1) as (W & Hrh & HS & HT).
  exists W. split; [exact Hrh|]. split; [exact HS|].
  (* the second typing has the same lower [S1], so by coherence the stored
     member is the same and its upper is below [T2] *)
  destruct (Hshape G z U A S1 T2 Hi Hb Hrt H2) as (W2 & Hrh2 & HS2 & HT2).
  pose proof (@record_type_open U z Hrt) as Hrtopen.
  destruct (@record_type_typ_unique (open z U) A W W W2 W2 Hrtopen Hrh Hrh2)
    as [E1 E2].
  subst W2. exact HT2.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The continuation lemma: the fully proved [trans] handling.             *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma bracket_cont :
  sel_bracket_aux ->
  record_no_bot ->
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf:typ) (X T:typ),
    inert G ->
    record_type V ->
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: X ->
    bracket G a Tf Tf X ->
    G ⊢ X <: T ->
    bracket G a Tf Tf T.
Proof.
  intros Hsel Hbot G V a Tf X T Hi Hrt Hrh Hpre Hb Hsub.
  revert V a Tf Hi Hrt Hrh Hpre Hb.
  induction Hsub using subtyp_ind; intros V a Tf Hi Hrt Hrh Hpre Hb.
  - (* subtyp_top *) intros Sl Su Hrh2. inversion Hrh2.
  - (* subtyp_bot *) exfalso. eapply Hbot; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_refl *) exact Hb.
  - (* subtyp_trans *)
    eapply IHHsub0.
    + exact Hi.
    + exact Hrt.
    + exact Hrh.
    + eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hpre|exact Hsub].
    + eapply IHHsub; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_and11 *) intros Sl Su Hrh2. apply Hb with (Sl:=Sl) (Su:=Su).
    apply rh_andl. exact Hrh2.
  - (* subtyp_and12 *) intros Sl Su Hrh2. apply Hb with (Sl:=Sl) (Su:=Su).
    apply rh_andr. exact Hrh2.
  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
    assert (Hb1 := IHHsub Hi Hrt Hrh Hpre Hb).
    assert (Hb2 := IHHsub0 Hi Hrt Hrh Hpre Hb).
    intros Sl Su Hrh2. apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh2.
    destruct Hrh2 as [Hrh2|Hrh2].
    + apply Hb1. exact Hrh2.
    + apply Hb2. exact Hrh2.
  - (* subtyp_fld *)
    intros Sl Su Hrh2. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh2.
    inversion Hrh2; subst.
    pose proof (proj1 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hlow.
    pose proof (proj2 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hup.
    split.
    + eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
    + eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_typ *)
    intros Sl Su Hrh2. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh2. discriminate Hrh2.
  - (* subtyp_sel2 *) intros Sl Su Hrh2. inversion Hrh2.
  - (* subtyp_sel1 *)
    eapply Hsel; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_all *) intros Sl Su Hrh2. inversion Hrh2.
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The main inversion, and Hcov/Hcontr.                                   *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Theorem field_inversion_inert_of_aux :
  sel_bracket_aux ->
  record_no_bot ->
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf T:typ),
    inert G ->
    record_type V ->
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: T ->
    bracket G a Tf Tf T.
Proof.
  intros Hsel Hbot G V a Tf T Hi Hrt Hrh Hsub.
  eapply bracket_cont.
  - exact Hsel.
  - exact Hbot.
  - exact Hi.
  - exact Hrt.
  - exact Hrh.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - apply record_type_bracket; eassumption.
  - exact Hsub.
Qed.

Theorem field_cov_inert_of_aux :
  sel_bracket_aux ->
  record_no_bot ->
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
    inert G ->
    record_type V ->
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    G ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.
  intros Hsel Hbot G V a Tf S U Hi Hrt Hrh Hsub.
  pose proof (@field_inversion_inert_of_aux Hsel Hbot G V a Tf
                (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U)) Hi Hrt Hrh Hsub) as Hb.
  exact (proj2 (Hb S U (rh_one (dec_trm a S U)))).
Qed.

Theorem field_contr_inert_of_aux :
  sel_bracket_aux ->
  record_no_bot ->
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
    inert G ->
    record_type V ->
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    G ⊢ S <: Tf.
Proof.
  intros Hsel Hbot G V a Tf S U Hi Hrt Hrh Hsub.
  pose proof (@field_inversion_inert_of_aux Hsel Hbot G V a Tf
                (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U)) Hi Hrt Hrh Hsub) as Hb.
  exact (proj1 (Hb S U (rh_one (dec_trm a S U)))).
Qed.

Theorem field_pair_inert_of_aux :
  sel_bracket_aux ->
  record_no_bot ->
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
    inert G ->
    record_type V ->
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    G ⊢ S <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.
  intros Hsel Hbot G V a Tf S U Hi Hrt Hrh Hsub.
  split.
  - eapply field_contr_inert_of_aux; eassumption.
  - eapply field_cov_inert_of_aux; eassumption.
Qed.

(* Conversely, the full inversion restricted to a record target is exactly
   the pair of Hcov and Hcontr. *)
Lemma field_target_pair_of_cov_contr :
  (forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
     inert G -> record_type V -> record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
     G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) -> G ⊢ Tf <: U) ->
  (forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
     inert G -> record_type V -> record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
     G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) -> G ⊢ S <: Tf) ->
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf S U:typ),
    inert G -> record_type V -> record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) -> G ⊢ S <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: U.
Proof.
  intros Hcov Hcontr G V a Tf S U Hi Hrt Hrh Hsub.
  split.
  - eapply Hcontr; eassumption.
  - eapply Hcov; eassumption.
Qed.

    G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) ->
    G ⊢ S <: Tf.

(* work: the [sel1] rule jumps from a vacuous bracket at a selection to   *)
(* a target where the [nobot] component fails.  The continuation lemma    *)
(* below therefore carries the reachability hypothesis [V <: X], which    *)
(* is exactly what rules this jump out under inertness.                   *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Definition x0 : var := proj1_sig (var_fresh \{}).

Section CompatCounterexample.

Variable (A:typ_label).
Variable (a:trm_label).

Definition Uz : typ := typ_rcd (dec_typ A typ_bot typ_bot).

Lemma record_type_Uz : record_type Uz.
Proof.
  unfold Uz. exists (\{label_typ A}). apply rt_one.
  - apply rd_typ.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition Gz : ctx := empty & x0 ~ typ_bnd Uz.

Lemma x0_fresh_empty : x0 # (empty:ctx).
Proof. rewrite (@dom_empty typ). apply notin_empty. Qed.

Lemma binds_Gz : binds x0 (typ_bnd Uz) Gz.
Proof. unfold Gz. apply binds_push_eq. Qed.

Lemma inert_Gz : inert Gz.
Proof.
  unfold Gz. eapply inert_all.
  - apply inert_empty.
  - apply inert_typ_bnd. exact record_type_Uz.
  - exact x0_fresh_empty.
Qed.

Lemma typing_Gz : Gz ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x0) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A typ_bot typ_bot).
Proof.
  change (Gz ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x0) ∶ open x0 Uz).
  eapply ty_rec_elim. apply ty_var. exact binds_Gz.
Qed.

Lemma sel1_Gz : Gz ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x0) A <: typ_bot.
Proof.
  eapply subtyp_sel1. exact typing_Gz.
Qed.

Lemma compat_sel_Gz :
  compat Gz a typ_top typ_top (typ_sel (avar_f x0) A).
Proof.
  split.
  - cbn [nobot]. exact I.
  - intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
Qed.

Lemma not_compat_bot_Gz : ~ compat Gz a typ_top typ_top typ_bot.
Proof.
  intros [Hn _]. cbn [nobot] in Hn. exact Hn.
Qed.

End CompatCounterexample.

Lemma compat_not_preserved_inert :
  forall (A:typ_label) (a:trm_label),
    exists (G:ctx) (Al Au S U:typ),
      inert G /\ G ⊢ S <: U /\
      compat G a Al Au S /\ ~ compat G a Al Au U.
Proof.
  intros A a.
  exists (Gz A), typ_top, typ_top, (typ_sel (avar_f x0) A), typ_bot.
  split; [exact (inert_Gz A)|].
  split; [exact (sel1_Gz A)|].
  split; [exact (compat_sel_Gz A a)|exact (not_compat_bot_Gz A a)].
Qed.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The exact residuals.                                                   *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* The [subtyp_sel1] coherence step: when a record-typed source [V] has   *)
(* been shown below a selection [z.A], the [typ_bnd Uz] binding of [z]    *)
(* and its equal-bounded [dec_typ A W W] member force every field member  *)
(* of the upper bound [T0] of any typing [z : {A: S..T0}] to be           *)
(* bracketed by the source field [Tf].                                     *)

Definition sel_bracket_aux : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf:typ) (z:var)
         (A:typ_label) (S T0:typ),
    inert G ->
    record_type V ->
    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
    G ⊢ V <: typ_sel (avar_f z) A ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T0) ->
    bracket G a Tf Tf T0.

(* A record type is never below [typ_bot].  This is the other primitive
   fact needed by the continuation lemma (the [subtyp_bot] source is
   [typ_bot] itself, which is incompatible with [record_type]). *)
Definition record_no_bot : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ),
    inert G -> record_type V -> G ⊢ V <: typ_bot -> False.

(* The type-member coherence statement, exactly as recorded at the end of
   FieldInert.v: two record typings of the same inert-bound variable at
   the same type label have coherent bounds. *)

Definition TypeMemberCoherence : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (A:typ_label) (S1 T1 S2 T2:typ),
    inert G ->
    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
    record_type U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2) ->
    G ⊢ S1 <: T2.

(* The stronger shape statement which makes the coherence immediate: any
   record typing of [z] at the type label [A] goes through a stored
   equal-bounded member [dec_typ A W W] of the opening of the binding. *)

Definition typ_member_shape : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (z:var) (U:typ) (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
    inert G ->
    binds z (typ_bnd U) G ->
    record_type U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    exists W, record_has (open z U) (dec_typ A W W) /\
              G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.

(* The exact same-label pair produced by the sel detour: the lower bound
   of one typing and the upper bound of the other both pass through the
   stored equal-bounded member [W]. *)
Lemma typ_member_shape_coherence :
  typ_member_shape -> TypeMemberCoherence.
Proof.
  intros Hshape G x U A S1 T1 S2 T2 Hi Hb Hrt H1 H2.
  destruct (Hshape G x U A S1 T1 Hi Hb Hrt H1) as
    (W1 & Hrh1 & HS1 & HT1).
  destruct (Hshape G x U A S2 T2 Hi Hb Hrt H2) as
    (W2 & Hrh2 & HS2 & HT2).

If the full proof is too long, leave all helper lemmas Qed and the main statement as a `Definition`/comment (no Abort); report exact remaining subgoals. Compile with the standard rocq command and report.

8	(* ====================================================================== *)
9	(* Inert-restricted field subtyping: the exact reduction.                 *)
10	(*                                                                        *)
11	(* This file isolates the genuinely inert-restricted field lemmas         *)
12	(*                                                                        *)
13	(*   Hcov   : inert G -> record_type V ->                               *)
14	(*            record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->                          *)
15	(*            G ⊢ V <: typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U) -> G ⊢ Tf <: U,           *)
16	(*   Hcontr : same hypotheses -> G ⊢ S <: Tf.                            *)
17	(*                                                                        *)
18	(* Everything is reduced to two precise residuals:                        *)
19	(*                                                                        *)
20	(*   [sel_bracket_aux] : the [subtyp_sel1] coherence step.  If [V] is a   *)
21	(*     record type with a balanced field [(Tf,Tf)] and [V] is below the   *)
22	(*     selection [z.A], then every field member of the upper bound [T0]   *)
23	(*     of a typing [z : {A: S..T0}] is bracketed by [Tf].  This is where  *)
24	(*     the auxiliary variable [z]'s [typ_bnd Uz] body and its equal-      *)
25	(*     bounded [dec_typ A W W] member are used.                           *)
26	(*                                                                        *)
27	(*   [record_no_bot] : a record type cannot be below [typ_bot].           *)
28	(*                                                                        *)
29	(* All other steps are proved below, in particular the [subtyp_trans]     *)
30	(* case.  The proof avoids the "composition adds a [trans] node" cycle by *)
31	(* proving a continuation lemma [bracket_cont] which carries the prefix   *)
32	(* [V <: X] as a hypothesis and recurses only on the structural           *)
33	(* subderivation [X <: T]; a [trans] node therefore strictly decreases    *)
34	(* the suffix, while the (possibly re-composed) prefix is only passed     *)
35	(* along, never re-inducted on.  This is the flattened-path idea: the     *)
36	(* prefix plays the role of the accumulated path and is not charged to    *)
37	(* the inductive measure.                                                 *)
38	(*                                                                        *)
39	(* We also machine-check that the naive [compat] preservation suggested   *)
40	(* in the task statement is FALSE under [inert]: the selection rules can  *)
41	(* jump to [typ_bot], where the [nobot] component fails.  Thus a          *)
42	(* reachability-aware invariant (the prefix [V <: X] above) is necessary. *)
43	(* No Admitted/Axiom/Parameter is used.                                   *)
44	(* ====================================================================== *)
45	
46	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
47	(* Record structure.                                                      *)
48	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
49	
50	Lemma record_typ_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
51	  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
52	Proof.
53	  intros T ls D Hrt. induction Hrt as
54	    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ]; intros Hrh.
55	  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. subst D. exact Hdec.
56	  - apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh. destruct Hrh as [Hl|Hr].
57	    + eapply IH. exact Hl.
58	    + apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hr. subst D. exact Hdec.
59	Qed.
60	
61	Lemma record_type_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (D:dec),
62	  record_type T -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
63	Proof.
64	  intros T D [ls Hrt] Hrh. eapply (@record_typ_has_dec T ls D); eassumption.
65	Qed.
66	
67	Lemma record_type_has_equal_bounds : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
68	  record_type T -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U) -> S = U.
69	Proof.
70	  intros T a S U Hrt Hrh.
71	  pose proof (@record_type_has_dec T (dec_trm a S U) Hrt Hrh) as Hdec.
72	  inversion Hdec; subst. reflexivity.
73	Qed.
74	
75	Lemma record_type_has_typ_equal_bounds : forall (T:typ) (A:typ_label) (S U:typ),
76	  record_type T -> record_has T (dec_typ A S U) -> S = U.
77	Proof.
78	  intros T A S U Hrt Hrh.
79	  pose proof (@record_type_has_dec T (dec_typ A S U) Hrt Hrh) as Hdec.
80	  inversion Hdec; subst. reflexivity.
81	Qed.
82	
83	Lemma record_typ_trm_unique : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (a:trm_label)
84	    (T1 U1 T2 U2:typ),
85	  record_typ T ls ->
86	  record_has T (dec_trm a T1 U1) ->
87	  record_has T (dec_trm a T2 U2) ->
88	  T1 = T2 /\ U1 = U2.
89	Proof.
90	  intros T ls a T1 U1 T2 U2 Hrt.
91	  induction Hrt as [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ];
92	    intros H1 H2.
93	  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
94	    apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
95	    assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
96	    { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
97	    inversion E. auto.
98	  - apply record_has_and_inv in H1.
99	    apply record_has_and_inv in H2.
100	    destruct H1 as [H1|H1]; destruct H2 as [H2|H2].
101	    + eapply IH; eassumption.
102	    + exfalso. apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
103	      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T1 U1) H1) as Hin.
104	      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1) = l).
105	      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2)).
106	        - cbn. reflexivity.
107	        - rewrite H2. symmetry. exact Heq. }
108	      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
109	    + exfalso. apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
110	      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T2 U2) H2) as Hin.
111	      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2) = l).
112	      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1)).
113	        - cbn. reflexivity.
114	        - rewrite H1. symmetry. exact Heq. }
115	      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
116	    + apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
117	      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
118	      assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
119	      { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
120	      inversion E. auto.
121	Qed.
122	
123	(* The type-member analogue, needed to identify the same stored type member
124	   when a variable receives two record typings at the same type label. *)
125	Lemma record_typ_typ_unique : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (A:typ_label)
126	    (S1 T1 S2 T2:typ),
127	  record_typ T ls ->
128	  record_has T (dec_typ A S1 T1) ->
129	  record_has T (dec_typ A S2 T2) ->
130	  S1 = S2 /\ T1 = T2.
131	Proof.
132	  intros T ls A S1 T1 S2 T2 Hrt.
133	  induction Hrt as [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ];
134	    intros H1 H2.
135	  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
136	    apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
137	    assert (E : dec_typ A S1 T1 = dec_typ A S2 T2).
138	    { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
139	    inversion E. auto.
140	  - apply record_has_and_inv in H1.
141	    apply record_has_and_inv in H2.
142	    destruct H1 as [H1|H1]; destruct H2 as [H2|H2].
143	    + eapply IH; eassumption.
144	    + exfalso. apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
145	      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_typ A S1 T1) H1) as Hin.
146	      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_typ A S1 T1) = l).
147	      { transitivity (label_of (dec_typ A S2 T2)).
148	        - cbn. reflexivity.
149	        - rewrite H2. symmetry. exact Heq. }
150	      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
151	    + exfalso. apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
152	      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_typ A S2 T2) H2) as Hin.
153	      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_typ A S2 T2) = l).
154	      { transitivity (label_of (dec_typ A S1 T1)).
155	        - cbn. reflexivity.
156	        - rewrite H1. symmetry. exact Heq. }
157	      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
158	    + apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
159	      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
160	      assert (E : dec_typ A S1 T1 = dec_typ A S2 T2).
161	      { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
162	      inversion E. auto.
163	Qed.
164	
165	Lemma record_type_trm_unique : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (T1 U1 T2 U2:typ),
166	  record_type T ->
167	  record_has T (dec_trm a T1 U1) ->
168	  record_has T (dec_trm a T2 U2) ->
169	  T1 = T2 /\ U1 = U2.
170	Proof.
171	  intros T a T1 U1 T2 U2 [ls Hrt] H1 H2.
172	  eapply (@record_typ_trm_unique T ls a T1 U1 T2 U2); eassumption.
173	Qed.
174	
175	Lemma record_type_typ_unique : forall (T:typ) (A:typ_label) (S1 T1 S2 T2:typ),
176	  record_type T ->
177	  record_has T (dec_typ A S1 T1) ->
178	  record_has T (dec_typ A S2 T2) ->
179	  S1 = S2 /\ T1 = T2.
180	Proof.
181	  intros T A S1 T1 S2 T2 [ls Hrt] H1 H2.
182	  eapply (@record_typ_typ_unique T ls A S1 T1 S2 T2); eassumption.
183	Qed.
184	
185	Lemma record_type_bracket : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf:typ),
186	  record_type V -> record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
187	  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has V (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
188	    G ⊢ Sl <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: Su.
189	Proof.
190	  intros G V a Tf Hrt Hrh Sl Su Hrh2.
191	  pose proof (@record_type_trm_unique V a Tf Tf Sl Su Hrt Hrh Hrh2) as [E1 E2].
192	  subst. split; apply subtyp_refl.
193	Qed.
194	
195	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
196	(* The bracket / compat predicates.                                       *)
197	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
198	
199	Fixpoint nobot (T:typ) : Prop :=
200	  match T with
201	  | typ_bot => False
202	  | typ_and T1 T2 => nobot T1 /\ nobot T2
203	  | _ => True
204	  end.
205	
206	Definition bracket (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
207	  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has T (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
208	    G ⊢ Sl <: Al /\ G ⊢ Au <: Su.
209	
210	Definition compat (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
211	  nobot T /\ bracket G a Al Au T.
212	
213	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
214	(* The naive compat closure under inert contexts is FALSE.                *)
215	(*                                                                        *)
216	(* Counterexample: [G = empty & x ~ typ_bnd {A: bot..bot}].  Then         *)
217	(* [x : {A: bot..bot}], so [subtyp_sel1] gives                              *)
218	(*                                                                        *)
219	(*      [G ⊢ x.A <: bot].                                                  *)
220	(*                                                                        *)
221	(* [compat] holds at [x.A] (selections have no [record_has] members, so    *)
222	(* the bracket part is vacuous and [nobot] is trivially true), but        *)
223	(* [compat] at [typ_bot] is false because [nobot bot = False].  Thus the   *)
224	(* suggested completely type-directed preservation of [compat] cannot     *)
225	(* work: the [sel1] rule jumps from a vacuous bracket at a selection to   *)
226	(* a target where the [nobot] component fails.  The continuation lemma    *)
227	(* below therefore carries the reachability hypothesis [V <: X], which    *)
228	(* is exactly what rules this jump out under inertness.                   *)
229	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
230	
231	Definition x0 : var := proj1_sig (var_fresh \{}).
232	
233	Section CompatCounterexample.
234	
235	Variable (A:typ_label).
236	Variable (a:trm_label).
237	
238	Definition Uz : typ := typ_rcd (dec_typ A typ_bot typ_bot).
239	
240	Lemma record_type_Uz : record_type Uz.
241	Proof.
242	  unfold Uz. exists (\{label_typ A}). apply rt_one.
243	  - apply rd_typ.
244	  - reflexivity.
245	Qed.
246	
247	Definition Gz : ctx := empty & x0 ~ typ_bnd Uz.
248	
249	Lemma x0_fresh_empty : x0 # (empty:ctx).
250	Proof. rewrite (@dom_empty typ). apply notin_empty. Qed.
251	
252	Lemma binds_Gz : binds x0 (typ_bnd Uz) Gz.
253	Proof. unfold Gz. apply binds_push_eq. Qed.
254	
255	Lemma inert_Gz : inert Gz.
256	Proof.
257	  unfold Gz. eapply inert_all.
258	  - apply inert_empty.
259	  - apply inert_typ_bnd. exact record_type_Uz.
260	  - exact x0_fresh_empty.
261	Qed.
262	
263	Lemma typing_Gz : Gz ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x0) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A typ_bot typ_bot).
264	Proof.
265	  change (Gz ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x0) ∶ open x0 Uz).
266	  eapply ty_rec_elim. apply ty_var. exact binds_Gz.
267	Qed.
268	
269	Lemma sel1_Gz : Gz ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x0) A <: typ_bot.
270	Proof.
271	  eapply subtyp_sel1. exact typing_Gz.
272	Qed.
273	
274	Lemma compat_sel_Gz :
275	  compat Gz a typ_top typ_top (typ_sel (avar_f x0) A).
276	Proof.
277	  split.
278	  - cbn [nobot]. exact I.
279	  - intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
280	Qed.
281	
282	Lemma not_compat_bot_Gz : ~ compat Gz a typ_top typ_top typ_bot.
283	Proof.
284	  intros [Hn _]. cbn [nobot] in Hn. exact Hn.
285	Qed.
286	
287	End CompatCounterexample.
288	
289	Lemma compat_not_preserved_inert :
290	  forall (A:typ_label) (a:trm_label),
291	    exists (G:ctx) (Al Au S U:typ),
292	      inert G /\ G ⊢ S <: U /\
293	      compat G a Al Au S /\ ~ compat G a Al Au U.
294	Proof.
295	  intros A a.
296	  exists (Gz A), typ_top, typ_top, (typ_sel (avar_f x0) A), typ_bot.
297	  split; [exact (inert_Gz A)|].
298	  split; [exact (sel1_Gz A)|].
299	  split; [exact (compat_sel_Gz A a)|exact (not_compat_bot_Gz A a)].
300	Qed.
301	
302	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
303	(* The exact residuals.                                                   *)
304	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
305	
306	(* The [subtyp_sel1] coherence step: when a record-typed source [V] has   *)
307	(* been shown below a selection [z.A], the [typ_bnd Uz] binding of [z]    *)
308	(* and its equal-bounded [dec_typ A W W] member force every field member  *)
309	(* of the upper bound [T0] of any typing [z : {A: S..T0}] to be           *)
310	(* bracketed by the source field [Tf].                                     *)
311	
312	Definition sel_bracket_aux : Prop :=
313	  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf:typ) (z:var)
314	         (A:typ_label) (S T0:typ),
315	    inert G ->
316	    record_type V ->
317	    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
318	    G ⊢ V <: typ_sel (avar_f z) A ->
319	    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T0) ->
320	    bracket G a Tf Tf T0.
321	
322	(* A record type is never below [typ_bot].  This is the other primitive
323	   fact needed by the continuation lemma (the [subtyp_bot] source is
324	   [typ_bot] itself, which is incompatible with [record_type]). *)
325	Definition record_no_bot : Prop :=
326	  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ),
327	    inert G -> record_type V -> G ⊢ V <: typ_bot -> False.
328	
329	(* The type-member coherence statement, exactly as recorded at the end of
330	   FieldInert.v: two record typings of the same inert-bound variable at
331	   the same type label have coherent bounds. *)
332	
333	Definition TypeMemberCoherence : Prop :=
334	  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (A:typ_label) (S1 T1 S2 T2:typ),
335	    inert G ->
336	    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
337	    record_type U ->
338	    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) ->
339	    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2) ->
340	    G ⊢ S1 <: T2.
341	
342	(* The stronger shape statement which makes the coherence immediate: any
343	   record typing of [z] at the type label [A] goes through a stored
344	   equal-bounded member [dec_typ A W W] of the opening of the binding. *)
345	
346	Definition typ_member_shape : Prop :=
347	  forall (G:ctx) (z:var) (U:typ) (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
348	    inert G ->
349	    binds z (typ_bnd U) G ->
350	    record_type U ->
351	    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
352	    exists W, record_has (open z U) (dec_typ A W W) /\
353	              G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
354	
355	(* The exact same-label pair produced by the sel detour: the lower bound
356	   of one typing and the upper bound of the other both pass through the
357	   stored equal-bounded member [W]. *)
358	Lemma typ_member_shape_coherence :
359	  typ_member_shape -> TypeMemberCoherence.
360	Proof.
361	  intros Hshape G x U A S1 T1 S2 T2 Hi Hb Hrt H1 H2.
362	  destruct (Hshape G x U A S1 T1 Hi Hb Hrt H1) as
363	    (W1 & Hrh1 & HS1 & HT1).
364	  destruct (Hshape G x U A S2 T2 Hi Hb Hrt H2) as
365	    (W2 & Hrh2 & HS2 & HT2).
366	  pose proof (@record_type_open U 0 x Hrt) as Hrtopen.
367	  destruct (@record_type_typ_unique (open x U) A W1 W1 W2 W2 Hrtopen
368	              Hrh1 Hrh2) as [E1 E2].
369	  subst W2.
370	  eapply subtyp_trans; [exact HS1|exact HT2].
371	Qed.
372	
373	(* The pair formulation of the detour used in the task statement:
374	   [V <: W] and [W <: T0] for the same stored member [W]. *)
375	Lemma typ_member_shape_pair :
376	  typ_member_shape ->
377	  forall (G:ctx) (z:var) (U:typ) (A:typ_label) (S1 T1 T2:typ),
378	    inert G ->
379	    binds z (typ_bnd U) G ->
380	    record_type U ->
381	    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) ->
382	    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f z) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T2) ->
383	    exists W, record_has (open z U) (dec_typ A W W) /\
384	              G ⊢ S1 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T2.
385	Proof.
386	  intros Hshape G z U A S1 T1 T2 Hi Hb Hrt H1 H2.
387	  destruct (Hshape G z U A S1 T1 Hi Hb Hrt H1) as (W & Hrh & HS & HT).
388	  exists W. split; [exact Hrh|]. split; [exact HS|].
389	  (* the second typing has the same lower [S1], so by coherence the stored
390	     member is the same and its upper is below [T2] *)
391	  destruct (Hshape G z U A S1 T2 Hi Hb Hrt H2) as (W2 & Hrh2 & HS2 & HT2).
392	  pose proof (@record_type_open U 0 z Hrt) as Hrtopen.
393	  destruct (@record_type_typ_unique (open z U) A W W W2 W2 Hrtopen Hrh Hrh2)
394	    as [E1 E2].
395	  subst W2. exact HT2.
396	Qed.
397	
398	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
399	(* The continuation lemma: the fully proved [trans] handling.             *)
400	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
401	
402	Lemma bracket_cont :
403	  sel_bracket_aux ->
404	  record_no_bot ->
405	  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf:typ) (X T:typ),
406	    inert G ->
407	    record_type V ->
408	    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
409	    G ⊢ V <: X ->
410	    bracket G a Tf Tf X ->
411	    G ⊢ X <: T ->
412	    bracket G a Tf Tf T.
413	Proof.
414	  intros Hsel Hbot G V a Tf X T Hi Hrt Hrh Hpre Hb Hsub.
415	  revert V a Tf Hi Hrt Hrh Hpre Hb.
416	  induction Hsub using subtyp_ind; intros V aa Tf Hi Hrt Hrh Hpre Hb.
417	  - (* subtyp_top *) intros Sl Su Hrh2. inversion Hrh2.
418	  - (* subtyp_bot *) exfalso. eapply Hbot; eassumption.
419	  - (* subtyp_refl *) exact Hb.
420	  - (* subtyp_trans *)
421	    eapply IHHsub0.
422	    + exact Hi.
423	    + exact Hrt.
424	    + exact Hrh.
425	    + eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hpre|exact H].
426	    + eapply IHHsub; [exact Hi|exact Hrt|exact Hrh|exact Hpre|exact Hb].
427	  - (* subtyp_and11 *) intros Sl Su Hrh2. apply Hb with (Sl:=Sl) (Su:=Su).
428	    apply rh_andl. exact Hrh2.
429	  - (* subtyp_and12 *) intros Sl Su Hrh2. apply Hb with (Sl:=Sl) (Su:=Su).
430	    apply rh_andr. exact Hrh2.
431	  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
432	    assert (Hb1 : bracket G aa Tf Tf T)
433	      by (eapply IHHsub; [exact Hi|exact Hrt|exact Hrh|exact Hpre|exact Hb]).
434	    assert (Hb2 : bracket G aa Tf Tf U)
435	      by (eapply IHHsub0; [exact Hi|exact Hrt|exact Hrh|exact Hpre|exact Hb]).
436	    intros Sl Su Hrh2. apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh2.
437	    destruct Hrh2 as [Hrh2|Hrh2].
438	    + apply Hb1. exact Hrh2.
439	    + apply Hb2. exact Hrh2.
440	  - (* subtyp_fld *)
441	    intros Sl Su Hrh2. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh2.
442	    inversion Hrh2; subst.
443	    pose proof (proj1 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hlow.
444	    pose proof (proj2 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hup.
445	    split.
446	    + eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
447	    + eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
448	  - (* subtyp_typ *)
449	    intros Sl Su Hrh2. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh2. discriminate Hrh2.

451	  - (* subtyp_sel1 *)
452	    eapply Hsel; eassumption.

11	(* The two target lemmas are [field_cov_inert] and [field_contr_inert].   *)
12	(* Below we prove:                                                        *)
13	(*   (1) inertness really does exclude the bad asymmetric type-member    *)
14	(*       binding used in FieldSub2.v;                                      *)
15	(*   (2) both target lemmas in full, under the (stronger than inert)      *)
16	(*       assumption that the context derives no record typing of a        *)
17	(*       variable at a type member [dec_typ A S T].  This hypothesis is   *)
18	(*       exactly what is needed to make selections impossible; it is      *)
19	(*       satisfied by the empty context, giving both lemmas for [empty].  *)
20	(*   (3) the precise remaining subgoal for the general inert case: the    *)
21	(*       coherence of the type-member bounds of an inert [typ_bnd]        *)
22	(*       binding (see the comment at the end of the file).                *)

48	Lemma record_typ_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
49	  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
50	Proof.
51	  intros T ls D Hrt. induction Hrt as
52	    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ]; intros Hrh.
53	  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. subst D. exact Hdec.
54	  - apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh. destruct Hrh as [Hl|Hr].
55	    + eapply IH. exact Hl.
56	    + apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hr. subst D. exact Hdec.
57	Qed.

60	  record_type T -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
61	Proof.

63	Qed.

65	Lemma record_type_has_equal_bounds : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
66	  record_type T -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U) -> S = U.
67	Proof.
68	  intros T a S U Hrt Hrh.
69	  pose proof (@record_type_has_dec T (dec_trm a S U) Hrt Hrh) as Hdec.
70	  inversion Hdec; subst. reflexivity.
71	Qed.

73	(* Two [record_has] members of a record type with the same label are the
74	   same member.  This is the uniqueness needed to turn the equal-bound
75	   fact for one member into the bounds bracket for every member. *)
76	
77	Lemma record_typ_trm_unique : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (a:trm_label)
78	    (T1 U1 T2 U2:typ),
79	  record_typ T ls ->
80	  record_has T (dec_trm a T1 U1) ->
81	  record_has T (dec_trm a T2 U2) ->
82	  T1 = T2 /\ U1 = U2.
83	Proof.
84	  intros T ls a T1 U1 T2 U2 Hrt.
85	  induction Hrt as [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ];
86	    intros H1 H2.
87	  - apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
88	    apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
89	    assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
90	    { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
91	    inversion E. auto.
92	  - apply record_has_and_inv in H1.
93	    apply record_has_and_inv in H2.
94	    destruct H1 as [H1|H1]; destruct H2 as [H2|H2].
95	    + eapply IH; eassumption.
96	    + (* H1 in T0, H2 in the right component *)
97	      exfalso.
98	      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
99	      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T1 U1) H1) as Hin.
100	      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1) = l).
101	      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2)).
102	        - cbn. reflexivity.
103	        - rewrite H2. symmetry. exact Heq. }
104	      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
105	    + (* H1 in the right component, H2 in T0 *)
106	      exfalso.
107	      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
108	      pose proof (@record_typ_labels T0 ls0 Hrt (dec_trm a T2 U2) H2) as Hin.
109	      assert (Hl : label_of (dec_trm a T2 U2) = l).
110	      { transitivity (label_of (dec_trm a T1 U1)).
111	        - cbn. reflexivity.
112	        - rewrite H1. symmetry. exact Heq. }
113	      rewrite Hl in Hin. exact (Hnot Hin).
114	    + (* both in the right component *)
115	      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H1.
116	      apply record_has_rcd_inv in H2.
117	      assert (E : dec_trm a T1 U1 = dec_trm a T2 U2).
118	      { transitivity D0; [exact H1|symmetry; exact H2]. }
119	      inversion E. auto.
120	Qed.

122	Lemma record_type_bracket : forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf:typ),
123	  record_type V -> record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
124	  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has V (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
125	    G ⊢ Sl <: Tf /\ G ⊢ Tf <: Su.
126	Proof.
127	  intros G V a Tf [ls Hrt] Hrh Sl Su Hrh2.
128	  pose proof (@record_typ_trm_unique V ls a Tf Tf Sl Su Hrt Hrh Hrh2)
129	    as [E1 E2].
130	  subst. split; apply subtyp_refl.
131	Qed.
