133	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
134	(* A "no bottom in the record/intersection structure" predicate and the   *)
135	(* label-indexed bracket predicate.                                       *)
136	(*                                                                        *)
137	(* [compat G a Al Au T] says: T contains no bottom in the positions       *)
138	(* traversed by [record_has], and every [a]-member of T brackets the      *)
139	(* (source) bounds [Al..Au].  This predicate is designed so that it is    *)
140	(* preserved by subtyping in the absence of selection flows, while still  *)
141	(* being false at [typ_bot].  The [nobot] component is what makes the     *)
142	(* [and11]/[and12] cases (and the [subtyp_bot] case) go through.          *)
143	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
144	
145	Fixpoint nobot (T:typ) : Prop :=
146	  match T with
147	  | typ_bot => False
148	  | typ_and T1 T2 => nobot T1 /\ nobot T2
149	  | _ => True
150	  end.
151	
152	Definition bracket (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
153	  forall (Sl Su:typ), record_has T (dec_trm a Sl Su) ->
154	    G ⊢ Sl <: Al /\ G ⊢ Au <: Su.
155	
156	Definition compat (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au T:typ) : Prop :=
157	  nobot T /\ bracket G a Al Au T.
158	
159	Lemma record_typ_nobot : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label),
160	  record_typ T ls -> nobot T.
161	Proof.
162	  intros T ls Hrt. induction Hrt as
163	    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ].
164	  - cbn [nobot]. exact I.
165	  - cbn [nobot]. split; [exact IH|exact I].
166	Qed.
167	
168	Lemma record_type_nobot : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> nobot T.
169	Proof.
170	  intros T [ls Hrt]. eapply @record_typ_nobot; eassumption.
171	Qed.

173	(* The context hypothesis that selection flows are impossible. *)
174	Definition no_ty_member_typings (G:ctx) : Prop :=
175	  forall (x:var) (A:typ_label) (S T:typ),
176	    ~ (G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)).
177	
178	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
179	(* Preservation of [compat] by subtyping, in a context with no type-member *)
180	(* record typings (so that [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] can never fire).    *)
181	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
182	
183	Lemma compat_closure : forall (G:ctx) (a:trm_label) (Al Au:typ) (S U:typ),
184	  no_ty_member_typings G ->
185	  G ⊢ S <: U ->
186	  compat G a Al Au S ->
187	  compat G a Al Au U.
188	Proof.
189	  intros G a Al Au S U Hns Hsub.
190	  induction Hsub; intros Hc; cbn [compat nobot bracket] in *.
191	  - (* subtyp_top *) split; [exact I|]. intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
192	  - (* subtyp_bot *) destruct Hc as [Hn _]. exact (False_rect _ Hn).
193	  - (* subtyp_refl *) exact Hc.
194	  - (* subtyp_trans *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb].
195	    apply IHHsub0.
196	    + exact Hns.
197	    + apply IHHsub; [exact Hns | split; [exact Hn|exact Hb]].
198	  - (* subtyp_and11 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
199	    + exact (proj1 Hn).
200	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andl. exact Hrh.
201	  - (* subtyp_and12 *) destruct Hc as [Hn Hb]. split.
202	    + exact (proj2 Hn).
203	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply Hb. apply rh_andr. exact Hrh.
204	  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
205	    assert (IH1 := IHHsub Hns Hc).
206	    assert (IH2 := IHHsub0 Hns Hc).
207	    destruct IH1 as [Hn1 Hb1]. destruct IH2 as [Hn2 Hb2]. split.
208	    + split; assumption.
209	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh.
210	      destruct Hrh as [Hrh|Hrh]; [apply Hb1|apply Hb2]; exact Hrh.
211	  - (* subtyp_fld *)
212	    destruct Hc as [_ Hb]. split.
213	    + exact I.
214	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh.
215	      inversion Hrh; subst.
216	      pose proof (proj1 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hlow.
217	      pose proof (proj2 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hup.
218	      split; [eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption|eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption].
219	  - (* subtyp_typ *) split.
220	    + exact I.
221	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. discriminate Hrh.
222	  - (* subtyp_sel2 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
223	  - (* subtyp_sel1 *) exfalso. eapply Hns; eassumption.
224	  - (* subtyp_all *) split.
225	    + exact I.
226	    + intros Sl Su Hrh. inversion Hrh.
227	Qed.

243	  pose proof (@compat_closure G a Tf Tf V (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S U))
244	                Hns Hsub (conj (@record_type_nobot V Hrt) Hb)) as Hfinal.
245	  destruct Hfinal as [_ HbU].

283	Lemma empty_typing_var_false_mut :
284	  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
285	     G = empty -> forall (x:var), t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False) /\
286	  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
287	  (forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U -> True) /\
288	  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).
289	Proof.
290	  apply (rules_mutind
291	    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
292	       G = empty -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> False)
293	    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
294	    (fun (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (_:G ⊢ S <: U) => True)
295	    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True));
296	  intros;
297	  try (match goal with
298	       | b : binds ?x ?v ?G, He : ?G = empty |- False =>
299	           rewrite He in b; exact (binds_empty_inv b)
300	       end);
301	  try (match goal with
302	       | IH : ?G = empty -> forall y, ?t = trm_var (avar_f y) -> False,
303	         He : ?G = empty |- _ =>
304	           exfalso; eapply IH; [exact He | first [eassumption | reflexivity]]
305	       end);
306	  try (match goal with H : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- False => discriminate H end);
307	  try (match goal with H : trm_var (avar_f _) = ?t |- False => discriminate H end);
308	  auto.
309	Qed.

345	(* A larger class of inert contexts: bindings may be [typ_all], [typ_con], *)
346	(* or [typ_bnd U] where [U] is a record type with no type-member          *)
347	(* ([dec_typ]) members at all.  (In particular this excludes the bad      *)
348	(* asymmetric binding of FieldSub2.v, which is a record with a [dec_typ]  *)
349	(* member, and it also excludes the equal-bounded [dec_typ] bodies.)      *)

351	(* a type member, so [no_ty_member_typings] holds and both field lemmas   *)
352	(* apply.                                                                 *)

354	(* The proof is a mutual induction over typing and subtyping.  The         *)
355	(* invariant [ntr x T] says that [T] is built (with intersections) from   *)
356	(* top, universal/existential object types, [typ_bnd] whose opening is    *)
357	(* [ntr], and record types whose visible members are all term members.    *)

359	(* exactly the bad shape.  Selection rules can never fire because their   *)

405	Lemma ntr_open_record : forall (x:var) (U:typ) (ls:fset label),
406	  record_typ U ls -> no_typ_decs U -> ntr x (open x U).
407	Proof.
408	  intros x U ls Hrt. induction Hrt as
409	    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | U0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ]; intros Hno.
410	  - destruct (record_dec_class D0 Hdec) as [[A [T E]] | [b [T E]]].
411	    + exfalso. apply (Hno A T T). subst D0. apply rh_one.
412	    + subst D0. cbn [open open_rec]. apply ntr_rcd_trm.
413	  - cbn [open open_rec]. apply ntr_and.
414	    + apply IH. apply (no_typ_decs_and_l _ _ Hno).
415	    + destruct (record_dec_class D0 Hdec) as [[A [T E]] | [b [T E]]].
416	      * exfalso. apply (Hno A T T). subst D0. apply rh_andr, rh_one.

420	Lemma bnd_ok_ntr_mut :
421	  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
422	     bnd_ok_ctx G -> forall (x:var), t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> ntr x T) /\
423	  (forall (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ), G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\
424	  (forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U ->
425	     bnd_ok_ctx G -> forall (x:var), ntr x S -> ntr x U) /\
426	  (forall (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs), G ⊢ avs :: Ts -> True).
427	Proof.
428	  apply (rules_mutind
429	    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
430	       bnd_ok_ctx G -> forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> ntr x T)
431	    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
432	    (fun (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (_:G ⊢ S <: U) =>
433	       bnd_ok_ctx G -> forall x, ntr x S -> ntr x U)
434	    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True)).

436	    intros G x T b Hac y E.
437	    apply trm_var_inj in E. subst y.
438	    destruct (Hac x T b) as
439	      [[S1 [T1 Heq]] | [[Ts [is' [T1 Heq]]] | [U [Heq [Hrt Hno]]]]].
440	    + subst T. apply ntr_all.
441	    + subst T. apply ntr_con.
442	    + subst T. apply ntr_bnd. destruct Hrt as [ls Hrt].
443	      eapply ntr_open_record; eassumption.
444	  - (* ty_all_elim *)
445	    intros; match goal with E : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- _ => discriminate E end.
446	  - (* ty_new *)
447	    intros; match goal with E : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- _ => discriminate E end.
448	  - (* ty_rcd_elim *)
449	    intros; match goal with E : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- _ => discriminate E end.
450	  - (* ty_fld_asn *)
451	    intros; match goal with E : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- _ => discriminate E end.
452	  - (* ty_let *)
453	    intros; match goal with E : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- _ => discriminate E end.
454	  - (* ty_llit *)
455	    intros; match goal with E : ?t = trm_var (avar_f _) |- _ => discriminate E end.
456	  - (* ty_rec_intro *)
457	    intros G x T p IH Hac y E.
458	    apply trm_var_inj in E. subst y.
459	    apply ntr_bnd. apply (IH Hac x eq_refl).
460	  - (* ty_rec_elim *)
461	    intros G x T p IH Hac y E.
462	    apply trm_var_inj in E. subst y.
463	    pose proof (IH Hac x eq_refl) as Hntr.
464	    inversion Hntr; subst. assumption.

466	    intros G x T U p IH1 p2 IH2 Hac y E.
467	    apply trm_var_inj in E. subst y.
468	    apply ntr_and.
469	    + apply (IH1 Hac x eq_refl).
470	    + apply (IH2 Hac x eq_refl).
471	  - (* ty_sub *)
472	    intros G t T U p IH1 s IH2 Hac y E.
473	    apply (IH2 Hac y (IH1 Hac y E)).
474	  - (* ty_all_intro *) intros; exact I.
475	  - (* ty_con_intro *) intros; exact I.
476	  - (* subtyp_top *)
477	    intros G T Hac x Hntr. apply ntr_top.
478	  - (* subtyp_bot *)
479	    intros G T Hac x Hntr. inversion Hntr.
480	  - (* subtyp_refl *)
481	    intros G T Hac x Hntr. assumption.
482	  - (* subtyp_trans *)
483	    intros G S T U s IH1 s0 IH2 Hac x Hntr.
484	    apply (IH2 Hac x (IH1 Hac x Hntr)).
485	  - (* subtyp_and11 *)
486	    intros G T U Hac x Hntr. inversion Hntr; subst; assumption.
487	  - (* subtyp_and12 *)
488	    intros G T U Hac x Hntr. inversion Hntr; subst; assumption.
489	  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
490	    intros G S T U s IH1 s0 IH2 Hac x Hntr.
491	    apply ntr_and.
492	    + apply (IH1 Hac x Hntr).
493	    + apply (IH2 Hac x Hntr).
494	  - (* subtyp_fld *)
495	    intros G a0 T1 T2 U1 U2 s IH1 s0 IH2 Hac x Hntr.
496	    apply ntr_rcd_trm.
497	  - (* subtyp_typ *)
498	    intros G A S1 T1 S2 T2 s IH1 s0 IH2 Hac x Hntr.
499	    exfalso. inversion Hntr.

673	(* Status of the general inert statements and the precise remaining       *)
674	(* subgoal.                                                               *)
675	(*                                                                        *)
676	(* Under [inert G] the only missing ingredient is the following           *)
677	(* coherence property for type members of an inert [typ_bnd] binding.     *)
678	(*                                                                        *)
679	(*   TypeMemberCoherence:                                                 *)
680	(*     forall G x U A S1 T1 S2 T2,                                        *)
681	(*       inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U ->             *)
682	(*       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) ->            *)
683	(*       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2) ->            *)
684	(*       S1 <: T2.                                                        *)
685	(*                                                                        *)
686	(* Indeed [record_type] gives a unique equal bound [W] at the label [A]   *)
687	(* in [U]; after opening, any record typing of [x] at [dec_typ A S T]    *)
688	(* must be obtained by widening a flow tip of [open x U], which forces    *)
689	(* S <: W <: T.  Two typings therefore give S1 <: W <: T2.  This is       *)
690	(* exactly the type-member analogue of the two field lemmas we prove      *)
691	(* above, and it has the same proof shape (the [compat] preservation      *)
692	(* argument of [compat_closure], with [bracket] replaced by a             *)
693	(* type-label bracket and the [sel2]/[sel1] cases discharged by the       *)
694	(* typing induction instead of by vacuity).  The general inert versions   *)
695	(* of [field_cov_inert]/[field_contr_inert] then follow by the             *)
696	(* [compat] closure argument, defining [compat] on [typ_sel] types via    *)
697	(* the canonical member bound [W] of the variable's inert binding.        *)
698	(*                                                                        *)
699	(* The obstruction is genuinely a mutual induction: in                    *)
700	(* [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] the typing premise is not a subderivation  *)
701	(* of the subtyping tree, so the induction must be taken over             *)
702	(* [rules_mutind] (typing and subtyping simultaneously), with a typing    *)
703	(* motive producing [TypeMemberCoherence].  The [ty_sub] case of that     *)
704	(* motive needs the [compat] preservation above for a *type-label*        *)
705	(* bracket, and the [ty_rec_intro]/[ty_rec_elim] cases need the           *)
706	(* body/opening correspondence [typ_bnd W -> open x W].  The auxiliary    *)
707	(* negative result [bnd_companion_not_unique] (RootSub.v) shows that      *)
708	(* the body [W] cannot be recovered by uniqueness, which is why the       *)
709	(* motive has to be type-directed.                                        *)
710	(*                                                                        *)
711	(* The verified [bnd_ok_ctx] class above covers exactly the sub-case in   *)
712	(* which the bound body [U] has no [dec_typ] members, so that no         *)
713	(* selection typing of [x] can exist.  The remaining gap is [U] with      *)
714	(* equal-bounded [dec_typ] members: selections do exist there (for        *)
715	(* instance [x : open x U] gives a record typing at each member), and     *)
716	(* [TypeMemberCoherence] is what rules out the bad asymmetric            *)
717	(* counterexample in that case.                                           *)
718	(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

  Construct `HopenU : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x U`:

1	Require Import Base.
2	Require Import LibExtra.
3	Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
4	Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
5	Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
6	Unset Implicit Arguments.
7	
8	(* ====================================================================== *)
9	(* Supporting machinery: record-shaped (rc) types.                        *)
10	(*                                                                        *)
11	(* [rc] is the class of types built from top and record types by          *)
12	(* intersection.  These are exactly the types that can appear as the      *)
13	(* body of an inert [typ_bnd] binding.  The key property is that           *)
14	(* subtyping maps rc types to rc types, which excludes arbitrary          *)
15	(* selections, bottoms, and bound types from appearing in rc positions.   *)
16	(* ====================================================================== *)
17	
18	Inductive rc : typ -> Prop :=
19	| rc_top : rc typ_top
20	| rc_rcd : forall (D:dec), rc (typ_rcd D)
21	| rc_and : forall (T U:typ), rc T -> rc U -> rc (typ_and T U).
22	
23	Lemma rc_not_bnd : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (X:typ), T = typ_bnd X -> False.
24	Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros X E; discriminate E. Qed.
25	
26	Lemma rc_not_bot : forall (T:typ), rc T -> T = typ_bot -> False.
27	Proof. intros T H. induction H; intro E; discriminate E. Qed.
28	
29	Lemma rc_not_sel : forall (T:typ), rc T -> forall (a:avar) (A:typ_label),
30	  T = typ_sel a A -> False.
31	Proof. intros T H. induction H; intros a A E; discriminate E. Qed.
32	
33	Lemma record_typ_rc : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label),
34	  record_typ T ls -> rc T.
35	Proof.
36	  intros T ls H. induction H.
37	  - apply rc_rcd.
38	  - apply rc_and; [assumption|apply rc_rcd].
39	Qed.
40	
41	Lemma record_type_rc : forall (T:typ), record_type T -> rc T.
42	Proof. intros T [ls H]. exact (@record_typ_rc T ls H). Qed.
43	
44	(* Note: rc is *not* preserved by subtyping in general.  For instance an rc
45	   source can reach a selection type through [subtyp_sel2], and then an
46	   arbitrary type through [subtyp_sel1].  This is precisely why the
47	   analysis of the main lemma cannot be a one-line appeal to rc inversion;
48	   the sel rules must be handled through the typing premises they carry.
49	   The invariants that do hold for rc sources are the shape facts
50	   [rc_not_bot]/[rc_not_bnd]/[rc_not_sel] and the equal-bound structure
51	   [record_type_has_dec] below. *)
52	
53	(* ====================================================================== *)
54	(* The equal-bound structure of record types.                             *)
55	(*                                                                        *)
56	(* This is the structural fact that ultimately rules out the sel-chain    *)
57	(* counterexamples: every component of a record type is a [record_dec],   *)
58	(* i.e. its two bounds are syntactically equal.  Hence a variable bound    *)
59	(* to [typ_bnd U] with [record_type U] cannot simultaneously acquire two  *)
60	(* record typings of the same type label whose upper bounds differ        *)
61	(* (which is exactly what the [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] flow would      *)
62	(* require in order to manufacture a record supertype of [typ_top]).      *)
63	(* ====================================================================== *)
64	
65	Lemma record_typ_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
66	  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
67	Proof.
68	  intros T ls D Hrt. induction Hrt as
69	    [ D0 l Hdec Heq | T0 ls0 D0 l Hrt IH Hdec Heq Hnot ]; intros Hrh.
70	  - (* rt_one *) apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh. subst D. exact Hdec.
71	  - (* rt_cons: T = typ_and T0 (typ_rcd D0) *)
72	    apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh. destruct Hrh as [Hl|Hr].
73	    + (* component in T0 *) eapply IH. exact Hl.
74	    + (* component is the right record *) apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hr.
75	      subst D. exact Hdec.
76	Qed.
77	
78	Lemma record_type_has_dec : forall (T:typ) (D:dec),
79	  record_type T -> record_has T D -> record_dec D.
80	Proof.
81	  intros T D [ls Hrt] Hrh. eapply (@record_typ_has_dec T ls D); eassumption.
82	Qed.
83	
84	(* If a record type has a member with label [a], the corresponding dec has
85	   equal bounds.  Used below in the discussion of the sel-chain. *)
86	Lemma record_type_has_equal_bounds : forall (T:typ) (a:trm_label) (S U:typ),
87	  record_type T -> record_has T (dec_trm a S U) -> S = U.
88	Proof.
89	  intros T a S U Hrt Hrh.
90	  pose proof (@record_type_has_dec T (dec_trm a S U) Hrt Hrh) as Hdec.
91	  inversion Hdec; subst. reflexivity.
92	Qed.
93	
94	(* ====================================================================== *)
95	(* The companion fact suggested as a possible helper is FALSE.            *)
96	(*                                                                        *)

107	(* [typ_bnd U] (by [ty_var]) and at [typ_bnd T] (open [x] at [U], widen   *)

113	Lemma bnd_companion_not_unique : forall (A:typ_label) (x:var),
114	  exists (G:ctx) (U T:typ),
115	    inert G /\ binds x (typ_bnd U) G /\ record_type U /\
116	    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T /\ T <> U.
117	Proof.
118	  intros A x.
119	  pose (U := typ_rcd (dec_typ A typ_top typ_top)).
120	  pose (T := typ_rcd (dec_typ A typ_bot typ_top)).
121	  assert (HrtU : record_type U).
122	  { subst U. exists (\{label_of (dec_typ A typ_top typ_top)}). apply rt_one.
123	    - apply rd_typ.
124	    - reflexivity. }
125	  assert (Hx : x # (empty:ctx)).
126	  { rewrite (@dom_empty typ). apply notin_empty. }
127	  pose (G := empty & x ~ typ_bnd U).
128	  assert (Hbnd : binds x (typ_bnd U) G).
129	  { subst G. apply binds_push_eq. }
130	  assert (Hinert : inert G).
131	  { subst G. eapply inert_all.
132	    - apply inert_empty.
133	    - apply inert_typ_bnd. exact HrtU.
134	    - exact Hx. }
135	  assert (HopenU : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x U).
136	  { apply ty_rec_elim. apply ty_var. exact Hbnd. }
137	  assert (Hsub : G ⊢ open x U <: open x T).
138	  { subst U T. cbn. eapply subtyp_typ.
139	    - apply subtyp_bot.
140	    - apply subtyp_refl. }
141	  assert (HopenT : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x T).
142	  { eapply ty_sub; [exact HopenU|exact Hsub]. }
143	  assert (HbndT : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd T).
144	  { eapply ty_rec_intro. exact HopenT. }
145	  exists G, U, T. repeat split; try assumption.
146	  (* T <> U *)
147	  subst U T. intro Heq. inversion Heq.
148	Qed.

150	(* The exact target formula, recorded but deliberately NOT asserted as a
151	   lemma: it is not proved in this file.  See the explanation below. *)
152	Definition ty_var_record_sub_statement : Prop :=
153	  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),
154	    inert G ->
155	    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
156	    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->
157	    G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.

159	(* ====================================================================== *)
160	(* Status of the main statement [ty_var_record_sub].                      *)
161	(*                                                                        *)
162	(* The statement is TRUE, but the proof is not a short structural         *)
163	(* inversion.  Below is a precise account of what is needed and why the   *)
164	(* obvious routes fail.                                                    *)
165	(*                                                                        *)
166	(* 1. Why inertness is essential.                                          *)
167	(*    Without inertness the statement is false.  Take                        *)
168	(*        G = empty & x ~ typ_bot                                          *)
169	(*    (or more generally a non-record, non-inert binding).  Then            *)
170	(*    [x : typ_bot] by [ty_var], and [typ_bot <: typ_rcd D] by             *)
171	(*    [subtyp_bot], so [x : typ_rcd D] is derivable, while [open x U]      *)
172	(*    (for [U] not a subtype of [typ_rcd D]) need not be.  Inertness       *)
173	(*    rules this out because [inert_typ] admits only [typ_all],            *)
174	(*    [typ_con], and [typ_bnd] of a record type, and only record types of  *)
175	(*    the latter kind can flow to a record.  (With an inert-but-not-record *)
176	(*    binding [x ~ typ_and (typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_bnd V) (typ_bnd V)))   *)
177	(*    (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S (typ_rcd D)))] one also gets a counterexample: *)
178	(*    the two components, via [and11]/[and12] and [subtyp_sel2]/           *)
179	(*    [subtyp_sel1], witness [typ_bnd V <: typ_rcd D].  A [record_type]    *)
180	(*    forbids two members with the same label, which is precisely the      *)
181	(*    gap closed by inertness.)                                            *)
182	(*                                                                        *)
183	(* 2. The typing induction and the "Real" motive.                          *)
184	(*    Induct on the typing derivation [G ⊢ x ∶ T] and prove, for the       *)
185	(*    fixed binding [binds x (typ_bnd U) G] with [record_type U],          *)
186	(*        Real(T) := forall R, rc R -> G ⊢ T <: R -> G ⊢ open x U <: R.   *)
187	(*    The main conclusion is [Real (typ_rcd D)] at R = typ_rcd D via       *)
188	(*    [subtyp_refl] (and [rc_rcd]).  The [ty_sub] case is handled by       *)
189	(*    transitivity of subtyping: from [T0 <: T] and [T <: R] get           *)
190	(*    [T0 <: R] and apply the induction hypothesis [Real(T0)].             *)
191	(*    The [ty_and_intro] case needs a decomposition: from                  *)
192	(*    [typ_and T1 T2 <: R] with [rc R], derive [T1 <: R] or [T2 <: R] and  *)
193	(*    apply the IH; this is the "and-target split".  The variable base     *)
194	(*    cases need the bnd/rc separation described next.                    *)
195	(*                                                                        *)
196	(* 3. The remaining obstruction: bnd/rc separation.                        *)
197	(*    For the [ty_var] and [ty_rec_intro] cases one has to show, for all   *)
198	(*    [W] and all [rc R], that [G ⊢ typ_bnd W <: R] yields                 *)
199	(*    [G ⊢ open x W <: R].  This is true, but it cannot be proved by a     *)
200	(*    direct induction on the subtyping derivation: the [subtyp_trans]     *)
201	(*    case passes through an intermediate [S] with no known shape, and    *)
202	(*    the [subtyp_sel2]/[subtyp_sel1] rules go through record typings of  *)
203	(*    auxiliary variables [z].  The auxiliary record typing is itself a    *)
204	(*    subderivation of the subtyping premise and hence of the whole        *)
205	(*    typing derivation, so a mutual induction over [ty_trm] and           *)
206	(*    [subtyp] (using [rules_mutind]) is the correct vehicle: the sel      *)
207	(*    premises are then handled by the typing induction hypothesis, and    *)
208	(*    the only genuinely circular-looking sel chains are broken by the      *)
209	(*    equal-bound fact [record_type_has_equal_bounds] above.  The exact    *)
210	(*    mutual statement must moreover track the [typ_bnd] body / iterated   *)
211	(*    opening correspondence (a type-directed motive which maps            *)
212	(*    [typ_bnd W] to [Real (open x W)]), because [ty_rec_elim]'s premise   *)
213	(*    has type [typ_bnd W] whereas its conclusion is [open x W].           *)
214	(*                                                                        *)
215	(*    The plausible shortcut that every typing [x : typ_rcd D] is a       *)
216	(*    supertype of a [precise_flow] tip of the binding is FALSE in         *)
217	(*    general:                                                             *)
218	(*    [ty_rec_intro] can produce [x : typ_bnd W] which is not below any    *)
219	(*    flow tip (flow tips of [typ_bnd U] live inside [open x U] and its    *)
220	(*    components and cannot be below a [typ_bnd]).  It is only for         *)
221	(*    *record-like* conclusions that a flow-based argument can work, and   *)
222	(*    that restriction is exactly what the mutual induction above encodes. *)
223	(*                                                                        *)
224	(* 4. Why the statement is nevertheless true.                              *)
225	(*    A counterexample would require an inert context [G] with            *)
226	(*    [binds x (typ_bnd U) G], [record_type U], and a derivation of        *)
227	(*    [G ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd D] with [G ⊢ open x U ≮ typ_rcd D].  Since          *)
228	(*    [x ∶ typ_rcd D] cannot be obtained by [ty_var] (the binding is a     *)
229	(*    [typ_bnd]) or by [ty_and_intro] (whose conclusion is an              *)
230	(*    intersection), the only possible sources are recursive elimination   *)
231	(*    [ty_rec_elim] and widening [ty_sub].  Recursive elimination can      *)
232	(*    only open the binding's record structure, and widening to a record   *)
233	(*    target must respect the equal bounds of the record components        *)
234	(*    ([record_type_has_dec]).  Any detour through [subtyp_sel2]/          *)
235	(*    [subtyp_sel1] requires two record typings of one variable at the     *)
236	(*    same label with incompatible upper bounds; record types cannot       *)
237	(*    supply this, and inertness guarantees the variable's binding is a    *)
238	(*    record type.  Detours through [typ_bot] would require an [x]-type    *)
239	(*    below [typ_bot]); no such type is reachable from a record-typed      *)
240	(*    binding without a same-label sel detour, and the equal-bound        *)
241	(*    structure of record types rules that detour out.  Thus no            *)
242	(*    counterexample exists.                                               *)
243	(*                                                                        *)
244	(* In summary: the lemma is provable in principle, but a fully checked     *)
245	(* proof requires the mutual [rules_mutind] induction of item 3 with the   *)
246	(* type-directed body/opening invariant; the straightforward inversion     *)
247	(* and the flow-tip shortcut both fail for exactly the reasons above.      *)
248	(* No [Admitted]/[Axiom] is used in this file.                             *)
249	(* ====================================================================== *)

252	Check ty_var_record_sub_statement.
253	Check record_type_has_dec.
254	Check bnd_companion_not_unique.

28	(* Under inertness a [typ_bnd] binding carries a record type.  (This is
29	   the fact recorded in the task statement; it follows from inversion of

32	  inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U.

96	Lemma real_from_rcd : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T:typ),
97	  inert G ->
98	  binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
99	  record_type U ->
100	  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
101	  forall (R:typ), rc R -> G ⊢ T <: R -> G ⊢ open x U <: R.
102	Proof.
103	  intros G x U T Hi Hb Hrt Hty R HR.
104	  induction HR as [| D | R1 R2 HR1 IH1 HR2 IH2]; intros Hsub.
105	  - (* rc_top *) apply subtyp_top.
106	  - (* rc_rcd *) eapply Hrcd; eassumption.
107	  - (* rc_and *) apply subtyp_and2.
108	    + apply IH1. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub | apply subtyp_and11].
109	    + apply IH2. eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub | apply subtyp_and12].
110	Qed.

121	  G ⊢ open x U <: R.

128	Lemma ty_var_record_sub_of_rcd : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),

    { apply ty_rec_elim. apply ty_var. exact Hb. }
    split.
    + intros D Hsub. exact (H3 U D HopenU Hsub).
    + intros W Hsub. exact (H4 U W HopenU Hsub).
  - (* ty_rec_intro *)
    intros G x T Hprem IH x0 U Hi Hb Hrt Heq.
    injection Heq as Hx. subst x0.
    destruct (HPure G x U Hi Hb Hrt) as [H3 [H4 [H5 [H6 H7]]]].
    destruct (IH x U Hi Hb Hrt eq_refl) as [IHm IHo].
    split.
    + intros D Hsub. apply IHm with D. exact (H3 T D Hprem Hsub).
    + intros W' Hsub. apply IHo with W'. exact (H4 T W' Hprem Hsub).
  - (* ty_rec_elim *)
    intros G x T Hprem IH x0 U Hi Hb Hrt Heq.
    injection Heq as Hx. subst x0.
    destruct (HPure G x U Hi Hb Hrt) as [H3 [H4 [H5 [H6 H7]]]].
    destruct (IH x U Hi Hb Hrt eq_refl) as [IHm IHo].
    split.
    + intros D Hsub.
      pose proof (IHo T (subtyp_refl G (typ_bnd T))) as Hopen.

Require Import Base.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence OperationalSemantics Effects Initialization InitTyping InitLookup ConfigTyping.
Require Import CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts InitWeakening EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems PreciseTyping HeapUpdate.
Require Import RootSub Real.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* rcd_case_statement: reduction to an explicit canonical-forms bundle.   *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* We isolate the typing/subtyping induction performed in [typing_...].   *)
(* The induction itself is fully proved here; what remains is the bundle  *)
(* [Pure] below, whose five components are the genuine canonical-forms    *)
(* facts about inert [typ_bnd] bindings.  The five components are         *)
(* recorded separately at the end of the file.  No axioms, Admitted,      *)
(* admit or Abort occur in this file.                                     *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

(* The two type-directed conclusions of the typing induction. *)
Definition MainProp (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall D, G ⊢ T <: typ_rcd D -> G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.

Definition OpenProp (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall W, G ⊢ T <: typ_bnd W -> G ⊢ open x U <: open x W.

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The isolated canonical-forms bundle.                                    *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* All items are parameterized by an inert context [G] and a [typ_bnd]    *)
(* binding [x ~ typ_bnd U] with [record_type U].                          *)
(*                                                                        *)
(*   (1) bnd/rcd separation with the opening of the source typed:         *)
(*       [x : open W] and [typ_bnd W <: typ_rcd D] force                 *)
(*       [open W <: typ_rcd D].                                          *)
(*   (2) bnd/bnd body monotonicity:                                       *)
(*       [x : open W] and [typ_bnd W <: typ_bnd W'] force                *)
(*       [open W <: typ_bnd W'].                                         *)
(*   (3) open/bnd transfer:                                               *)
(*       [x : typ_bnd W] and [open W <: typ_bnd W'] force                *)
(*       [open U <: open W'].                                            *)
(*   (4) and/rcd splitting.                                               *)
(*   (5) and/bnd splitting.                                               *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* These are the exact leaves of the mutual typing/subtyping induction.   *)
(* The sel2/sel1 detours live inside them: in an inert context the        *)
(* auxiliary variable's binding body is a record type, so its stored      *)
(* type-member bounds are equal and the detour reduces to the same stored *)
(* bound.  Proving the bundle unconditionally is the remaining task.      *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Definition Pure : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ),
    inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U ->
    (* (1) bnd source / record target, opened and typed *)
    (forall (W:typ) (D:dec),
       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x W ->
       G ⊢ typ_bnd W <: typ_rcd D ->
       G ⊢ open x W <: typ_rcd D)
    /\
    (* (2) bnd source / bnd target, opened and typed *)
    (forall (W W':typ),
       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x W ->
       G ⊢ typ_bnd W <: typ_bnd W' ->
       G ⊢ open x W <: typ_bnd W')
    /\
    (* (3) open source / bnd target, from a bnd typing *)
    (forall (W W':typ),
       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd W ->
       G ⊢ open x W <: typ_bnd W' ->
       G ⊢ open x U <: open x W')
    /\
    (* (4) and / record splitting *)
    (forall (T1 T2:typ) (D:dec),
       G ⊢ typ_and T1 T2 <: typ_rcd D ->
       G ⊢ T1 <: typ_rcd D \/ G ⊢ T2 <: typ_rcd D)
    /\
    (* (5) and / bnd splitting *)
    (forall (T1 T2:typ) (W:typ),
       G ⊢ typ_and T1 T2 <: typ_bnd W ->
       G ⊢ T1 <: typ_bnd W \/ G ⊢ T2 <: typ_bnd W).

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* The typing induction.                                                   *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* Proved by [rules_mutind] over the mutual typing/subtyping derivations. *)
(* The subtyping, literal and avar motives are [True]: all subtyping facts *)
(* we need are supplied by [Pure].  The typing motive is vacuous on every *)
(* term except a variable.  The five variable-producing rules are the     *)
(* only non-vacuous cases: [ty_var], [ty_rec_intro], [ty_rec_elim],       *)
(* [ty_and_intro] and [ty_sub].                                           *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Lemma typing_main_open_of_pure : Pure ->
  forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    forall (x:var) (U:typ),
      inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U ->
      t = trm_var (avar_f x) ->
      MainProp G x U T /\ OpenProp G x U T.
Proof.
  intros HPure.
  apply (rules_mutind
    (fun (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ t ∶ T) =>
       forall (x:var) (U:typ),
         inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U ->
         t = trm_var (avar_f x) ->
         MainProp G x U T /\ OpenProp G x U T)
    (fun (G:ctx) (l:lit) (T:typ) (_:G ⊢ l ∶ T) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (_:G ⊢ S <: U) => True)
    (fun (G:ctx) (avs:avars) (Ts:typs) (_:G ⊢ avs :: Ts) => True)).
  all: try (intros; exact I).
  all: try (intros; discriminate).
  - (* ty_var *)
    intros G x T b x0 U Hi Hb Hrt Heq.
    injection Heq as Hx. subst x0.
    assert (HT : T = typ_bnd U) by (eapply binds_functional; eassumption).
    subst T.
    destruct (HPure G x U Hi Hb Hrt) as [H3 [H4 [H5 [H6 H7]]]].
    assert (HopenU : G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x U).
    { apply ty_rec_elim. apply ty_var. exact Hb. }
    split.
    + intros D Hsub. exact (H3 U D HopenU Hsub).
    + intros W Hsub.
      pose proof (H4 U W HopenU Hsub) as Hob.
      exact (H5 U W (ty_var Hb) Hob).
  - (* ty_rec_intro: the premise is x : open x T, the conclusion x : typ_bnd T *)
    intros G x T Hprem IH x0 U Hi Hb Hrt Heq.
    injection Heq as Hx. subst x0.
    destruct (HPure G x U Hi Hb Hrt) as [H3 [H4 [H5 [H6 H7]]]].
    destruct (IH x U Hi Hb Hrt eq_refl) as [IHm IHo].
    split.
    + intros D Hsub. apply (IHm D). exact (H3 T D Hprem Hsub).
    + intros W' Hsub. apply (IHo W'). exact (H4 T W' Hprem Hsub).
  - (* ty_rec_elim: the premise is x : typ_bnd T, the conclusion x : open x T *)
    intros G x T Hprem IH x0 U Hi Hb Hrt Heq.
    injection Heq as Hx. subst x0.
    destruct (HPure G x U Hi Hb Hrt) as [H3 [H4 [H5 [H6 H7]]]].
    destruct (IH x U Hi Hb Hrt eq_refl) as [IHm IHo].
    split.
    + intros D Hsub.
      assert (Hrefl : G ⊢ typ_bnd T <: typ_bnd T) by apply subtyp_refl.
      pose proof (IHo T Hrefl) as Hopen.
      eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
    + intros W' Hsub. exact (H5 T W' Hprem Hsub).
  - (* ty_and_intro *)
    intros G x T U Hprem1 IH1 Hprem2 IH2 x0 U0 Hi Hb Hrt Heq.
    injection Heq as Hx. subst x0.
    destruct (HPure G x U0 Hi Hb Hrt) as [H3 [H4 [H5 [H6 H7]]]].
    destruct (IH1 x U0 Hi Hb Hrt eq_refl) as [IH1m IH1o].
    destruct (IH2 x U0 Hi Hb Hrt eq_refl) as [IH2m IH2o].
    split.
    + intros D Hsub.
      destruct (H6 T U D Hsub) as [Hleft|Hright].
      * apply (IH1m D). exact Hleft.
      * apply (IH2m D). exact Hright.
    + intros W' Hsub.
      destruct (H7 T U W' Hsub) as [Hleft|Hright].
      * apply (IH1o W'). exact Hleft.
      * apply (IH2o W'). exact Hright.
  - (* ty_sub *)
    intros G t T U Hprem IH HsubT Htrue x0 U0 Hi Hb Hrt Heq.
    destruct (IH x0 U0 Hi Hb Hrt Heq) as [IHm IHo].
    split.
    + intros D Hsub. apply (IHm D).
      eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
    + intros W' Hsub. apply (IHo W').
      eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
Qed.

(* The requested statement follows from the typing induction. *)
Lemma rcd_case_of_pure : Pure ->
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T:typ) (D:dec),
    inert G ->
    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
    record_type U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
    G ⊢ T <: typ_rcd D ->
    G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.
Proof.
  intros HPure G x U T D Hi Hb Hrt Hty Hsub.
  destruct (@typing_main_open_of_pure HPure G (trm_var (avar_f x)) T Hty
              x U Hi Hb Hrt eq_refl) as [Hmain Hopen].
  exact (Hmain D Hsub).
Qed.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* The target statement, exactly as requested.                            *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* It is stated as a Definition (not an asserted lemma) because the       *)
(* remaining [Pure] bundle is not proved in this file.  The implication   *)
(* [rcd_case_statement_of_Pure] below is fully checked.                   *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Definition rcd_case_statement : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T:typ) (D:dec),
    inert G ->
    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
    record_type U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
    G ⊢ T <: typ_rcd D ->
    G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.

Lemma rcd_case_statement_of_Pure : Pure -> rcd_case_statement.
Proof. intros HPure. exact (@rcd_case_of_pure HPure). Qed.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* Unconditional reductions around the target.                            *)
(*                                                                        *)
(* (a) The general statement is equivalent to its direct record-instance. *)
(* (b) Real.v's [rc] formulation is equivalent to it (via [Real]).        *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Lemma rcd_case_direct : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ) (D:dec),
    inert G ->
    binds x (typ_bnd U) G ->
    record_type U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd D ->
    G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.

Lemma rcd_case_statement_to_direct : rcd_case_statement -> rcd_case_direct.
Proof.
  intros Hrcd G x U D Hi Hb Hrt Hty.
  eapply Hrcd; [exact Hi|exact Hb|exact Hrt|exact Hty|apply subtyp_refl].
Qed.

Lemma rcd_case_direct_to_statement : rcd_case_direct -> rcd_case_statement.
Proof.
  intros Hdir G x U T D Hi Hb Hrt Hty Hsub.
  eapply Hdir; [exact Hi|exact Hb|exact Hrt| |].
  - eapply ty_sub; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma rcd_case_statement_iff_direct :
  rcd_case_statement <-> rcd_case_direct.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply rcd_case_statement_to_direct.
  - apply rcd_case_direct_to_statement.
Qed.

(* The bundle's five components, recorded separately for the record. *)
Definition pure_bnd_rcd_component : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U W:typ) (D:dec),
    inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x W ->
    G ⊢ typ_bnd W <: typ_rcd D ->
    G ⊢ open x W <: typ_rcd D.

Definition pure_bnd_bnd_component : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U W W':typ),
    inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x W ->
    G ⊢ typ_bnd W <: typ_bnd W' ->
    G ⊢ open x W <: typ_bnd W'.

Definition pure_open_bnd_component : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U W W':typ),
    inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U ->
    G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd W ->
    G ⊢ open x W <: typ_bnd W' ->
    G ⊢ open x U <: open x W'.

Definition pure_and_rcd_component : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (T1 T2:typ) (D:dec),
    inert G -> G ⊢ typ_and T1 T2 <: typ_rcd D ->
    G ⊢ T1 <: typ_rcd D \/ G ⊢ T2 <: typ_rcd D.

Definition pure_and_bnd_component : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (T1 T2 W:typ),
    inert G -> G ⊢ typ_and T1 T2 <: typ_bnd W ->
    G ⊢ T1 <: typ_bnd W \/ G ⊢ T2 <: typ_bnd W.

Check rcd_case_statement.
Check typing_main_open_of_pure.
Check rcd_case_of_pure.
Check rcd_case_statement_of_Pure.
Check rcd_case_statement_iff_direct.
Check pure_bnd_rcd_component.
Check pure_bnd_bnd_component.
Check pure_open_bnd_component.
Check pure_and_rcd_component.
Check pure_and_bnd_component.
EOF

225	(* work: the [sel1] rule jumps from a vacuous bracket at a selection to   *)
226	(* a target where the [nobot] component fails.  The continuation lemma    *)

402	Lemma bracket_cont :
403	  sel_bracket_aux ->
404	  record_no_bot ->
405	  forall (G:ctx) (V:typ) (a:trm_label) (Tf:typ) (X T:typ),
406	    inert G ->
407	    record_type V ->
408	    record_has V (dec_trm a Tf Tf) ->
409	    G ⊢ V <: X ->
410	    bracket G a Tf Tf X ->
411	    G ⊢ X <: T ->
412	    bracket G a Tf Tf T.
413	Proof.
414	  intros Hsel Hbot G V a Tf X T Hi Hrt Hrh Hpre Hb Hsub.
415	  revert V a Tf Hi Hrt Hrh Hpre Hb.
416	  induction Hsub using subtyp_ind; intros V aa Tf Hi Hrt Hrh Hpre Hb.
417	  - (* subtyp_top *) intros Sl Su Hrh2. inversion Hrh2.
418	  - (* subtyp_bot *) exfalso. eapply Hbot; eassumption.
419	  - (* subtyp_refl *) exact Hb.
420	  - (* subtyp_trans *)
421	    eapply IHHsub0.
422	    + exact Hi.
423	    + exact Hrt.
424	    + exact Hrh.
425	    + eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hpre|exact H].
426	    + eapply IHHsub; [exact Hi|exact Hrt|exact Hrh|exact Hpre|exact Hb].
427	  - (* subtyp_and11 *) intros Sl Su Hrh2. apply Hb with (Sl:=Sl) (Su:=Su).
428	    apply rh_andl. exact Hrh2.
429	  - (* subtyp_and12 *) intros Sl Su Hrh2. apply Hb with (Sl:=Sl) (Su:=Su).
430	    apply rh_andr. exact Hrh2.
431	  - (* subtyp_and2 *)
432	    assert (Hb1 : bracket G aa Tf Tf T)
433	      by (eapply IHHsub; [exact Hi|exact Hrt|exact Hrh|exact Hpre|exact Hb]).
434	    assert (Hb2 : bracket G aa Tf Tf U)
435	      by (eapply IHHsub0; [exact Hi|exact Hrt|exact Hrh|exact Hpre|exact Hb]).
436	    intros Sl Su Hrh2. apply record_has_and_inv in Hrh2.
437	    destruct Hrh2 as [Hrh2|Hrh2].
438	    + apply Hb1. exact Hrh2.
439	    + apply Hb2. exact Hrh2.
440	  - (* subtyp_fld *)
441	    intros Sl Su Hrh2. apply record_has_rcd_inv in Hrh2.
442	    inversion Hrh2; subst.
443	    pose proof (proj1 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hlow.
444	    pose proof (proj2 (Hb T2 U1 (rh_one _))) as Hup.
445	    split.
446	    + eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
447	    + eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.

(* stated as                                                        *)

(* The five components of [Pure2] are recorded at the end.  No Admitted,  *)
(* admit, Abort, Axiom, Parameter or Conjecture is used.                  *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Definition MainProp2 (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall D, G ⊢ T <: typ_rcd D -> G ⊢ open x U <: typ_rcd D.

Definition OpenProp2 (G:ctx) (x:var) (U T:typ) : Prop :=

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The corrected canonical-forms bundle.                                  *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Definition Pure2 : Prop :=
  forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (U:typ),
    inert G -> binds x (typ_bnd U) G -> record_type U ->
    (* (1) bnd source / record target, opened and typed *)

       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x W ->
       G ⊢ typ_bnd W <: typ_rcd D ->
       G ⊢ open x W <: typ_rcd D)
    /\

    (forall (W W':typ),
       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ open x W ->
       G ⊢ typ_bnd W <: typ_bnd W' ->
       G ⊢ open x U <: open x W')
    /\
    (* (3) open source / bnd target, from a bnd typing *)
    (forall (W W':typ),
       G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_bnd W ->
       G ⊢ open x W <: typ_bnd W' ->
       G ⊢ open x U <: open x W')

       G ⊢ T1 <: typ_rcd D \/ G ⊢ T2 <: typ_rcd D)
    /\
    (* (5) and / bnd splitting *)
    (forall (T1 T2:typ) (W:typ),

(* The typing induction for the corrected bundle.                          *)

## Result

Created `/mnt/claude-home/scratch/PureProof.v` (330 lines, 13 `Qed`). Compiles with the standard command (exit 0); no `Admitted`/`admit`/`Abort`/`Axiom`/`Parameter`/`Conjecture`/`Hypothesis`. `RcdCase.v` was not overwritten.

## Key finding: one `Pure` component was mis-stated

`RcdCase.Pure` component 2 was

```
x : open x W  ->  typ_bnd W <: typ_bnd W'  ->  open x W <: typ_bnd W'
```

This is not the invariant the typing induction needs (at `W' = W` it asks for a record type to be below a `typ_bnd`). The correct/open-to-open form is the earlier `bnd_bnd_opening` statement:

```
x : open x W  ->  typ_bnd W <: typ_bnd W'  ->  open x U <: open x W'
```

`PureProof.v` therefore defines a corrected bundle `Pure2` and redoes the whole typing induction against it.

## Fully proved in `PureProof.v`

- `typing_main_open_of_pure2 : Pure2 -> forall t T, G ⊢ t ∶ T -> ... MainProp2 /\ OpenProp2` (full `rules_mutind` proof, same five var-producing rules).
- `rcd_case_of_pure2`, `rcd_case_statement_of_Pure2 : Pure2 -> rcd_case_statement`.
- `record_type_open` (opening preserves `record_type`, proved from scratch).
- `typ_member_shape_of_Pure2_and_bracket : Pure2 -> type_member_bracket_component -> typ_member_shape_statement`.
- `typ_member_shape_statement_iff_FieldInertRel` and `record_no_bot_statement_iff_FieldInertRel` (no assertion of the residuals).
- Equivalences showing corrected components 3/4/5 are literally `RcdCase.pure_open_bnd_component` / `pure_and_rcd_component` / `pure_and_bnd_component`.

## Exact remaining subgoals

The five components of `Pure2` (`pure2_bnd_rcd_component`, `pure2_bnd_bnd_component`, `pure2_open_bnd_component`, `pure2_and_rcd_component`, `pure2_and_bnd_component`). For inert `G`, `binds x (typ_bnd U) G`, `record_type U`:

1. `x : open x W` and `typ_bnd W <: typ_rcd D` imply `open x W <: typ_rcd D`.
2. `x : open x W` and `typ_bnd W <: typ_bnd W'` imply `open x U <: open x W'`.
3. `x : typ_bnd W` and `open x W <: typ_bnd W'` imply `open x U <: open x W'`.
4. `typ_and T1 T2 <: typ_rcd D` implies `T1 <: typ_rcd D \/ T2 <: typ_rcd D`.
5. `typ_and T1 T2 <: typ_bnd W` implies `T1 <: typ_bnd W \/ T2 <: typ_bnd W`.

Plus `type_member_bracket_component` (the type-label analogue of `FieldInertRel`'s bracket residual), which with `Pure2` yields exactly `typ_member_shape_statement`.

These five remain the same equal-bound/`sel2`-`sel1`-coherence obstruction; `FieldInertRel.bracket_cont` covers the term-label field inversion but its `sel1` step uses the still-unproved `sel_bracket_aux`, and no analogous step discharges these record/bnd-target components. `Print Assumptions` on the new lemmas shows only the pre-existing environment axioms.

175	    record_type U ->
